jobs.description:
Location: South Africa (Remote)

Salary: R450 000 - R650 000 per annum

About Cognisys

Cognisys is a cybersecurity consultancy helping organisations strengthen their security posture through Penetration Testing, GRC Consulting and Managed Security services. We are a small but mighty team working with clients across more than 30 countries, delivering practical security solutions that make a measurable difference.

The Opportunity

As an Information Security Auditor, you will assess and evaluate the effectiveness of information security controls across a range of clients and industries. You'll work with client stakeholders to review security practices, gather and analyse evidence, identify control weaknesses and assess alignment with recognised security frameworks and standards.

This role is suited to someone with a solid understanding of information security, risk and compliance, who enjoys investigating how security controls operate in practice, identifying areas of risk and producing clear, evidence-based audit findings. You'll work alongside experienced security professionals while developing your technical audit and assessment capabilities.

What You'll Be Doing

Audit Delivery & Assessment

  • Conduct information security audits, control assessments and compliance reviews across a range of clients and industries.

  • Assess the design, implementation and operating effectiveness of information security controls.

  • Review client environments, processes and supporting documentation to evaluate security practices.

  • Gather, examine and validate evidence to support audit findings and conclusions.

  • Identify control deficiencies, non-conformities and potential security risks.

  • Assess client alignment with frameworks and standards such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST and related requirements.

  • Support internal and external audit activities, including certification and assurance assessments.

Technical & Risk Evaluation

  • Evaluate technical and organisational security controls, including access management, asset management, vulnerability management, incident response and business continuity.

  • Review policies, procedures, risk registers and other governance documentation.

  • Assess whether security controls are appropriately implemented and operating as intended.

  • Analyse identified weaknesses and determine their potential impact on the organisation's security posture.

  • Develop clear, evidence-based audit findings and practical recommendations.

  • Follow up on remediation activities and assess whether identified issues have been appropriately addressed.

Quality & Professional Standards

  • Produce accurate, objective and high-quality audit reports and supporting documentation.

  • Maintain clear audit trails and appropriate evidence records.

  • Follow established audit methodologies, procedures and internal quality standards.

  • Manage assigned audit activities, priorities and deadlines effectively.

  • Maintain independence, professional judgement and attention to detail throughout the audit process.

  • Stay informed about emerging cybersecurity risks, threats, controls and industry practices.

About You

You're naturally curious, analytical and detail-oriented, with a genuine interest in understanding how organisations manage and protect their information security environments. You enjoy investigating how controls work in practice, asking the right questions and identifying gaps that others might overlook.

You're comfortable working with different stakeholders, gathering evidence and challenging findings constructively. You take pride in producing accurate, objective work and can communicate technical risks and audit findings in a clear, practical way.

You're also someone who takes ownership, enjoys learning and developing your technical expertise, and understands the importance of balancing thoroughness with practical business considerations.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • 2–5 years' experience in information security, IT auditing, cybersecurity, risk or compliance-related roles.

  • Practical knowledge of at least one recognised framework or standard, such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST or similar.

  • Experience assessing security controls, reviewing evidence or supporting audit and assurance activities.

  • Understanding of information security principles, technical controls and risk management.

  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to investigate issues, identify weaknesses and draw evidence-based conclusions.

  • Excellent written communication skills, particularly when documenting findings and preparing reports.

  • Confidence engaging with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple audit activities and deadlines.

Desirable Skills & Experience

  • Previous experience conducting IT, information security or cybersecurity audits.

  • Exposure to external audits, certification assessments or independent assurance engagements.

  • Experience with GRC platforms such as Vanta.

  • Familiarity with technical security domains such as identity and access management, network security, vulnerability management and incident response.

Certifications

Relevant certifications are advantageous but not essential. These may include:

  • ISO 27001 Lead Auditor.

  • Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA).

  • Certified Information Security Manager (CISM).

  • CompTIA Security+.

  • Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC).

  • Other relevant information security or auditing qualifications.

What Success Looks Like

  • Conducting thorough and structured information security audits and assessments.

  • Evaluating the design and effectiveness of security controls against recognised frameworks and standards.

  • Identifying control gaps, weaknesses and areas of potential risk.

  • Gathering, reviewing and validating audit evidence to support findings and conclusions.

  • Producing accurate, well-structured audit reports with clear findings and recommendations.

  • Communicating audit outcomes effectively to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Managing audit activities, documentation and deadlines while maintaining quality and consistency.

Why Join Us?

At Cognisys, you will be part of a collaborative and innovative team that values your input and shares support. You'll have the opportunity to work on challenging projects that make a real impact for our clients. We'd love to hear from you if you want to challenge, lead and innovate! We're not just about the work; we're about the people. Join a team where innovation is celebrated, and your contributions are valued. We foster a collaborative environment where fresh ideas thrive, and professional growth is encouraged.

What we Offer:

  • Annual Leave: 25 days per year plus 12 South African public holidays.

  • Additional Leave: 1 day of paid leave for your Birthday.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Individual healthcare insurance plan and access to an employee mental health and wellbeing platform.

  • Professional Development: £2,000 annual training budget to support your continued learning and career growth.

  • Referral Bonus: help to grow our team and earn up to £2,000 per successful referral.

Applications

We’re always happy to help with questions, but to keep our process fair for everyone, we’re unable to accept applications via email—please apply directly through the job advert page.

Please feel free to reach out to Andrea, our Talent Acquisition Lead, if you would like any further information, to discuss accessibility requirements, or if you require this information provided in an alternative format –

We welcome applications from candidates from a range of diverse backgrounds and can make various reasonable adjustments to consider individual needs.

jobs.excerpt: Position SummaryThe Senior Accountant is responsible for overseeing and executing all aspects of full-cycle accounting—including accounts receivable, accounts payable, general ledger maintenance, and month-end close.
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Senior Accountant is responsible for overseeing and executing all aspects of full-cycle accounting—including accounts receivable, accounts payable, general ledger maintenance, and month-end close. This role ensures timely and accurate financial reporting, maintains compliance with accounting standards, and supports management with financial insights to drive decision-making. This is a hands-on role that requires both transactional efficiency and strong analytical skills. The ideal candidate will be detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable working in a dynamic MSP environment with both recurring revenue and project-based billing. The ability to read, understand, and produce accurate financial statements is crucial.

Key Responsibilities

Accounts Receivable

  • Manage client invoicing for managed services, project work, and software licensing (recurring and non-recurring).
  • Monitor AR aging, follow up on collections, and resolve billing discrepancies.
  • Coordinate with operations and account managers to ensure contract-driven billing accuracy.
  • Utilize ConnectBooster for AR processing and collections.

Accounts Payable

  • Process vendor invoices, expense reports, and credit card transactions.
  • Maintain vendor records and ensure timely payments.
  • Reconcile vendor statements and resolve discrepancies.

· Utilize Bill.com for AP management.

Receipt Collection & Documentation

  • Collect and manage receipts from employees and vendors.
  • Attach receipts to QuickBooks Online (QBO) transactions for audit and compliance.
  • Use HubDOC for receipt collection and integration into QBO.
  • Ensure proper documentation and organization of financial records, saving reports, bank statements, and maintaining folder structures.

Month-End Close & General Ledger

  • Prepare and post journal entries, accruals, and adjustments.
  • Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and balance sheet accounts.
  • Maintain deferred revenue and prepaid expense schedules.
  • Ensure proper cutoffs and accurate revenue recognition (especially MRR and project-based revenue).
  • Prepare monthly financial statements (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow).

Compliance & Reporting

  • Ensure compliance with GAAP and internal policies.
  • Assist with tax filings, audits, and compliance reporting as needed.
  • Assist with developing and maintaining accounting process documentation and SOPs.

Analysis & Support

  • Provide variance analysis and financial insights to management.
  • Support budgeting and forecasting processes.
  • Recommend process improvements and automation opportunities (e.g., leveraging PSA tools such as Autotask for PO processes and item receipts, QBO, Bill.com).
  • Carry out additional tasks and responsibilities as assigned by the Controller/CFO to support the overall goals of the Finance & Accounting department, including serving as a backup payroll processor.

Requirements

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (CPA or progress toward CPA preferred).
  • 5+ years of progressive accounting experience with full-cycle responsibilities.
  • Strong proficiency in financial statements: must be able to read and interpret financials, prepare and post journal entries, and identify/resolve errors in accounting records.
  • Experience in a Managed Service Provider (MSP), SaaS, or technology services environment strongly preferred.
  • Proficiency in QuickBooks Online (QBO) and related integrations.
  • Familiarity with Bill.com, ConnectBooster, HubDOC, and Autotask.
  • Strong understanding of GAAP and revenue recognition principles.
  • Excellent attention to detail, organization skills, and ability to meet deadlines.
  • Advanced Excel skills; experience with reporting and variance analysis.
    •

Key Competencies

  • Ownership: Takes initiative and sees tasks through to completion.
  • Accuracy: High attention to detail, producing reliable financial results.
  • Collaboration: Works effectively across teams (operations, sales, IT).
  • Organization: Maintains clear folder structures, records, and documentation for easy retrieval and compliance.
  • Problem-Solving: Identifies issues and develops practical solutions.
  • Adaptability: Thrives in a fast-paced, growing MSP environment.
    •

jobs.excerpt: Crimson Education is the world’s leading college admissions consulting firm, with over 1,490 Ivy League offers and 2,410 to the US Top 15.
jobs.description:
Crimson Education is the world’s leading college admissions consulting firm, with over 1,490 Ivy League offers and 2,410 to the US Top 15. We help ambitious students gain admission to the world’s top universities through expert-led guidance and proven, data-driven strategies. Crimson students are 7x more likely to get into the Ivy League than their peers. We were recently featured on the front page of the Wall Street Journal.

Crimson is the only college admissions consultancy that brings together:

  • Former Ivy League and Top 20 admissions officers to rigorously review and refine applications

  • Professors and PhD teaching fellows from leading universities to guide students through original, independent research — with pathways to selective peer-reviewed publication or conference presentation

  • Past ISEF winners and judges who coach students to compete for state, national, and international science fair awards

  • Capstone project mentors who help students design and scale leadership initiatives with real-world impact, measurable outcomes, and credible external validation

We’re backed by leading VC firms, including Tiger Global, Heal Partners, IceHouse Ventures, and Movac, and recently closed a USD $40M Series D funding round at a USD $640M valuation. We now operate across 21 markets worldwide, including the US, Canada, UK, Singapore, Japan, Hong Kong, Australia, and New Zealand.

The Role

We're hiring a Full Stack Engineer to own our marketing website and the tracking and attribution behind it. You'll be building functionality, attribution and tracking in a large enterprise system.

You'll play an integral role in shaping the architecture of our systems and implementing them, working closely with marketing, data and product.

What you'll work on

• Website: Build polished, high-quality UI across our multi-locale headless website on Next.js, Vercel and Storyblok, from components and forms to landing pages and content tools. You'll care as much about how it looks and feels as how it works.

• Technical SEO: Own site architecture, metadata, structured data, sitemaps, robots, hreflang and redirects across every locale.

• Performance: Implement our caching and rendering roadmap (ISR, edge, CDN) so pages stay fast in every region we serve.

• Analytics and attribution: Own analytics and conversion tracking across web and ad platforms, ensuring data is accurate, reliable and trusted for decision making.

• Integrations: Build and maintain Node.js APIs and webhooks that connect our forms to automation tools, CRM, Supabase and Snowflake.

• Monitoring and testing: Run automated tests and monitoring that catch broken forms, tracking gaps and lost leads before marketing or sales notice.

• Martech systems: Build and improve the systems behind our lead flow, such as auto-prioritisation flows, dedupe logic and attribution inserts.

• Documentation: Keep clear, current docs for everything you own, using AI to make that easy.

Success looks like

• Attribution you can trust: Every lead carries the right source, UTMs and click IDs, and ad platform conversions reconcile with the CRM.

• No silent failures: Broken forms, tracking or integrations get caught by monitoring within hours, not found by sales weeks later.

• Fast pages: Key templates pass Core Web Vitals and load in under 2 seconds across target regions.

• Strong SEO foundations: Clean, indexable architecture across all locales, with no regressions from releases.

• Documented systems: Anyone on the team can pick up what you've built from the docs.

Roadmap delivered: Martech roadmap work ships on time and cleanly replaces old flows.

You'll need

5+ years of commercial full stack experience, equally strong on front end and back end

• Strong React, Next.js, Node.js and TypeScript

• A strong eye for UI: you turn designs into beautiful, responsive and accessible interfaces, and sweat the details

• Production experience on Vercel, including caching, ISR, edge middleware and preview workflows

• Experience on a large headless website or product, ideally with a headless CMS like Storyblok, Sanity or Contentful

• Deep technical SEO knowledge, with sites you can point to

• A track record of setting up accurate analytics and attribution: GTM, GA4, server-side tagging or conversion APIs, UTM and consent handling

• Strong web performance skills: caching, CDNs, rendering strategies and Core Web Vitals

• Comfortable building with AI tools like Claude Code or Cursor in your day-to-day, while reviewing and testing everything you ship

• Clear writing and good documentation habits

• Based in New Zealand or Australia with full working rights, and comfortable working async across time zones

Nice to have

• Worked in an engineering team where a good share of code is AI-generated, with solid review practices around it

• Marketo, Salesforce or other marketing automation and CRM APIs

• Meta CAPI, Google Ads offline or enhanced conversions

• Supabase or Postgres, Snowflake, Metabase

• Multi-locale sites (i18n, hreflang)

• High-volume lead gen or EdTech experience

Why work for Crimson?

  • Rapidly growing start up, with a flexible working environment where you will be empowered to structure how you work

  • Limitless development and exposure - our internal promotions/role changes made up 33% of all recruitment last year

  • $1000 individual training budget per year, we love to ‘Level Up’ (it’s one of our core values)!

  • Psychologist on staff

  • Insightful fireside chats and workshops to help support our high-performing and ambitious team

  • Radical Candor is a feedback approach we live by

  • We’re a global player with 28 markets (and growing) across the globe. Most roles have the option to work from one of our many offices or remotely!

If you're passionate about growing in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and want to work with cutting-edge technology, then we'd love to hear from you!

Please keep an eye on your spam/junk email folder for correspondence from Team Tailor.

Job Description:

At Sparklight/Cableone and our family of brands, we keep our customers and associates connected to what matters most. For our associates, that means: a thriving and rewarding career, respect for the communities where they live and work, a focus on health and wellness, an excellent work/life balance, and an open and inclusive workplace.

As a Channel Partner Sales Representative, you will be a strategic partner to external channel partners and technology advisors, helping them succeed with Sparklight Business suite of services. You’ll build long-term relationships with channel partner networks, drive sales growth through indirect channels, and deliver measurable business outcomes.

What you will do to contribute to the company's success

  • Consultative Support: Work closely with partners to understand their clients’ needs and help them present customized B2B solutions that drive ROI.
  • Pipeline Development: Support partners in building and managing a robust sales funnel through targeted outreach, referrals, and strategic networking.
  • Partner Performance Management: Monitor partner activity, provide coaching, and help partners achieve or exceed monthly and quarterly sales targets.
  • Market Intelligence: Stay informed on industry trends, competitive landscape, and emerging technologies to position Sparklight as a trusted service provider for partners.
  • Client Retention & Expansion: Assist channel partners in maintaining and growing their accounts by delivering exceptional service and identifying upsell opportunities.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with internal teams (engineering, product, support) to ensure seamless delivery and client satisfaction for partner-referred customers.

Qualifications

  • At least one year of B2B channel sales experience, preferably in telecommunications, SaaS, or technology services.
  • Proven ability to manage complex sales cycles and engage senior leadership stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of channel sales models, enterprise business drivers, and technology solutions.
  • Sales CRM experience a must, salesforce experience preferred.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
  • Self-motivated, organized, and results-driven with a professional demeanor.

Core Competencies

  • Proactive: Understand what our customers need, and actively works to make their relationship with use seamless, easy, and rewarding.
  • Personal: Knows our customers well, and tailors our communications and interactions to address their needs and expectations.

Benefits

Cable One and our family of brands appreciates the role our associates play to help the company grow, and in return an excellent benefits package is offered to our associates to recognize the importance of their contributions, such as:

  • Paid time off (vacation, holiday, and personal/sick days)
  • 401(k) - 100% company match starts day 1 of employment (up to 5% of eligible compensation)
  • Group Legal plan with Identity Theft Protection

Additional Perks

  • Tuition reimbursement (up to $5,250 on 1st year)
  • Annual community support to various organizations across the U.S.
  • Associate recognition & awards programs
  • Advancement opportunities
  • Collaborative work environment
  • FREE Cable One services for associates who live in a serviceable area

Our Commitment

Diversity lies in the communities we serve and among the associates who dedicate themselves to ensure our continued success. Here at Cable One and our family of brands, we believe it is our individual and unique talents, backgrounds and perspectives that, when combined, truly make us an unstoppable force. "Stronger Together" is not just a verbal cue, it is the motto that our associates live by, exemplify, and embody each and every day.

Cable One and our family of brands is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, among other things, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, status as a protected veteran, or disability.

Pre-hire Processes

Cable One and our family of brands is committed to keeping our associates and customers safe. Job offers are contingent upon the results of background, drug screening, and reference check. Only after successfully passing these pre-hire clearances are individuals approved for hire and ready to start their successful and rewarding career.

jobs.description:
Position Summary:

The Start Up (SU) Lead is an expert in global site start-up activities and is accountable for the execution of the site start-up strategy and planning, including the management and coordination activities such as Core/Site document collection and approval, ICF customization and approval, IRB/EC and CA/ MoH submissions and delivery of quality IMP release packages. Will act as Subject Matter Expert for questions by other in-country members (SUSs, CRAs, CSSs or others) supporting site start-up activities, Trainer for less-experienced staff on site start-up activities and may be identified as Owner of country specific tools and guidance documents to increase knowledge share of country specific site start-up activities.

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

  • Manage the site start up process through development of an activation readiness strategy to enable oversight of site start up delivery.
  • Coordinate, develop and present critical path planning including IRB/EC & CA/ MoH Strategy, ICF Customization, Risk Mitigations, IMP Release Requirements and Contract Execution.
  • Collaborate and communicate with stakeholders to secure input for milestone planning, and alignment of operational goals to ensure timely delivery of site start up activities to allow on time activation.
  • Participate in client meetings to establish client expectations for delivery, communication, risk mitigation strategy, status reporting, and metrics related to site start up.
  • Partner closely with Functional Leaders and Site Start up Specialists to proactively identify any risks to delivery and develop and execute mitigations to remove risks to timelines.
  • Provide oversight to ensure accuracy and completeness of agreed tracking and systems are maintained in real time to allow analysis of progress metrics against targets/timelines at study, country, and site levels.
  • Responsible to co-ordinate translations for documents required for submissions.
  • Maintain communication with other key functions participating to country start up i.e., Feasibility, Clinical Operations, Project Management, Regulatory and Site Contracts management group on project specific status and deliverables.
  • Act as SME for collection and maintenance of site level critical path to IMP Release data points such as local IRB/Ethics Committee (EC) timelines, other required reviews to secure activation, site contracts and budget negotiation requirements that may be in place as well as other start up requirements for assigned country.
  • If needed, directly support country or site level activities start up activities.
  • Support development of country specific Country Start-up summary and process flow identifying timelines, risks, and success factors.
  • Support development and facilitation of training sessions to expand Country Start-up knowledge and act as Subject Matter Expert for queries.
  • Mentor staff on local study start-up regulations, submissions, internal procedures and SSDL.
  • Interact with clients in proposal activities, including slide development and client presentation as required.
  • Performs other duties as assigned by management.

Qualifications:

Minimum Required:

  • Bachelors degree in life sciences or related field, or Registered Nurse (RN) or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.
  • 5 years or more in start up, ideally with SU Lead or PM experience in either a CRO or pharmaceutical/ biotech industry or equivalent, relevant experience and/or demonstrated competencies.
  • 2 years or more experience in project milestone management, managing resources, budgets and coordinating team activities.

Other Required:

  • Demonstrated leadership experience in driving cross-functional activities
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills are essential.
  • Experience using computerized information systems, electronic spreadsheets, word processing and electronic mail required.
  • Fluency in English and for non-English speaking countries the local language of country where position based.
  • Experience using milestone tracking tools/systems

Preferred:

  • Advanced degree in life sciences or related field

Competencies:

  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Ability to follow task-specific procedures, be attentive to detail and place importance on accuracy of information.
  • Excellent organizational skills.
  • Ability to effectively interact with project team(s) and effectively communicate in English and the local language of the country where located.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment with a sense of urgency to match the pace.
  • Must demonstrate excellent computer skills.
  • Excellent time management and prioritization skills to ensure deadlines are met.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, interpersonal skills, both written and spoken, with an ability to inform, influence, convince, and persuade.
  • Occasional travel may be required.

jobs.description:
Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of relevant work experience is required, plus a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience; or Master's degree plus a minimum of 6 years of relevant experience.

Due to the nature of work performed within our facilities, U.S. citizenship is required.

Responsibilities for this Position

Ready to be a leader with the company that is committed to pushing the limits of truly advanced technologies? At General Dynamics Mission Systems, we create the products and services that help our service members, intelligence analysts and first responders keep our nation safe. The work we do is so advanced, it’s often classified. If you want to put your talent in the spotlight, it’s waiting for you right now, right here. We apply advanced technologies such as Artificial Intelligence, Blockchain, AR/VR, Cloud Native and Quantum Physics to solve our customers’ missions in cyber, RF, undersea, interstellar and everything in between. Utilizing your seasoned team building skills, the Sr Advanced Program Performance Management Specialist will utilize required experiences with an integrated performance management, schedule management, or subject matter expert focus. Essentially, you’ll lead a team in contract/program cost and/or schedule development and management/analysis for developing engineering programs for critical major components, or production or logistics programs for a large custom subsystems or small total systems. The scope of the programs will have a contract value typically at $20-50M per year, with total program value of $50-300M. You’ll lead the development of the program cost and/or schedule baselines within the contract parameters, the analysis of program performance (historical and predictive), the monitoring of the contract/program estimate at completion, and the review of results and recommendations to program teams.

What you’ll experience:

  • Technologies that aren’t just top-notch, they’re often top-secret
  • A team of bold thinkers committed to exploring what’s next
  • Opportunities to gain new knowledge - as it’s discovered

What you bring to the table:

  • A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent plus a minimum of 8 years relevant experience; or Master's degree plus a minimum of 6 years relevant experience
  • Advanced user in Primavera P6 scheduling and EVMS tools and principles
  • Experience in coordination of program requirements across planning stages with several subcontractors across distinct product lines
  • Exceptional experience with DCMA audits

What sets you apart:

  • Creative thinking with the ability to multi-task
  • Commitment to ongoing professional development
  • Team player who thrives in collaborative environments and revels in team success
  • Identifies opportunities to apply AI for continuous improvement and innovation

Our Commitment to You:

  • An exciting career path with opportunities for continuous learning and development.
  • Research oriented work, alongside award winning teams developing practical solutions for our nation’s security
  • Competitive benefits, including 401k matching, flex time off, paid parental leave, healthcare benefits, health & wellness programs, employee resource and social groups, and more
  • See more at gdmissionsystems.com/careers/why-work-for-us/benefits

Workplace Options:

This position can be supported remotely but proximity to any of our 'hubs' (MA, VA, AZ) is ideal.

Salary Note

This estimate represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors (geographic location, etc.). Actual pay may vary. This job posting will remain open until the position is filled.

Combined Salary Range

USD $130,000.00 - USD $140,000.00 /Yr.

Company Overview

General Dynamics Mission Systems (GDMS) engineers a diverse portfolio of high technology solutions, products and services that enable customers to successfully execute missions across all domains of operation. With a global team of 12,000+ top professionals, we partner with the best in industry to expand the bounds of innovation in the defense and scientific arenas. Given the nature of our work and who we are, we value trust, honesty, alignment and transparency. We offer highly competitive benefits and pride ourselves in being a great place to work with a shared sense of purpose. You will also enjoy a flexible work environment where contributions are recognized and rewarded. If who we are and what we do resonates with you, we invite you to join our high-performance team!

Equal Opportunity Employer / Individuals with Disabilities / Protected Veterans

jobs.excerpt: SaaS Revenue & Financial Analyst — FlosumAbout FlosumFlosum is a Salesforce-native platform company delivering enterprise-grade DevOps, data protection, and security solutions to some of the world's largest organizations.
jobs.description:
SaaS Revenue & Financial Analyst — Flosum

About Flosum

Flosum is a Salesforce-native platform company delivering enterprise-grade DevOps, data protection, and security solutions to some of the world's largest organizations. Our product portfolio spans Cloud DevOps, Data Migrator, Data Masking, Data Backup, Org Security, Cloud Trust Center, and Sandbox Synchronization — all built natively on the Salesforce platform. We serve enterprise customers across technology, energy, financial services, healthcare, and federal government. Flosum is a growth-stage company operating with the intensity and speed of a startup backed by the discipline of a mature operator.

The Role

We're hiring a SaaS Revenue & Financial Analyst who will own the measurement layer of our entire business. You will be the person who knows every number — ARR, net retention, expansion, churn, pipeline conversion, cost of acquisition, gross margin by product line, services margin, cash flow, and everything in between. You'll work across Salesforce (our CRM and billing system of record) and QuickBooks (our financial system) to build a unified, always-current picture of company performance.

This is not a reporting role. This is an analytical role where you connect revenue operations data to financial outcomes and surface the insights that drive decisions at the CEO level.

What You'll Own

You will build and maintain our SaaS metrics infrastructure — ARR waterfall, cohort retention analysis, revenue recognition schedules, deferred revenue tracking, and unit economics by segment. You will reconcile Salesforce bookings data against QuickBooks revenue entries and ensure we have a single source of truth across both systems. You will produce monthly and quarterly financial and revenue packages for leadership, including variance analysis against plan. You will model scenarios for pricing changes, product bundling, geographic expansion, and headcount investment. You will monitor pipeline health and translate pipeline data into revenue forecasts with documented assumptions. You will own the data integrity between our CRM and accounting systems, flagging discrepancies before they compound. You will support board-level and investor-level reporting with clean, defensible metrics.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

You have three-plus years of experience in SaaS financial analysis, revenue operations, or FP&A at a B2B software company. You are deeply proficient in Salesforce — not as a user, but as someone who understands opportunity objects, product schedules, contract structures, and reporting at a data level. You are equally proficient in QuickBooks Online, including chart of accounts design, revenue categorization, journal entries, and reconciliation workflows. You understand ASC 606 revenue recognition principles and can apply them to a multi-product SaaS business with annual and multi-year contracts. You can build financial models from scratch in Excel or Google Sheets — not from templates, from logic. You think in terms of cohorts, not just totals. You understand the difference between bookings, billings, and revenue, and you can explain why each matters. You are precise, skeptical of your own numbers, and obsessive about data integrity.

Preferred

Experience at a company with a mix of subscription revenue and professional services. Familiarity with Salesforce CPQ or native Salesforce quoting and contract objects. Exposure to investor or board reporting at a growth-stage company. Experience with Marketo or HubSpot data as it relates to CAC and attribution modeling.

Why Flosum

You'll report directly into the CEO's operating rhythm. Your work will not sit in a queue — it will shape hiring plans, product investment, and go-to-market strategy in real time. Flosum is building the definitive platform for Salesforce lifecycle management, and we need someone who can measure every dimension of that growth with precision.

jobs.excerpt: À propos de ShareGateShareGate est le leader en migration et gouvernance Microsoft 365, avec plus de 100 000 professionnels TI qui comptent sur sa simplicité imbattable.
jobs.description:
À propos de ShareGate

ShareGate est le leader en migration et gouvernance Microsoft 365, avec plus de 100 000 professionnels TI qui comptent sur sa simplicité imbattable.

Il offre l’approche la plus simple, fiable et abordable pour migrer les données d’entreprise sur Microsoft 365.

Que ce soit Google Workspace, les disques réseaux, Exchange Online, SharePoint On-Premises, ou d’un tenant à l’autre, ShareGate s’en occupe et offre la paix d’esprit. D’une transition vers le cloud à l’intégration d’une nouvelle entreprise, il garde les choses vraiment simples.

ShareGate est aussi l’outil de prédilection pour garder le contrôle des données une fois que la migration est complétée. Ses fonctionnalités de gouvernance permettent d'évaluer rapidement les environnements M365, détecter les problèmes et apporter les correctifs nécessaires, pour que tout reste ordonné, sécurisé et optimisé. Il aide à mettre en place la fondation pour déployer avec confiance l’assistant d'IA de Microsoft.

ShareGate est développé par Workleap Technologies, une entreprise de logiciels basée à Montréal.

Ton rôle

ShareGate est un outil de confiance, adoré des partenaires qui réalisent des migrations Microsoft 365, et on veut maintenant faire passer ces relations d'une logique produit à une logique stratégique. À titre de Gestionnaire de comptes indirects, tu prends en charge un portefeuille défini de partenaires Premier et Elite en Amérique du Nord et tu deviens la personne responsable de leur croissance avec ShareGate. C'est un rôle axé sur les ventes avant tout : on cherche une personne avec une mentalité de chasseur.euse, qui va chercher le revenu avec ses partenaires plutôt que de simplement entretenir des comptes.

Ton impact :

  • Propulser la croissance du revenu généré par les partenaires en assumant ton objectif, en maintenant une couverture de pipeline solide et en produisant des prévisions précises, pour que ShareGate atteigne (et dépasse) ses cibles de canal trimestre après trimestre ;
  • Prendre en charge ton portefeuille de partenaires Premier et Elite en bâtissant un plan de croissance pour chacun (objectifs, actions conjointes, indicateurs de succès), pour que les partenaires les plus performants passent à la vitesse supérieure, que les partenaires à fort potentiel décollent et que les partenaires sous-performants deviennent des comptes de croissance ;
  • Faire évoluer les relations d'une logique produit à une logique stratégique en tissant des liens à plusieurs niveaux (ventes, technique, direction) et en devenant le.la Sherpa ShareGate de tes partenaires, pour que ShareGate devienne le fournisseur de choix pour faire croître leur entreprise ;
  • Outiller les partenaires pour vendre plus et conclure plus vite en animant de la formation en vente et des sessions techniques avec l'équipe d'enablement, en mobilisant les bonnes ressources internes (technique, RevOps, ventes directes) au bon moment et en créant de la demande avec le marketing de canal, pour que plus de partenaires concluent des ventes ShareGate de façon autonome et qu'aucune occasion ne s'enlise faute de soutien ;
  • Ouvrir de nouvelles sources de revenus avec tes partenaires en repérant des projets de migration plus grands et plus complexes, en développant la migration de boîtes courriel (y compris le remplacement d'outils concurrents) et l'adoption de Protect, et en accélérant l'adoption des nouveaux programmes de partenaires dès leur lancement ;
  • Utiliser l'IA au quotidien pour la recherche de comptes, la planification avec les partenaires, les prévisions et les communications, pour consacrer ton temps aux conversations qui font avancer les ventes plutôt qu'à la préparation.

Ton équipe

L'équipe Canal de ShareGate grandit vite et fonctionne comme on aime : rapidement, en collaboration et en toute confiance. Tu relèves de la direction régionale des ventes de canal et tu travailles au quotidien avec la direction du département, d'autres gestionnaires de comptes de canal, les gestionnaires de canal de distribution et les gestionnaires de développement de partenaires, tandis que le marketing de canal, RevOps, l'enablement technique, le soutien et les ventes directes sont là au besoin. Dans les 6 à 12 prochains mois, l'ambition de l'équipe est de faire passer le canal d'une logique produit à une logique stratégique : approfondir les relations avec les partenaires Premier et Elite, accélérer l'adoption des nouveaux programmes de partenaires et transformer les partenaires à fort potentiel en véritables comptes de croissance. D'ici 6 mois, tu auras pris en charge ton portefeuille et tes cadences, bâti un plan de croissance pour tes partenaires et commencé à tester de nouvelles idées pour préparer la suite.

Ce que tu apportes

  • La maîtrise de l’anglais est requise, car tu vas collaborer régulièrement avec des collègues, des clients et des partenaires qui parlent une autre langue que le français ;
  • 5 ans et plus d'expérience en vente par canal indirect en Amérique du Nord, idéalement aux États-Unis, avec des résultats démontrés d'atteinte et de dépassement de quotas (déplacements jusqu'à 30 % du temps entre le Canada et les États-Unis) ;
  • Expérience de gestion de partenaires de niveau Premier ou Elite, incluant l'élaboration et l'exécution de plans d'affaires avec des partenaires ;
  • Mentalité de chasseur.euse axée sur les ventes : une personne autonome et entrepreneuriale, qui crée son propre pipeline, fait preuve de jugement et d'initiative, et peut être efficace rapidement ;
  • Excellentes habiletés de communication, de présentation et de négociation, avec l'aisance d'échanger autant avec des équipes de vente qu'avec la direction de nos partenaires ;
  • Bonne compréhension de l'écosystème de canal TI (distributeurs, revendeurs et partenaires de services), idéalement dans l'écosystème Microsoft, avec des relations existantes avec des partenaires M365 ;
  • Aisance à utiliser l'IA (ex. : Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT) au quotidien pour la recherche de comptes, la planification, les prévisions et les communications : pas une expérience, une habitude.

La plupart de cela te ressemble ? Postule.

Ce que le poste inclut

  • Salaire de base : 105 000$ - 120 000$. Cette fourchette reflète notre échelle salariale pancanadienne. L'offre finale peut être ajustée selon la région du candidat pour s'aligner avec les conditions du marché local.
    • OTE : 150 000 $ - 170 000 $ CAD
  • Programme LTIP, participation à la croissance à long terme de Workleap.
  • REER + Assurances collectives familiales + télémédecine + budget bien-être annuel.
  • Politique de vacances flexible.
  • Télétravail, avec accès à nos bureaux de Montréal.
  • Rassemblement en personne deux fois par an.
  • Claude accessible à tous.

Ce qui nous anime

On construit des logiciels au cœur de l'expérience de travail, au quotidien, à tous les niveaux.

On avance vite. Les priorités évoluent, les décisions se prennent avec l'information qu'on a, et on itère. Si tu carbures à l'intensité et que l'ambiguïté ne te fait pas peur, tu vas te sentir chez toi. On est des bâtisseurs. On fait ce qu'il faut pour avancer. L'IA fait partie de l'arsenal. On l'utilise pour aller plus vite et décider plus intelligemment, pas pour remplacer le jugement.

Si tu veux de l'impact réel et un endroit où tes décisions comptent, c'est ici.

Comment on recrute

La transparence, c'est notre façon de recruter — pour toi comme pour nous.

Voici comment ça se passe : un premier échange avec un.e recruteur.euse, puis un entretien virtuel avec le.la gestionnaire d'embauche. Tu complètes ensuite une étude de cas à faire chez toi, suivie d'une rencontre avec de futur.es collègues pour en discuter ensemble. Selon le poste, le parcours peut varier légèrement — ton.ta recruteur.euse t'en donnera tous les détails lors de votre premier appel.

On utilise l'IA pour soutenir certaines étapes du processus, mais chaque décision d'embauche reste humaine.

On a hâte de te rencontrer.

En postulant, tu confirmes avoir lu et accepté notre politique de confidentialité.

Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI)

Panopto AI Use Policy:

Panopto’s AI Use Policy is committed to a hiring process that is thoughtful, fair, and centered on human connection. As artificial intelligence (AI) becomes more prevalent in the workplace, we believe that it is important to describe our use of AI in the hiring process, as well as outline to candidates what use of AI is and is not allowed. While AI can be a valuable tool, it cannot replace genuine human interaction or an individual’s unique perspective, experience, and voice.

Company Use of AI:

Panopto may utilize tools to enhance the efficiency, objectivity, and quality of our recruitment and evaluation process. These tools assist our team throughout the hiring lifecycle by focusing on four key areas:

  • Content Creation: Providing a starting point for crafting job descriptions and assisting in building tailored interview questions.

  • Resume Parsing: Analyzing candidate skillsets and resume alignment to efficiently identify qualified candidates.

  • Interview & Assessment Insights: Providing interview transcription, summarization, and identifying key insights from candidate assessments in relation to specific role requirements.

  • Data Organization: Organizing and storing information gathered during assessments to help our team make informed, data-driven decisions.

Ultimately, these tools are used to support—not replace—our team in assessing skills, generating insights, and identifying the best talent for Panopto.

To ensure fairness and transparency:

Human-Centric Decisions: Please be assured that AI tools are used to support our team, and all final hiring decisions are made by human reviewers. Panopto hiring teams will thoroughly review your application and assessment results. AI is not used to make final decisions regarding your candidacy.

Bias Mitigation: We are committed to algorithmic fairness. Our AI-assisted tools undergo regular independent audits to detect and mitigate bias, with the goal of keeping our processes equitable and inclusive. Our methodology aligns with global best practices and regional digital ethics standards to provide every candidate with a fair and merit-based evaluation.

Your Rights & Accommodations: We provide inclusive access for all applicants. If you require a reasonable adjustment due to a disability, or if you prefer a non-automated review of your application, please contact Panopto Talent Attraction. We respect your right to request human intervention; please note that opting for a manual review may impact the standard processing timeline.

Data Privacy and Security:

Your personal data and recordings are processed securely in compliance with global privacy and employment regulations (including EEOC, GDPR, and other local or regional privacy laws, as applicable).

To facilitate our recruitment and evaluation process, limited candidate data may be shared securely with trusted third-party vendors and service providers acting on our behalf. We retain candidate data only as long as necessary to fulfill the recruitment purpose or as required by applicable statutory retention periods. Once this purpose is met, or the retention period expires, your data is securely deleted or anonymized in accordance with our data governance policy.

Panopto is dedicated to a fair and equitable hiring process for all candidates.

Use of AI:

Statement of Transparency:

At Panopto, we embrace the transformative power of AI to enhance productivity and learning. We believe in providing a level playing field where candidates can use modern tools to put their best foot forward, provided those tools support, rather than replace, their authentic voice and expertise. While we encourage the use of AI as a tool for growth and preparation, we require transparency and authenticity to ensure a fair evaluation for all.

Acceptable Use:

  • AI-Assisted Preparation: You are encouraged to use Generative AI (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini) as a mock interviewer or coach to refine your speaking points.

  • Research & Knowledge Gathering: Using AI to synthesize industry trends or company background is permitted and viewed as proactive preparation.

  • Career Guidance Tools: Simulation tools that help you practice the STAR method or identify skill gaps are acceptable.

Prohibited Use:

  • Live Interview Assistance: The use of real-time AI "teleprompters," live answer-generators, or deepfake audio/video during Panopto recordings or live sessions is strictly prohibited.

  • Plagiarized Work Samples: Any take-home assignments or portfolios must be your original work. While AI can assist in formatting or brainstorming, the core logic and execution must be yours.

Panopto has a zero-tolerance policy toward the misrepresentation of job-related skills. Consequences of using prohibited tools may result in my immediate disqualification from the hiring process, the withdrawal of any pending offer, or termination of employment if discovered after hire.

Verification of Experience:

To ensure the integrity of our hiring process and validate the skills demonstrated during your Panopto submission, Panopto may require the following "Proof of Experience":

  • Work Samples & Portfolios: Candidates may be asked to provide original work samples (e.g., code repositories, design portfolios, case studies) that pre-date the current application.

  • Digital Footprint & Professional Links: We may request links to professional profiles (e.g., LinkedIn, GitHub, Behance) to verify career trajectory and industry contributions.

Disclosures:

  • Live Validation: Any technical skill demonstrated in an asynchronous Panopto recording is subject to a live, "Human-in-the-Loop" technical assessment or deep-dive discussion.

  • Fraud Detection: Please be aware that we utilize metadata analysis and fraud detection tools to ensure the authenticity of all video submissions.

By submitting your application and participating in the recruitment process, you acknowledge and consent to Panopto's use of AI, as well as the acceptable and prohibited uses of AI as a candidate, as described above.

Panopto is dedicated to a fair and equitable hiring process for all candidates.

We are committed to the well-being and growth of our employees, and we prioritize continuous learning and development through fully funded training programs.
Our focus on people, expertise, and commitment to excellence underscores our mission to make a positive impact in the tech industry.

Role Overview:

Our customers rely on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central to run important parts of their day-to-day
operations. When something goes wrong or a user needs help, they need a fast, clear and dependable
response. As a D365 BC Support Analyst, you’ll be the first point of contact within our Business Central Managed
Services team. You’ll diagnose issues, resolve what you can at first contact and make sure more complex
problems reach the right specialist with the context needed to move quickly. The role exists to reduce disruption, improve the customer experience and help us deliver a responsive, commercially sustainable managed service.

What success looks like:

    Customer support and triage
    • You improve the efficiency and consistency of our Business Central managed service. Strong firstline
    resolution and effective escalation reduce avoidable specialist effort, support service
    performance and help us build lasting customer relationships.
    First-line resolution
    • Investigate and resolve familiar functional and user issues across Business Central. Apply practical
    troubleshooting rather than simply passing tickets on.

    Effective escalation
    • Escalate issues to second or third line when specialist input is required. Provide clear evidence,
    investigation notes and customer context so the next team can act quickly.
    Ticket Ownership
    • Log, categorise and prioritise incidents and service requests accurately. Monitor progress, follow up
    on open cases and help prevent tickets from becoming stuck.

    Customer communication
    • Keep customers informed throughout the support lifecycle. Set clear expectations, explain progress
    in straightforward language and maintain confidence even when the resolution is not immediate.

    Service improvement
    • Document useful resolutions, contribute to the internal knowledge base and share recurring themes
    with the wider team. Support the onboarding of new customers and help improve how the managed
    service operates.

The kind of problems you’ll solve:

  • A user cannot complete an important process in Business Central and needs help identifying the

jobs.description:
Who we are

We’re bold thinkers and kind teammates, growing fast but staying grounded. Our Nordic roots and global outlook shape a culture of friendliness, creativity, and collaboration, all powered by openness and shared wins. We care deeply about doing the right thing - and doing it together. We aim to improve the flow of goods, time, and energy - and we know we can’t shape the future by clinging to the past. So, we keep evolving, together.

What we do

RELEX runs the planning decisions behind 700+ retailers and manufacturers worldwide, deciding, at real scale, what gets forecast, stocked, priced, promoted, and produced across the entire value chain. Few problems combine this much data, this much complexity, and this much real-world weight: get it right and a shelf stays stocked, a factory line doesn’t stall, food doesn’t rot in a warehouse before it’s sold. Get it wrong, and it shows up in actual losses, for some of the largest retail and manufacturing brands in the world.

We’ve grown for 76 consecutive quarters straight, and it’s accelerating: the first half of 2026 was the strongest in the company’s history, with new contract value up 83% year over year. We’re a team of 2,000+ people, headquartered in Helsinki, with offices across Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific.

At RELEX, Product Designers own the user experience of their product or domain – from problem definition to shipped quality by utilizing AI-assisted workflows. You will be working as part of R&D organization in RELEX Production team who owns their outcomes and ways of working end-to-end. You will also have the support of Design Excellence community of 15+ designers across RELEX to share your craft and learn from your peers.

As a Product Designer, you will own the user experience across our Production planning and Scheduling solutions – setting the bar for quality, influencing what gets built, and driving design coherence. You’ll work closely with engineering and industry experts who configure and deliver these solutions to customers, and with other Product Designers to turn complex planning logic into experiences that help planners to understand, trust and act on their decisions.

What we need you to do and be

Bring your ideas. Challenge ours. Grow with us.

  • Own the UX vision and quality for RELEX Production: Act as the end-to-end owner and expert of user experience. Maintain the quality through craft and taste, and keep it grounded in the real work of planners and production sites of our manufacturing customers
  • Think in systems: Be curious to understand complex information architecture and planning domain to keep innovating on our platform tools. Shape the product structure so that new solutions ship fast while leaving room for growth
  • Stay close to users: Lead research and discovery (customer visits, observation, interviews, user testing) with planners and schedulers to keep solutions connected to the realities of production planning. Actively engage with internal experts to formulate and challenge product assumptions which you translate into design requirements
  • Own the value end to end: Follow and validate your work from design to implementation and customer delivery – working with customers and internal consultants to see how new features are received, adopted, and iterated
  • Drive your own agenda: Set your priorities, communicate clearly across teams, and push back when evidence supports it
  • Prototype and ship both with and for AI: Build real, working solutions and workflows with AI-assisted tools, taking them close to production ready. Consider agentic AI as another consumer of the product while designing processes and features

What you’ll bring to the table

Our five values are our playbook. We speak up when things don’t make sense. We stop doing what doesn’t add value. We stay curious, back each other up, and make space for both innovation and laughter.

  • 5+ years of experience in end-to-end product design with a strong focus on user experience, research, and interaction design
  • Strong expertise in systemic thinking and working with complex platform products, with a good sense of UI design taste
  • Ability to move between strategic concepts and development-ready designs
  • Experience in AI-enabled workflows from discovery, design to code
  • Proactive and independent work attitude. You proactively find important problems to address, bring them to the surface and independently find ways to drive solutions for those problems
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills to work effectively with different stakeholder groups in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to listen, spar, and challenge existing assumptions and requirements based on available data, user research, and user needs
  • Collaborative team attitude: contribute to a positive team atmosphere by sharing knowledge and solving problems together
  • Fluent written and spoken English, to collaborate with an international team

What we offer in return

You’ll be supported and given the space to thrive. We offer meaningful work, flexibility, and a culture that backs you to share your voice and be authentic.

  • An international career and learning opportunities
  • A rapidly growing and financially robust software company with exciting opportunities for career growth, also in the future

RELEX key benefits

  • Flexibility in how and where you work
  • Room to thrivein a fast-growing global company with a good market position
  • Practical benefits that support work, family, wellness, and everyday life
  • Annual leave
  • Diverse, inclusive, and supportive work culture
  • Work that meaningfully reduces waste and improves sustainability
  • Ownership, autonomy and flat hierarchies
  • Two paid volunteering days each year

We are a global community of different cultures, voices, and experiences. We celebrate what makes us unique and connect through what we share, in an authentic and safe environment. Together we shape the future, and each other.

Please note that to be considered for this position, you must be fluent in English and hold a valid work permit for your country of residence.We’re excited to connect with applicants who meet these criteria and share our passion to do hard things, trust each other, and build what’s next for the product, the planet, and the people.

If you feel this is the opportunity you don’t want to miss, you can apply by sending your cover letter and resume through the application form as soon as possible.

Apply today and be part of the future. Be RELEX!

jobs.excerpt: Vaga 100% remotaAqui a gente conecta o mundo Sensedia é uma multinacional brasileira provedora de plataforma de gerenciamento de APIs, governança de agentes e soluções de integração, além de serviços profissionais.
jobs.description:
Vaga 100% remota

Aqui a gente conecta o mundo

Sensedia é uma multinacional brasileira provedora de plataforma de gerenciamento de APIs, governança de agentes e soluções de integração, além de serviços profissionais. A companhia impulsiona a transformação digital de grandes empresas habilitando arquiteturas mais ágeis, modernas e escaláveis, possibilitando assim que seus clientes ofereçam produtos e experiências digitais a todo o seu ecossistema.

Trabalhar aqui é pertencer a uma cultura plural, descontraída e inovadora. É para quem tem coragem de ir além, pensar e agir fora da caixa. Preferimos pedir desculpas ao invés de pedir permissão e estamos sempre dispostos a nos transformar, nos reinventar.
Nossas pessoas são incríveis e você pode fazer parte disso tudo. Nos comprometemos em garantir um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor e respeitoso.

Conheça + em nosso site:


Qual a missão do Cargo?

O Principal Engineer direciona a evolução tecnológica da plataforma de produtos da Sensedia. Faz isso com princípios arquiteturais claros, com uma visão de futuro dos produtos e, principalmente, liderando as iniciativas de transformação que deixam a plataforma mais escalável, resiliente e segura, e alinhada aos objetivos de negócio.

Essa direção combina duas fontes. De um lado, o que acontece fora da Sensedia: mercado, concorrentes, tecnologias e tendências. De outro, o que os times de produto já definiram — objetivos, backlog, prioridades e feedback de clientes —, trabalhado em parceria com os Product Managers.

O papel atua sobretudo por influência. Nas squads, os padrões de arquitetura chegam pelos Staff Engineers; com os demais stakeholders, a relação é direta, mas sem hierarquia. Comunicação clara e capacidade de negociação fazem parte do trabalho diário. Esperamos alguém com autonomia para, diante de um desafio, transitar entre as dimensões técnica, de
negócio e de relacionamento, e transformar isso em resultado mensurável.

Quais serão suas atividades do dia-a-dia?

  • Definir a visão de futuro dos produtos e as iniciativas de transformação tecnológica, combinando duas frentes: trazer para a discussão o que vem de fora (mercado, concorrência, tecnologias emergentes) e considerar o backlog e as prioridades definidos pelos times de cada produto. Os princípios arquiteturais dão coerência entre a evolução tecnológica e os objetivos de negócio.
  • Conduzir a transição da arquitetura atual para a arquitetura alvo: mapear o estado atual, incluindo onde os requisitos não funcionais estão sendo atendidos ou não, para priorizar onde atuar, e liderar as iniciativas de transição que vão além do horizonte de um único value stream.
  • IA generativa e agêntica nos produtos: definir como IA generativa e agêntica entra na arquitetura dos produtos — quais capacidades fazem sentido (LLMs, agentes, exposição da plataforma a agentes via MCP), onde se encaixam e com quais requisitos de segurança, custo e governança — e transformar isso em diretrizes, arquiteturas de referência e provas de conceito que os times usam na construção.
  • IA no processo de desenvolvimento de software: contribuir com a arquitetura de como construímos software com agentes: orquestração, papéis e guardrails, e os impactos na forma de trabalho dos times.
  • Experimentar como método: protótipos, provas de conceito e pilotos para as decisões técnicas relevantes, antes de comprometer a arquitetura, muitas vezes como parte natural do dia a dia. É o que dá espaço para a inovação e quebra eventuais resistências à complexidade de fazer diferente
  • Atuar em parceria com Produto: acompanhar mercado, concorrentes e tecnologias em integração, API Management, Open Finance e IA, e apoiar os Product Managers nas descobertas estratégicas com a visão de viabilidade, complexidade e tecnologia, garantindo que o desenho técnico sirva ao negócio.
  • Liderar a guilda de arquitetura: conduzir o fórum onde os temas comuns aos value streams viram decisões e padrões, escalando ao Diretor quando uma escolha comprometer a estratégia tecnológica. Ser referência para os Staff Engineers e apoiar o desenvolvimento e a sucessão da trilha técnica sênior.
  • Analisar antes de recomendar, e negociar até a decisão: estruturar toda recomendação técnica (problema, requisitos, cenários de solução possíveis e prós e contras), e negociar os trade-offs entre técnica, negócio e conformidade até uma solução sustentável. Nas decisões de alto risco e impacto, apoiar o desenho técnico mitigando riscos de arquitetura, conformidade, resiliência, escalabilidade e eficiência operacional.
  • Ser a face interna e externa da tecnologia de produto: com engenheiros, C-level, outras áreas da Sensedia, clientes e analistas de mercado.
  • Ser referência técnica também na prática: reservar tempo para entregas técnicas relevantes (código, provas de conceito, code review, troubleshooting) e apoiar as squads nos problemas de maior peso técnico.
  • Profundidade e cobertura de requisitos não funcionais: escalabilidade, resiliência, disponibilidade, SLOs, segurança de aplicações e containers, e custo projetados na arquitetura/como critérios de desenho, e não remendados depois.

Quais são os requisitos obrigatórios para esse cargo?

  • Carreira técnica longa e comprovada, transversal a múltiplos produtos ou domínios
  • Histórico de decisões de arquitetura que atravessaram uma organização inteira e sobreviveram ao tempo
  • Experiência prática com IA generativa e agêntica aplicada à arquitetura de produto, incluindo sistemas com LLMs, agentes e plataformas expostas a agentes (MCP, tool-use)
  • Vivência em desenvolvimento de software com orquestração de agentes no dia a dia de construção
  • Experiência em liderar arquitetos ou técnicos seniores por influência e exemplo, sem hierarquia
  • Histórico de influenciar decisões sem autoridade formal, com a confiança de engenheiros, diretoria e C-level
  • Arquiteturas distribuídas e multi-tenant em cloud, em escala
  • Visão de produto, com capacidade de conectar decisões de arquitetura a objetivos de negócio e de clientes
  • Comunicação e negociação com públicos técnicos e executivos, apoiadas em análise estruturada antes de cada recomendação
  • Inglês avançado para leitura técnica e de mercado, e para conversa com clientes e fornecedores

Contexto do ambiente:

  • Linguagens e runtimes: ecossistema JVM (Spring Boot no core, Quarkus/GraalVM no serverless), com Java 8 convivendo com Java 25; Go, Python e Node/TypeScript nos demais serviços
  • Arquitetura: multi-tenant, com separação entre control plane e data plane; event-driven com Kafka e SNS/SQS
  • Infraestrutura e operação: Kubernetes e GitOps (EKS, ArgoCD, Terraform) com centenas de clusters de clientes; observabilidade com OpenTelemetry
  • IA: agêntica no produto e no desenvolvimento (AI Gateway, runtime MCP)

Quais serão os requisitos diferencias para este cargo?

  • Experiência com API Management, Open Finance e iPaaS
  • Identidade e regulatory tech: OAuth/OIDC/mTLS, perfil FAPI, Open Finance e Open Insurance (JWS, DCR, PAR)
  • Espanhol
  • Contexto de setores regulados e compliance (LGPD, PCI, ISO 27001)
  • Experiência em gestão de pessoas

Aqui você vai encontrar:

  • Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (Cartão Flash benefícios), Plano de Saúde, Plano Odontológico, Seguro de Vida, PPR, TotalPass, Auxílio Creche, Programa Well-Being (destinado para saúde física e mental), Universidade Corporativa (nossa #SensediaAcademy), com diversas trilhas de desenvolvimento; Parceiros culturais e educacionais, com descontos especiais; Somos uma empresa cidadã, proporcionando licença maternidade e licença paternidade estendida.

  • Temos #WorkWhereYouBelong como proposta de valor, que é um modelo flexível de trabalho que nos ajuda a aumentar o senso de pertencimento dos Sensediers.
    Trabalhe onde você pertence, porque as barreiras físicas estão menores, e o sentimento é de que exista apenas uma Sensedia em qualquer lugar que você esteja trabalhando.

Esta oportunidade também é para PCD! ;)

Suas experiências são compatíveis? Se candidate e venha conhecer a maior referência de APIs no Brasil! Queremos você em nossa equipe!!

  • Pensando em promover times cada vez mais diversos e ambientes de trabalho plurais, nossa missão é mapear os diferentes públicos que alcançamos com ele! Por isso, faremos algumas perguntinhas relacionadas à diversidade*, tudo bem? =)
*Os dados pessoais e dados pessoais sensíveis coletados serão tratados de acordo com a Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados - Lei n° 13.709/2018

jobs.description:
It's a new day with a new opportunity at 8am!

About the role:

8am is looking for a Salesforce Administrator to own the configuration, design, and functionality of the Salesforce platform that Sales, Marketing, and Customer Operations rely on every day. You’ll have a real impact on how efficiently the whole company works and be a key voice in shaping our systems strategy as we grow.

You’re Salesforce certified, fluent in API-based integrations, and just as comfortable explaining things to non-technical teammates as working through details with engineers. You think like an owner, build for the long term, and love going above and beyond for the people you support.

About us:

At 8am, our vision is to power a world where professionals thrive. We start every day on a mission to empower professionals with the most trusted, innovative technology to deliver world-class outcomes for their clients and exceptional financial results for their business. They count on our purpose-built solutions to simplify operations, ensure compliance, and fuel profitable growth, so they can focus on their clients and do more of the work that matters.

Founded in 2005, 8am™ (formerly AffiniPay) is the professional business platform built to help legal, accounting, and other client-focused professionals run stronger, more profitable businesses. Today, more than 250,000 professionals across the U.S. trust 8am to help them work smarter, serve clients better, and unlock their full potential. We have been recognized as one of Inc 5000’s fastest growing companies in the U.S. for 13 years in a row, and as a result, our teams continue to grow as well!

What you'll do:

  • Own day-to-day configuration, support, maintenance, and customization of our Salesforce instance and its integrations.
  • Partner with stakeholders end to end: uncover the real problem, translate requirements into clear technical designs, balance priorities, and drive a successful launch.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert in business process design: evaluate how teams work today, identify gaps and inefficiencies, and redesign processes so that Salesforce supports them rather than just mirroring them.
  • Design, build, and maintain a scalable, well-governed org architecture, applying best practices to the data model, page layouts, validation rules, and automation.
  • Build with Flow and declarative tools first, make sound build-versus-code decisions, and partner with developers or contribute to Apex and Lightning Web Components when code is the better fit.
  • Manage profiles, roles, permission sets, and sharing settings to uphold high security standards.
  • Deliver fast, friendly user support and monitor data quality and system health, tracing issues to the root cause and implementing permanent fixes.
  • Run a disciplined change management process: every change is documented, reviewed, and approved before moving through QA, UAT, and production.
  • Own release quality through test plans and functional, regression, and UAT testing before anything reaches production.
  • Identify and adopt practical AI capabilities, in Salesforce and beyond, to improve admin productivity and user outcomes.
  • Keep documentation current, build training that grows Salesforce skills across 8am, and collaborate with admins, developers, operations, and enablement teams.
  • Stay current on Salesforce releases and recommend improvements with a long-term mindset.

About you:

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both business and technical teams.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Administrator, with Salesforce Administrator certification preferred (Advanced Administrator or Platform App Builder a plus).
  • A bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent work experience
  • Strong business analysis skills, including requirements gathering, process mapping, and the ability to understand how teams work and translate their needs into well-defined, testable solutions.
  • Ability to diagnose issues to the root cause, prioritize competing requests, and deliver lasting fixes.
  • Strong command of Flow and declarative tools, with a track record of building scalable automation.
  • Working knowledge of Apex and Lightning Web Components, enough to partner with developers and contribute when needed.
  • Solid grasp of the Salesforce data and security models: objects, fields, record types, permission sets, roles, and sharing.
  • Experience with API-based integrations, including configuring, monitoring, and troubleshooting connections between Salesforce and other systems.
  • Curiosity about AI and a habit of testing new tools to work faster and better.
  • Demonstrated experience leveraging AI tools and technologies to improve workflows, enhance decision-making, or drive innovation.

Diversity, equity & inclusion at 8am:

At 8am, we recognize that innovation occurs with a strong team of people who are diverse in background, personality, talent and ideas. Experience comes in many forms and ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace where we continue to learn from each other is an integral part of our culture. We are committed to creating a welcoming and transparent environment for all that embraces those differences through education, equal access to opportunities and information, inclusionary programs, and community outreach.

Why 8am

At 8am, our culture is shaped by the people who bring it to life every day. Together, we build a company rooted in continuous learning, genuine community, holistic wellness, and meaningful engagement—values that empower us as individuals and unite us as a team. Our culture is grounded in our core values: Work Smart, Win Fast; Outshine Ordinary, and We Find a Way. These values drive how we serve our customers and work with each other in a collaborative, inspiring, and empowering environment, every day.

Here’s how we support our 8Team:

  • Statutory Benefits – Full compliance with Colombian social security (health, pension, and risk coverage)
  • Staff Referral Bonus – Rewards for referring great candidates to the 8Team
  • Paid Sick Leave – Covered from day one, with EPS support after the 2nd day
  • Flexible Time Off (FTO) – Up to 15 paid days off per year
  • Parental Leave – Maternity and paternity leave in line with Colombian law
  • Company Holidays – Paid time off for all official Colombian public holidays

Security advisory:

Our hiring teams at 8am are dedicated to recruiting top talent that share our passion for serving the professional services industry through innovative financial technology. As such, our Talent Acquisition Team only follows legitimate hiring practices. We will always communicate with our candidates using emails with the 8am domain and will never ask for sensitive/personal data during the application process. All interviews take place over phone call, Zoom/Google Meet or in person. All offers are communicated verbally by our Talent Acquisition Specialists with a written offer letter as a follow up.
