jobs.description:
Job Description: Service Technology Engineer – Power

Vertiv is seeking a Service Technology Engineer – Power to join our Services Technology team. In this role, you will serve as the technical authority for analyzing system data and driving insights that improve the performance and reliability of digitally enabled Power products. You will collaborate with engineering, technical support, and field service teams to ensure data accuracy, troubleshoot complex issues, and deliver solutions that enhance customer outcomes.

This position plays a critical role in New Product Development and Introduction (NPDI). The Engineer will partner closely with engineering, product management, and service teams throughout the product lifecycle to ensure digital readiness of new Power products, including defining telemetry requirements, validating monitoring capabilities, and enabling seamless integration into Digital Services platforms.

This role provides an opportunity to influence product design, improve serviceability, and shape the future of digital power management across Vertiv’s portfolio. The position is remote, with occasional travel and global team collaboration.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as the subject matter expert for analyzing parametric, telemetric, diagnostic, and alarm data for Power products, driving insights to improve performance and reliability.
  • Collaborate with engineering, product management, technical support, and field service teams to validate data accuracy, troubleshoot issues, and deliver effective remediation strategies.
  • Support New Product Development and Introduction (NPDI) activities by defining telemetry requirements, validating SNMP/MODBUS data models, and ensuring monitoring readiness prior to product release.
  • Participate in design reviews and product development activities to ensure serviceability, observability, and digital integration requirements are incorporated into new designs.
  • Lead onboarding of new products into Digital Services platforms, including data integration, alarm validation, and dashboard readiness.
  • Analyze system performance trends and support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance reliability, efficiency, and service quality.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, knowledge articles, and standards for integrating Power products into Digital Services ecosystems.
  • Collaborate with firmware, controls, and software teams to ensure consistency in data exposure and monitoring capabilities across product families.
  • Support pilot deployments, beta testing, and early field validation of new products, capturing feedback and driving corrective actions.
  • Participate in customer engagements, escalations, and strategic projects as required.

QUALIFICATIONS

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent experience required.
  • Minimum of five years of experience interacting with customers in a technical capacity within data center or mission-critical environments.
  • Strong expertise in Power systems and demonstrated ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Experience working with digital service solutions to monitor, analyze, and troubleshoot Power system data.
  • Proven experience in Power systems diagnostics, performance analysis, and remediation.
  • Experience supporting New Product Development and Introduction (NPDI) activities, including collaboration with engineering and product teams.
  • Familiarity with product lifecycle processes, design reviews, and validation for digital service readiness.
  • Working knowledge of telemetry standards such as SNMP, MODBUS, or API-based data models.
  • Experience with cloud-based platforms for data analysis is highly desirable.
  • Understanding of predictive analytics or machine learning concepts is a plus.
  • Experience in data center environments preferred.
  • Experience collaborating with global or cross-functional teams preferred.

Skills and Competencies

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and time management abilities.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
  • Leadership capability with the ability to guide technical discussions and influence outcomes.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and web-based technologies.

jobs.description:
Job Summary

Job Summary

The Senior Recruiter will be responsible for attracting, screening, and hiring qualified candidates for designated open positions at WellBe Senior Medical, with a primary focus on data and IT roles, including Data Engineers, Data Systems Analysts, and related positions. This individual will deliver a customer-focused recruitment experience and serve as a talent acquisition subject matter expert in support of WellBe’s “Right Hire” talent acquisition strategy.

The Senior Recruiter will apply full-cycle recruitment best practices while partnering with an interdisciplinary team to enhance the candidate experience and provide consultative support to hiring managers and other WellBe associates. Key responsibilities include maintaining consistent communication with hiring teams, sharing talent acquisition metrics and performance standards, and supporting recruitment process transformation and continuous improvement initiatives.

Additionally, this role will promote consistency and compliance with WellBe Senior Medical’s employment policies and programs while contributing to broader Human Resources initiatives.

Job Description

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Candidate Sourcing: Identify and attract qualified candidates through a variety of sourcing channels, extending beyond online platforms to maximize reach and engagement.

  • Talent Pipeline Development: Partner with hiring teams to identify and develop additional candidate pools within designated markets, including alumni networks, professional associations, educational institutions, and training programs.

  • Weekly Sourcing Goals: Consistently develop a pipeline of at least 25 new prospects per week through various sourcing channels, with the goal of converting prospects into candidate screenings.

  • Hiring Manager Partnership: Proactively collaborate with hiring managers to develop sourcing, pipeline development, and candidate screening strategies aligned with WellBe’s “Right Hire” talent acquisition strategy.

  • Full-Cycle Recruitment: Manage the end-to-end recruitment process, including developing sourcing strategies, reviewing resumes, screening candidates, coordinating hiring manager interviews, negotiating offers, and assisting with pre-boarding activities as needed.

  • Recruitment Strategy and Process Improvement: Develop and implement short-term (SWAT) and long-term strategies to improve recruitment outcomes, including employer branding, job postings, workflow optimization, sourcing strategies, and hands-on recruiting efforts.

  • Recruitment Program Development: Provide input into the design, implementation, and coordination of cost-effective recruitment programs that support WellBe’s strategic initiatives and meet established service-level objectives.

  • Communication and Customer Engagement: Develop and implement consistent communication strategies to effectively engage internal and external stakeholders throughout the recruitment process.

  • Compliance and Policy Adherence: Ensure compliance with applicable state and federal employment regulations, as well as WellBe Senior Medical’s employment-related policies and procedures.

  • Pre-Boarding Support: Assist with the implementation, coordination, and ongoing enhancement of pre-boarding processes as needed.

  • Additional Responsibilities: Perform other duties as necessary to support the team’s objectives and achieve organizational goals.

Salary- $75,773 - $126,288/year

Job Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of four years of recruiting experience within a healthcare agency or corporate recruiting environment. A combination of three years of recruiting experience and one year of sourcing experience may be considered.

  • Four years of experience in high-volume sourcing and recruitment production.

  • Knowledge of healthcare recruitment and/or healthcare terminology preferred.

  • Proven track record of successfully recruiting and hiring Data Engineers, Data Analysts, Systems Analysts, or similar technical professionals.

  • Working knowledge of the data and IT landscape, including SQL, Python, ETL processes, data pipelines, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), data warehousing, and business intelligence (BI) tools.

  • Ability to consistently achieve and maintain recruitment metrics and performance expectations appropriate for a Senior Recruiter role.

  • Knowledge of Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO), Office of Federal Contract Compliance Programs (OFCCP) requirements, and applicable employment laws.

  • Proficiency with computer-based applications and recruiting tools, including Google Workspace (G-Suite), Microsoft Office, applicant tracking systems (ATS), particularly iCIMS, online resume mining and sourcing platforms, internet job boards, and interactive media tools.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Demonstrated success in change management and adapting to evolving processes and business needs.

  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

Physical and Mental Requirements

  • Ability to sit or stand for extended periods.

  • Visual acuity and fine motor skills necessary to perform essential job functions.

  • Ability to travel to various locations as needed.

Work Environment

  • Remote position.

  • Travel may be required up to 20%, locally or nationally.

  • This position has no supervisory responsibilities.

Sponsorship Statement

WellBe does not offer employment-based visa sponsorship for this position. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future.

Pay Transparency Statement

Compensation for this position will be disclosed in accordance with applicable state and local pay transparency laws.

Drug Screening Requirement

As a condition of employment, WellBe Senior Medical requires all candidates to successfully complete a pre-employment drug screening. Continued employment may also be contingent upon compliance with the company’s Drug-Free Workplace Policy, which includes random, post-accident, and reasonable suspicion drug testing. The company reserves the right to test for substances that may impair an employee’s ability to safely and effectively perform job duties.

Background Check Statement

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check, as permitted by law. As a healthcare organization, WellBe conducts monthly Fraud and Abuse Control Information System (FACIS) checks on all employees. Continued employment is contingent upon satisfactory results of these checks, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement

WellBe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA)

WellBe Senior Medical is committed to complying with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

If you require an accommodation during the application, interview, or employment process, please contact Human Resources at .

At-Will Employment Statement

Employment with WellBe is at-will unless otherwise specified by contract. This job description does not constitute an employment contract.

Disclaimer

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and qualifications required for the position. Management reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties as necessary.

Associate Director, AP History and Social Science

College Board- AP & Instruction

Location: This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes. This role does need to be based in either the Eastern or Central time zone to align with the broader team's work hours.

Role Type: This is a full time position


About the Team

The AP Curriculum and Assessment Team at College Board (125+ staff) collaborates with colleagues across all aspects of the AP Program to develop, manage, and deliver AP’s 43 courses in a wide variety of subject areas. AP® is a rigorous academic program built on the commitment, passion, and hard work of students and educators from secondary schools and higher education. AP provides willing and academically prepared high school students with the opportunity to study and learn at the college level. AP’s course teams comprised of educators and disciplinary experts ensure that course curricula are aligned to higher education expectations and reflect the state of the art in the discipline, contribute to instructional resources and tools for teachers, and develop assessments that allow students in these courses to demonstrate their mastery of course content and skills. AP leads in strategic use of AI to expand student access, strengthen instructional design and professional support, and enhance assessment creation and exam analysis. The English, World Languages, and Arts department, which includes English Literature, English Language, Spanish Language, Italian Language, French Language, German Language, Chinese Language, Japanese Language, Latin, Music Theory, Spanish Literature, and Art and Design is currently comprised of approximately 35 people supporting 14 courses in the AP portfolio. The Science department, which includes biology, chemistry, physics, psychology, environmental science, and Research, is currently comprised of approximately 25 people supporting 10 courses in the AP portfolio. The History and Social Science department, which includes history, art history, human geography, government and politics, economics, business, African American studies, and Seminar, is currently comprised of approximately 35 people supporting 12 courses in the AP portfolio. The Math, Computer Science, and Cybersecurity department, which includes precalculus, calculus, statistics, computer science, cybersecurity, and networking is currently comprised of approximately 22 people supporting 6 courses in the AP portfolio.


About the Opportunity

As the Associate Director, History and Social Science Assessment Content you are responsible for sourcing texts and drafting items for use on the AP History and Social Science exams. The Associate Director, AP History Assessment Development is the primary point of contact in AP for all stimulus content development and item development for History and Social Science exams collaborating closely with the AP History and Social Science Course Experts who lead all operational assessment development activities. The Associate Director may provide assessment development support in other related subject areas. You will ethically and effectively integrate AI technologies in assessment creation and review. This includes judiciously using AI assisted tools to support fairness, validity, and innovation in AP assessments. You will train SMEs on assessment development protocols, translates between academics and technical experts (psychometricians), and collaborates to develop formative assessment materials and resources to support AP History and Social Science exams.

In this role, you will:

Assessment Development and Scoring (80%) 

  • Independently identifies, selects, reviews, and edits appropriate stimulus material for use in developing assessment items for AP History and Social Sciences, ready for internal and external review.
  • Facilitates the review process (internal and/or external) for all stimulus materials, and adapts future stimulus identification and selection process based on internal and external acceptance criteria for stimulus materials (e.g., permissions, Development Committee review, etc.)
  • With support from your manager, author assessment content, leveraging generative AI to improve and/or make more efficient assessment processes and outputs.
  • As needed, and in collaboration with AP Course Experts, support multiple face-to-face, weekend meetings, and virtual meetings (during work week, evenings, or weekends) annually with the AP Test Development Committee.
  • In collaboration with AP Course Experts support the successful scoring of student responses for AP Exams at the annual scoring event in person and online—the “AP Reading”—and produce AP Reading publications materials for teacher and student use.

Assessment Quality and Process (20%)

  • Contribute to current research and best practices in assessment, and engage regularly with AP Curriculum & Assessment colleagues to align on standards and shared principles guiding AP’s assessment directions
  • Support assessment workstreams within the AP History and Social Science Department.
  • Contribute to processes for efficient, high-quality assessment development
  • Monitor and improve stimulus quality, reliability, fairness, etc.

About You


  • A Master’s degree in History or a directly related discipline, and knowledge of current trends in the discipline (required), although a doctorate in the discipline is strongly preferred
  • Located in Eastern or Central time zone with an ability to work mostly east coast hours.
  • Expertise in AP History (US, World, or European History) with at least 3 years of experience in standardized assessment development or related work; experience with digital assessment and teaching preferred
  • Strong oral and written communication skills, with solid technical proficiency and a customer-focused mindset
  • Excellent organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and maintain close attention to detail, including proofreading
  • Demonstrated ability to implement processes and procedures, manage project plans and schedules, and maintain tracking documentation
  • Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across all levels, and engage in giving and receiving constructive feedback
  • Ability to travel 6-8 times per year, plus up to two additional weeks for the AP Reading; must be eligible to work in the United States

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort with learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.
  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal
  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.
  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.
  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success
  • Authorization to work in the United States

About Our Process

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.
  • While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise such as item review and analysis, live coding, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than a paycheck- we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.

A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  • The hiring range for this role is $60,000-$100,000.
  • Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.
  • We aim to make our best offer upfront, rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.
  • We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more.

Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit .

Team Description

The Privacy and Compliance Engineering team is responsible for preparing Reddit’s platforms for evolving regulatory requirements. We’re building products that establish the foundation of trust in the Reddit platform, while partnering closely with teams across the company to ensure our platforms and features meet the highest standards. Engineers on this team will thrive in dynamic, ambiguous problem spaces and work across multiple domains and technology stacks.

Role Description

We’re hiring a GRC Software Engineer to build and improve the software that supports Reddit’s security and compliance programs. You will design, implement, and maintain integrations, data pipelines, scheduled workflows, and automated checks across cloud, identity, HR, finance, code, and ticketing systems. Working closely with engineering and business partners, you’ll translate requirements into reliable tools that surface issues early and reduce manual work. You’ll own projects from discovery through launch, make clear technical trade-offs, and establish sustainable support with engineering partners.

How You’ll Have Impact:

This role will make Reddit’s compliance programs more effective and scalable by building systems that help teams address requirements early and automate recurring assurance work. You’ll work with engineers and control owners to define clear requirements, deliver practical solutions, and follow through after launch. Your work will improve how controls operate, make evidence more timely and reliable, and surface gaps sooner. Success means dependable systems that teams continue to use, less manual work, faster remediation, and clearer visibility into risk.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own software projects from discovery through launch: work with partners to define the problem, agree on success measures, make technical trade-offs clear, deliver the solution, and follow through on results.
  • Lead efforts to automate evidence collection across key systems in scope for SOX and other compliance requirements. Work with control owners and system teams to define evidence requirements, build and validate integrations, monitor failures, and establish ongoing support.
  • Build and maintain integrations and scheduled workflows across cloud, identity, HR, finance, ticketing, version control, CI/CD, and GRC systems.
  • Use APIs, scripts, queries, and orchestration tools to collect, normalize, validate, and retain data from authoritative systems. Own authentication, data modeling, testing, monitoring, failure recovery, documentation, and maintenance.
  • Design data models that connect risks, controls, assets, owners, systems, and evidence across sources with different schemas, identifiers, permissions, and data quality.
  • Build automated checks that detect missing, stale, inconsistent, or out-of-policy data, and route actionable failures to the right owners.
  • Turn control requirements and audit requests into data specifications, testable checks, and exception logic. Partner with control owners to validate system scope and resolve gaps.
  • Build strong working relationships across Security, Engineering, Infrastructure, Product, Privacy, Legal, and Finance. Learn how their systems operate and deliver tools, monitoring, and runbooks they can rely on after launch.

Role Requirements:

  • 7+ years of experience in security, compliance, automation, data integration, security engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Hands-on proficiency with Python, Go, or a comparable language and SQL, including writing, testing, reviewing, and maintaining code used by other people or operational workflows.
  • Experience building API-based integrations using REST APIs, webhooks or polling, authentication flows, pagination, rate limits, error handling, and structured data formats.
  • Experience building scheduled data workflows with an orchestrator such as Airflow and moving validated data between enterprise SaaS systems, databases, and cloud object storage.
  • Technical fluency with a major cloud platform and its identity, storage, logging, monitoring, and secrets-management services; GCP experience is helpful but not required.
  • Experience with version control, automated testing, code review, CI/CD, observability, secure credential handling, failure recovery, and the runbooks needed to support an integration after launch.
  • Practical knowledge of security and compliance controls, including how requirements translate into system design, evidence, testing, and remediation. Experience applying one or more relevant frameworks or regulatory requirements, such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, SOX ITGC, NIST CSF, EU DSA, or EU NIS 2.
  • Demonstrated ability to earn trust and influence without authority by listening carefully, making risk and technical trade-offs clear, reducing partner burden where possible, addressing concerns directly, and following through on commitments. You can independently own complex projects from discovery through launch and measurable results.

jobs.excerpt: JUNTE-SE À NOSSA EQUIPE A MUST está comprometida com a formação de uma força de trabalho global em um ambiente diverso e inclusivo, oferecendo iguais oportunidades de crescimento pessoal, profissional e social.
jobs.description:
JUNTE-SE À NOSSA EQUIPE

A MUST está comprometida com a formação de uma força de trabalho global em um ambiente diverso e inclusivo, oferecendo iguais oportunidades de crescimento pessoal, profissional e social.

Se você se identifica com nossa visão, junte-se à nossa equipe e encontre seu lugar em nossas vagas para Corpo Docente ou Posições Administrativas.

POR QUE TRABALHAR CONOSCO?

  • Ambiente global
  • Flexibilidade
  • Crescimento
  • Contribuição para a formação de futuros profissionais

Sobre a posição

O Capstone Advisor orienta estudantes de pós-graduação em todas as fases do Projeto Final (Capstone), garantindo rigor acadêmico e acompanhamento contínuo do progresso. A função combina orientação individualizada, participação em bancas de avaliação, gestão documental e monitoramento proativo do engajamento dos alunos no Learning Management System (LMS).

O sucesso neste cargo requer profundo conhecimento técnico na área, sólida orientação em metodologia de pesquisa e compromisso em promover uma experiência acadêmica inclusiva e motivadora.

Responsabilidades

  • Realizar encontros com os estudantes conforme o calendário pré-aprovado de orientação, oferecendo direcionamento sobre escolha de tema, desenho de pesquisa e marcos do projeto.
  • Acompanhar cada etapa do Projeto Final, verificar entregas intermediárias e garantir o cumprimento dos prazos estabelecidos.
  • Participar das bancas formais de defesa dos estudantes designados; avaliar de forma justa as apresentações e entregas finais.
  • Preparar e enviar todos os formulários necessários para formalizar, registrar e monitorar o progresso dos estudantes no processo de Capstone.
  • Revisar regularmente a atividade no LMS, confirmar as postagens obrigatórias dos estudantes e intervir preventivamente quando indicadores de desempenho estiverem abaixo do esperado.
  • Incentivar o engajamento contínuo dos estudantes em todas as fases do projeto, fornecendo feedback construtivo e pontual.
  • Participar de sessões de coordenação do programa, reuniões obrigatórias e workshops de capacitação.
  • Incentivar a participação dos estudantes e, quando possível, contribuir para inspirar novas turmas.
  • Executar outras tarefas inerentes à função e projetos designados pelo Vice-Presidente de Assuntos Acadêmicos.

Qualificações

  • Grau terminal — Doutorado (PhD, EdD, DBA ou equivalente) na área relevante ou relacionada; histórico de publicações acadêmicas.
  • Mínimo de dois (2) anos de experiência orientando pesquisas de pós-graduação ou supervisionando trabalhos de tese/capstone; sucesso comprovado em ambientes virtuais ou híbridos.
  • Proficiência (fala, leitura e escrita) em inglês. Português ou espanhol são diferenciais.
  • Conhecimento avançado em metodologia de pesquisa e normas de escrita acadêmica.
  • Domínio de plataformas LMS (Canvas, Moodle, Blackboard) e MS Teams.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de acompanhamento de dados (ex.: Business Analytics).
  • Forte capacidade organizacional, disciplina com prazos e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Habilidade para fornecer feedback empático, porém rigoroso.

jobs.description:
Universal Technical Resource Services, Inc. (UTRS) is currently seeking a C-37 MFOQA Analyst to join our team! At UTRS, we enjoy the benefits of working in a collaborative environment of close-knit team members. As a company, we provide a wide range of leading-edge engineering, management, and digital services to the public and private sectors. We are looking for someone that will support our mission to consistently deliver creative, high-quality, technology-based services to our customers on time and within budget.

This position, C-37 Military Flight Operations Quality Assurance (MFOQA) Flight Data Analyst (FDA), works with the Air Mobility Command (AMC) MFOQA Program Manager to measure and manage operational safety hazards and trends across the C-37 fleet for MFOQA program enhancement and support. Additionally, the FDA enhances flight safety through the management and analysis of data collected from MFOQA utilizing the Safety Integrated Risk Information System (S-IRIS) and state-of-the-art commercial data visualization software programs. This position is remote.

What will you be doing?

This position will be a key member of the UTRS Aviation Safety Technology team. Duties include:

  • Utilize software to analyze recorded aircraft information/flight data in relation to Triggered Events (TEs) and Routine Operational Measurements (ROMs); verify and validate aircraft specific measurement sets; generate flight operations trends and special studies; and detect hazardous conditions and risks.
  • Assist AMC MFOQA Program Manager to support AMC's Aviation Safety Action program (ASAP).
  • Advocate MFOQA/ASAP program goals, benefits, and proper uses within AMC, and the AF, including AFSEC's Proactive Aviation Safety.
  • Assist analysis team in developing, deploying, and sustaining processes that facilitate the collection, reporting, analysis, quality control, and visualization of MFOQA and ASAP data and transformation into actionable information for identifying, assessing, mitigating, and tracking operational hazards.
  • Provide knowledge of Airlift/Airlift operational environments, the missions flown, and the maneuvers performed during those missions.
  • Interface regularly with analysis team, AMC staff, AFSEC staff, and units to identify areas of interest; generate analysis products; present emerging trends, hazards, and risks; and disseminate (within and outside AMC/MAF) analysis results and corrective actions.
  • Collaborate with the AMC MFOQA Program Manager to identify trends and deviations from standard procedures and parameters; identify corrective actions; coordinate implementation of corrective actions with AMC staff; and evaluate effectiveness of any corrective actions undertaken.
  • Assist in the development, evaluation, monitoring, and compliance with MFOQA/ASAP regulations, policies, standards, and procedures.
  • Generate informational articles, briefings, case studies, cost benefit analysis, marketing materials, and training materials to stakeholders and designated users throughout the MAF and targeted bases on MFOQA and ASAP safety findings, corrective actions, program plans, goals, objectives, benefits, schedule, and the road ahead.
  • Assist AMC MFOQA Program Manager with the development of long-term funding needs and POM submittals.
  • Support MFOQA/ASAP-related meetings, including MFOQA Program Management Reviews, meetings with Sister Services, Aircraft Information Working Groups, System Safety Groups, industry safety forums, and presentations to Air Staff, AMC, AFSEC, and program office personnel.
  • Participate in working groups and design reviews to ensure that MFOQA requirements are included in any proposed upgrades to flight recorders and other data acquisition systems.

What skills will the ideal candidate have to be successful?

This position will require the following skillsets and experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher
  • 10 years of flight experience as an airlift pilot
  • Joint, HAF, MAJCOM, or NAF staff experience a plus
  • Formal USAF Safety Training a plus
  • General knowledge of the Guard and Reserve component of AMC
  • Technical requirements
    • Military aviation experience and extensive knowledge of airlift aircraft operational environments, operating characteristics, standards, missions flown, and the maneuvers performed for military airlift aircraft.
    • Knowledge of and experience with aviation safety programs, including MFOQA, ASAP, and LOSA, and operational risk management and processes.
    • Proven ability to collaborate with all echelons, from headquarters staff to squadron operations and maintenance.
  • Analytical and database software proficiency desired (Excel, Tableau, etc.)
  • S. Citizenship required? Yes
  • Security Clearance? Yes (Secret)
  • Travel required? Yes (Anticipate travel approximately 1 trip every 3-6 months.)

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt: About ImprovadoImprovado is a marketing data and AI analytics platform for enterprise brands and agencies.
jobs.description:
About Improvado

Improvado is a marketing data and AI analytics platform for enterprise brands and agencies. We connect 500+ marketing and sales data sources, normalize them through a governed data model, and put an AI agent on top so marketing teams can ask questions of their own data without going through BI or IT.

What we sell: extraction and 500+ connectors; data transformation (SQL and dbt-compatible); Marketing Data Governance — taxonomy, naming, data-quality rules; warehouse and storage; dashboards; AI agent and MCP access to live marketing data; DECS, data engineering as a service on a 2 to 4 week SLA.

Who buys it:

  • Economic buyers: CMO, VP Marketing, VP Demand Gen, agency COO and ops leadership
  • Technical evaluators: VP or Director of Marketing Analytics, marketing analysts, data engineering, sometimes IT and security
  • Segments: enterprise brands, mid-market, agencies
  • Verticals: pharma and healthcare, financial services, retail and eCommerce, gaming, agencies

Why this role, now

  • Our messaging is not aligned. Positioning, web, sales pitch, product and content each carry a different version of what Improvado is. The market categorizes us as "marketing ETL" while we position as an AI marketing analytics platform. That gap costs us deal quality and price.
  • The category is crowded and moving fast. Battlecards exist but decay, and nobody owns keeping them true.
  • Attribution, incrementality and causal measurement is where deals are won and lost — and it is the hardest thing to argue credibly without hand-waving.
  • Analyst firms are a silent blocker. When an enterprise buyer asks Gartner or Forrester about Improvado, there is no briefed narrative waiting for them.

You would not start from a blank page. We already have a positioning registry, roughly 11 documented buyer personas, a pain-point and value-prop library, competitor intel reports and about 10 battlecards. They are inconsistent and under-used. Your first job is to make one version true and make people use it.

What you'll own

  • Positioning and messaging. Core positioning, category framing and message hierarchy across ICPs and personas. ICP and persona documentation that is used, not filed. The messaging layer of new product and feature launches, including the internal rollout that makes the field able to sell it.
  • Competitive intelligence and win/loss. A structured win/loss interview program with quarterly readouts. Living battlecards. Monitoring competitor positioning, pricing and product moves, and driving our counter-positioning.
  • Sales enablement. The core pitch narrative, demo storyline and objection-handling framework. The messaging components of new-rep onboarding. A standing weekly cadence with Sales leadership — not quarterly check-ins. Direct support on competitive and enterprise deals: RFPs, security and technical evaluations, displacement plays.
  • Market and analyst relations. The Improvado narrative for Gartner, Forrester and category influencers, so that a buyer's analyst call becomes an accelerator rather than a blocker. Feeding structured market and buyer insight back into product prioritization.

What we're looking for

  • 4 to 8 years in product marketing, or an equivalent blend of product marketing with marketing analytics, marketing or data ops, sales engineering, analytics consulting, or product management on a data product.
  • Category fluency in marketing data and measurement: attribution models, incrementality testing, MMM, data governance and taxonomy, warehouses and ETL/ELT — including where each is honestly weak.
  • B2B SaaS sold to marketing or data buyers. Marketing analytics, martech, measurement, CDP, BI and data-infrastructure vendors are the reference profile.
  • Proof you have shipped, not just documented: positioning that changed the website and the pitch, battlecards reps actually opened, a win/loss program that survived past its second quarter.
  • Writing that survives contact with a skeptical technical buyer — claim and evidence, not adjective stacking.
  • Comfort operating close to Sales: weekly cadence, deal reviews, live calls, direct feedback.

Nice to have: hands-on SQL, dbt or BI, enough to validate a claim yourself. Experience marketing AI capabilities without hype. Analyst-relations experience. Agency-side or enterprise-brand background. Vertical depth in pharma and healthcare, financial services, retail and eCommerce, or gaming.

Not a fit if: your product marketing has been mostly launch logistics and content calendars; you need a fully staffed team and a finished brand system to be effective; you are uncomfortable being told in a deal review that your messaging did not work.

How we measure success

  • Win rate in competitive deals against our top 3 named competitors, baseline set in month 1.
  • Stage-to-stage conversion on open opportunities, particularly discovery to demo to proposal.
  • Time-to-first-deal for new reps.
  • Field adoption of enablement assets — measured, not assumed.
  • Win/loss program running on cadence, with themes that visibly change product and GTM decisions.
  • Message consistency: a quarterly audit across web, deck, product UI and content.

What We Offer

  • Remote-first environment
  • Strong product/market fit: marketing data product for US-based enterprises
  • 20 working days of PTO per year
  • US holidays and additional days off
  • Professional development reimbursement

You will set the plan for stress, fault injection, and regression tests of the core platform software, and for pulling integration tests other teams wrote into suites that run together. You will also put an on-call rotation, triage, and vehicle and release enablement in place to support the customer-facing products and services of our team.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Platform Test: Own software platform-level test suites, and the work of combining and improving integration tests other teams wrote so they run as one suite. Run release qualification, regression, and bring-up campaigns on HIL, SIL, and vehicle setups.
  • Production Support: Own on-call for onboard core software on the car and for the services supported by our team including software deployment and vehicle data ingestion.
  • Team Leadership: Hire and develop this team. You own priorities, performance, and career growth for the people on it. You will stay close enough to the tests and the incident queue to hold the bar, and you will build leads who can run a slice of the work on their own.

  • Education: BS or MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent knowledge and work experience.
  • Experience: 10+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team of engineers. This should be in a field where software runs on physical hardware, or on the infrastructure used to build and operate it, such as automotive, robotics, aerospace, or large device fleets.
  • Test or Support Depth: You have owned platform or system-level testing (stress, fault injection, integration suites, release campaigns) or production support (on-call, incident triage, postmortems) for software other teams depend on.

  • Hands-on experience with hardware-in-the-loop, software-in-the-loop, or simulation infrastructure, as someone who has run test campaigns on it or written requirements for it.

We are seeking a strategic and highly analytical Enterprise Application Architect to bridge the gap between our business objectives and technical execution within our Telehealth platform. In this critical role, you will be responsible for understanding and documenting our current technical landscape, designing resilient future-state architectures, and driving the complex technical strategy required to achieve and maintain our FedRAMP certification.

You will serve as a technical north star for our engineering teams, balancing the need for rapid innovation with strict adherence to security, compliance, and scalability standards. Crucially, you will architect and enforce the codebase branching and release management strategies that allow our commercial and government offerings to coexist efficiently without accumulating massive technical debt. If you excel at translating complex technical concepts for executive stakeholders, mentoring senior technical talent, and navigating the nuances of multi-environment, highly-regulated architectures (including both FedRAMP and HIPAA), we want you on our team.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership & Vision

  • Current & Future State Architecture: Document the current architectural state and draft comprehensive future-state target architectures.
  • FedRAMP Certification Architecture: Serve as the primary technical driver for FedRAMP authorization. Define clear system boundaries, evaluate and mandate compliant component choices (e.g., FIPS 140-2/3 validated cryptography), and lead technical remediation efforts to address audit findings and POA&Ms (Plan of Action and Milestones).
  • Advanced Branch Management & Alignment: Design, implement, and enforce a sustainable branching, merging, and release strategy across commercial and government environments. Prevent codebase drift, manage feature toggling across compliance boundaries, and optimize shared services while maintaining strict FedRAMP isolation requirements.
  • Future-Proofing & AI/ML Strategy: Lay the architectural groundwork for future Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI/ML) integrations, evaluating where these technologies can drive business value and enhance user experiences in upcoming product builds.
  • Business Alignment: Actively align technology initiatives and roadmaps with overarching business goals.
  • Lifecycle & Debt Management: Manage technology roadmapping, oversee lifecycle management, and proactively identify and mitigate technical debt incurred by parallel commercial/government product development.
  • Strategic Evaluation: Conduct "buy vs. build" analyses, vendor evaluations, and provide architectural input on requirement reviews and Level of Effort (LOE) estimations.

Technical Design & Standards

  • Telehealth & Real-Time Communications: Architect highly scalable, low-latency integrations for video technology and telephony systems that serve as the backbone of our Telehealth offerings.
  • System Optimization: Make actionable recommendations for improvements to platform performance, scalability, stability, and security.
  • Architecture Modernization: Guide the strategic transition and considerations between microservices and monolithic architectures.
  • Integration & Interoperability: Define API strategy, governance, and system integration patterns to ensure seamless interoperability.
  • Data Oversight: Collaborate on data flow architectures and provide oversight for data modeling best practices.

Compliance & Security

  • Government Compliance Enforcement: Translate FedRAMP (Moderate/High), DoD SRG, or other government compliance frameworks into actionable, testable engineering requirements and architectural patterns.
  • Healthcare Compliance & Data Privacy: Ensure all architectures strictly comply with HIPAA, safeguarding Protected Health Information (PHI), alongside other data privacy regulations such as GDPR and CCPA.
  • Secure Architecture: Drive the implementation of Zero-Trust architecture paradigms.
  • Identity Management: Collaborate with security teams on robust Identity and Access Management (IAM) strategies.

Process & Methodology

  • Agile/DevOps Integration: Integrate architectural workflows within Agile and SAFe frameworks.
  • Deployment Excellence: Align architectural standards with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps best practices, specifically accounting for deployment pipelines into distinct commercial and GovCloud environments.
  • Innovation Testing: Lead the development and evaluation of Proof of Concepts (PoCs) for emerging technologies, including early-stage exploration of AI/ML tooling.
  • Business Continuity: Participate in disaster recovery planning and ensure architectures support strict business continuity requirements.

Collaboration & Mentorship

  • Cross-Functional Communication: Bridge the communication gap between product management and engineering teams.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Translate complex technical concepts, trade-offs, and strategies into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Mentorship: Mentor senior developers and tech leads, fostering a continuous culture of technical excellence and collaborative problem-solving.

Requirements

  • Experience: 8+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3+ years in an enterprise architectural role.
  • FedRAMP & GovCloud Experience: Proven, hands-on experience architecting software for FedRAMP authorization, including deep familiarity with government cloud environments (e.g., AWS GovCloud, Azure Government) and boundary isolation requirements.
  • Technical Depth: Deep understanding of cloud architectures (AWS/Azure/GCP), API gateways, microservices, complex source control management (SCM) strategies for parallel release tracks, modern deployment pipelines, video/telephony integrations, and data models in a Ruby on Rails environment.
  • Emerging Tech: Familiarity or hands-on experience with AI/ML architectural concepts and large language model (LLM) integrations is a strong plus.
  • Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with a track record of influencing executive leadership.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

jobs.excerpt: Analyste qualité intermédiaire en automatisation – Adhésion des marchands et acquisition En tant qu'analyste qualité intermédiaire au sein de l'équipe d'adhésion des marchands (Merchant Onboarding), vous jouerez un rôle essentiel en garantissant la qualité, la fiabilité et la performance des intégrations qui permettent aux nouveaux marchands de rejoindre la plateforme PayFacto, tant dans notre application Web que dans nos API.
jobs.description:
Analyste qualité intermédiaire en automatisation – Adhésion des marchands et acquisition

En tant qu'analyste qualité intermédiaire au sein de l'équipe d'adhésion des marchands (Merchant Onboarding), vous jouerez un rôle essentiel en garantissant la qualité, la fiabilité et la performance des intégrations qui permettent aux nouveaux marchands de rejoindre la plateforme PayFacto, tant dans notre application Web que dans nos API. Vous prendrez en charge les tests de vos fonctionnalités, de la planification jusqu'à la mise en production, en travaillant de façon autonome et en étroite collaboration avec les développeurs, les gestionnaires de produits et l'équipe de support à la clientèle.

Principales responsabilités :

  1. Planification et conception des tests : Analyser les exigences et les récits utilisateurs liés aux parcours d'adhésion des marchands, puis concevoir des plans de test, des cas de test et des scénarios couvrant l'application Web et les API, en appliquant des techniques reconnues (partitions d'équivalence, valeurs limites, tests basés sur les risques).
  2. Tests de l'application Web : Effectuer des tests fonctionnels, de bout en bout et exploratoires de l'application Web d'adhésion des marchands, notamment les formulaires, les validations, le téléversement de documents et les flux de statut.
  3. Tests d'API : Tester les API REST utilisées dans les intégrations d'adhésion des marchands à l'aide de Postman, en validant les requêtes, les réponses, les codes de statut, la gestion des erreurs, l'authentification et les contrats de données.
  4. Automatisation des tests : Concevoir, développer et maintenir des tests automatisés d'interface et d'API avec Playwright et TypeScript, et contribuer à leur intégration dans le pipeline CI/CD.
  5. Tests d'intégration et validation des données : Vérifier les flux de données de bout en bout entre l'application Web, les API et les systèmes internes ou tiers (p. ex. vérification d'identité, souscription, configuration du compte marchand) afin d'assurer l'exactitude et la cohérence des données.
  6. Tests de règlement et de rapprochement : Valider les flux d'acquisition (acquiring) afin de s'assurer que les transactions des marchands nouvellement intégrés sont réglées correctement, que les frais, les montants versés et les calendriers de versement correspondent à la configuration du marchand, et que les fichiers de règlement et les rapports de rapprochement concordent avec les données transactionnelles.
  7. Tests de régression : Maintenir et exécuter les suites de tests de régression, manuelles et automatisées, afin de détecter rapidement les problèmes introduits par les nouvelles versions, les correctifs ou les changements d'intégration.
  8. Gestion des défauts : Documenter, suivre et classer par ordre de priorité les défauts à l'aide d'outils de suivi, avec des étapes de reproduction claires, et collaborer avec les développeurs pour en assurer la résolution rapide.
  9. Autonomie et responsabilisation : Prendre en charge les tests des fonctionnalités qui vous sont assignées, gérer vos priorités et signaler de façon proactive les risques et les enjeux de qualité, avec un minimum de supervision.
  10. Collaboration et partage des connaissances : Participer aux cérémonies Agile, communiquer les résultats des tests et partager les meilleures pratiques avec l'équipe afin de favoriser une culture de qualité et d'amélioration continue.

Qualifications :

  • Baccalauréat ou diplôme d'études collégiales en informatique, en technologie de l'information ou dans un domaine connexe, ou expérience équivalente.
  • Au moins 3 ans d'expérience en assurance qualité ou en tests logiciels.
  • Solides connaissances théoriques et pratiques en assurance qualité : niveaux et types de tests, techniques de conception de tests, cycle de vie des défauts et stratégies de test. Une certification ISTQB est un atout.
  • Expérience pratique de l'automatisation des tests avec Playwright et TypeScript (ou JavaScript).
  • Solide expérience des tests d'API REST avec Postman (collections, environnements, scripts et assertions). La connaissance de Newman est un atout.
  • Capacité à travailler de façon autonome, à gérer ses priorités et à prendre en charge ses livrables du début à la fin.
  • Solides compétences en matière d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes, avec un grand souci du détail.
  • Excellentes aptitudes à la communication et à la collaboration au sein d'équipes interfonctionnelles. Le bilinguisme (français et anglais) est un atout.
  • Connaissance des méthodologies Agile, de Git et des pipelines CI/CD.
  • Connaissance du domaine de l'acquisition (acquiring), en particulier des processus de règlement et de rapprochement : cycle de vie d'une transaction (autorisation, capture, compensation, règlement, versement), frais d'interchange et de traitement, et rétrofacturations.
  • Une expérience en adhésion des marchands ou en technologies financières est un atout.

À propos de nous :

  • Nous fournissons des solutions de paiement et de points de vente entièrement intégrées aux restaurants, aux hôtels et aux bars.
  • Nous sommes reconnus pour nos systèmes de point de vente à la fine pointe de la technologie (Veloce et Maitre'D).
  • Nous avons des bureaux au Canada, aux États-Unis et en Europe

Nous offrons :

  • Une couverture médicale et dentaire dès le premier jour
  • Télémédecine 24/7
  • Cotisation REER
  • Des vacances et des jours personnels

Rejoignez-nous pour façonner l'expérience d'adhésion des marchands à notre plateforme de paiement, et contribuez à offrir une valeur inégalée à nos clients.

Vous souhaitez faire partie de l'ADN de PayFacto alors que nous atteignons de nouveaux sommets ? Postulez maintenant !

********************************

Intermediate QA Automation Analyst – Merchant Onboarding & Acquiring

As an Intermediate Quality Analyst on our Merchant Onboarding team, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of the integrations that bring new merchants onto the PayFacto platform, across both our web application and our APIs. You will own testing for your features from planning through release, working independently while partnering closely with software developers, product managers, and customer support.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Test Planning & Design: Analyze requirements and user stories for merchant onboarding flows, and design test plans, test cases, and scenarios covering the web application and APIs, applying sound techniques such as equivalence partitioning, boundary value analysis, and risk-based testing.
  2. Web Application Testing: Perform functional, end-to-end, and exploratory testing of the merchant onboarding web application, including forms, validations, document uploads, and status workflows.
  3. API Testing: Test the REST APIs used in merchant onboarding integrations with Postman, validating requests, responses, status codes, error handling, authentication, and data contracts.
  4. Test Automation: Design, build, and maintain automated UI and API tests using Playwright and TypeScript and contribute to integrating them into the CI/CD pipeline.
  5. Integration & Data Validation: Verify end-to-end data flows between the web application, APIs, and internal or third-party systems (e.g., identity verification, underwriting, merchant account setup) to ensure merchant data is accurate and consistent.
  6. Settlement & Reconciliation Testing: Validate acquiring flows to ensure transactions for newly onboarded merchants settle correctly, that fees, funding amounts, and payout schedules match the merchant's configuration, and that settlement files and reconciliation reports balance against transaction records.
  7. Regression Testing: Maintain and execute manual and automated regression suites to quickly catch issues introduced by new releases, patches, or integration changes.
  8. Defect Management: Document, track, and prioritize defects using defect tracking tools, with clear reproduction steps, and collaborate with developers to ensure timely resolution.
  9. Ownership & Autonomy: Take ownership of testing for assigned features, manage your own priorities, and proactively raise risks and quality concerns with minimal supervision.
  10. Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing: Participate in Agile ceremonies, communicate test results, and share best practices with the team to foster a culture of quality and continuous improvement.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or college diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in quality assurance or software testing.
  • Solid grasp of QA theory and practice: test levels and types, test design techniques, defect lifecycle, and test strategy. ISTQB certification is an asset.
  • Hands-on experience automating tests with Playwright and TypeScript (or JavaScript).
  • Strong experience testing REST APIs with Postman (collections, environments, scripts, and assertions). Experience with Newman is an asset.
  • Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and own deliverables from start to finish.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with meticulous attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills in cross-functional teams. Bilingualism (French and English) is an asset.
  • Knowledge of Agile methodologies, Git, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Knowledge of the acquiring domain, particularly settlement and reconciliation processes: the transaction lifecycle (authorization, capture, clearing, settlement, funding), interchange and processing fees, and chargebacks.
  • Experience in merchant onboarding or fintech is a plus.

About us:

  • We provide fully integrated payment and point of sales solutions to restaurants, hotels and bars
  • We are known for our state-of-the-art point of sales systems (Veloce and Maitre’D)
  • We have offices in Canada, US and Europe

We offer:

  • Medical and dental coverage as of Day 1
  • Telemedicine 24/7
  • RRSP contribution
  • Vacation and personal days

Join us in shaping how merchants are onboarded to our payment platform and contribute to delivering unparalleled value to our clients and customers.

Are you looking to be part of our PayFacto DNA as we climb to new heights? Apply now!

Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions.

About the Role:

The Sr. Director, People Solutions leads the technology, data, and operational backbone of the People function. This leader owns three connected areas: our HR systems (Workday and the applicant tracking system), People Analytics, and People Operations. The goal is a seamless employee and manager experience, reliable data, and insights that inform business decisions.

You will set the strategy and roadmap for People technology, build a culture of data-driven decision-making, and ensure core HR processes run accurately, compliantly, and efficiently as the company scales. This is a key role and thought partner to the CPO and the People leadership team.

Responsibilities

    People Systems (Workday and ATS)

  • Own the vision, roadmap, and governance for Workday HCM (and any additional modules such as Recruiting, Compensation, Talent, Learning, or Absence) and the ATS.

  • Lead system configuration, releases, and optimization, including Workday’s twice-yearly releases, testing, change management, and communications.

  • Partner with IT, Finance, Security, and Legal on integrations, data privacy, access controls, audit readiness, and SOX or other compliance requirements.

  • Manage vendor relationships, contracts, budgets, and performance, and evaluate new tools in the HR tech ecosystem.

  • Drive adoption and user experience improvements through automation, self-service, and process simplification.

  • Develop and implement a comprehensive strategy for utilizing AI tools to enable the People team.

    • People Analytics

  • Build and lead the People Analytics function: workforce planning, headcount and attrition reporting, DEI metrics, engagement and talent analytics, compensation analysis, and recruiting funnel metrics.

  • Establish a single source of truth for People data, with clear definitions, data quality standards, and governance.

  • Deliver dashboards and executive-level reporting that translate data into actionable insights for the CPO, executive team, and Board.

  • Develop predictive and advanced analytics capabilities, such as retention risk and workforce modeling, as the organization matures.

    • People Operations

  • Oversee core People Ops processes: onboarding and offboarding, employee lifecycle transactions, HR data administration, employment verification, immigration and mobility support (as applicable), and policy administration.

  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, and international employment regulations and reporting requirements.

  • Define and monitor service levels, case management, and continuous improvement for the People service model.

  • Standardize and scale processes to support growth, acquisitions, and organizational change.

    • Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team across systems, analytics, and operations.

  • Serve as a member of the People leadership team, contributing to enterprise People strategy, planning, and budgeting.

  • Build strong partnerships across the People Team and other Corporate functions.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in HR operations, HR technology, People analytics, or related areas, including 5+ years leading teams.

  • Deep, hands-on expertise with Workday HCM, including configuration, reporting, security, and release management.

  • Experience managing an ATS (e.g., Greenhouse, Lever, iCIMS, Workday Recruiting) and its integrations.

  • Demonstrated success building analytics capabilities and presenting insights to senior executives.

  • Strong understanding of HR processes, employment compliance, and data privacy requirements.

  • Proven ability to manage large cross-functional projects, vendors, and budgets.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical and data concepts to non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Workday certification(s) or equivalent depth of experience.

  • Experience with BI and analytics tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Workday Prism, Visier) and working knowledge of SQL.

  • Experience scaling People Operations/HRIS in a high-growth or multi-country environment.

  • Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business, Information Systems, Analytics, or a related field. Master’s degree or HR certifications (SHRM, HRCI) a plus.

An extraordinarily talented group of individuals work together every day to drive TNS' success, from both professional and personal perspectives.Come join the excellence!

Overview

Our Enterprise Business Systems Group is seeking a Senior Business Systems Analyst – Billing & Quote to Cash to join our team connecting technology with evolving business needs.
This role will serve as a senior business systems analyst supporting TNS's billing applications and end-to-end quote-to-cash processes. The position will partner closely with Finance, Commercial, Product, Sales Operations, and Technology teams to translate business needs into scalable system and process solutions across quoting, ordering, billing, invoicing, and related revenue processes.
The successful candidate will develop deep functional and technical knowledge of the applications that enable TNS's quote-to-cash capabilities, with particular emphasis on Salesforce and Expedite Commerce and their integration with other enterprise and billing systems. TikTok Specialist

Join the Zulay Kitchen Team!

Zulay Kitchen is a fast-growing consumer products brand creating innovative, practical, and affordable kitchen products that make everyday life easier.

About the Role

The TikTok Specialist will help manage and grow Zulay Kitchen's TikTok presence, including content planning, TikTok Shop operations, affiliate coordination, and performance monitoring.

We're looking for someone with hands-on experience managing TikTok accounts or TikTok Shop for an e-commerce brand who understands the platform, keeps up with trends, and knows how to turn content and engagement into business results.

You don't need to know everything, but you should have a solid understanding of TikTok, be creative, data-driven, and comfortable testing new ideas to improve performance.

Key Responsibilities

TikTok Content Strategy & Management

Performance Tracking & Optimization

Platform Updates & Growth Opportunities

You're also organized and take ownership of your work. You can manage multiple campaigns and priorities while staying on top of platform updates and new opportunities.

jobs.excerpt: About MISUMI AmericasMISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions.
jobs.description:
About MISUMI Americas

MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.

About the Foundation

MISUMI Imprint Foundation is the first corporate giving organization in MISUMI Group's history. It launched in October 2026 with a $2 million seed investment from MISUMI Americas and a mandate to fund the people who will build the physical world.

The reasoning is straightforward. MISUMI supplies the components that engineers design into machines, and as AI moves out of software and into factories, vehicles, operating rooms, and orbit, demand is rising for engineers, machinists, and technicians who can build hardware that works safely and reliably in the real world. The United States is not producing enough of them. The Foundation exists to widen that pipeline.

We make grants in three areas:

  • Scholarships & Access — need-based support for first-generation and underrepresented students in engineering, manufacturing, and supply chain, at four-year universities and community colleges alike
  • Maker Programs — equipment grants for manufacturing labs, engineering team sponsorships, maker spaces, and student hackathons
  • Industry–Academia Bridges — curricula built around real manufacturing problems, internship and apprenticeship pathways, mentorship and career support

The Foundation launched under the fiscal sponsorship of the SME Education Foundation and has filed for independent 501(c)(3) public charity status. Its defining structural feature is partner co-investment: MISUMI's global supplier partners are invited to contribute annually and join the Foundation Advisory Board, with seats at three tiers — Founding, Growth, and Community Partner.

About the role

This is a founding role. The mission is set, the seed capital is committed, and the board is in place. Almost everything else is yours to build: the first grant cycle, the review criteria, the partner program, the measurement framework, and the independent organization itself.

You will be the Foundation's first full-time employee and its public face — to universities and community colleges, to K–12 and robotics programs, to MISUMI's supplier partners, and to the press. You will report to the Board Chair and work closely with MISUMI Americas leadership, but the Foundation's day-to-day direction will be set by you.

We are looking for someone who wants the version of this job where the answers do not exist yet.

What you'll do

Build and run the grantmaking. Design the application, review, and award process across all three program areas. Source and evaluate grantees. Set award sizes and durations. Make the hard calls about what we fund and what we decline, and be able to explain both.

Grow the partner co-investment program. Recruit supplier partners into the Founding, Growth, and Community tiers. Run the Advisory Board, which convenes twice yearly to set grant priorities and announce awards jointly. Manage relationships with senior executives at some of the world's largest component manufacturers.

Complete the transition to an independent 501(c)(3). Work with counsel and the board to move the Foundation out of fiscal sponsorship into standalone operation — governance, policies, financial controls, audit readiness, and state charitable registrations.

Measure and report honestly. Define what success looks like beyond dollars granted, build the data to track it, and publish results — including the parts that did not work. Produce the Foundation's annual report.

Represent the Foundation externally. Speak at conferences and on campuses. Work with MISUMI Americas marketing on announcements and storytelling. Build relationships with industry bodies, workforce coalitions, and peer funders.

Build the team. Scope and hire the Foundation's next one to three roles as grant volume justifies them.

First-year priorities

  • Open and close the inaugural grant cycle, with a defensible process and a portfolio you can stand behind
  • Secure the first cohort of Founding Partners and hold two Advisory Board meetings
  • Complete the 501(c)(3) determination and operational transition from fiscal sponsorship
  • Publish a measurement framework and the Foundation's first annual report
  • Establish institutional relationships with a target set of universities, community colleges, and K–12 programs

Desired Traits

  • Seven or more years in philanthropy, workforce development, education, or a closely adjacent field, including direct ownership of a grantmaking or scholarship program — you have made funding decisions, not only administered them
  • Experience building something from the beginning. A founding role, a new program inside a larger institution, or an organization you took from idea to operating. Comfort with ambiguity is not a nice-to-have here
  • Credible with two very different audiences. You can hold a room of community college deans and a room of manufacturing executives, and you do not change your argument between them
  • Fundraising or partner development track record. You have asked people for significant money and been told yes
  • Working knowledge of nonprofit governance and compliance — 501(c)(3) requirements, fiscal sponsorship, board management, charitable registration. You do not need to be a lawyer, but you need to know what you are looking at
  • Clear writing. Grant guidelines, board materials, annual reports, and declines all live or die on it

Genuine interest in manufacturing and engineering education. You do not need an engineering degree. You do need to find this industry interesting enough to learn it properly

Helpful, not required

  • Background in engineering, manufacturing, or the skilled trades, or lived experience of a technical education pathway
  • Familiarity with community college and technical program funding, CTE, or registered apprenticeships
  • Relationships with FIRST, VEX, SkillsUSA, SME, NAM, the Manufacturing Institute, or similar
  • Experience inside a corporate foundation, or navigating the relationship between a foundation and its corporate parent
  • Japanese language ability or experience working across U.S. and Japanese organizations

What we offer

  • The chance to build a foundation from its first grant, with committed capital and a board that wants it to be independent
  • Competitive salary, health coverage, retirement contribution, and paid time off
  • Remote-first, with travel to campuses, partner sites, MISUMI Americas offices, and the Advisory Board convenings
  • A mandate that is deliberately broad, because the talent pipeline will change and we intend to change with it

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Ability to travel 25–30% annually within the United States for campus and grantee site visits, partner site visits, Advisory Board convenings (twice yearly), MISUMI Americas offices in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, and industry conferences.
  • Occasional international travel as the Foundation's work extends beyond the U.S.

Salary Range: $215,000 to $250,000 per year, based on experience and location

Interested in learning more? We look forward to hearing from you soon.

We’re actively seeking teammates who:

  • Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.
  • Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.
  • Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.
  • Have an ‘always learning’ mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.
  • Help us continue to build a world-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates

We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.
