jobs.excerpt: ABOUT US Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry.
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.

For more information, visit .

ABOUT THE ROLE

Xsolla Ads connects advertisers with players across Xsolla's games and commerce surfaces. Every dollar that moves through it depends on two kinds of integration working correctly: the oRTB connections to the DSPs and SSPs that buy and sell our inventory, and the MMP and event integrations that tell advertisers whether a player installed, registered, or made a purchase.

You'll be the technical owner of those integrations for our strategic partners. That means you're the person a DSP calls when their bid rate falls off a cliff, the person an MMP works with to get postbacks mapped correctly, and the person who tells an advertiser exactly why their dashboard and ours disagree. You'll work with Partnerships, Product, Engineering, and Data, and you'll bring what partners need back into the roadmap in a form engineers can act on.

RESPONSIBILITIES

oRTB integrations (supply and demand)

  • Own technical onboarding for DSPs and SSPs, from spec review and test traffic through to production.

  • Map bid requests and responses against oRTB 2.5/2.6, including partner-specific extensions, and catch mismatches before they cost money.

  • Set up and maintain seats, deal IDs, and floors, and keep ads.txt, app-ads.txt, sellers.json, and SupplyChain object data accurate.

  • Troubleshoot bid rate, win rate, timeouts, creative rejections, and revenue discrepancies down to root cause.

MMP and event integrations

  • Run integrations with MMPs such as AppsFlyer, Adjust, and Singular, plus direct advertiser postback setups.

  • Configure install and in-app event postbacks: macros and parameter mapping, click IDs, event names and values, attribution windows, and postback authentication.

  • Work with advertisers to define which in-app events matter for their campaigns and confirm they fire correctly before launch.

  • Reconcile conversion discrepancies between Xsolla, MMPs, and advertisers, and explain the cause in plain terms.

Strategic partner ownership

  • Be the technical point of contact on partner calls, and answer hard integration questions in real time.

  • Build integration plans and launch checklists, and stay close to partners through go-live.

  • Bring technical health and integration status into partner business reviews.

Voice of the partner

  • Turn partner requests and defects into well-scoped tickets with reproduction steps, logs, and expected behavior.

  • Give Product and Engineering early feedback on specs, so integration problems get caught on paper.

  • Write and maintain partner-facing integration guides and internal runbooks.

Data and reporting

  • Use SQL and logs to investigate discrepancies, monitor integration health, and spot problems before partners do.

  • Build simple dashboards and reports that show partner and integration performance.

WHAT YOUR WEEK LOOKS LIKE

  • A DSP's bid rate drops 40% overnight. You pull sample bid requests, find a field that changed format in the last release, and coordinate the fix with Engineering.

  • An MMP reports 18% fewer purchase events than we do. You trace it to event-value mapping and a deduplication rule, then agree the fix with both sides.

  • An SSP's sellers.json entry doesn't match our app-ads.txt, and buyers are filtering the inventory. You find the mismatch and get both files corrected.

  • A new advertiser wants to pay on day-7 retention. You work out which in-app events their MMP can send, map them, and test the postbacks end to end before the campaign goes live.

  • You notice three partners hitting the same integration problem, and you write it up for Product with a proposed fix.

QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

  • 5–8 years in ad tech in a technical account management, solutions engineering, integration engineering, or partner support role.

  • Fluent in oRTB. You can read a bid request and response, explain what each object does, and spot what's wrong.

  • Hands-on experience setting up MMP integrations and debugging install and in-app event postbacks with at least one major MMP.

  • Working knowledge of the supply chain transparency stack: ads.txt, app-ads.txt, sellers.json, and SupplyChain object.

  • Strong with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and server logs. Comfortable writing SQL to answer your own questions.

  • Experience as the technical owner for strategic partners such as DSPs, SSPs, MMPs, ad networks, or large advertisers.

  • Clear communication with both engineers and non-technical partners, and calm under pressure when revenue is on the line.

  • Ownership: you take a problem through to resolution rather than logging it and handing it off.

  • Based in North America and able to work across North American time zones.

  • Nice to have:

    • Hands-on experience with Prebid: Prebid.js, Prebid Server, or Prebid Mobile.

    • Familiarity with the Ad Context Protocol (AdCP) or other agent-to-agent advertising standards.

    • A track record of using Claude or other AI tools to get more done: writing integration test scripts, analyzing logs, drafting partner docs, or automating repeat work. Come ready to show us a real example.

    • Experience in mobile gaming, app monetization, rewarded ads, or offerwalls.

    • Familiarity with privacy-safe measurement such as SKAdNetwork and Privacy Sandbox.

HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED

  • New partners go from signed to live on schedule, without integration surprises in production.

  • Discrepancies get explained and closed, not left open as a standing argument.

  • Partners come to you first and resolve issues with you rather than escalating around you.

  • Engineering receives well-scoped tickets and spends less time on back-and-forth.

  • We catch integration health problems before partners report them.

BENEFITS

We are passionate about fostering a supportive environment for our team, so we prioritize the physical, mental, and emotional well-being of our employees and their families through a comprehensive Benefits Program. This includes 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision plans, unlimited Flexible Time Off, and a personalized career roadmap for each employee. By investing in professional development through training and educational opportunities, we ensure that our team thrives both personally and professionally. Together, we're not just building a business; we're cultivating a community that values creativity, collaboration, and the transformative power of play.

We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law. This engineer owns runtime protection for The Home Depot's agentic and AI traffic: the AI gateway, Prisma AIRS AI Runtime Security, Google Model Armor and the Koi integration.

You will act as the advisory engineer for configuring DLP policies in Prisma AIRS, guiding the teams that own the data on how to detect and stop exfiltration of sensitive data. You will also deploy Google Model Armor and DLP for the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, and integrate Prisma AIRS with Koi AES to cover endpoint agents and MCPs.

  • Deploy Google Model Armor for the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform with appropriate controls, and deploy DLP policies in Security Command Center (SCC).
  • Integrate Prisma AIRS with Koi AES for endpoint agents and MCPs, passing traffic to the gateway, and embed the API by other means where traffic does not reach the gateway.

jobs.title: Financial Analyst
jobs.excerpt: American farmers have made tremendous technology advancements through hardware improvements and investments in precision agriculture.
jobs.description:
American farmers have made tremendous technology advancements through hardware improvements and investments in precision agriculture. However, when it comes to the back-office, most farms are decades behind, relying on spreadsheets, filing cabinets, and decades-old on-prem software to recruit, manage, and pay their workforce. Seso is addressing this problem by modernizing the back-office for the farm.

Our mission is to build the premier platform for agribusiness to hire and manage their workforce and improve the lives of agricultural workers. We are addressing American farmers’ biggest pain point - access to qualified labor - through a software-enabled labor solution that automates the H-2A visa. Our comprehensive HR platform streamlines and automates the hiring process for farms and seamlessly integrates their efforts across recruitment, onboarding, payroll, and insurance while providing workers access to financial services for the first time.

Seso has raised over $60M from Tier I investors including Index, Founders Fund, and Mary Meeker at Bond, and has been recognized with awards including Forbes Rising Stars and Andreessen Horowitz's American Dynamism 50.

About the role

Seso is hiring a Financial Analyst to own our revenue model and forecasting. Seso helps agricultural employers hire, onboard and pay seasonal workers through the H-2A program, and finance sits at the center of how contracts turn into invoices, cash and reported revenue.

This is a hands-on role for a self-starter who would rather build a tool than repeat a task twice. You'll report to the Controller and work daily across all functions. We use AI across everything we do, and we want someone who will push that further.

What you'll do

Revenue model and forecasting

  • Own the revenue model by product line, pulling actuals from the ERP and tying them out every month.
  • Develop the initial yearly forecast and maintain model updates with actuals and scenario changes, and present the results and drivers to the Controller.
  • Update the bookings plan against actuals and partner with RevOps on ARR / revenue run-rate reporting.

Revenue reporting

  • Own monthly revenue reporting and revenue Budget vs. Actuals, including variance commentary for finance and leadership.
  • Reconcile the revenue model, QBO and billing data, and chase down discrepancies until they tie.
  • Manage revenue reporting in Aleph, keeping data connections, reports and dashboards accurate and up to date.

Automation and AI

  • Use AI to build, update and stress-test the revenue model: pulling and cleaning actuals, writing formulas and logic, and running scenarios faster
  • Automate the monthly refresh so actuals flow into the model and reports with minimal manual work.
  • Use AI to analyze variances and draft the commentary behind the numbers.
  • Work with our FP&A platform partners to move the model onto automated, connected data.

What we're looking for

  • Heavily invested in AI. You already use tools like Claude or ChatGPT every day to build models, write formulas and scripts, analyze data and automate workflows, and you can show us something you built. You're the person others ask how to use AI better.
  • Strong self-starter. You take a vague problem, figure out who and what you need, and drive it to completion without waiting to be told. You flag issues early and come with a proposed fix.
  • Finance and modeling experience. 3+ years in FP&A, finance, investment banking, consulting or a similar analytical role. You've built driver-based forecasts and scenario models in Excel or Google Sheets and can explain the story behind the numbers.
  • Basic accounting knowledge. You understand the three financial statements, accruals, revenue recognition basics and how a month-end close works. You don't need to be a CPA.
  • Detail and ownership. You care when numbers are $3K off and won't stop until they tie.
  • Clear communicator. You can explain a forecast to leadership and an invoicing exception to a CSM in plain language.

Nice to have

  • Experience at a SaaS or tech-enabled services company, especially with ARR, bookings and revenue run-rate metrics and/or experience in Agriculture.
  • Hands-on time with QuickBooks Online, Aleph, or Salesforce.
  • Comfort with SQL, Python, VBA or building simple apps and dashboards.
  • Bilingual in English and Spanish.

Tools and details

  • Tools you'll use: QuickBooks Online, Google Sheets/Excel, Salesforce, Airtable, Retool, Ramp, Front, Slack, and Aleph, plus Claude and other AI tools.
  • Reports to: Controller

jobs.excerpt: There are NO limits to your career: come shape the future and be part of a truly unique global culture at OutSystems!
jobs.description:
There are NO limits to your career: come shape the future and be part of a truly unique global culture at OutSystems!

As a Senior Security Engineer on the Application Security team at OutSystems, you will independently deliver meaningful security outcomes across our #1 AI-powered low-code platform, helping ensure that applications, platforms, and agentic capabilities are secure by design and safe by default.

In this role, you will own and execute small-to-medium sized security initiatives and deliver significant service components of a large Product Security program. You will partner closely with security, engineering, product, support, digital, legal, sales and enablement, and customer teams; to reduce real customer risk, eliminate recurring vulnerability patterns, and enable teams to move faster because security was already part of the plan.

This role is for a seasoned security engineer who can operate with autonomy, apply foundational security practices effectively in our environment, effectively collaborate and adapt their approach as complexity increases. You will be trusted to deliver quality outcomes end-to-end while mentoring junior team members and strengthening security relationships within your scope.

What You’ll Do

  • Independently drive security work across all phases of the SDLC, from early design and threat modeling through implementation, testing, and release.

  • Own delivery of moderately complex security projects or features, adjusting standard approaches as needed to achieve the intended outcome.

  • Partner with engineering and platform teams to secure AI-powered and agentic capabilities, ensuring security considerations are built in early rather than bolted on later.

  • Conduct focused security assessments of applications, APIs, internal services, and platform components using the appropriate depth and methodology for the risk.

  • Contribute to the development and adoption of secure-by-default patterns, guardrails, and paved roads that scale security without increasing friction.

  • Operate and improve security tooling by tuning signal quality, reducing noise, and identifying opportunities to improve effectiveness.

  • Build or extend security tooling and automation to eliminate manual or repetitive work.

  • Clearly communicate risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations to engineering partners in a way that supports informed decision-making.

  • Proactively identify gaps or inefficiencies in security processes and suggest practical improvements aligned with team goals.

  • Mentor junior engineers and new hires, helping them ramp up effectively and understand how Product Security operates at OutSystems.

  • Strengthen stakeholder relationships within your area of responsibility by being reliable, pragmatic, and outcome-oriented.

How We Measure Success

As a member of this team, success is measured by outcomes, not motion.

You will be expected to:

  • Deliver security improvements that reduce real risk over time

  • Shorten exposure windows for meaningful issues within your scope

  • Prevent the recurrence of known vulnerability patterns through better design or automation

  • Enable engineering teams to ship faster with fewer security surprises

  • Improve the quality and trustworthiness of security signal used by teams

  • High activity without risk reduction is not success. Quiet systems that work are.

All About You

Required (Must-Have) Qualifications

  • Proven experience executing application security work in modern, cloud-native environments.

  • Strong grounding in application security fundamentals, including:

    Secure design and threat modeling

    • Vulnerability intake, triage, collaborative analysis, and remediation

  • Ability to independently manage and deliver moderately complex security tasks from start to finish.

  • Comfortable working across application security, cloud security, and platform security concerns within a defined scope.

  • Demonstrated ability to write and reason about code, including:

    • Building or extending security tooling and automation using modern programming languages

    • Acting as a human-in-the-loop to review, validate, and secure AI-generated or low-code–generated code and workflows

  • Practical experience with AWS (required), Kubernetes, and microservices architectures.
    Clear understanding of the differences between penetration testing, red teaming, and purple teaming, and when each is appropriate.
    Strong communicator able to adapt messaging to different audiences and collaborate effectively across teams.

  • Demonstrated ability to mentor junior colleagues and contribute positively to team culture.

  • Comfortable seeking guidance on ambiguous or novel problems while owning execution and delivery.

Preferred (Nice-to-Have) Qualifications

  • Practical understanding of AI-enabled and automated systems, including how increased autonomy affects trust boundaries, failure modes, and risk.

  • Experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools or agents to accelerate delivery while maintaining security and correctness.

  • Experience contributing to or improving secure-by-default patterns, paved roads, or guardrails in a platform or product environment.

  • Exposure to Azure in addition to AWS.

  • Experience improving the signal quality of security tooling by reducing noise and increasing actionability.

  • Prior experience working on developer platforms, low-code platforms, or highly automated systems.

Scope and Expectations

  • Owns small-to-medium security initiatives or significant components of service delivery for a large program.

  • Works independently on day-to-day assignments with limited oversight.

  • Adjusts standard procedures when necessary to achieve the desired outcome.

  • Impact is primarily at the team and project level, with growing influence through trust and delivery.

  • Acts as a role model for “The OutSystems Way” of Product Security through execution, collaboration, and judgment.

Why This Role Matters

OutSystems is building an AI-powered, agentic future for software development. As systems become more autonomous, Product Security must shift from reactive controls to intentional system design.

As a Senior Security Engineer, you will help make that shift real. Your work will ensure customers inherit strong security by default, teams move faster with confidence, and security quietly does its job because it was designed in from the start.

If you’re ready to own meaningful security outcomes, mentor others, and help secure the next generation of developer platforms, we’d love to talk.

More about OutSystems

OutSystems is a leading AI Development Platform built for the enterprise. Global organizations trust OutSystems to rapidly build mission-critical apps and agents, modernize legacy processes with agentic systems, and govern their entire AI portfolio across complex regulatory environments, all on one unified platform.

As the future becomes agentic, our customers need us now more than ever. While AI has opened the door to extraordinary possibilities, most large organizations find themselves stuck on one side of the "enterprise gap" because AI by itself doesn't solve their complex use cases and business challenges. OutSystems bridges the "enterprise gap" by combining the speed of generative AI with a deterministic, enterprise-grade framework. We provide the tools for teams of any size to deliver high-quality, reliable AI solutions that drive real business impact.

We are looking for passionate, talented, and motivated people to join us as we empower organizations to build, deploy, and scale the next generation of enterprise software. While we are leading the charge into the agentic era, our mission is broader: we are the platform enterprise leaders trust to evolve their entire business, accelerating innovation through secure, governed human-AI collaboration.

OutSystems is a global company, with more than 900k developer community members, 1,700 employees, more than 600 partners, and thousands of active customers in over 75 countries and across 21 industries. Founded in 2001, OutSystems now has offices in the United States, United Kingdom, the Netherlands, Portugal, Germany, the UAE, Japan, Hong Kong, Malaysia, Australia, India, and Singapore, and includes a thriving, worldwide community of remote employees.

Our customers are some of the world's most recognizable brands across diverse industries— such as Toyota, Heineken, Bosch, KeyBank, and UCLA—who trust OutSystems to deliver ROI and transformational impact.

Consistently recognized as a leader by top analyst firms Gartner, IDC and Forrester, OutSystems continues to shape the future of enterprise software development in the agentic era. We are proud to be named a leader in more than 100 categories on G2, including #1 in Customer Satisfaction in Enterprise Low Code Development, and most recently as a leader in AI Agent Building in the G2 Spring 2026 Reports.

Working at OutSystems

Our culture is built on our core values of Trust, Customer Success, Innovation, and Alignment. We operate as one global OutSystems team, taking ownership to pursue our vision of being the AI platform enterprise leaders trust to build, secure, and evolve their most critical applications and systems.

What do we have to offer you?

  • A company at the vanguard of the agentic revolution, where we don’t just react to AI innovation—we architect it. Joining OutSystems means stepping onto a high-growth rocket ship that combines the fearless agility of a startup with the sophisticated, global foundation of an enterprise powerhouse.

  • Real growth opportunities. We don't just talk about development; we invest in it through structured programs designed to scale your expertise. Whether you are aiming for vertical progression, exploring lateral moves into new domains, or mastering specialized AI skills through our Professional Development Fund and Internal Mobility Program, we provide the resources to get you there.

  • A global collective of world-class talent, where you’ll collaborate with enterprise software legends and sought-after thought leaders. At OutSystems, our industry experts aren't just visionaries—they are accessible, approachable mentors who are deeply invested in your growth as we architect the agentic future together.

OutSystems nurtures an inclusive culture where talented individuals from all backgrounds are empowered to learn, experiment and make an impact. . About Arize

AI is rapidly transforming the world. As generative AI reshapes industries, teams need powerful ways to monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize their AI systems. That’s where we come in. Arize AI is the leading AI & Agent Engineering observability and evaluation platform, empowering AI engineers to ship high-performing, reliable agents and applications. From first prototype to production scale, Arize unifies build, test, and run in a single workspace, so teams can ship faster with confidence.

Arize serves a rapidly growing customer base of 150+ leading enterprises and Fortune 500 companies. Customers like , Uber, Siemens, and PepsiCo leverage Arize to deliver AI that works.

The Opportunity

AI is rapidly transforming the world. Whether it’s developing the next generation of human-level intelligence, enhancing voice assistants, or enabling researchers to analyze genetic markers at scale, AI is increasingly integrated into various aspects of our daily lives.

Arize AI is the leading AI observability and evaluation platform, empowering AI engineers to build and deploy high-performing, reliable models. As the AI landscape shifts from traditional ML to generative AI and agentic systems, Arize ensures teams have the tools to monitor, troubleshoot, and improve AI in production.

The Team

Our engineering team builds systems that interact with some of the most complex software ever deployed in production. The team is composed of industry veterans that have built deep learning infrastructure, autonomous drones, ridesharing marketplaces, ad tech and much more.

We are looking for a fast-paced, client-obsessed Account Executive with an entrepreneurial mindset to find, win and grow new customers. You’ll be searching for business while being an engaged member of the AI/ML community, identifying prospects who will benefit most from our solution. You’ll accomplish this by running an effective ground-game, talking to AI/ML leaders, identifying opportunities to help and building solutions to help achieve their goals. You’ll be involved in exciting and complex sales cycles and leverage your business acumen to navigate the intricacies.

What You’ll Do

  • Be a networker, seller and closer
    • Build relationships with AI/ML stakeholders and be an active member of the community
    • Conduct discovery with prospects and share the Arize vision
    • Run a sophisticated prospecting strategy to “get the word out” and find deals
    • Create sales plays, write talk tracks and strategically identify new business opportunities
    • Deeply research accounts, stakeholders and competitors
  • Manage proof of concepts, drive adoption and grow accounts
    • Manage and navigate internal / external stakeholders to ensure success
    • Understand use cases, scope licensing and find more workloads
    • BANT or MEDDIC methodology preferred

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years enterprise SaaS sales experience: Hungry, aggressive and motivated
  • Familiarity or willingness to learn sales technologies to find and attract prospects
  • Self-starter and comfortable working in limited process environments
  • Full-cycle sales experience and ability to navigate the complexities of enterprise deals
  • Fast-paced and focused on helping prospects / customers
  • Team player: Collaboration with peers and other organizations within Arize is critical to success, we deeply value the success of the collective team over individual gains
  • Strong communication skills: Clearly and objectively communicate observations from the field

Bonus Points, But Not Required

  • Previous selling experience in
    • Software Engineering
    • Data Science
    • Machine Learning

The estimated annual salary and variable compensation for this role is between $250,000 - $300,000 USD, plus a competitive equity package. Actual compensation is determined based upon a variety of job related factors that may include: transferable work experience, skill sets, and qualifications. Total compensation also includes a comprehensive benefit package, including: medical, dental, vision, 401(k) plan, unlimited paid time off, generous parental leave plan, and others for mental and wellness support.

While we are a remote-first company, we have opened offices in New York City and the San Francisco Bay Area, as an option for those in those cities who wish to work in-person. For all other employees, there is a WFH monthly stipend to pay for co-working spaces.

More About Arize

Arize’s mission is to make the world’s AI work—and work for people.
Our founders came together through a shared frustration: while investments in AI are growing rapidly across every industry, organizations face a critical challenge—understanding whether AI is performing and how to improve it at scale.

jobs.description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Veeva Vault PromoMats is the industry-leading platform that life sciences companies rely on to manage the full lifecycle of promotional content, and digital asset management (DAM) is how customers store, find, reuse, and distribute the approved assets behind every campaign. We are looking for an experienced product manager to own and grow Veeva's DAM capabilities, making our customers' brand, marketing operations, commercial, and medical affairs teams more efficient and productive.
In this role, you will own the product strategy and roadmap for DAM capabilities, such as asset ingestion and metadata, search and discovery, rights and usage management, content reuse, and multichannel distribution. You will work closely with Engineering, UX, and customers to identify high-impact problems, define requirements, and ship solutions that balance ease of use with the rigor demanded by a highly regulated industry.

What You'll Do

  • Product Strategy & AI: Own the vision, strategy, and multi-release roadmap for DAM, including where AI capabilities such as auto-tagging, semantic search, and generative variations fit, balancing customer demand, market trends, and the realities of design and engineering
  • Customer Discovery: Engage directly with brand, marketing operations, creative and agency, medical, and regulatory teams at life sciences companies to understand how they create, organize, find, reuse, and distribute assets, and translate those insights into prioritized product requirements
  • Measurement & Impact: Define and track the metrics that prove customer value, such as asset reuse rates, time to find and publish an approved asset, metadata completeness, and feature adoption, and use them to guide the next set of investments
  • Feature Definition & Delivery: Write clear specifications and partner with Engineering, UX, and QA through design, build, and release to ship capabilities that meet the scalability and quality standards of the Veeva Vault platform
  • Governance & Automation: Deliver capabilities that reduce manual effort across the asset lifecycle, such as automated metadata extraction, rendition and format management, rights and expiration tracking, and approved-asset distribution to downstream channels, while preserving the auditability regulated customers require
  • Cross-Product & Go-to-Market Alignment: Partner with product teams across Vault, including PromoMats MLR review and claims, to deliver connected experiences, and enable Sales, Services, and Support with the positioning, demos, and documentation needed to bring releases to market

Requirements

  • 5+ years of enterprise software product management, engineering, or consulting experience
  • 2+ years of hands-on focus on digital asset management (DAM), content management, or creative production platforms
  • Technical Proficiency: Working knowledge of how DAM systems are built, including metadata models and taxonomies, rendition and transcoding, APIs and integrations, and the application of AI/ML, such as auto-tagging, semantic search, and Generative AI, to asset workflows
  • Architectural Knowledge: Understanding of content and asset architecture, including storage and delivery, versioning, permissions and rights management, and integration with content management, work management, and distribution channels
  • Communication: Ability to translate complex technical concepts into business value for non-technical stakeholders in Marketing, Creative, Legal, Medical, and Regulatory departments
  • Collaboration: Proven track record of working with UX and Engineering to build intuitive tools for complex workflows
  • Marketing Acumen: Experience in Marketing or Marketing Operations, or building products for marketing teams, with a working understanding of how brand strategy, campaign planning, and content production come together
  • Marketing Process Fluency: Familiarity with the methodologies brand teams run on, creative and campaign briefs, agency and studio workflows, brand guidelines and governance, modular content and content supply chain models, omnichannel distribution, and launch readiness

Nice to Have

  • Domain Expertise: Direct experience with Veeva Vault PromoMats or a leading DAM platform (e.g., Adobe Experience Manager Assets, Aprimo, Bynder)
  • Life Sciences Experience: Familiarity with MLR review processes, 2253 submissions, or Medical Information (MedInfo) workflows
  • Rich Media & Creative Workflows: Experience with image, video, and other creative file formats, proofing and review tools, and agency or studio handoffs
  • Brand & Launch Experience: Hands-on involvement in brand strategy, brand or product launch planning, or global campaign rollout, including the content, claims, and approval cycles that support a launch
  • Marketing Technology: Working knowledge of the martech stack brand teams use alongside DAM, including content and experience platforms (e.g., Adobe Experience Manager, Aprimo, Sitecore), marketing work management (e.g., Adobe Workfront, Asana, Monday), marketing automation and CRM (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Marketo, Veeva CRM, Vault CRM), and campaign analytics tools

Interviewing with Veeva

    We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party, unless you have already completed it with Veeva previously.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • PTO and company-paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

  • Base pay: $130,000 - $180,000 CAD
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.
Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances. Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. .

Hiring and how we work

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Staff, Technical Account Manager.

About the job

Twilio is looking for an experienced Technical Account Manager who is going to be the designated technical support engineering contact for our strategic customers. As a designated TAM you will be supporting customers during Eastern hours (9am to 6pm ET) and working on the cases created by customers and resolving complex technical problems with potentially very costly and far-reaching consequences. You should have an interest in digging deep as well as be able to zoom out and look at the larger picture. The TAM delivers proactive guidance to the customer to provide added value through the use of Twilio technologies and deliver recommendations to make the customer’s environment less susceptible to business impacting downtime. You are able to remain calm and effective at higher workloads as well as excelling at prioritization and evaluation of situational urgency. There will also be the potential need to volunteer for holiday coverage on a stipend basis.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Use your strong technical and diplomatic skills to address customer issues and provide customer feedback to Twilio’s Product and Engineering teams.
  • Work with our customers' and partners' developers, architects, and support personnel to resolve complex problems with potentially very costly and far-reaching consequences.
  • Collaborate with your teammates and the Twilio Product and Engineering teams via Slack as well as filing JIRAs to report reproducible bugs.
  • Understanding customer trends, analyzing patterns, driving betterments and reporting what you observe to the management team in order to better improve our support process is a key part of the role.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

  • Skilled in troubleshooting network connectivity issues, with an understanding of TCP/UDP, and basics of SSL/TLS.

  • Advanced time management skills, ability to work well under pressure, and proficiency at developing workflows to increase troubleshooting efficiency while still following standard processes and procedures.

  • Interest in utilizing customer feedback to identify and drive improvements in our products.
  • Enthusiasm for interacting and collaborating with other departments within Twilio in your search for the solutions our customers need.
  • Ability to stand in the customer’s shoes and demonstrated dedication to the customer experience.
  • Experience in managing dedicated customer accounts.

Desired:

Location

This role will be remote,but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, NJ, NY, PA, WA

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation

Credible is a leading U.S. consumer finance marketplace, transforming the way consumers access and compare financial products. We operate at a consumer and enterprise level. On the consumer side, we help millions of people make smarter financial decisions by comparing personalized, pre-qualified offers across student loans, personal loans, mortgages, credit cards, and insurance — all without impacting their credit score. On the enterprise side, we power financial product comparison and distribution through deep integrations and partnerships with lenders, insurance carriers, and financial institutions, as well as providing marketplace technology and capabilities to third-party partners and distribution channels.

In this role, you will be working with our Head of Partnerships & Business Development to ideate, pitch, and win marketing partnerships to drive top-of-funnel traffic to Credible across several business lines. You will be committed to establishing relationships with marketing partners through sustained sales efforts that transform Credible’s business and grow revenue. SaaS Revenue & Financial Analyst — Flosum

About Flosum

Flosum is a Salesforce-native platform company delivering enterprise-grade DevOps, data protection, and security solutions to some of the world's largest organizations. Our product portfolio spans Cloud DevOps, Data Migrator, Data Masking, Data Backup, Org Security, Cloud Trust Center, and Sandbox Synchronization — all built natively on the Salesforce platform. We serve enterprise customers across technology, energy, financial services, healthcare, and federal government. Flosum is a growth-stage company operating with the intensity and speed of a startup backed by the discipline of a mature operator.

The Role

We're hiring a SaaS Revenue & Financial Analyst who will own the measurement layer of our entire business. You will be the person who knows every number — ARR, net retention, expansion, churn, pipeline conversion, cost of acquisition, gross margin by product line, services margin, cash flow, and everything in between. You'll work across Salesforce (our CRM and billing system of record) and QuickBooks (our financial system) to build a unified, always-current picture of company performance.

This is not a reporting role. This is an analytical role where you connect revenue operations data to financial outcomes and surface the insights that drive decisions at the CEO level.

What You'll Own

You will build and maintain our SaaS metrics infrastructure — ARR waterfall, cohort retention analysis, revenue recognition schedules, deferred revenue tracking, and unit economics by segment. You will reconcile Salesforce bookings data against QuickBooks revenue entries and ensure we have a single source of truth across both systems. You will produce monthly and quarterly financial and revenue packages for leadership, including variance analysis against plan. You will model scenarios for pricing changes, product bundling, geographic expansion, and headcount investment. You will monitor pipeline health and translate pipeline data into revenue forecasts with documented assumptions. You will own the data integrity between our CRM and accounting systems, flagging discrepancies before they compound. You will support board-level and investor-level reporting with clean, defensible metrics.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

You have three-plus years of experience in SaaS financial analysis, revenue operations, or FP&A at a B2B software company. You are deeply proficient in Salesforce — not as a user, but as someone who understands opportunity objects, product schedules, contract structures, and reporting at a data level. You are equally proficient in QuickBooks Online, including chart of accounts design, revenue categorization, journal entries, and reconciliation workflows. You understand ASC 606 revenue recognition principles and can apply them to a multi-product SaaS business with annual and multi-year contracts. You can build financial models from scratch in Excel or Google Sheets — not from templates, from logic. You think in terms of cohorts, not just totals. You understand the difference between bookings, billings, and revenue, and you can explain why each matters. You are precise, skeptical of your own numbers, and obsessive about data integrity.

Preferred

Experience at a company with a mix of subscription revenue and professional services. Familiarity with Salesforce CPQ or native Salesforce quoting and contract objects. Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Job Role: Marketing Manager (w/ Experience in Cold Funnels & Webinars)

Compensation range: $2,500 - $5,000 AUD / Monthly

Engagement type:Independent Contractor Agreement

Work Schedule: This role is expected to align with the AU/AEST business hours (approx. 9:00AM - 6:00 PM, Monday to Friday) strictly for collaboration.

Target Start Date: ASAP (2-4 weeks)

Who We Are:

At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.


Who The Client Is:

Our client is a marketing agency running paid acquisition across a small portfolio of in-house offers. The primary account is a high-ticket trading education company built around a personality brand, selling through webinar funnels, VSL funnels and book-a-call funnels. This is direct-response, high-ticket online marketing — the successful candidate needs to come from this world, not adjacent to it.

Role Overview

A hands-on Marketing Manager (w/ Experience in Cold Funnels & Webinars) who owns the ideation, the copy and the briefing behind our paid ads — not the production itself. The media buyer feeds the numbers; this person turns them into concepts, writes the copy and scripts, briefs the creative team, and manages the communication with the team members responsible for completing each project. Copywriting is the core craft of this role — essential, not optional.

The work is video-led, and the focus is hook-driven, direct-response promotional ads that sell a webinar, a live event, or whichever offer is currently live — rather than UGC or long-form VSL content — plus static/photo ads and landing page copy. They do not need to edit, design or produce (that sits with the in-house team); they do need to direct editors and the photo/video team confidently from concept through to a finished ad. The role starts as a senior individual contributor with a clear path to leading the creative team as it grows.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own creative strategy for paid ads: concepts, angles and hooks for Meta and YouTube, grounded in performance data and a real understanding of the offer.
  • Write the copy: ad copy, video ad scripts, static/photo ad concepts and landing pages. Hands-on writing, every week.
  • Script promotional video ads: hook-driven, direct-response video that sells webinars, live events and live offers — this, rather than UGC or VSL production, is the day-to-day focus.
  • Brief and direct the creative team: turn concepts into clear, executable briefs for video editors and the photo/video team, and own the communication and feedback loop through to a shipped ad — execution sits with the team.
  • Work from the data: partner with the media buyer on what is winning and why, and feed those insights straight back into new creative.
  • Use AI fluently: image generation, AI-assisted drafting and AI video tools as part of the everyday workflow.
  • Stay compliant: keep all creative within platform policies and the compliance constraints of the financial-education vertical (e.g. no income guarantees).
  • Ship reliably: quality-led output, with agreed creative delivered on schedule.

5. What Success Looks Like

  • Creative win rate climbing — a growing share of new tests beating control.
  • Strong hook rates, thumbstop and CTR across new creative.
  • Agreed creative shipped on schedule, every time.
  • The media buyer is never short of fresh, data-informed creative to test.
  • Ready to step up and lead the creative team as it grows.

Requirements

6. Must-Have Requirements

  • 5+ years in direct-response creative and copywriting for paid social (meta ads).
  • Exceptional copywriting and written English — the copy is theirs to write, not to delegate.
  • Track record with an account you have personally managed that was generating $500K+ in monthly revenue.
  • Experience working with personality brands / founder-led offers.
  • Well versed in the Australian market — has created ads for Australian audiences. This is a deal-breaker.
  • Video-led portfolio: has conceived, scripted and directed video ads through to finished output.
  • Has worked inside a creative team — alongside other copywriters, video editors and photo/video crews — not a solo operator.
  • Fluent with AI tools across image generation, drafting and video.
  • Available full-time across AEST business hours.

7. Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in the trading, finance or investing niche.
  • Prior creative leadership or mentoring experience — relevant to the growth path.
  • VSL scripting experience — welcome, just not the day-to-day focus.
  • Landing-page testing / CRO sensibility beyond the copy itself.

8. Candidate Submission Requirements

For each shortlisted candidate, please include:

  • Ad portfolio with performance numbers: spend levels, hook/CTR metrics or results where known, and the candidate’s specific role in the work.
  • Finished video ads the candidate personally conceived, scripted and directed through a team.
  • Copy and script samples: ad copy, video scripts and landing pages.
  • A short Loom-style video introduction from the candidate.

9. Recommended Final Stage

Before an offer is made, we recommend a short paid creative test: the candidate receives a sample offer brief and returns three hooks, one 30–60 second video ad script and one static ad concept. This tests the exact job — thinking, writing and brief-ability.

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”)

Project Overview

The RAPID project is a global emergency preparedness and rapid response mechanism that strengthens the capacity of local partners to deliver timely humanitarian assistance during crises. In South America, the project supports Caritas partners in Bolivia, Brazil, Ecuador, Paraguay, and Peru to prepare for the anticipated impacts of the 2026-2027 El Niño event, including flooding, drought, and wildfires. Through improved hazard monitoring, emergency planning, supply chain readiness, prepositioned assistance, and rapid response systems, the project aims to address critical preparedness gaps and ensure vulnerable communities can access lifesaving assistance quickly when disasters occur.

Job Summary

The Supply Chain Management Technical Advisor I will support the Supply Chain Management Technical Advisor II in providing technical assistance, accompaniment, and training to EMPOWER partners in South America to strengthen supply chain and operational preparedness for rapid emergency response. The role will help partners improve their capacity to set up and operate multiple-modality supply chains, including in-kind assistance and cash and voucher assistance (CVA), in an expedited, responsible, and compliant manner.

Roles and Key Responsibilities

Supply Chain Readiness and Planning

  • Support Technical Advisor II in implementing the multi-modality supply chain readiness process across the five target countries, working closely with partners and relevant CRS functions.
  • Assist with planning, tracking, and documentation for the five priority focus areas: updated specifications, strategic sourcing, prepositioned stocks, open contracts, and continuous improvement.
  • Develop and maintain readiness tools, action plans, trackers, databases, and continuous improvement plans, and monitor progress against agreed actions.

Market Analysis, Sourcing and Contracting

  • Conduct market, supplier, logistics, and service provider assessments, including data collection, market pricing, costing exercises, and verification of key assumptions.
  • Support the review and development of relief item specifications, kit contents, packing requirements, and other supply chain readiness standards to ensure suitability for local contexts and anticipated hazard scenarios.
  • Support the mapping, due diligence, prequalification, contracting readiness, and ongoing management of suppliers and service providers, including maintaining vendor databases, framework agreements, and supporting documentation.

Cash and Voucher Assistance (CVA) Readiness

  • Support the assessment, contracting readiness, and activation protocols of financial and mobile service providers for cash and voucher assistance (CVA), including compliance, liquidity, data protection, reconciliation, complaints handling, and failed-payment procedures.

Supply Chain Systems Strengthening

  • Support assessments of partner supply chain systems, including procurement, contracting, warehousing, inventory management, transport, distribution, quality assurance, and readiness for safe and accountable emergency operations.
  • Support analysis of warehouse requirements, inventory systems, storage practices, distribution readiness, transport options, and supply chain constraints, and assist partners in addressing identified gaps.

Capacity Strengthening and Knowledge Management

  • Support partner coaching sessions, simulations, readiness tests, and technical working sessions, including preparation of materials, meeting coordination, documentation, follow-up actions, and consolidation of final readiness packages and supporting tools.

We're looking for aBusiness Development Manager who is, first and foremost, can bring new leads to the table. Someone who takes a list of leads andturns them into real, live opportunities.

You own the process end to end, from sourcing, research, outreach, follow-up, qualification and warm handoff. You do it with the discipline of someone who never lets a lead go cold and never loses track of where every conversation stands.

About BlueThrone

BlueThrone is a remote-first company scaling a portfolio of mobile apps across multiple markets and categories.

We combine product intuition, growth execution, and sharp monetization strategy - and we double down on what works.

We’re not a corporate org with layers and slow approvals. We operate like a lean, high-ownership team where strong execution matters more than fancy titles.

Our teams work closely across product, growth, monetization, and engineering - and we care about one thing: building things that move the needle.

Your mission ⭐️

Sourcing & Research

  • Work through lists of leads (apps, founders and companies) provided by the team and independently identify and enrich additional prospects.

  • Find the right point of contact: founder, CEO or decision-maker through any means necessary, like LinkedIn, email, mutual connections, direct outreach, F2F conferences or events… whatever it takes.

Outreach & Relationship Building

  • Clearly and credibly represent BlueThrone's acquisition and partnership modelto an external audience.

  • Build and follow a systematic cadence for follow-ups so nothing slips.

  • Be ready to report to internal stakeholders on pipeline health, conversion and volume to leadership on a regular cadence.

Handoff to Analysts & M&A

  • Qualify interest and fit before handoff, you're the filter, not just the funnel.

What you'll be doing

  • Strong hands-on CRM discipline and Pipedrive experienceis a strong plus.

  • Comfortable doing the full A-to-Z: sourcing, research, outreach, follow-up and qualification, not just one slice of the funnel.

  • Sharp communicator who can build credibility quickly with founders and executives.

  • Self-starterwho thrives with autonomy in a remote, async, global team.

What we’re looking for

  • 2+ years track record of hitting outbound/sourcing targets in a sales or BD role, with high-ticket deals.

  • B2B experience is crucial,you must know how to navigate through multiple stakeholders in your target company and understand how to win trust in long sales cycles.

  • Experience with cold outbound is a must, you know how to structure persuasive outbound that converts to calls.

  • Experience and curiosity with mobile apps is a plus and relevant if you have experience working with or for SaaS companies in the mobile app ecosystem/

  • Willingness to travel frequently for meeting , conferences and events

  • Fluent English, excellent written and verbal communication.

  • Ability to work flexible hours across time zones (mostly Asia-Europe).

You’ll love it here if:

  • You prefer freedom and results over fixed schedules and "punching the clock."

  • You thrive in a drama-free, calm and systematicproblem-solving environment.

  • Experience leading a team to turn new techniques into best practices: experimenting, learning what works, and documenting it in a form others can adopt and a company can market - including packaging, pricing, and positioning.
  • Hands-on experience applying AI to software delivery, so you can separate what works today from what's still hype.
  • Deep familiarity with the software delivery life cycle (design, product, development, QA, and testing) and how AI changes each stage.
  • A plan-driven approach to growth, having built pipelines backward from revenue goals through marketing, partnerships, or referrals.
  • Relationships or experience with technology partners, such as AI vendors, platforms, or alliances that generated real opportunities.
  • A credible public point of view on AI, shown through talks, writing, or community involvement, even if content creation isn't your main job.
  • The ability to work closely with engineering leaders to make sure what you sell can be delivered at quality.


Role Summary

We're looking for a thought leader who is obsessed with how organizations use AI to improve digital product delivery. You'll continue to build Bitovi's AI Enablement practice, attract customers to it through marketing and partnerships, and close the sales that come in. Sales experience isn’t required. We’ll support you and train you.

Our current offering has three tiers: training teams to use AI, adding AI skills that streamline parts of their workflow, and measuring both against DORA metrics. It covers the full software delivery life cycle, including design, product, QA, and testing. Your immediate job is to sell that offering. Your longer-term job is to keep it ahead of where AI is going.

The responsibilities below are listed in order of priority.

1. Identify Technically Achievable Solutions Customers Want

  • Track where AI tools, techniques, and adoption are heading, and spot the problems organizations will pay to solve next.
  • Translate those trends into concrete offerings, playbooks, and a clear point of view that sets Bitovi apart.
  • Form hypotheses about how Bitovi can solve those problems, and test them with internal team members and real client work before selling them.
  • Make sure every offering is technically achievable. If Bitovi doesn't have the skills yet, say so, so the team can hire or train for them.
  • Refine, expand, or retire offerings as the market moves, so we aren't selling techniques nobody uses anymore.

2. Build the Plan to Attract Customers
You own the strategy for bringing customers to the practice. You don't have to produce all the marketing yourself.

  • Design the practice's sales and marketing pipeline.
  • Define the marketing and partnership strategy, including which partnerships to pursue (for example, AI vendor partnerships) and how to use them to find work.
  • Guide marketing on campaigns, content, and events. Decide which stories, projects, and messages to highlight.
  • Choose which conferences and communities matter, and what Bitovi should present there.
  • Give sales clear messaging, positioning, and materials that accurately reflect what the practice can deliver.

3. Close Sales

  • Partner with the Sales department and eventually own the full sales cycle for practice opportunities, from first conversation to signed engagement. Run it yourself or coordinate help from sales and practice leads.
  • Lead client conversations that shape the solution, confirm fit, and show credible expertise in what AI can do today.
  • Set deal strategy with sales for larger or more complex engagements.
  • Work with the practice lead on proposals so they reflect offerings Bitovi can deliver.
Supporting Responsibilities
  • Work with the Directors of Engineering to confirm that new offerings can be delivered at quality, and to flag skill gaps early.
  • Work with the practice lead, who turns offerings into documented services and handles proposal iteration.
  • Partner with Delivery Managers to refine offerings based on delivery feedback and client outcomes.
  • Track practice growth and market traction, and balance near-term revenue with longer-term investments.
  • When needed, help ramp up consultants on a newly sold offering. This is secondary to the priorities above.
  • Share ideas and strategies for regular content production with our Engineering Marketing Lead to strengthen Bitovi's position. Regular content production is the responsibility of the engineering marketer.
Not Part of This Role
  • Ongoing content production, such as videos, regular articles, and routine conference speaking. A separate engineering marketer will handle this.
  • Upskilling Bitovi's engineers as a primary responsibility.


Travel
Our team travels to meet with our clients and internal teams in person. Travel can range from 1-2 times per year to 3-5 days every 3-4 months, and we will do our best to work around your schedule. There are times with this role that you may be required to travel more due to leading or supporting in-person trainings

Job Title: Area Business Manager - Allergy/ENT - Denver N, CO

Sanofi focuses on developing specialty treatments for debilitating diseases that are often difficult to diagnose and treat, providing hope to patients and their families.Sanofi has pioneered the development and delivery of transformative therapies for patients affected by rare and debilitating diseases for over 30 years. The Area Business Manager (ABM) is responsible for engaging Allergists and Otolaryngologists, and other key customers within an assigned geography and presenting clinically focused selling messages to create and grow revenue and to consistently deliver product goals related to atopic dermatitis and asthma indications. ,

  • Collaborative and comfortable working cross-functionally with internal teams
  • Able to work well under pressure: consultations can move fast, and you need to stay composed and effective when they do
  • Self-starter who manages their own pipeline without needing heavy oversight

What success looks like

  • In your first 90 days, you will have run consultations end-to-end, closed new client engagements, and built strong working relationships across the team. You will know our ideal client profile cold, understand what makes a great-fit engagement, and have a clear, organized process for managing your pipeline. Clients will feel well taken care of from the very first conversation they have with us.

What we offer

  • Fully remote position with a flexible work schedule
  • Competitive base salary
  • Annual performance bonus
  • Anniversary loyalty bonuses
  • Company-sponsored health insurance
  • Generous PTO that increases with tenure (up to 30 days per year)
  • Birthday PTO day
  • 7 U.S. paid holidays
  • 5 paid sick days per year
  • Bereavement leave
  • Additional unpaid personal leave available
  • Home office stipend for equipment and workspace upgrades
  • Computer replacement stipend
  • Monthly internet allowance (increases with tenure)
  • Professional development and training programs
  • Education support for high performers
  • A collaborative, supportive team culture where people are genuinely invested in each other's success
  • A fast-moving environment where your work has real visibility and direct impact
  • Clear path to growth: we promote from within and reward people who perform

How to apply?

  • Hit Apply, and you'll be redirected to our application form.
  • Follow all instructions carefully

We are a fully remote company, and our hiring process reflects that. The first stages are completely asynchronous: no surprise calls, no scheduling pressure. You will complete a short written application and, if selected, move through an async assessment at your own pace. We communicate clearly at every step and respect your time throughout!

ABOUT onX

We’re a team of builders, adventurers, and risk takers using technology to help people confidently explore the outdoors. Driven by our mission to awaken the adventurer inside everyone, we build products that optimize every outdoor experience and inspire confidence to get out and go further.

We’re a high-growth tech company. The pace is fast, the work takes grit, and ambiguity is part of the job. As the world changes around us, we adapt - continuously evolving how we build, prioritize, and deliver.

Our business moves quickly, and there’s real opportunity to shape what we build next. Each of our verticals - Hunt, Offroad, Backcountry, and Fish - is at a different stage of maturity, which means the challenges you encounter and the impact you have will vary depending on where you sit and what the business needs most.

We operate with an experimentation mindset, continually iterating and improving how we solve problems. We expect our people to use the latest tooling, including AI, thoughtfully and responsibly, pairing human judgment with technology to increase quality, speed, and impact.

Our impact comes to life through the products we build, in the stories of our customers, and in our growing commitment to land stewardship and recreational access.

ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY

We're hiring a Recruiter / Sourcer (6-Month Fixed-Term) to help our Talent Acquisition team meet increased hiring demand. We're looking for an experienced, resourceful recruiting professional who can step in quickly, independently drive recruiting work forward, and deliver results across both full-cycle recruiting and proactive sourcing.

In this hybrid role, you'll flex between independently managing assigned searches from intake through accepted offer and partnering with other recruiters to drive sourcing and recruiting workstreams for priority openings. Whether you're owning a requisition or contributing to another recruiter's search, you'll have the autonomy to determine effective approaches, make informed decisions, and take accountability for delivering strong candidate pipelines and maintaining hiring momentum.

This is a six-month opportunity for someone who thrives on finding great talent, brings creativity and persistence to sourcing, and can confidently navigate competing priorities and recruiting challenges. You'll collaborate closely with hiring managers and recruiting teammates, using sound judgment and practical problem-solving to deliver high-quality results without sacrificing the candidate experience.

This is a remote position requiring candidates to reside within an eligible onX Basecamp region in the Pacific or Mountain time zones.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
Essential Job Duties & Functions

Build and Engage High-Quality Talent Pipelines

  • Independently develop and execute sourcing strategies for assigned searches, using hiring context, market insights, and sound judgment to identify relevant talent pools and engage qualified candidates.
  • Proactively identify and engage passive candidates through creative sourcing methods, targeted outreach, referrals, and persistent follow-through rather than relying primarily on inbound applicants.
  • Take ownership of pipeline development for assigned searches, evaluating candidate quality, identifying gaps, and adjusting sourcing approaches to improve results.
  • Conduct candidate conversations to assess relevant qualifications, motivations, and alignment with role requirements, using sound judgment to recommend candidates for consideration.

Own Recruiting Workstreams and Drive Hiring Outcomes

  • Independently manage assigned requisitions through the full recruiting lifecycle, from intake and candidate sourcing through interviews, selection, and offer acceptance.
  • Partner with other recruiters to independently own sourcing and other defined recruiting workstreams for priority searches, applying judgment and driving results without requiring day-to-day direction.
  • Balance ownership of multiple requisitions with sourcing, screening, coordination, and other recruiting responsibilities across additional searches, adapting priorities to meet hiring needs.
  • Proactively identify and resolve recruiting challenges, including pipeline gaps, unclear requirements, scheduling complexities, and process bottlenecks, escalating when broader decisions or stakeholder alignment are needed.
  • Make thoughtful decisions within assigned recruiting workstreams, balancing hiring urgency, candidate quality, stakeholder needs, and the candidate experience.

Partner with Hiring Managers and the Talent Acquisition Team

  • Partner with hiring managers and recruiters to clarify role requirements, understand hiring priorities, and establish effective recruiting approaches.
  • Share talent market insights, pipeline data, and candidate feedback to help hiring teams make informed decisions and adjust recruiting approaches when needed.
  • Navigate differing perspectives constructively, asking thoughtful questions and challenging assumptions when necessary to maintain alignment and hiring momentum.
  • Communicate proactively with candidates and hiring teams, managing expectations, coordinating next steps, and maintaining a consistent, high-quality recruiting experience.

Use Tools, Data, and AI to Improve Effectiveness

  • Use modern applicant tracking systems, sourcing tools, and market research to manage recruiting workflows, maintain accurate candidate information, and support effective recruiting decisions.
  • Apply AI tools to improve candidate research, sourcing, outreach, and recruiting efficiency while exercising judgment and validating outputs.
  • Monitor recruiting activity and pipeline performance to identify challenges, evaluate effectiveness, and adjust approaches.
  • Identify opportunities to improve sourcing techniques, workflows, or candidate engagement, and collaborate with teammates to implement practical solutions.

  • Duration: This is a six-month, fixed-term position expected to begin as soon as possible, with an anticipated start date before the end of 2026. The assignment will conclude approximately six months after the start date.
  • Weekly Hours: This is a full-time, salaried position based on a 40-hour workweek.
  • Assignment Completion Bonus: Upon successful completion of the full six-month assignment, this position is eligible for an assignment completion bonus.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • 4+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including successful in-house recruiting experience at a company that develops software or hardware products.
  • Demonstrated success recruiting for technical and product-focused roles, including software engineering, product management, or hardware engineering, with the ability to independently assess candidate qualifications and advise hiring teams.
  • Proven ability to proactively identify and engage hard-to-find talent through creative sourcing strategies, targeted outreach, and persistent candidate engagement, building qualified pipelines rather than relying primarily on inbound applicants.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple full-cycle requisitions (typically 2–4) while simultaneously owning sourcing, candidate screening, interview coordination, and other recruiting deliverables for additional searches.
  • Experience independently developing and adapting sourcing approaches based on hiring requirements, talent market insights, candidate quality, and pipeline performance.
  • Strong judgment and problem-solving skills, with demonstrated experience identifying recruiting challenges, evaluating options, and taking action to maintain hiring progress without requiring day-to-day direction.
  • Experience partnering directly with hiring managers to clarify requirements, provide market and candidate insights, and recommend adjustments to recruiting approaches.
  • Hands-on experience using a modern applicant tracking system, such as Greenhouse or Ashby, to manage recruiting workflows, maintain accurate pipeline data, and support hiring decisions.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities, communicate proactively, and maintain a high-quality candidate and hiring-manager experience in a fast-paced environment.
  • Practical experience using AI tools to improve sourcing, research, or recruiting workflows, with sound judgment in evaluating outputs.
  • Must reside within an eligible onX Basecamp region in the Pacific or Mountain time zones.

ADDED BONUSES

  • Familiarity with consumer-facing, product-led, or mobile technology companies.
  • Experience improving sourcing effectiveness through experimentation with outreach, tools, or recruiting workflows.

WHERE YOU CAN WORK

This is a remote position, with candidates required to reside within an eligible onX Basecamp (remote hubs) region in the Pacific or Mountain time zones.

onX has created a thriving distributed workforce designed to foster connection, collaboration, and shared experience across several US locations. We have two HQ locations in Bozeman and Missoula, MT, and established virtual workforce Basecamps in Austin, TX; Charlotte, NC; Denver, CO; Kalispell, MT; Minneapolis, MN; Portland, OR; Salt Lake City, UT; and Seattle, WA.

HOW YOU’LL BE COMPENSATED

onX is committed to compensating all employees fairly and equitably for their contributions. For this six-month fixed-term position, the annualized base salary range is $100,000–$120,000, equivalent to approximately $50,000–$60,000 in base earnings over the 6-month assignment. Actual earnings may vary slightly based on the assignment's start and end dates and payroll schedule. In addition to base compensation, this position is eligible for an Assignment Completion Bonus upon successful completion of the full 6-month term. Actual compensation will vary based on experience, skills, certifications, education, and other relevant factors.

WHAT WE’RE OFFERING YOU

  • Competitive salary
  • Medical benefits, including a no-monthly-cost medical plan
  • PTO accrual (vacation, holidays, sick time)
  • Eligibility for a bonus at the end of your term
  • 401k matching at 100% for the first 3% you save and 50% from 3-5%
  • Amazing outdoor industry perks

THE ONX EXPERIENCE

onX is a distributed company with more than 400 employees across the country. We come together regularly to work in person and stay connected through regional basecamps and a culture that balances individual ownership with deep collaboration.

While we move quickly, we’re not a scrappy start-up. We operate with clear goals, structure, and frameworks that guide how we prioritize and execute. Priorities matter. While they may shift, data shapes how we evolve as our business, products, and the world around us change.

Clear priorities and structure don’t limit ownership - they make it possible. You’ll have the autonomy to define your work and make meaningful decisions within clear strategic boundaries. You’ll partner closely with others to solve complex problems and build solutions that scale across teams and platforms. Summary

Junior Proposal Manager

Department
