Position Summary

We are seeking a motivated, detail-oriented Junior Proposal Manager to support the development of competitive, compliant, and compelling proposals for federal government contracting opportunities.

Working under the direction of the Director of Proposals, the Junior Proposal Manager will assist in coordinating all phases of the proposal development process, from solicitation analysis and planning through writing, production, and final submission. The position will also be responsible for managing smaller, less complex proposal efforts with appropriate guidance and oversight.

This position offers an excellent opportunity for an emerging proposal professional to expand their technical writing, project management, and proposal development skills while contributing directly to the company’s business development objectives.

The ideal candidate is an organized, proactive professional with strong writing abilities, exceptional attention to detail, and an eagerness to learn and grow within a collaborative, deadline-driven environment.

Key Responsibilities

Proposal Coordination and Management

  • Support the planning, coordination, development, and submission of federal government proposals, including RFPs, RFQs, RFIs, and task order responses.
  • Assist with reviewing solicitations to identify submission requirements, evaluation criteria, deliverables, and compliance obligations.
  • Develop and maintain proposal schedules, compliance matrices, outlines, action item trackers, and other proposal management documents.
  • Coordinate with subject matter experts, operations personnel, business development teams, and other contributors to gather required information and proposal content.
  • Monitor assigned proposal activities, track deadlines, and communicate progress and potential issues to the Director of Proposals.
  • Organize and participate in proposal kickoff meetings, status meetings, and structured proposal reviews.
  • Independently manage smaller or less complex proposals under the guidance of the Director of Proposals.
  • Assist with final proposal production, quality checks, and electronic submissions.

Proposal Writing and Editing

  • Draft and edit proposal narratives, including corporate experience, past performance, management approaches, staffing plans, and other assigned technical or administrative sections.
  • Work with subject matter experts to transform technical information into clear, concise, and persuasive proposal content.
  • Review and edit written contributions for grammar, clarity, consistency, responsiveness, and compliance.
  • Assist with incorporating win themes, competitive differentiators, and customer-focused messaging into proposal responses.
  • Support the development and formatting of tables, graphics, organizational charts, and other proposal materials.
  • Ensure proposal documents follow established corporate templates, formatting requirements, and style guidelines.

Quality Control and Compliance

  • Review proposal materials for compliance with solicitation instructions and applicable submission requirements.
  • Assist in preparing materials for Pink, Red, Gold, and other structured proposal reviews.
  • Track review comments and coordinate the incorporation of approved revisions.
  • Perform proofreading and quality control checks to identify errors, omissions, inconsistencies, and formatting issues.
  • Maintain document version control and organized proposal files throughout the development process.
  • Support final production and submission activities, including verification of required forms, attachments, and document formatting.

Proposal Department Support and Development

  • Maintain and update proposal content libraries, templates, past performance references, resumes, and other reusable materials.
  • Assist with developing and improving proposal processes, standard operating procedures, and department resources.
  • Participate in proposal lessons-learned activities and contribute suggestions for process improvement.
  • Support business development and capture activities by organizing opportunity information and assisting with preliminary proposal planning.
  • Develop familiarity with federal acquisition processes, government contracting terminology, and industry proposal development best practices.
  • Pursue ongoing professional development to strengthen proposal writing, management, and compliance skills.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in English, Communications, Business, Marketing, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • 1–3 years of experience in proposal coordination, proposal writing, technical writing, business development support, or a related professional role.
  • Strong writing, editing, proofreading, and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple assignments simultaneously.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Adobe Acrobat.
  • Ability to follow detailed instructions, interpret requirements, and produce accurate, professional documents.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to collaborate effectively with individuals across multiple departments.
  • Self-motivated with a willingness to learn, accept feedback, and take increasing responsibility.
  • Ability to work effectively under pressure and meet firm deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting federal government proposals or working within the government contracting industry.
  • Familiarity with federal solicitations, including RFP Sections L and M, compliance matrices, and proposal schedules.
  • Exposure to Shipley or APMP proposal development methodologies and color team reviews.
  • Experience with Adobe InDesign, Microsoft SharePoint, or similar document management and collaboration platforms.
  • Experience developing technical narratives, past performance descriptions, or management plans.
  • Familiarity with federal facilities management, operations and maintenance, environmental services, healthcare support, or other government services contracts.
  • APMP Foundation certification or interest in pursuing professional certification.

Core Competencies

  • Organization and Time Management: Ability to manage priorities, track deliverables, and meet established deadlines.
  • Written Communication: Ability to develop clear, accurate, concise, and professional proposal content.
  • Attention to Detail: Commitment to accuracy, consistency, and compliance with requirements.
  • Collaboration: Ability to coordinate effectively with proposal contributors, technical personnel, and management.
  • Initiative and Accountability: Willingness to take ownership of assigned responsibilities and proactively address issues.
  • Adaptability: Ability to respond to changing priorities and perform effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Professional Growth: Demonstrated interest in developing proposal management expertise and advancing within the profession.

Performance Expectations

Success in this position will be measured by:

  • Timely and accurate completion of assigned proposal tasks and deliverables.
  • Quality, clarity, and compliance of written proposal contributions.
  • Effective coordination and communication with proposal team members.
  • Accuracy and organization of proposal schedules, compliance matrices, and supporting documentation.
  • Consistent adherence to corporate proposal procedures and quality standards.
  • Demonstrated growth in the ability to independently manage smaller proposal efforts.
  • Proactive contributions to department efficiency, knowledge management, and process improvement.

Career Development

This position is intended to develop the skills and experience necessary for advancement to a Proposal Manager role.

The Junior Proposal Manager will receive guidance, mentoring, and progressively greater responsibility as proficiency increases in proposal planning, coordination, writing, compliance, and full lifecycle management.

jobs.excerpt: WGSN | Remote, United States (Chicago preferred) | Permanent, full-time About WGSNFor two decades, WGSN's proprietary trend intelligence has shaped how the world's most valuable brands in fashion, beauty, consumer goods, interiors and food and drink make decisions.
jobs.description:
WGSN | Remote, United States (Chicago preferred) | Permanent, full-time

About WGSN

For two decades, WGSN's proprietary trend intelligence has shaped how the world's most valuable brands in fashion, beauty, consumer goods, interiors and food and drink make decisions. Now those same brands are rebuilding their technology around AI (agents, knowledge platforms, recommendation engines and personalization systems) and they want WGSN forecast intelligence flowing into them as a data layer, delivered through the WGSN Intelligence API.

About the Role

You will be the solution lead on WGSN's largest and most complex new enterprise opportunities in North America. Partnering with Enterprise Account Directors, Product and Engineering, you will qualify, scope, design and close Intelligence API and data deals of $500k and above, mainly with new logos.

This is a hybrid technical and consultative role. You won't write code, and the API itself is simple. What matters is that you can sit credibly in two rooms: the commercial conversation with senior business leaders, and the technical conversation with the people who will integrate. Most of all, you'll make sure every deal grows WGSN's relationship with the client, protects the subscription business underneath it, and keeps our intelligence clearly credited to WGSN.

You'll report to the VP North America, working closely with our global commercial leadership, and you'll help raise the commercial standards of the wider North America sales team.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the solution and commercial design on priority enterprise deals, turning pipeline into signed multi-year contracts.
  • Run discovery with senior buyers in design, insight, buying and merchandising, and with Chief Digital, Innovation and Data Officers.
  • Map where WGSN intelligence creates value in a client's data and AI plans, and be clear about what the API does and doesn't do.
  • Structure deals that open new use cases, new buyers and new budgets without cannibalizing the existing subscription.
  • Build IP protection and brand attribution into the solution, the commercial model and the licensing terms from day one.
  • Design and run paid pilots that give clients a credible first step.
  • Coach the sales team on qualification and deal design, build collateral and battle cards, and feed customer insight back to Product.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong commercial judgement. You can tell true expansion from revenue moving between budget lines.
  • 6+ years in enterprise pre-sales, solutions consulting or solutions engineering, selling data, content, API or SaaS products to large enterprises.
  • A track record of leading the solution on $500k+ multi-year deals, including new logos.
  • Confidence with C-level and senior VP buyers, and the presence to lead a deal team.
  • Experience protecting IP, attribution and licensing in content, data or API deals, and the judgement to walk away when the terms are wrong.
  • Clear writing. You can produce a proposal an executive will sign and a solution outline an engineering lead will respect.

Nice to Have

  • Knowledge of fashion, beauty, retail, consumer goods or interiors, or of trend, research or consumer data businesses.
  • Experience with enterprise AI buying: agents, RAG, knowledge platforms, personalization engines.
  • MEDDPICC or a similar qualification method.
  • Spanish or Portuguese.

Experience

6 to 10 years in enterprise pre-sales or solutions consulting within SaaS, content, martech or data businesses.

Location & Ways of Working

Remote within the United States, with a preference for Chicago. We plan to add office space as the North America team grows. Some travel to client sites is expected.

jobs.excerpt: Summary of Job Role and ResponsibilitiesThe ideal Senior team member will provide leadership in many areas but specific to this position is the ability to support the analysis of data center infrastructure as part of our strategy development projects.
jobs.description:
Summary of Job Role and Responsibilities

The ideal Senior team member will provide leadership in many areas but specific to this position is the ability to support the analysis of data center infrastructure as part of our strategy development projects. The skill sets are broken into 4 categories, Electrical, Mechanical, Operations, and Master Planning. The successful candidate must have these skills for the accurate completion of various data center “due diligence” tasks as part of an overall team conducting a data center strategy analysis for our client.

Electrical

  • Demonstrated expertise in interpreting electrical one-line diagrams and evaluating mission-critical electrical distribution systems, including utility service, switchgear, UPS, generators, transfer switches, PDUs, transformers, and grounding systems.
  • Strong understanding of electrical redundancy concepts (N, N+1, 2N, etc.), reliability principles, load calculations, power capacity, and identifying single points of failure with practical risk mitigation strategies.
  • Ability to assess the condition, operation, and maintenance effectiveness of critical power infrastructure, including UPS systems, battery systems, standby power, electrical distribution equipment, and associated controls.
  • Experience collecting, analyzing, and interpreting operational data from electrical infrastructure to evaluate system performance, reliability, energy efficiency, and compliance with industry best practices.
  • Working knowledge of the National Electrical Code (NEC), mission-critical facility design standards, and the ability to safely perform work in energized or critical infrastructure environments.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and computer skills, with the ability to serve as a trusted subject matter expert while preparing technical reports and using Microsoft Office applications.

Mechanical

  • Interpret mechanical one-line drawings and evaluate HVAC infrastructure in mission-critical facilities, from central cooling plants through CRAC/CRAH systems, while understanding redundancy concepts and calculating system load capacity.
  • Assess the condition, operation, and maintenance of mechanical infrastructure including chillers, cooling towers, heat rejection systems, pumps, valves, piping, thermal storage, and associated controls and instrumentation.
  • Analyze mechanical system designs to identify components, single points of failure, reliability risks, and energy optimization opportunities, providing practical recommendations to improve resilience, maintainability, and efficiency.
  • Collect, interpret, and analyze operational data from mechanical equipment and perform engineering calculations related to cooling capacity, power, kVA, power factor, and energy performance.
  • Apply industry best practices for mission-critical mechanical systems, including redundancy classifications, reliability principles (MTBF, MTTR, availability, maintainability), and safe work practices while effectively using Microsoft Office applications.
  • Serve as a confident, customer-facing mechanical subject matter expert, communicating technical findings and recommendations clearly while following written and verbal instructions.

Operations

  • Develop maintenance staffing plans and define the technical skill requirements needed to support mission-critical facility operations.
  • Operate and evaluate Building Monitoring and Control Systems (BMS/BAS) supporting critical mechanical and electrical infrastructure.
  • Assess the condition, maintenance practices, and documentation of mission-critical infrastructure, including raised floor environments, fire detection and suppression systems, and critical equipment records.
  • Evaluate operational processes including maintenance management, change management, and security systems to ensure reliability, compliance, and best practices.
  • Identify single points of failure, assess infrastructure reliability risks, and develop practical, cost-effective mitigation recommendations to improve data center availability.
  • Demonstrate comprehensive knowledge of mission-critical systems including Emergency Power Off (EPO), VESDA, FM-200, Ansul, sprinkler and pre-action systems, as well as physical security technologies such as card access, video surveillance, biometric access, and perimeter protection.

Conceptual Master Planning

  • Be able to evaluate the overall facility and provide input to such in the planning sessions and workshops
  • Working with Engineering/Design colleagues, assist in the development of conceptual designs for infrastructure expansion and/or capacity changes.
  • Possess a complete understanding redundancy requirements and Tier levels
  • Ability to evaluate the overall critical loading requirements for data center “greenfield” options
  • Ability to provide ROM (Rough Order of Magnitude) estimates (+/- 30%) for recommendations
  • Ability to present findings and interact with customers at all levels.

Other Skills and Knowledge

The Senior Data Center Consultant will demonstrate the following required abilities: • Managing and participating in the delivery of major projects – the candidate is expected to act as the client partner and project executive for all projects they develop. This will position the candidate to manage the project, its quality, and the client as a portfolio over time. The candidate will participate in delivery and will need to learn the use of the group’s analytic tools and support that need as required. The candidate will also manage the project to the forecast financial measures.

Presentation and Writing Skills: The candidate will need to communicate professionally, effectively, and persuasively in verbal and written form to client CIO/CFO/COO’s and other senior positions. In addition to client focused work, the candidate is expected to participate as an industry expert in symposiums, professional journals, and webinars.

Team-members generally work from their home office and travel when required. Travel can average 25%-50%, but there might be times when sustained travel over short periods of time are required, particularly when supporting our global projects.

It is desirable that the successful candidate have one or more of the following advanced requirements:

  • Applicable data center professional certifications
  • 10 Years + data center operational experience in privately owned or colocation facilities
  • BA/BS from an accredited College/University. Engineering or Computer Science degree is a plus.
  • Ability to pass a background check prior to offer letter
  • Hold a U.S. passport and travel internationally

Work at the heart of sustainable change

Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. We believe sustainable change should create a thriving world for both nature and people. Our culture is grounded in openness, curiosity, responsibility, and respect for diverse perspectives.

Ready to join us?

If you are ready to bring your project leadership, technical judgment, and client management skills to a business focused on sustainable energy solutions, we invite you to apply.

Please submit your application and include your CV and any other relevant documents.

Ramboll in the Americas

Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a foundation-owned people company. Ramboll has thousands of experts working across more than 70 offices in the Americas, delivering innovative solutions within Environment & Health, Water, Energy, and Planning & Urban Design. We invite you to contribute to a sustainable future working in an open, collaborative, and empowering company. Combining local experience with global knowledge, we together shape the societies of tomorrow.

Salary Transparency

At Ramboll, we are committed to fair and transparent compensation practices that support our people and our purpose of creating sustainable societies. The anticipated base salary range for this position is $125,000 to $155,000 per year. This range reflects the compensation we reasonably expect to offer at the time of posting. Actual compensation will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and internal equity. Because we operate across multiple U.S. markets, pay may differ depending on the cost of labor in specific locations. In addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for bonus, overtime or other forms of compensation and we offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports well-being, professional development, and work-life balance. Our recruiters are happy to share more about the specific salary range and total rewards package applicable to your location during the hiring process.

Where People Flourish

Our mission is to create sustainable societies where people and nature flourish. This means that a culture of inclusion is embedded in everything we do. Our people bring diverse backgrounds and experiences to the company, enabling us to deliver innovative and forward-thinking solutions to our clients. We also know how important it is to achieve the right balance of where, when, and how much you work. At Ramboll, we offer flexibility as part of our positive and inclusive approach to work. We are committed to equal employment opportunity, regardless of age, disability or medical condition, gender identity, marriage and domestic partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, ancestry, or national origin, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation, military service and veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Ramboll wants to ensure opportunities are accessible to candidates with disabilities. So, please let us know if there are any changes we could make to the application process to make it more comfortable for you. You can contact us at with such requests.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Position: Senior Data Center Consultant

EYP Mission Critical Facilities, part of Ramboll Americas Engineering, is an innovator and a market leader in sustainable Data Center Consulting & Strategy, Design, and Commissioning with a 25-year history of excellence in the industry. Numerous Fortune 500 companies, top tier universities, and global data center providers/investors, rely on EYP MCF to provide responsive solutions to today’s complex data center challenges. The Consulting groups core focus is to provide data center strategy analysis with the expertise to address the clients forward mission goals inclusive of their IT and Network architecture. The end goal is to develop a data center sourcing solution for our clients to use their existing facilities, colocation services, cloud services, or build new facilities. This includes developing a new data center topology, reliability and redundancy needs, and associated financial analysis for decision support requirements. The group also supports a wide range of data center assessment projects for investors looking to acquire data centers or develop them. Our growing team depends on motivated professionals with a flexible skill set and the ability to provide often unique, critical thinking to address the ever-changing landscape of data center design and operations.

Position: Senior Manager, Partnerships & Outreach

Location: Remote, with 15% of expected travel for in-person team meetings and events.

Who We Are

The States Forum (TSF) was founded on the conviction that delivering for the American people requires more than good policy ideas. It requires good ideas based in a clear, coherent worldview that policymakers can articulate and Americans can aspire to.

Most Americans want the same things: the freedom to control their own lives and a real path from effort to opportunity. But power over our economy, government, and culture is concentrated in too few hands, leaving a democracy that fails many Americans. TSF helps leaders deliver on what matters most to the people who elected them. TSF’s mission is to reinvigorate Americans’ trust in our democracy by producing and disseminating state-based ideas grounded in our nation’s founding ideals of political equality, universal rights, individual freedom, and true economic opportunity for everyone.

TSF focuses on states because that’s where the government still works for Americans. We are building a network of thinkers, practitioners, and policymakers who generate ideas. We do this work through partnerships, policy accelerators, research, and convenings; and we publish written, graphic, and video content through our own channels.

Those partners include state government decisionmakers and the staff who work closely with them, state-focused organizations, think tanks, and coalitions.

To provide high-quality, commercially focused and pragmatic legal advice across the Group's commercial activities, supporting the negotiation, drafting and management of a broad range of commercial arrangements, including supplier contracts, outsourcing and technology arrangements, together with legal support for data-related matters, custody and dealing arrangements, investment manager and discretionary fund manager relationships, and distribution arrangements. The role is particularly suited to a lawyer with experience of financial services outsourcing arrangements and/or investment services, including custody and dealing.
The role will support a broad range of stakeholders across the business on business-as-usual matters, strategic initiatives, proposition development and regulatory change projects. The successful candidate will be expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, managing matters from instruction through to completion, building strong stakeholder relationships and collaborating effectively with colleagues across Legal and the wider business to deliver practical, risk-based solutions.
Key Accountabilities and Responsibilities:

General Commercial and outsourcing
· Act as a key Legal contact for commercial matters across the Group, developing trusted stakeholder relationships and providing practical, risk-based legal advice.
· Draft, review, negotiate and advise on a wide range of commercial agreements, including supplier contracts, regulatory outsourcing arrangements, software and technology agreements, intragroup agreements, consultancy agreements and data-related arrangements.
· Support the Group's vendor management and outsourcing activities, ensuring third-party arrangements are appropriately structured, documented and governed, and reflect applicable legal, regulatory and operational requirements, as well as the Group's risk appetite.
· Advise stakeholders on contractual risk, governance requirements, operational resilience considerations and legal obligations arising from supplier relationships.
· Instruct and manage external legal advisers where specialist support is required.
· Monitor relevant legal, regulatory and market developments and provide timely updates and practical guidance to stakeholders.
· Support the development and maintenance of commercial contract templates, playbooks, guidance notes and precedent documentation.
· Assist with strategic projects, business change initiatives, procurement exercises and corporate activity as required.
Platform, Investment and Distribution Arrangements
· Support legal work relating to our investment platforms, including custody, dealing, settlement and distribution arrangements.
· Draft and negotiate agreements with discretionary fund managers, investment managers, fund groups, custodians and other financial services counterparties.
· Assist with product launches, proposition enhancements and strategic commercial initiatives.
General Business Advisory
· Support stakeholders across the Group by providing commercially focused and pragmatic legal advice on business-as-usual matters, strategic initiatives and proposition development activities.
· Assist with business change projects and other strategic initiatives, identifying legal and regulatory risks and helping stakeholders deliver practical, risk-based solutions.

Key Competencies:
· Strong commercial contracting skills, including drafting, negotiation and risk assessment.
· Sound legal judgement and ability to balance legal risk against commercial and operational objectives.
· Ability to manage a varied workload independently and prioritise competing demands effectively.
· Excellent stakeholder management skills and ability to build trusted relationships across the business.
· Strong negotiation and influencing skills.
· Clear and practical communication style, with the ability to explain complex legal issues to non-lawyers.
· Commercial awareness and understanding of the role of Legal in supporting business objectives.
· Strong attention to detail while maintaining a pragmatic and solutions-focused approach.
· Collaborative working style and willingness to support colleagues across Legal and the wider business.
· Continuous improvement mindset, including an interest in improving legal processes, documents and ways of working.

Knowledge and Experience:
· Solicitor qualified to practise in England & Wales or Scotland with approximately 5+ years' PQE or equivalent experience.
· Strong experience drafting, reviewing and negotiating commercial contracts.
· Experience advising on supplier, outsourcing, technology and services agreements.
· Experience of data protection matters within a commercial contracting environment.
· Experience gained in-house and/or within financial services, fintech or another regulated environment, in particular in material outsourcing arrangements, would be advantageous but is not essential.
· Experience negotiating investment management, custody and dealing arrangements would be beneficial but is not essential.
· Experience supporting strategic projects, business change activities and stakeholder decision-making.
· Experience maintaining precedents, templates, playbooks or guidance documentation.
· Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple matters simultaneously.
· Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office and other business systems used to manage legal workload and documentation.

Values and Behaviours:
· Positively demonstrate the Nucleus values and behaviours, acting with integrity and supporting a culture that is open, inclusive, collaborative and accountable.
· Provide clear, pragmatic and business-focused legal advice that helps stakeholders make informed decisions.
· Build trusted relationships across the business by being approachable, responsive and solutions focused.
· Take ownership of matters, follow through on actions and escalate clearly where required.
· Support continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to simplify processes, improve documentation and strengthen ways of working.
· Work collaboratively across Legal and the wider business, contributing to team resilience, knowledge sharing and shared success.

A little about us 
We’re the Nucleus Financial Platforms group and we help make retirement more rewarding.
People come first - whether it’s our colleagues, or the advisers and customers we support, we know that working in partnership and collaboration leads to the best outcomes. Together, we’ve shaped the platform to how it is today. We work hard, and we celebrate hard too. 
Our ambition is to create a platform with a difference, putting the customer centre stage meant tearing up the rule book and starting from scratch. We’ve come a long way since then, but our mission remains just as focused. That’s why our culture, values, and social responsibility are things we keep at the top of our agenda – because we know they matter and have a big impact. 
Our culture is one of the many things that sets us apart from the pack. We want to have an environment where our people feel that they can make a real difference, know they’ll be rewarded for their efforts and more importantly, enjoy themselves at work. 
Are we a perfect match? Check out this video and find out! 
Inclusion and diversity at Nucleus 
As with most things in life, who cares, wins. We really care about inclusion. 
For us it’s not a tick box exercise; inclusion and diversity are embedded in our culture and everything we do. It’s a commercial imperative. It isn’t about being PC. It’s about being future-relevant and durable. We owe it to ourselves and the industry to ensure we are playing our part in creating a fair, balanced and transparent financial services sector. 
More diversity means broader experience, a wider set of perspectives and a better collective ability to problem-solve. And it means being more representative of customer groups, which supports areas such as product development. 
At Nucleus, we offer a generous blend of benefits for the things that really matter to our people, including a non-contributory pension, bonus, enhanced parental leave, paid time off for emergencies, health and wellbeing initiatives and flexible working options. 
If you’d like to find out more about us or the role, get in touch with Hannah in our People team.

Across our portfolio, we help service professionals run and grow their businesses through intuitive software and payments. Learn more at careers.evercommerce.com.


Business / Vertical

Within EverPro, Invoice Simple serves one-person businesses and microbusinesses across industries and countries. Its highly rated, mobile-first product helps customers create estimates, send invoices and get paid without becoming software experts. Our ambition is to become the financial operating system for one-person businesses, helping them get paid, manage their money and grow while staying radically simple.


Invoice Simple has global reach, hundreds of thousands of customers and a meaningful payments business. We are investing in customer growth, financial workflows and AI that completes useful work, not just answers questions.


Position Summary

Our customers don’t want more software. They want the admin to disappear. AI now makes that possible, and we’re looking for the product leader who will make it real.


Reporting to the General Manager of Invoice Simple, the Head of Product owns the product vision, the product organization and measurable customer and business outcomes. You’ll partner with a GM who brings deep PLG, pricing and growth expertise. Your complementary strength is building exceptional products: turning vision into intuitive, trusted experiences that ship quickly.

This is a builder’s role with a leader’s scope, not roadmap administration. We want a hands-on, AI-native builder who prototypes ideas, makes hard product choices, raises the quality bar and redesigns how a modern product team works. You’ll say “no” more often than “yes,” and deliver on your commitments.


What You’ll Own in Your First Year

  • A clear strategy and roadmap, with outcomes and dates the business can plan around.
  • More customers accepting payments through Invoice Simple, with less friction and faster payment.
  • New bookkeeping and financial management experiences that customers adopt and value.
  • AI-powered workflows that complete real work for customers, measurably saving time and earning trust.
  • Measurable improvements in activation, paid conversion and retention across mobile and web.
  • A product team where every PM prototypes with AI, runs their own analysis and ships faster.

Key Responsibilities


Build the next generation of Invoice Simple.

Take one of the world’s most popular invoicing apps and make it indispensable to the people who run their businesses on it. Go beyond invoices to help customers get paid faster, manage their finances and make better decisions. Turn an ambitious vision into a focused strategy, clear priorities and experiences customers love.


Make AI do the work, not just talk about it.

Lead intelligent experiences that understand customers, anticipate their needs and complete meaningful work on their behalf, from creating invoices and following up on payments to organizing expenses and spotting opportunities. Move quickly, experiment boldly, and set the quality, transparency and safeguards required when customers trust us with their money.


Reinvent how great products get built.

Challenge the traditional product playbook. Build smaller, faster, AI-native teams where product managers prototype, analyze, experiment and ship, not just write requirements. Lead by example, turning ideas into working experiences in days, not months. Raise the bar for product craft, decision-making and delivery speed.


Turn product excellence into measurable growth.

Partner with the General Manager and functional leaders to accelerate acquisition, activation, conversion, retention and revenue. Improve every step of the customer journey, from app-store discovery and onboarding to subscriptions, payments and long-term engagement. Build a culture where ideas are tested quickly, results are measured rigorously and investment follows impact.


Make the complex feel effortless.

Our customers are busy business owners, not software experts. As Invoice Simple expands into payments, bookkeeping and automation, your greatest challenge will be making it even simpler. Bring exceptional judgment to what we build, what we leave out and how it all fits together, with consumer-grade experiences across mobile, web, languages and markets.


Build an exceptional team that delivers.

Attract, develop and inspire outstanding product talent. Set a high bar for ownership, curiosity, customer empathy and execution. Be a true partner to Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, Payments and Customer Experience. Make difficult trade-offs, remove obstacles and deliver on time.

  • 10+ years in product management or development, including 5+ years leading product managers and owning a meaningful product portfolio.

  • A track record of shipping consumer, SMB or self-serve SaaS products at scale, with measurable gains in activation, conversion, retention or revenue.

Personal Characteristics

  • A builder at heart: curious, technically fluent and happiest when an idea becomes something customers can use.

  • Comfortable challenging assumptions, deciding with imperfect information and owning results.

Overview

About the role

Consilio’s Legal Management Consulting team advises corporate legal departments on how to improve the way they work. This role focuses on our Legal GenAI work: helping legal departments decide where generative AI is worth using, choose the right tools and put them to work safely.

Our GenAI work includes strategy and readiness, use-case identification and prioritisation, tool selection, pilot design and implementation planning, AI-enabled workflow redesign, prompt and workflow development, governance and risk, and training and adoption.

As a Senior Consultant, you will lead substantial GenAI workstreams and, where appropriate, smaller client engagements. You will work directly with General Counsel, Heads of Legal Operations and other senior stakeholders to understand their challenges, identify where GenAI can help, structure solutions and translate analysis into pragmatic recommendations.

You will combine strong consulting delivery with credible, hands-on GenAI knowledge, team leadership and commercial awareness. You will also play an important role in developing junior colleagues, shaping our methodologies, supporting business development and strengthening Consilio’s market position.

Responsibilities

What you will do

  • Lead major workstreams and selected engagements across Legal GenAI strategy, readiness, tool selection, pilots and adoption.
  • Structure consulting engagements and define the analysis, activities and deliverables required to address client objectives.
  • Facilitate workshops and interviews with General Counsel, Heads of Legal Operations and senior legal, procurement, technology and business stakeholders.
  • Synthesise complex qualitative and quantitative information into clear findings, strategic options and actionable recommendations.
  • Lead Legal GenAI strategy and readiness engagements, assessing business needs, use cases, processes, technology landscape, data and knowledge sources, governance, risk, organisational readiness and adoption requirements.
  • Lead Legal GenAI selection and pilot engagements, including use-case prioritisation, requirements, vendor evaluation, success criteria, benchmark tasks, user testing, business case development, risk and governance considerations and implementation planning.
  • Design AI-enabled legal workflows, identifying where GenAI, agentic workflows, automation and human legal judgement should be combined to improve legal service delivery.
  • Develop and guide GenAI enablement assets including prompt libraries, reusable workflows, prompt-testing methodologies, evaluation criteria, user guidance, training and adoption approaches.
  • Challenge AI-led assumptions and help clients determine where GenAI genuinely creates value and where conventional technology or process change is the better answer.
  • Develop pragmatic GenAI adoption roadmaps that take account of business priorities, dependencies, organisational readiness, risk and available resources.
  • Own the quality and consistency of major client deliverables and ensure recommendations are evidence-based, practical and aligned to client objectives.
  • Manage engagement activities, dependencies, risks and stakeholder expectations in collaboration with the engagement lead.
  • Direct and review the work of Consultants and Junior Consultants and actively support their professional development.
  • Contribute to client proposals, RFP responses, statements of work, scoping and effort estimation.
  • Support business development discussions and help identify opportunities to expand or deepen client relationships.
  • Develop GenAI methodologies, accelerators, points of view, training materials, whitepapers and other thought leadership.
  • Maintain strong awareness of developments in GenAI models, Legal GenAI tools and the wider legal technology market, and translate those developments into practical implications for clients.

Qualifications

What we are looking for

  • 5–7+ years of relevant experience in legal consulting, legal technology, legal operations, technology-enabled transformation, professional services or an in-house legal function, including recent, direct experience of GenAI work.
  • Strong practical understanding of GenAI and its application within corporate legal departments and professional services, including use-case identification, workflow design, prompting, evaluation, governance, adoption and the limitations of current models.
  • Experience applying GenAI to contracting, for example contract review, drafting or AI-enabled contract lifecycle tools.
  • Hands-on knowledge of enterprise Legal GenAI platforms such as Harvey, Legora, CoCounsel, Wordsmith or equivalent tools, together with prompt development, workflow design or evaluation methodologies.
  • A degree in law, business, finance, information technology, information systems, data science or another relevant discipline.
  • Demonstrable experience leading consulting workstreams or complex technology adoption initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of how corporate legal departments operate and how legal work actually gets done, so that GenAI recommendations are grounded in practice.
  • Strong consulting skills, including problem structuring, stakeholder management, analysis, facilitation and the development of practical recommendations.
  • Experience engaging credibly with senior stakeholders, including General Counsel, Heads of Legal Operations and senior functional leaders.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to simplify complex topics without losing their substance.
  • Experience developing executive-level presentations, findings reports, business cases, roadmaps or strategic recommendations.
  • A good understanding of the Legal GenAI market, including the main tools and vendors, and how they fit alongside the other technology legal departments already use.
  • Commercial awareness and an ability to balance client objectives, project scope, quality and delivery requirements.
  • A collaborative leadership style and willingness to remain hands-on when required.

Helpful but not essential

  • Experience translating GenAI opportunities into business cases, roadmaps or technology strategies, including consideration of value, feasibility, risk and organisational impact.
  • Change management experience or certification, for example Prosci.
  • Formal process improvement or business analysis qualifications.
  • Previous consulting or professional services experience with large multinational organisations.
  • A second language relevant to Consilio’s international client base.

What we offer

  • Leadership responsibility on complex engagements with major global legal departments.
  • Direct relationships with senior legal and legal operations leaders.
  • The opportunity to specialise in Legal GenAI, helping major legal departments redesign how legal services are delivered in an AI-enabled environment.
  • A meaningful role in developing Consilio’s GenAI consulting methodologies and market propositions.
  • Responsibility for coaching and developing the next generation of consultants.
  • Opportunities to contribute to business development, thought leadership and the continued growth of the practice.

Are you a curious, analytical student who wants to see how strategy decisions get made at a fast-growing payments company? As a Business Strategy Intern on NMI’s Revenue Acceleration team, you’ll own strategic projects for our leadership team, covering pricing, monetization and competitive strategy across the payments and fintech landscape.

This is a US remote internship for Summer 2027, running 11–13 weeks. You’ll use AI throughout your work, partner with stakeholders across the business, and end the summer by presenting your findings and recommendations to our executive team. Working hours are 8am–5pm, Monday through Friday in your local time zone. We prefer candidates in the Eastern or Central time zones, but welcome applicants from anywhere in the US.

About NMI

NMI, a global leader in payment technologies, allows software and sales professionals to deliver payment innovations to their clients without having to build payment expertise in house. NMI enables our partners with choice, and challenges the one-size-fits-all approach to payments. You’ve probably used NMI in the last 24 hours without even realizing it. We’re the platform that powers success for innovative tech created by SMBs, entrepreneurs and fintech startups. We’re creative problem solvers who help visionaries smash through boundaries and think beyond what’s possible so they can think about what’s next. But we’re not just built for the tech savvy. We democratize the latest payments technology so that everyone can realize the benefits of easy payments across the full spectrum of commerce. Our mission is to use our expertise to enable more payments, in more ways and more places. We provide ISOs, Fintech Innovators and Technologists the freedom to focus on what they do best, liberating them from restricted payment solutions and giving them access to the latest payment technology now and in the future.

How We Work - Our Core Values

  • Be a Good Person, It’s Simple. We treat everyone fairly and with respect. We lead with kindness, humility and integrity. We take the time to understand each other and our customers. And we serve with care, because customers are never a transaction, and always our focus
  • Align, Trust & Go. We debate openly, listen carefully and challenge thoughtfully. Once we decide, we move forward together - holding ourselves accountable to our commitments, and focusing on what matters most to our customers. That alignment creates momentum.
  • Raise the Bar. Good enough isn’t enough. We stay curious, measure everything, stay honest about progress and keep pushing ourselves to think creatively. We drive change, again and again. And leave things better than we found them. When we raise the bar, our customers feel it too.

What will I be doing?

  • Analyze pricing and monetization approaches across the payments and fintech industry, and turn them into practical recommendations for NMI.
  • Research the competitive landscape, including competitors’ product strategy, packaging, go-to-market approach and AI capabilities.
  • Use AI throughout your work, including agentic AI, generative AI and other AI tools, to research, analyze data, build models and create deliverables faster and at a higher level.
  • Build business cases and financial models that help leadership evaluate strategic opportunities.
  • Create reusable assets, such as competitive trackers and comparison frameworks, that the team can maintain and update over time.

jobs.excerpt: Hello.  We’re Teya. Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.
jobs.description:
Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that.

We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you

To be a Teyan

We are not just a fintech company. We develop people by giving them the autonomy and the responsibility to challenge the status quo, so they can be the main actors of the change we want to bring to the market.

We are always looking for people better than us to join the team, disrupt payments, and revolutionise commerce in Europe. The goal we share, the mission is one, and at the end of the day we are just people trying to help other people.

What is your mission?

Our sales agents are on the front lines, talking to merchants every day. Across the go to market systems they use to manage their sales, HubSpot CRM is where their deals, activities, conversations, reporting, automations and portfolio lives. When HubSpot works, our salespeople sell. When it breaks quietly in the background, deals stall, data drifts, and the people who trust the numbers stop trusting the tool.

Your mission is to be the guardian of that system. You are the person who keeps HubSpot healthy, honest, and trustworthy, so that every seller and every leader can rely on it without ever thinking about it.

This is not a caretaking job where you wait for tickets and tick them off. You are a detective and a builder. You go looking for what is wrong before anyone reports it, you find the real reason something failed instead of patching the symptom, and you make sure the same failure never happens twice. You turn a messy, growing CRM into a system people can trust, and you can prove it with data.

As the guardian of our CRM you will

Investigate root causes, not symptoms. When something in HubSpot fails, you own it. You dig into what actually went wrong, validate the real root cause, and drive it to a fix. You are the single point of contact when the CRM misbehaves, and nothing gets dropped on your watch.

Prevent the next bug before it happens. You do not just close errors, you learn from them. You spot the patterns, harden the implementations that keep breaking, and put guardrails in place so a whole class of problems disappears. Every automation and implementation, local or global, follows our guidelines because you make sure it does, before and after it goes live.

Measure the health of the CRM. You build the dashboards that show, at a glance, whether what we ship actually works and keeps working. You track error rates, adoption, and data quality over time, so CRM health stops being a feeling and becomes a number we can watch and improve.

Turn data into action. You are as comfortable reading the numbers as fixing the system. You globalise and clean up our reporting once the requirements from Commercial Excellence are aligned, retire the dashboards no one needs, and use data to find the problems no one has noticed yet.

Build and improve, hands on. You create new automations and refine the ones we have, you read the logic of a workflow well enough to debug it, and you keep the instance clean, governed, and scalable across every market in Europe.

Your goal is to maximise the value and the trust in the CRM our salespeople rely on. Your success is measured in the health of the platform: fewer recurring failures, faster time to a real fix, cleaner data, and leaders who believe the numbers again because someone is watching them every day.

What is your story?

You need to be eager to learn and improve every day. Some qualities you must have:

  • A detective's instinct: you are not satisfied with a symptom, you want the root cause, and you enjoy the hunt

  • An owner's mindset: you do not wait to be told, you know the instance and you act on it

  • Reactive when it counts and proactive by default: when something breaks you are on it and you meet the SLA, and when you see a risk you raise it before it spreads

  • Data-driven and analytical: you read data, understand the problem, and propose the fix

  • The confidence to challenge a request rather than just take it, because requests will not only come from us, and the right thing to build is your job to protect

  • Experience with a CRM (HubSpot ideal, Salesforce or similar is welcome), with ticketing and SLAs, and comfort building automations and reading the logic behind them

This is not a deep-specialist or heavy-code role. Understanding custom code is a plus, but the heart of the job is investigation, prevention, reporting, and governance. If you get satisfaction from taking something messy and making it trustworthy, this is your role.

Teya is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work. We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, stronger outcomes, and a more supportive workplace for all.

If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process whether for interviews, assessments, or other parts of the application—we encourage you to let us know. We are committed to ensuring that every candidate has a fair and accessible experience with us.

jobs.description:
Structural Designer – Timber & Wood Framing

3D Structural Modeling | Revit / Cadwork | Fabrication & Construction

About the Role

DC Structures is looking for a Structural Designer to join our design and fabrication team.

This is not simply a drafting position.

Our Structural Designers virtually build our structures in 3D before they are fabricated and constructed in the field.

Working from architectural plans, structural engineering requirements, and project specifications, you will develop detailed 3D models of the complete structural framing system using Revit and/or Cadwork.

You will model and detail the structural components that make up our buildings—including wall framing, floor systems, roof systems, beams, posts, heavy timber, connections, openings, and other structural elements. Your work becomes the bridge between architecture, engineering, fabrication, and construction.

What You'll Do

Structural Modeling & Design

Develop detailed 3D structural models using Revit and/or Cadwork
Model complete wood-framed and heavy timber building systems
Develop framing layouts for walls, floors, roofs, beams, posts, and timber systems
Translate architectural drawings and structural engineering requirements into coordinated, buildable structural models
Determine how structural components come together and identify potential conflicts before they reach the field
Incorporate engineering requirements, details, connections, and revisions into the structural model
Coordinate architectural, structural, and fabrication requirements within the model
Review your work for accuracy, constructability, efficiency, and completeness

Construction Documents & Shop Drawings

Turn the structural model into the information our fabrication and construction teams need to build the project.

You will:

Produce detailed structural drawings

Develop framing plans and details

Create shop and fabrication drawings

Produce cut sheets and component drawings
Create detailed material and component takeoffs
Develop drawings for engineering and client review
Incorporate engineering and project revisions into final construction documents
Help create accurate information for prefabrication and field installation

Fabrication & Prefabrication

DC Structures prefabricates significant portions of our structural building packages before they arrive at the jobsite.

Our Structural Designers play a critical role in making that possible.

You will work closely with our fabrication and operations teams to ensure that what is modeled on the computer can be accurately fabricated, packaged, delivered, and assembled in the field.

This means thinking beyond what something looks like on a drawing and understanding:

Collaborate throughout the design and prefabrication process with:

Architects

Structural engineers

Project managers

Fabrication teams
Construction teams
General contractors
Clients
Vendors and suppliers
You will help identify and resolve design conflicts, constructability challenges, and missing information before they become problems during fabrication or construction.

The Type of Projects You'll Work On

DC Structures specializes in highly customized wood-framed and heavy timber buildings throughout the United States.

Projects include:

Luxury custom homes

Heavy timber residences

Barn homes

Equestrian facilities
Wedding and event venues
Wineries and tasting rooms
Commercial buildings
Mixed-use structures

Large custom timber structures

Many of our projects combine conventional wood framing with heavy timber, engineered wood products, complex roof systems, large spans, custom connections, and prefabricated components.

Every project is different.

What We're Looking For:

Experienced Structural / BIM Designer

You may already have experience with:

Revit

Cadwork

Tekla

AutoCAD
BIM modeling
Structural drafting
Wood framing design
Timber framing
Shop drawings

Fabrication modeling

Qualifications:

Strongly Preferred

Wood framing or heavy timber construction knowledge
Ability to read architectural and structural construction documents
Understanding of building sequencing and constructability
Experience with 3D modeling, CAD, BIM, drafting, or detailing

Experience with Revit and/or Cadwork

Experience producing construction documents, framing plans, or shop drawings

Additional Skills

Strong computer aptitude

Bluebeam proficiency

Microsoft Office proficiency

Strong mathematical and spatial reasoning
Ability to visualize complex structures in three dimensions
Excellent organization and attention to detail
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

We're looking for someone who is:

Detail-oriented

Curious

Technically minded

Construction-minded
A strong problem solver
Self-motivated
Accountable
Comfortable asking questions
Able to communicate with both designers and builders
Interested in continuously improving systems and processes

From Design to Fabrication to Construction

Our Structural Designers are involved in a critical part of the DC Structures process:

Architecture → Structural Engineering → 3D Structural Modeling → Fabrication → Delivery → Construction

You will see the structures you model become real buildings.

That's what makes this position different from a traditional drafting role.

You're not simply documenting a building.

You're helping figure out how we're going to build it.

About DC Structures

DC Structures specializes in the design and delivery of custom wood-framed and heavy timber building packages throughout the United States.

We bring together architecture, structural design, engineering coordination, material procurement, prefabrication, and construction expertise to deliver highly customized structures.

Our team works on projects ranging from luxury residences and timber homes to equestrian facilities, wineries, event venues, and large commercial structures.

DC Structures — dcstructures.com

DC Builders — dcbuilding.com

As a Senior Full-Stack Engineer on the Grafana Catalog team, you will help grow the Grafana plugin ecosystem. Plugins are how Grafana connects to almost any data source, panel type or app, and the catalog has more than 300 of them from Grafana Labs, commercial partners and the open source community.

We own the full plugin lifecycle. Developers build plugins with our tooling, publish them to the catalog, and users discover, install and update them in Grafana and Grafana Cloud. We are also building the Grafana Marketplace, which lets partners and independent developers sell their plugins to Grafana users. It is in pilot today and you will help us take it from there.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • The Grafana Marketplace: paid plugins, publisher onboarding, and how customers buy and get access to them
  • The plugin catalog in grafana.com and inside Grafana, where users search, compare and discover plugins
  • Plugin installation and management in Grafana and Grafana Cloud
  • Plugin delivery: publishing, signing, validation and the CDN that serves plugins to every Grafana Cloud instance
  • Plugin review: every plugin published to the catalog goes through our review process before it reaches users
  • Developer tooling and developer portal that helps develop the plugins

A typical “day in the life” could include:

  • Building new Marketplace features across the Grafana frontend, our Go services and grafana.com
  • Improving how users find and install plugins, for both humans and agents like Grafana Assistant
  • Making it easier and faster for developers to build, test and publish plugins
  • Automating and improving the review process that every published plugin goes through
  • Supporting the operations and reliability of plugin installs and delivery in Grafana Cloud
  • Talking to plugin developers and partners and turning their feedback into roadmap items
  • Coming up with suggestions for process improvements
  • Working closely with the rest of the Grafana Division

Job Description:

Baker Tilly is hiring a The Senior Director, Identity and Access Management (IAM) for our Enterprise IT team. This leader will define and execute a modern identity strategy for a large, complex enterprise of more than 15,000 users; improve IAM maturity, reliability, automation, and user experience; and ensure identity services securely enable workforce, privileged, B2B, and B2C use cases across cloud and SaaS platforms. The role leads people, platforms, partners, and operational outcomes across a variety of identity and security technologies.


Responsibilities:

Set IAM strategy, architecture, and capability roadmap (25%)

  • Define the enterprise IAM strategy, target-state architecture, reference patterns, standards, and multi-year capability roadmap aligned to business, security, cloud, data, and application strategies.
  • Provide executive ownership for workforce identity, privileged access, identity governance, authentication, authorization, federation, external identity, machine/non-human identity, and directory services.
  • Translate business and regulatory requirements into sequenced investments, measurable maturity outcomes, and product/capability roadmaps with clear dependencies and benefits.

IAM engineering, platform modernization, and IaC (20%)

  • Lead IAM engineering across Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, SailPoint, Azure, AWS, Databricks, Salesforce, Workday, and supporting integration platforms.
  • Establish and scale Infrastructure as Code (IaC), policy-as-code, automated testing, CI/CD, reusable modules, version control, and environment promotion practices for identity platforms.
  • Drive modernization away from manual, one-off administration toward API-first, event-driven, automated, resilient, and observable identity services.
  • Ensure architecture and engineering patterns support high availability, disaster recovery, zero trust, least privilege, and secure-by-default implementation.

IAM operations, reliability, and service management (20%)

  • Own operational performance and service health for enterprise IAM services, including incident/problem management, monitoring, alerting, capacity, resilience, lifecycle management, and vendor support.
  • Establish measurable service levels, operational KPIs/KRIs, runbooks, on-call/escalation models, and continuous-improvement mechanisms.
  • Reduce operational toil and access-related risk through automation, self-service, proactive detection, root-cause elimination, and disciplined problem management.
  • Oversee joiner/mover/leaver execution and access lifecycle controls spanning Workday, SailPoint, Entra ID/Active Directory, SaaS applications, and cloud platforms.

IAM product/capability management and maturity (15%)

  • Operate IAM as an enterprise product/capability with defined customers, outcomes, roadmap, backlog, architecture guardrails, adoption measures, and lifecycle plans.
  • Assess current IAM maturity, establish target maturity levels, and lead sustained improvement across governance, technology, process, data quality, operating model, and user experience.Lead organizational and process change associated with MFA, passwordless authentication, access governance, privileged access, application onboarding, and modern identity standards.
  • Partner with Security, Enterprise Architecture, HR, Legal, Risk, Audit, application teams, and business leaders to drive adoption and resolve cross-functional ownership decisions.

Enterprise identity integration and external identity (10%)

  • Design and govern scalable identity patterns for an enterprise of more than 15,000 users, including employees, contingent workers, partners, clients, customers, service accounts, and non-human identities.
  • Lead B2B and B2C identity capabilities, federation, single sign-on, lifecycle integration, conditional access, and delegated administration across internal and external ecosystems.
  • Ensure identity is consistently integrated into Salesforce, Workday, Databricks, cloud platforms, enterprise applications, data platforms, and acquired or merged environments.

Leadership, AI-enabled IAM, risk, and governance (10%)

  • Build, lead, coach, and develop architecture, engineering, and operations teams; establish clear accountabilities and succession/capability plans.
  • Use AI and machine learning responsibly to improve IAM operations, access intelligence, anomaly detection, request fulfillment, support, access reviews, and decision quality while maintaining human oversight and control.
  • Own vendor/partner strategy, technology evaluation, commercial outcomes, audit readiness, and remediation of identity-related risks and control gaps.
  • Communicate IAM strategy, investment needs, risk posture, maturity progress, and operational health to executives and governance forums.

Qualifications

Education & Certifications/Licenses

  • Bachelor's degree in information technology, cybersecurity, computer science, engineering, business, or related field required; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • Master's degree preferred.
  • Microsoft identity/security certification (e.g., Identity and Access Administrator, Cybersecurity Architect Expert).
  • SailPoint certification or equivalent identity governance certification.
  • Cloud architecture/security certification in Microsoft Azure and/or AWS.
  • CISSP, CISM, or comparable security/technology leadership certification.

Experience

  • 12+ years of progressive experience in identity and access management, cybersecurity, enterprise infrastructure/platform engineering, or closely related technology roles.
  • 5+ years leading managers and/or senior technical teams with accountability for architecture, engineering, and operations.
  • Proven leadership of IAM in a large enterprise environment supporting more than 15,000 users and complex employee, contractor, partner, customer, and application ecosystems.
  • Demonstrated implementation and modernization experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, and SailPoint, including identity governance, SSO/federation, MFA/passwordless, conditional access, lifecycle management, and privileged access patterns.
  • Hands-on leadership experience integrating IAM with Workday as a workforce identity source and with Salesforce, Azure, AWS, Databricks, and other enterprise/cloud applications.
  • Proven implementation of Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD for identity/security platforms using tools such as Terraform, Bicep, PowerShell, Python, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or equivalent.
  • Experience building and executing multi-year IAM roadmaps, improving IAM maturity, and leading enterprise-wide process and technology change.
  • Experience operating IAM as a product/capability with measurable outcomes, roadmaps, backlogs, lifecycle plans, service metrics, and stakeholder governance.
  • Experience designing and supporting B2B and B2C identity solutions, external identity/federation, and secure partner/customer access at scale.
  • Proven operational leadership across incident/problem management, reliability, service management, audit/control evidence, disaster recovery, and security remediation.

Preferred prior work experience

  • Mergers and acquisitions, tenant/domain consolidation, identity migration, and complex hybrid/cloud transformation.
  • Zero Trust architecture, phishing-resistant authentication, non-human identity, secrets management, and cloud entitlement management.
  • Regulated or audit-intensive environments with strong controls over access certification, segregation of duties, privileged access, and evidence management.
  • Use of AI/ML, automation, or intelligent operations to improve identity risk detection, access decisions, service experience, and operational efficiency.
