jobs.description:
Job Description

A bit about this role:

The Clinical Associate is an integral part of our interdisciplinary virtual-first medical practice called Devoted Medical (DM). Devoted Medical is focused on delivering multiple clinical services to our Devoted Health members including comprehensive wellness visits, transitions of care visits, monthly longitudinal visits for our most complex and frail members, and on-demand urgent care visits. This role may include occasional weekend hours, through optional overtime.

In the role of Clinical Associate, you will be a vital liaison between our healthcare services, providers, and Devoted members. You will work closely with our clinicians to provide high-touch telehealth visits, facilitate virtual patient onboarding, and proactively support our clinical team by identifying care gaps and navigating members through a fragmented healthcare system. This includes coordinating across primary care (PCP) offices and specialty networks, managing electronic prescription requests and pharmacy communications, driving referral workflows, and tracking durable medical equipment (DME), home health care, imaging, and laboratory orders through completion. Through these efforts, you will be a strong advocate for our members, eliminating barriers to care and improving adherence to care plans. At the end of the day, your goal in this position is to ensure that every member receives the prompt, empathetic, h

igh-quality care that you would want for a beloved family member—driving measurable clinical outcomes and a superior member experience.


Responsibilities and Impact will include:

Responsibilities will vary based on the clinical program you will be supporting: Devoted Medical Primary Care Program, Devoted Medical Acute Care Program, and Devoted Medical Devoted to Me Program!


Order Management & Care Coordination

  • Collaborate with home health agencies to establish Start of Care (SOC) dates, process skilled nursing orders, and coordinate DME requests—tracking authorizations diligently until delivery is confirmed.
  • Coordinate member lab and diagnostic imaging orders, diligently tracking electronic results and documents to ensure timely clinician review and avoid backlogs or patient safety risks.
  • Manage inbound and outbound referral workflows, identifying high-quality in-network specialists and obtaining required clinical records or authorizations.
  • Assist with prescription refill requests, medication clarification routing, and adverse event/clinical inquiry escalation under provider guidance.
  • Coordinate with DM Providers on medical record collection, information gathering, setting up and confirming appointments, and submitting outbound communications from Devoted Medical.

Disclaimer: This role does not include clinical decision-making or any activity requiring licensure, and all clinical tasks are delegated by, and performed under the supervision of, licensed professionals. Clinical Associates should direct clinical concerns raised by members to the appropriate licensed team.


Quality Improvement & STARS/HEDIS Care Gap Closure

  • Review member panels and disease registries to identify and close preventive care gaps, including A1c control, blood pressure monitoring, Colorectal Cancer Screenings (CRC), Diabetic Retinal Eye Exams, Mammograms, and Kidney Health Evaluations.
  • Educate members on the importance of routine preventive screenings and coordinate in-home testing kits, mobile diagnostics, or clinic appointments to improve quality measures.

Member Advocacy & Communication

  • Serve as an advocate and reliable point of contact for members reaching out with care coordination needs via inbound calls, outreach queues, and digital messaging portals.
  • Break down complex medical instructions, plan benefits, and health system navigation into clear, compassionate, and easily understandable guidance for members and their families.
  • Review internal program referrals, initiate welcome outreach, and distribute educational materials and care kits.

Required skills and experience:

  • MA Certification (highly preferred); expired MA certifications are OK! Verification: A copy of your active or expired certification (CMA, RMA, CCMA) will be required. No Certification: If you have significant MA experience/background, we may request copies of your MA school diploma/transcripts if needed.
  • Two (2) years of patient-facing healthcare experience, with strong preference for experience in virtual care, outpatient ambulatory clinics, or telehealth settings.
  • Experience utilizing Electronic Health Record (EHR/EMR) systems (e.g., Epic, AthenaHealth, eClinicalWorks, Cerner) for clinical documentation and order tracking.
  • Thorough understanding of HIPAA regulations, patient privacy standards, and clinical documentation compliance.

Desired skills and experience:

  • Proven experience in care coordination and quality metric improvement, particularly assisting Medicare Advantage populations in closing STARS/HEDIS preventive care gaps (A1c, Colorectal Cancer, Diabetic Retinopathy, Mammography, KED and Blood Pressure).
  • English/Spanish
    • Fully bilingual in English and Spanish (written and verbal communication) preferred
  • Highly organized and adaptable, able to prioritize and manage a high-volume member panel (100+ members) across multiple channels (Inbound, Outbound queues, Advanced Dialer, digital task queues, and CRM/case management workflows).
  • Prior experience with order workflows: DME authorization tracking, home health coordination, lab/imaging requisition follow-through, and specialist referral routing.

Attributes to success:

  • Agile & Growth-Minded: Thrive in a fast-paced, high-energy, and rapidly growing organization—adapting quickly to evolving business priorities, supporting process rollouts within a given month or quarter, and maintaining composure through organizational shifts.
  • Empathetic Communicator: Skilled at de-escalating member anxiety, actively listening, and delivering warm, compassionate support to vulnerable seniors during stressful healthcare moments.
  • Strong Interdisciplinary Collaborator: Highly effective at communicating across diverse stakeholders, including physicians, advanced practice providers (APPs), registered nurses, community pharmacies, and family caregivers.
  • Versatile & Entrepreneurial: Self-starter who takes initiative and thrives as a collaborative team player—willing to be cross-trained to support sister teams across clinical programs and operational queues as needs arise.
  • Tech-Savvy Learner: Quick to adopt and navigate modern tech tools, dual-monitor workflows, electronic health records, Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs), AI-assisted documentation tools, CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce), and automated telephony/dialer systems.
  • Mission-Driven: Deeply committed to delivering healthcare with the same quality, urgency, and heart you would expect for your own family.

Salary Range:

$23.00 – $27.00 / hour

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

  • Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium

  • Generous paid time off

  • $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend

  • Stock options for all employees

  • Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

  • Parental leave program

  • 401K program

  • And more....

*Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.

Founded in 2017, Devoted Health is on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for everyone like they are family, and that includes our employees. Our robust and seamlessly integrated care platform merges advanced data and AI access with world-class clinical and service experiences to create a member experience that is unlike the industry norm. To continue building upon our mission, we want to bring together those who share our values, embrace change and advancement, and are enthusiastic about where we're going — all the while bringing their own unique qualities, experiences, and expertise, in hopes of further changing the healthcare experience.


Devoted is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.excerpt: Summary: VIAVI (NASDAQ: VIAV) has a 100+ year history of technical innovations that have evolved to keep pace and address our customers’ most pressing business issues.
jobs.description:
Summary:

VIAVI (NASDAQ: VIAV) has a 100+ year history of technical innovations that have evolved to keep pace and address our customers’ most pressing business issues. We make equipment, software, and systems that help to plan, deploy, certify, monitor, and optimize all kinds of networks - like those for mobile phones, service providers, large businesses and data centers. VIAVI is also a leader in high performance thin film optical coatings and engineered diffusers, providing light management solutions to anti-counterfeiting, consumer electronics, automotive, defense and instrumentation markets.

We are the people behind the products that help keep the world connected – at home, school, work, at play, and everywhere in between. VIAVI employees are fierce about supporting customer success and we welcome people who bring their best every day to the company - to question, to collaborate and to push for solutions that will delight our customers.

VIAVI Solutions is seeking a strategic and highly technical Product Line Manager (PLM) to join its Automated Mobility Solutions (AMS) business unit, specifically owning the evolution of the NITRO Mobile product portfolio.

In this role, you will drive the product strategy, roadmap, and commercial success of our next-generation Mobile Core Service Assurance solutions. You will blend deep cellular network domain expertise (4G EPC, 5G NSA, and 5G Standalone Service-Based Architecture) with robust software product management practices. This position bridges engineering, data science, marketing, and sales to deliver cloud-native observability, automated root-cause analysis (RCA), and AI-driven insights (AIOps) to global Tier-1 Communication Service Providers (CSPs).

Duties & Responsibilities:

1. Portfolio Strategy & Lifecycle Management:


  • Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for assigned NITRO Mobile core service assurance modules, from inception and market requirements definitions (PRDs/MRDs) to development, launch, and eventual sunset.
  • Define the multi-year portfolio roadmap, balancing tactical customer commitments with long-term strategic evolution toward automated network operations and network slicing assurance.
  • Champion cloud-native observability paradigms, ensuring NITRO Mobile platforms gracefully handle high-throughput 5G user-plane (UPF) and control-plane telemetry.

2. Product Architecture & Technical Definition:


  • Translate complex 3GPP standards and service-based interfaces into actionable software requirements for data collection, probe ingestion, and analytics dashboards.
  • Drive integration with modern orchestration and data layers, ensuring alignment with industry automation benchmarks such as TM Forum Open APIs.
  • Collaborate with engineering and data science teams to specify and validate machine learning-driven anomaly detection, predictive health indicators, and automated service triage models.

3. Business & Market Success:


  • Manage product line profitability (P&L optimization), pricing strategies, and packaging frameworks as the portfolio shifts toward virtualized, cloud-native subscription and SaaS delivery models.
  • Conduct market analysis to evaluate the Total Addressable Market (TAM), competitive landscapes (including independent software vendors and network equipment providers), and emerging operator pain points.
  • Support high-value pre-sales activities, delivering technical portfolio briefings, leading proof-of-concept (PoC) scopes, and responding to complex RFI/RFP requirements for major global carriers.

Pre-Requisites / Skills / Experience Requirements:

Technical Knowledge & Skills:


  • Cellular Core Architecture: Mastery of 4G Evolved Packet Core (EPC) and 5G Standalone (5G SA) architectures, including comprehensive familiarity with network functions like AMF, SMF, UPF, NSSF, and NWDAF.
  • Protocols & Telemetry: Deep understanding of mobile core protocol stacks (HTTP/2, GTPv2, Diameter, SIP/IMS) and real-time capture infrastructure (DPI, virtual taps, eBPF telemetry).
  • Cloud & Modern Infrastructure: Working familiarity with cloud-native deployment patterns (Kubernetes, AWS/Azure telco clouds), containerized applications, and distributed high-scale data architectures (Kafka, ClickHouse).
  • Standards Compliance: Familiarity with 3GPP performance management/trace specifications and TM Forum automation/service management frameworks.

Business & Market Requirements:


  • Product Management Excellence: Minimum of 8 to 10 years of experience as a technical Product Manager, PLM, or Solution Architect in the telecom OSS/BSS, monitoring, or service assurance space.
  • Commercial Acumen: Demonstrated experience managing software product pricing, constructing software subscription models, and generating business cases for major technology shifts.
  • Stakeholder Influence: Proven capability to influence across boundaries, collaborating effectively with software developers, system architects, finance, product marketing, and executive leadership.
  • Communication Skills: Exceptional ability to synthesize highly complex, low-level technical infrastructure challenges into clear value propositions for executive-level (C-suite) operator decision-makers.

If you have what it takes to push boundaries and seize opportunities, apply to join our team today.

jobs.description:
About Abridge

Founded in 2018, Abridge is the first AI-native clinician intelligence platform organized around the patient, built for clinicians, and designed to help health systems coordinate the clinical, financial, and evidence-based decisions for every moment of care. Powered by purpose-built AI for healthcare, Abridge connects patients, providers, payers, and life sciences companies. This year, the platform will support more than 100 million patient-clinician conversations across more than 300 of the largest and most complex health systems in the U.S. With deep workflow integration, the Abridge clinician intelligence platform has been validated to support encounters in 28+ languages across specialties and care settings.

Abridge is setting the industry standard for the responsible deployment of Al across health systems with continual and transparent Al evaluation. Clinical decision support references and cites gold-standard sources of evidence, and features like Linked Evidence map AI-generated documentation to source data, helping clinicians quickly trust and verify the output.

Abridge was awarded Best in KLAS for Ambient AI in 2025 and 2026, in addition to other accolades, including TIME Best Inventions of 2024 and 2025, CNBC Disruptor 2025, and Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies 2025.

We are a growing team of practicing clinicians, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to transform healthcare. We have offices located in San Francisco, New York, and Pittsburgh.

The Role

As Associate General Counsel, Product, you’ll be a senior legal advisor to the teams building Abridge’s products, focused on our most complex and highest-impact initiatives. You’ll work closely with product and engineering and bring together healthcare, privacy, and AI regulatory requirements with the company’s commercial and operational goals. You’ll help shape how Abridge approaches new legal questions and build the guidance and systems that let teams innovate with confidence.

This is a unique opportunity to work at the forefront of AI and healthcare, helping a category-defining company navigate novel legal terrain.

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as lead counsel on Abridge’s most complex product initiatives, from early design through launch and post-launch review, including areas where the law is still developing.

  • Shape the legal strategy for the products and features you support, giving teams practical paths forward that account for regulatory, commercial, and operational realities.

  • Advise on product launches, feature changes, user-facing disclosures, and marketing claims.

  • Partner with product, engineering, policy, partner experience, marketing, IT, finance, corporate development, and commercial teams, including senior leadership, to align on risk and move initiatives forward.

  • Turn recurring issues into practical legal processes, frameworks, and templates that scale with the company.

  • Provide strategic guidance on regulatory, privacy, and compliance matters, including the evolving AI/ML landscape, and help shape Abridge’s positions on emerging regulation.

  • Flex across the broader Product, Privacy, and Regulatory Legal portfolio as company priorities and risks change.

  • Work with outside counsel on specialist issues and turn their advice into fast, actionable guidance for the business.

  • Monitor emerging laws and regulations affecting Abridge’s products and data practices, and advise stakeholders on their implications.

What You’ll Bring

  • Passion for Abridge’s mission and the drive to support fast-moving product and operational teams.

  • 10+ years of legal experience, including 6+ years in product counseling. Prior in-house experience at a technology company is required.

  • Experience owning complex, high-stakes legal matters independently, especially where there is little settled precedent.

  • Sound business judgment and the ability to prioritize risk, balance speed with quality, and know when to bring in specialist expertise.

  • Proven ability to translate complex regulatory and legal concepts into clear, practical guidance for non-legal colleagues, including senior leaders.

  • Proven ability to build trusted relationships with technical, design, and commercial teams.

  • Comfort operating with ambiguity, tight timelines, competing priorities, and a high volume of novel legal questions.

  • Creativity in solving novel legal problems, including building new processes, language, and frameworks for a fast-moving company in an emerging industry.

Bonus Points If…

  • You have deep expertise in healthcare regulatory matters, including FDA, FTC, fraud, waste, and abuse laws, health data interoperability and/or information blocking rules, and related state laws.

  • You’re familiar with recent trends in AI, particularly large language models and responsible AI principles.

  • You have prior experience at a growth-stage, AI-native, or healthcare technology company.

Location

This role is in our San Francisco or New York office on Monday, Wednesday, and Frid

Why Work at Abridge?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.

How we take care of Abridgers:

  • Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees

  • Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.

  • Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.

  • Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees.

  • Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family.

  • 401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future.

  • Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage.

  • Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits.

  • Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more.

  • Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals.

  • Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment.

  • Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees.

  • ... and much more!

Equal Opportunity Employer

Abridge is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process.

Staying safe - Protect yourself from recruitment fraud

We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Abridge recruiters and/or hiring managers. Abridge will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process. Any emails from the Abridge recruiting team will come from an @abridge.com email address. You can learn more about how to protect yourself from these types of fraud by referring to this article. Please exercise caution and cease communications if something feels suspicious about your interactions.

How do we define Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging at Talkspace?

Diversity

Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.

Equity

Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.

Inclusion

Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.

Belonging

Belonging reflects the affinity and positive relationships that develop among employees from diverse backgrounds when businesses actively promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.

About the Working Families Party

The Working Families Party (WFP) is the progressive party for the multiracial working class, fighting for a nation that works for the many, not the few. We recruit, train, and support transformational candidates up and down the ballot — and run them to win.
We believe that no matter where we come from or what our color, most of us want the same things. We want to earn enough to thrive, not just survive, and leave a better future for our kids. We want healthy food and clean water, safe neighborhoods and a safe world. We want to be free.
The Working Families Party is regular people coming together across our differences to make a better future for us all. We’re a multiracial party that fights for workers over bosses and people over the powerful. We want an America which realizes the promise – unrealized in our history – of freedom and equality for all.

ABOUT THIS ROLE

The Working Families Party and Working Families Power share the goal of winning governing power for working people and wielding it to improve their lives. In Michigan, we have elected working-class champions and built a coalition of values-aligned electeds to begin to wield significant governing power. Through our advocacy organization Working Families Power, the Michigan Progressive Governance Director will lead the work to support these elected officials. The position of Progressive Governance Director will maintain relationships with aligned elected officials, - particularly state legislators - to help them develop progressive policy, communicate powerfully, organize in solidarity with one another, create shared strategy, and effectively engage their constituents year-round. Through the Working Families Party and WF Power, the Progressive Governance Director will also support incumbents in their electoral campaigns, support legislative caucuses and cohorts through strategy and political education, and work with partner organizations to advance the MI WFP Legislative agenda.

  • Lead WFP’s work to support progressive legislators at the federal, state, and local levels.
  • Convene regular opportunities for values-aligned legislators to talk, learn, and strategize together.
  • Plan and build programming to increase strategic alignment and ability to act in solidarity between values-aligned elected officials and community and advocacy organizations
  • Work with key local and state partners, such as re:power and Local Progress to support legislative training opportunities and other developmental opportunities
  • Develop trusting working relationships with allied legislators and partner organizations in order to advance issue advocacy
  • Provide analysis and strategy of the legislative landscape at the state and local level
  • Connect WFP electeds to outside advocacy groups and coalitions, national policy expertise, and cohorts of like-minded electeds across state lines.
  • Track priority legislation.
  • Identify opportunities to advance shared messages.
  • Create talking points and toolkits on priority issues.
  • Support MI WFP electeds in their communication to their districts.
  • Support electeds in planning their re-election campaigns as a part of MI WFP shared strategy.
  • In conjunction with the Organizing Director, develop pathways for activists to support values-aligned elected officials and legislation.
  • Train staff, activists, leaders, and newly elected candidates on how the legislature works and power building in the legislative context.
  • Other related duties as assigned.

SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

    Required:

  • At least 5 years of experience in government, advocacy, politics, or organizing.
  • Demonstrated ability to work closely with elected officials to pass progressive policy.
  • Excellent facilitation skills and the ability to build solidarity and shared strategy across differences.
  • Ability to quickly learn new contexts and policy areas.
  • Ability to make decisions with consequences in nuanced political settings.
  • Strong empathy and the ability to build collaborative relationships.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and strong judgment in moments of conflict.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and manage complex projects.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects at once and prioritize work.
  • Valid license, access to a car, and ability to travel throughout Michigan

    • Preferred:

🚀 About Finalis

Finalis is the leading platform enabling independent and boutique investment banking firms to operate legally and compliantly. The firm provides regulatory affiliation and compliance infrastructure supporting private market transactions, including M&A, capital raising, private placements, secondary transactions, and alternative investments.

✨ About the role

The Investment Banking Compliance Analyst supports Finalis’s investment banking and private markets business by providing compliance guidance throughout the transaction lifecycle. This role works directly with investment bankers and registered representatives on private placements, M&A engagements, and other private market transactions, from initial engagement and due diligence through closing.

We are looking for someone who is intellectually curious and enjoys understanding how transactions work. The strongest candidate will be comfortable analyzing complex or unfamiliar structures, asking thoughtful questions, and becoming a trusted compliance resource to our bankers.

✍️ What you'll do

Transaction & Regulatory Review

  • Review proposed investment banking engagements, engagement letters, compensation arrangements, and transaction structures for compliance with applicable securities laws, FINRA requirements, and Finalis policies.
  • Review private securities offerings and applicable Securities Act exemptions, with particular emphasis on Regulation D and Rules 506(b) and 506(c).
  • Analyze M&A, secondary, and other private market transactions for applicable securities-law and broker-dealer considerations.
  • Review M&A transactions under the federal M&A broker exemption framework and identify circumstances requiring registered broker-dealer involvement.
  • Support applicable FINRA private placement requirements, including Rules 5122 and 5123.

Due Diligence & Transaction Execution

  • Conduct risk-based due diligence on issuers, sponsors, control persons, and other relevant transaction parties and evaluate identified red flags.
  • Review offering materials, organizational documents, financial information, transaction agreements, and other relevant diligence materials.
  • Work with bankers to resolve diligence and compliance questions and appropriately document conclusions, conditions, and approvals.
  • Monitor transactions for material changes and review transaction and closing documentation for consistency with the approved structure.
  • Support transactions through closing, including satisfaction of applicable compliance conditions, books and records, and required regulatory filings.

Banker & Business Partnership

  • Serve as a day-to-day compliance resource for investment bankers and registered representatives.
  • Participate in transaction calls and work directly with bankers to understand proposed structures and resolve regulatory and compliance questions.
  • Ask thoughtful questions to understand the economic substance of transactions rather than relying solely on labels or form.
  • Translate regulatory requirements into clear, practical guidance while maintaining sound compliance judgment.
  • Stay current on regulatory developments affecting private placements, M&A, and private market transactions.

🔎 Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • 3+ years of relevant experience in broker-dealer compliance, investment banking, securities law, private markets, or a related field.
  • Working knowledge of private placements and exemptions from Securities Act registration, particularly Regulation D.
  • Familiarity with FINRA requirements applicable to private placements and investment banking activities.
  • Ability to understand complex transaction structures and legal, financial, and offering documents.
  • Strong analytical skills, sound judgment, and intellectual curiosity.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and comfort working directly with investment bankers and other sophisticated stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple active transactions and competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Bonus Track!

  • You currently hold, or have previously held, one or more relevant FINRA registrations, including the Series 7, 24, 79, and/or 82.
  • You have experience reviewing Regulation D offerings and FINRA Rules 5122 and 5123.
  • You have experience working on M&A transactions and analyzing transactions under the federal M&A broker exemption framework.
  • You have experience reviewing investment banking engagement letters, offering documents, purchase agreements, subscription documents, and closing materials.
  • You have experience conducting issuer or transaction-level due diligence and evaluating regulatory or compliance red flags.
  • You have familiarity with private funds, SPVs, secondary transactions, or other complex private market structures.
  • You have experience at an investment bank, broker-dealer, securities law firm, FINRA, the SEC, or another financial-services regulatory organization.

🌟 What we offer

  • 100% Remote work
  • Competitive USD salary
  • Generous Paid Time Off
  • Additional Flex Days
  • Benefits Package (Healthcare, Medical, Vision, Dental, 401k)
  • Paid Family Leave

We are seeking a curious, operationally minded leader to serve as Director, Utilization Management Operations. Reporting to the Vice President of Health Services, you will lead the teams behind our administrative work: a large onshore and offshore team of UM Administrative Coordinators who manage intake, outreach, notifications, and follow-up. You will also hold dotted-line accountability for monitoring and ensuring the success of our Part B medical authorization turnaround times (TAT).

This role is for someone who is energized by a complex process: someone who wants to unravel it, reimagine it, and lead the build of something simpler, faster, and more consistent. You will have significant influence over the roadmap for Orinoco, our internal technology platform, and an integrated AI engine to put to work. This role will help pave the way towards realizing the next generation of our UM program, driving improvements in effectiveness, efficiency, and experience for our members and provider partners.


Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:

  • SLA & Timeliness Ownership: Own SLA performance for the administrative steps that support authorization review across UM, delivering consistent, predictable performance at a meaningfully lower cost. Hold dotted-line accountability for Part B medical authorization turnaround times (TAT), partnering with the clinical leaders of that team to monitor performance, surface risks early, and remove administrative barriers to on-time decisions.
  • Process Reimagination: Map our administrative processes end to end, including auth intake, requests for additional clinical information, facility census checks, member and provider notifications, and member follow-up, and lead their redesign for speed, consistency, and simplicity.
  • Technology & AI Leadership: Partner with Product and Engineering to shape the Orinoco roadmap so that process and technology evolve together. Put our integrated AI tools to work to remove manual effort, so our administrative capacity no longer has to grow at the same rate as our membership.
  • Build for Measurement: Design processes that are highly measurable and transparent by default. Partner with Data Science to define and monitor the KPIs that matter, including timeliness, cost per authorization, quality, and provider experience, and use them to drive decisions and continuous improvement.
  • People & Vendor Leadership: Lead and develop a team that includes approximately 50 onshore UM Administrative Coordinators and their leaders. Manage our offshore vendor partnership, which supports more than 250 administrative team members, holding it to clear performance standards while building a shared culture of ownership and care.
  • Provider & Member Experience: Partner with the Provider Network team to understand what providers and facilities need from this process, and build it in. Design every touchpoint, from outreach to notifications to follow-up, with the humans on the other end in mind.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with the Senior Director of UM, who owns end-to-end authorization performance, along with the UM Medical Directors, Compliance, Provider Network, Data Science, and Engineering teams to keep the operation aligned and consistently audit-ready.

Required skills and experience:

  • Mission & Heart: A genuine commitment to treating members like family, and a belief that operational excellence and empathy belong together.
  • Proven Operator at Scale: A track record of leading high-volume operations that deliver consistent SLA performance.
  • Builder Mindset: Experience taking a complex, multi-step process apart and leading the build of a simpler, more scalable one, rather than only maintaining what exists. You are naturally curious and ask why a step exists before deciding how to improve it.
  • Metrics-Oriented: You build for measurement, are comfortable working deep in the workflows and the data, and use both to drive decisions and hold teams and partners accountable.
  • Technology & AI Curiosity: Experience partnering with product and engineering teams, and genuine excitement about using AI-enabled tools to transform how work gets done.
  • Vendor Management: Experience managing vendor partners against clear performance and quality standards.
  • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex problems into actionable updates for leadership and stakeholders.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree required.

Desired skills and experience:

  • Healthcare Operations: Experience in payer operations, utilization management, claims, provider revenue cycle, or a similar high-volume healthcare environment. Prior UM experience is not required.
  • Medicare Advantage Familiarity: Understanding of Medicare Advantage operations and CMS requirements.

It is a customer-facing technical pursuit and architecture position designed to extend the regional field Solutions Engineer, lead strategic and transformational opportunities, and convert each engagement into reusable technical intellectual property for SHI.

This position is a remote position with Home Office setup as determined by SHI management.

Role Description

  • Partner with SHI account teams and regional Solutions Engineers to qualify, scope, and lead complex Dell Technologies opportunities while preserving regional ownership and customer continuity.
  • Lead discovery sessions that translate ambiguous business, operational, application, security, and infrastructure requirements into clear architecture decisions, assumptions, dependencies, and next steps.
  • Analyze assessment data, workload requirements, configuration information, and technical telemetry to support evidence-based sizing and architecture decisions.
  • Design and defend Dell-based solutions across compute and AI, storage, private cloud and hyperconverged infrastructure, data protection and cyber resilience, and data center networking.
  • Create architectures using relevant Dell Technologies platforms, including PowerEdge, PowerStore, PowerScale, PowerSwitch, Dell Private Cloud, Dell Automation Platform, PowerProtect, Cyber Recovery, and supporting AIOps capabilities.
  • Lead customer whiteboards, technical workshops, architecture reviews, demonstrations, proofs of concept, and validation activities for complex or transformational pursuits.
  • Explain architectural trade-offs and competitive alternatives with credibility, using SHI’s cross-OEM perspective while maintaining a clear, evidence-based recommendation.
  • Integrate Dell infrastructure with the customer’s broader environment, including VMware Cloud Foundation, Nutanix, Microsoft and public-cloud services, data protection ecosystems, networking fabrics, automation, and SHI professional services.
  • Collaborate with Dell field, specialist, engineering, and roadmap resources to validate designs, resolve technical risks, and align the right resources to strategic pursuits.
  • Develop complete technical deliverables such as discovery guides, reference architectures, sizing checklists, bills of material inputs, migration considerations, battlecards, workshop decks, and decision or risk logs.
  • Produce reusable technical IP from customer engagements and contribute it to the team repository so successful approaches can be repeated across regions.
  • Enable SHI sales and technical teams through field coaching, opportunity support, technical briefings, solution playbooks, and customer-ready content.
  • Maintain opportunity awareness by identifying attach opportunities, services alignment, lifecycle and modernization triggers, competitive displacement potential, and agreed technical next steps.
  • Manage multiple concurrent pursuits with disciplined documentation, follow-up, stakeholder communication, and escalation.

Behaviors and Competencies

  • Adaptability: Can proactively adapt to challenging situations, anticipate changes, and make modifications to meet the demands of changing circumstances.
  • Communication: Can effectively communicate complex ideas and information to diverse audiences and can facilitate effective communication between others.
  • Documentation: Independently produces and maintains documentation for routine processes; ensures accuracy and consistency.
  • Leadership: Can proactively seek out leadership roles, initiate team projects, and contribute to team development and success.
  • Problem Solving: Can proactively identify potential problems, initiate preventive measures, and propose and contribute to innovative solutions.
  • Teamwork: Can lead a team effectively, facilitate cooperation, sharing information, and ensuring that all team members are able to contribute to their full potential.
  • Self – Motivation: Can proactively seek out challenges, initiate self-development projects, and contribute to personal or professional innovative ideas.


Skill Level Requirements


  • Advanced experience leading complex data center architecture and pre-sales technical engagements.
  • Advanced knowledge in at least one Dell Technologies domain, with working knowledge across multiple adjacent areas including Compute + AI, Storage, Private Cloud + HCI, Data Protection, and Networking.
  • Expertise in architecting, sizing, integrating, and positioning Dell Technologies infrastructure within complex, multi-vendor customer environments.
  • Ability to lead technical discovery and translate business and application requirements into architecture, configuration guidance, migration considerations, and validation plans.
  • Strong experience with PowerEdge and accelerator-based infrastructure supporting virtualization, private cloud, modern applications, and AI workloads.
  • Strong knowledge of enterprise storage concepts and Dell platforms such as PowerStore and PowerScale, including performance, availability, data services, connectivity, and operational considerations.
  • Strong understanding of private cloud and HCI technologies, including Dell Private Cloud, Dell Automation Platform, VMware Cloud Foundation, Nutanix, and relevant Microsoft technologies.
  • Experience with data protection and cyber-resilience architectures, including PowerProtect, Cyber Recovery, CyberSense, backup and recovery, immutability, recovery validation, and business continuity.
  • Working knowledge of data center networking, including Ethernet fabrics, PowerSwitch, SONiC, storage connectivity, and infrastructure integration dependencies.
  • Ability to confidently present, articulate, and defend proposed solutions during customer-facing architecture reviews, technical discussions, and executive-level presentations.
  • Ability to clearly communicate technical, operational, and business value while supporting the sales process and maintaining architectural integrity.
  • Excellent problem-solving, collaboration, technical communication, and customer-facing skills.

Other Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience required.
  • Five or more years of experience in solutions architecture, systems engineering, technical pre-sales, infrastructure consulting, or a comparable customer-facing role preferred.
  • Demonstrated customer-facing experience with complex infrastructure discovery, design, presentation, and technical decision support.
  • Ability to travel to SHI, Dell Technologies, partner, and customer meetings and events as business needs require.
  • Current Dell Technologies training or certification in one or more relevant domains preferred; advanced architecture, VMware, Nutanix, Microsoft, networking, security, or data protection credentials are also valued.


The estimated annual pay range for this position is $180,000 - $250,000 which includes a base salary and bonus. The compensation for this position is dependent on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location and, therefore, will vary from individual to individual. Benefits may include, but are not limited to, medical, vision, dental, 401K, and flexible spending.

Equal Employment Opportunity – M/F/Disability/Protected Veteran Status

Standard Job Description

When it comes to using cutting-edge machine learning to tackle complex problems, Lockheed Martin is driven by a singular mission focus and desire to continuously innovate. Today’s challenges to global security aren’t just changing – they’re accelerating faster than ever before. Through our dedication to our mission, our AI-enabled systems are changing the way militaries operate and protect their forces, the way first responders fight fires, and how researchers explore the far reaches of space and the ocean’s depths.

The Lockheed Martin Artificial Intelligence Center (LAIC) team is seeking a high energy engineer with hands-on experience in developing AI/ML software in support of the AI Consulting team. In this role you will be part of the larger AI Foundations organization consisting of colleagues possessing varying skill sets including AI/Machine Learning specialists, front-end and back-end developers, data engineers, product managers, and other data scientists. The selected candidate will focus on the AI Consulting team, but will be included as part of a broader range of projects across the LAIC portfolio. The AI Consulting team is focused on employing small, innovative, and agile teams to rapidly iterate and mature solutions from prototypes to deployment for utilization across the Lockheed Martin enterprise.
The LAIC AI Consulting Team’s mission includes serving as a center of excellence for AI at Lockheed Martin. The candidate will work to disseminate best practices of the AI Consulting team to other AI and data science teams in the corporation. The candidate will be required to create knowledge materials to publish these best practices, as well as meet with other data science leaders in Lockheed Martin to teach and discuss these practices.

The Full Stack Software Engineer Stf designs, develops, deploys, and supports secure, scalable, and reliable software solutions across the full application lifecycle. The role is responsible for frontend and backend development, API and database design, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, security controls, and production application stability.

This position will build and operate AI/ML-enabled web applications, integrating services such as model-serving APIs, LLM providers, vector-search tools, and internal machine-learning platforms. Responsibilities include translating business requirements into user-focused technical solutions; developing responsive interfaces and backend services; and ensuring applications are maintainable, performant, and secure.

The engineer will provide technical leadership in Agile delivery, infrastructure automation, deployment processes, monitoring, incident response, and reliability improvements. The role partners with product, data science, security, infrastructure, operations, and business stakeholders while mentoring engineers and establishing sound engineering standards.

Desired Skills

  • Experience delivering and operating AI/ML-powered web applications, including integrations with model-serving APIs, LLM providers, embedding or vector-search systems, and internal machine-learning platforms.

  • Experience improving the reliability, scalability, and availability of cloud-native applications through Kubernetes operations, autoscaling, networking, secrets management, load balancing, monitoring, alerting, incident response, and capacity planning.

  • Experience with asynchronous and event-driven architectures, including message queues, background jobs, streaming workflows, serverless services, or similar patterns.
  • Proven technical leadership, including establishing engineering standards, mentoring engineers, and proactively managing production risks related to quality, performance, usability, reliability, and security.

jobs.excerpt: Client Partner (East Coast, US)Lateral stands for technology excellence.
jobs.description:
Client Partner (East Coast, US)

Lateral stands for technology excellence.

We’re a profitable, award-winning design and technology company with over 20 years of experience launching bold ventures and transforming businesses. A globally distributed team of 200+ experts united by a shared purpose: the continuous pursuit of quality.

Our clients come to us for results, quality and craft - and stay because we keep raising the bar.

We do things differently at Lateral

Our mission is simple: design and build great products.
What sets us apart isn’t just the talent of our team - it’s the way we work:

We Have A Bias For Action & Results

We are doers - we spot the gaps, connect the dots, anticipate what’s around the corner and take action. We move fast, stay focused, and let the results - not the effort - speak for themselves.

We Work On Time, On Budget, On Quality

Discipline is our edge - a commitment we make to each other, to our clients, and to the standards we hold ourselves to.

We Care Deeply

We care about our work and about each other. Care Is A Competitive Advantage. Every detail matters. Every design, every line of code, every decision. Thoughtful by default.

We Do Things Right - Because It’s the Right Thing to Do

Right over easy. Integrity isn’t up for negotiation. We hold the bar high even when no one’s watching. We take pride in doing great work the right way - not the easy way.

We Keep Improving

The best teams keep improving and we’re never done learning. We iterate. We reflect on what’s working and what’s not. Feedback fuels us, we receive it openly, and adapt quickly. Progress over perfection.

We’re Obsessed With Agility, Not The Agile Manifesto

We don’t chase dogma or rituals - we chase momentum. We adapt processes to fit problems, not the other way around.


We Take Ownership

Everyone leads something here. You will have room to run with ideas, and the trust to execute. That trust is built on how you show up: thinking things through, sweating the details, and following through.

What You’ll Do

As a Client Partner at Lateral, you’ll be the trusted business partner to our clients, shaping how they think about technology as a driver of measurable value. You’ll own key client relationships end to end: from identifying opportunities and shaping deals, to ensuring delivery meets (and exceeds) commercial outcomes.

This is a role for someone who blends commercial acumen, consultative selling, and delivery awareness. You’ll know how to open doors, nurture relationships, and connect Lateral’s capabilities to client business priorities.

You will:

  • Build, grow, and own a portfolio of client relationships, driving long-term revenue and partnership value.

  • Identify and convert new opportunities within existing and new accounts. You’ll know how to move from a first conversation to a signed engagement with clarity and confidence.

  • Partner with Delivery and Technical Leads to ensure projects align with client goals and deliver tangible business results.

  • Be the voice of the client inside Lateral translating their commercial objectives into clear internal focus.

  • Develop and execute account strategies: mapping stakeholders, anticipating needs, and expanding our footprint through trust and results.

  • Represent Lateral externally - you’ll already have a network you can activate on day one.

  • Stay close to delivery without being in it: you’ll track satisfaction, renewals, and the health of the partnership, ensuring we keep raising the bar.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for a self-starting, commercially driven operator who thrives at the intersection of business development and delivery excellence.

You must bring:

  • Proven commercial results. You’ve personally led complex deals from 0% to 100% and can walk us through how you built the relationship, structured the opportunity, and closed it.

  • An active network. You have a Rolodex of people you’d call on day one - contacts who trust your judgment and would take your call because you’ve delivered value before.

  • Agency mindset. You move fast, think commercially, and build momentum without needing playbooks. You can create opportunity where none existed.

  • Client leadership. You’ve been the face of delivery and the commercial voice for clients, ensuring their business objectives stay at the heart of everything we build.

  • Strategic curiosity. You’re energized by understanding how businesses make money, where technology creates leverage, and how to shape deals that align both.

  • Reputation for excellence. If we called five people you’ve worked with, they’d describe you as proactive, trustworthy, sharp, and relentless in driving results.

  • Comfort in ambiguity. You can build clarity where there’s none and know when to push, when to listen, and when to close.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Real Impact: You’ll work on meaningful products that make a measurable difference - from healthcare and commerce to sustainability and next-gen tech.

  • Remote-First, Office Friendly: Work from wherever you’re most productive - whether that’s your home, a co-working space, or one of our offices. We’re a remote-first company, but if you’re near an office, you’re welcome to drop in, collaborate in person, or work onsite regularly.

    We prioritize async collaboration, respect your time zone, and focus on outcomes over hours.

  • An Outstanding Team: Talented, kind, and hard-working people who care deeply about their craft - and about each other. No egos. No politics. Just professionals doing their best work.

  • Growth: You’ll be supported in growing your craft, exploring new paths, and stepping into greater responsibility - at your own pace

  • A Culture of Excellence: We care deeply about doing the right thing - for our clients, our team, and ourselves. No burnout. No crunch. Just high-quality work, delivered sustainably.

  • Variety & Stability: We’re profitable, independent, and over a decade strong. Yet every project brings a fresh challenge. You’ll never be bored here.

This Role Might Not Be for You

We want to respect your time by being clear about what this role isn’t. You should skip this opportunity if:

  • You prefer well defined structure. If you gravitate towards a clear hierarchy, well defined roles and swim lanes, you may find our self-managed style challenging.

  • Distributed work isn’t your thing. If you find async communication, design documentation and being proactive without a manager nearby difficult, our setup won’t suit you.

  • Feedback doesn't excite you. We’re obsessed with quality and believe in continuous improvement. That means we give feedback that’s sometimes nitpicky. If refining the work until it’s excellent feels over the top, you are likely going to find working here frustrating.

  • Change makes you uncomfortable. We’re scaling and maturing. That means not everything is perfect yet. Priorities shift. Processes evolve. If ambiguity is uncomfortable, this may feel bumpy.

However, If this sounds like fuel, we’d love to talk!

How to apply and what to expect in the interview process

01. Your work
Show us the work that reflects you at your best. We’ll look at depth, design thinking, and the logic behind your choices.

02. Lateral team fit
You’ll speak with our Talent team about your career direction, your motivators, and our plans ahead.

03. Work trial

You’ll tackle a take-home challenge that mirrors what we actually do.

04.Engineering deep dive
A collaborative session with our engineers.

05. Project fit
An interview focussed on prioritization, collaboration across disciplines, and how you handle the "messy middle".

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Compliance Director and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one.

You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area.

What You’ll Own

  • Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures.

  • Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite.

  • Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients.

  • Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity.

  • Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments.

  • File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR.

  • Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board.

  • Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest.

  • Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters.

  • Prepare the firm for the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027.

  • Build the compliance and AML team as the business grows.

What We’re Looking For

  • Significant experience in AML/CTF at a regulated EU financial institution. Ideally at an investment firm, neobroker, neobank or e-money institution.

  • Experience with digital onboarding and remote identity verification at scale.

  • Hands-on experience building risk assessments, monitoring scenarios and EDD processes.

  • Experience filing suspicious activity reports and handling regulatory inspections.

  • Knowledge of MiFID II conduct and investment-services compliance, or the ability to learn it fast.

  • Experience selecting and overseeing KYC, screening and monitoring tools.

  • Strong judgment and the confidence to challenge senior colleagues.

  • Clear, concise writing for policies, board reports and regulators.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a key function holder.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania or the FNTT.

  • Knowledge of Lithuanian AML law and Bank of Lithuania instructions.

  • Experience with clients across several EEA countries.

  • CAMS (ACAMS) or ICA certification.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • People who copy policies from templates without fitting them to the business.

  • People who say no without offering a compliant way forward.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

About Matter Health

Matter Health delivers primary and preventive healthcare directly to older adults living in public housing communities. Our mission is simple: to improve healthcare access by meeting patients where they are and building trusted relationships within the communities we serve. We are rapidly expanding and are seeking mission-driven professionals who thrive in fast-paced, people-centered environments.

We Lead with Love in Everything We Do.

About the Role

Matter Health is seeking a hands-on, mission-driven AI Automation Workflow Specialist to join our Information Technology team. This individual contributor role is responsible for building and deploying AI-assisted workflow automations that support our operations, clinical, care support, and field-based teams, helping them spend less time on repetitive tasks and more time on the patients and work that matter most.

Working directly with business and clinical stakeholders, you will identify day-to-day workflow opportunities, configure and deploy automations using Matter Health's established AI tools and platform, and support adoption across the organization. This is a building and operational role, not a platform architecture or people management position.

This role is ideal for someone who learns new AI tools quickly, enjoys partnering with non-technical teams to solve real problems, and is excited about applying emerging AI capabilities in service of a genuine mission. This position reports to the Chief Technology Officer. This is a fully remote role with up to 10% travel for occasional in-person meetings or team offsites.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with clinical, care support, operations, and field-based teams to understand day-to-day workflows, pain points, and opportunities for AI-driven automation
  • Gather requirements from stakeholders with varying levels of technical fluency and translate real operational problems into automation ideas that can be built and tested quickly
  • Collect structured and informal feedback from clinicians, care support agents, operations staff, and field-based teams to guide ongoing iteration of deployed automations
  • Submit identified opportunities into the team's intake process and collaborate with the AI Platform Engineer and requesting-team leadership to define priorities
  • Use approved AI tools, agent platforms, and automation software to configure, build, and deploy workflow automations and AI-assisted processes for operations, clinical, care support, and field-based teams
  • Write and refine prompts and configure workflow logic within existing platform tooling, templates, and standards to automate repetitive day-to-day tasks
  • Test and refine deployed automations with real users, iterating based on usage feedback and observed performance
  • Monitor day-to-day performance of deployed automations and escalate issues related to accuracy, reliability, or unexpected behavior to the AI Platform Engineer or Engineering team
  • Follow established platform standards, prompt and context templates, and controls when building and deploying automations, including those handling protected health information (PHI)
  • Create documentation, training materials, and enablement content to support successful adoption of new AI-driven workflows
  • Maintain a library of deployed automations, prompts, and workflow configurations to support consistency, reuse, and knowledge sharing across the organization
  • Support change management and adoption efforts as new automations are rolled out across operational teams
  • Partner with the AI Platform Engineer and stakeholders to evaluate when a deployed automation is ready to expand, refine, or retire

Qualifications

Required

• Associate's or Bachelor's degree, or equivalent practical experience

  • 1-3 years of experience in business operations, process improvement, workflow automation, or a related operational role
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools, chatbots, or no-code/low-code automation platforms to build or configure workflows
  • Strong ability to gather requirements from business and clinical stakeholders with varying levels of technical fluency
  • Comfortable working within established technical standards, prompt and context templates, and controls without needing to design underlying platform architecture
  • Experience documenting workflows and automation configurations clearly for both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Basic understanding of responsible AI practices and safe handling of sensitive data, including protected health information (PHI)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain new tools clearly to non-technical audiences

Preferred

  • Experience in the healthcare industry; familiarity with clinical operations, call center or care support workflows, or field-based care models is a plus
  • Experience with EMR systems, healthcare data, or clinical workflow tools
  • Familiarity with value-based care, Medicare, or Medicare Advantage environments
  • Experience supporting distributed, remote, or field-based teams
  • Background in change management, user training, or internal enablement
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, high-growth organization where priorities evolve

What Success Looks Like

  • Meaningful hours saved for operational, clinical, and field-based teams through deployed automations
  • Strong adoption of deployed automations by their target teams and users
  • A growing library of automations successfully built, deployed, and actively maintained in production
  • Efficient intake-to-launch cycle time from approved automation request to deployment
  • Collaborative, trusted relationships with clinical and operational stakeholders across the organization
  • Clear and accessible documentation that enables teams to understand and build on deployed workflows
  • Active contribution to a growing culture of AI-native thinking across the organization

Why Matter Health

At Matter Health, we believe that where you live should never determine the quality of care you receive. Every team member is vital in improving healthcare access for older adults who have historically been underserved by traditional healthcare systems.

This isn't just a mission statement. It's the work we do every day.

Our culture is the ideal blend of entrepreneurial spirit and enterprise investment, enabling the chance to move at a rapid pace with some of the most complex, leading-edge technologies available.

For over 35 years, the experts at Mitratech have been focused on solving the complex needs. Today, we serve 20,000 client companies of all sizes globally, representing 30% of the Fortune 500 and over 500,000 users in over 160 countries.

As we continue to grow, we’re always looking for resourceful, enthusiastic, and fresh perspectives. Join our global team and see what makes Mitratech a truly exceptional place to work!

Job Overview:

You’ll be joining our Mitratech Workforce Compliance Engineering team, building AI-first SaaS products. This role sits at the intersection of two disciplines. First, you’ll build the AI features our customers use every day: LLM-powered workflows, retrieval over compliance content, and agents that take action inside our products. Second, you’ll help lead how we build software, using agentic, pipeline-driven development in which AI coding agents plan, write, test, and review code under strong engineering oversight.

We hold both to the same bar: high quality (low escaped defects), well tested (Cypress automation framework with focus on unit test coverage), secure (scanned and verified), scalable (AWS, but hardware isn’t the answer), and measurably accurate when AI is involved. This is a great opportunity to join a growing company, be part of an excellent team, architect solutions to complex problems, and deliver valuable features where clean code, and trustworthy AI, matter.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

Agentic, Pipeline-Driven Development

  • System Design & Task Decomposition: Break down high-level product goals into well-defined, modular engineering tasks with clear specifications and acceptance criteria that can be executed by both engineers and AI coding agents.
  • Agentic Development Pipelines: Develop and optimize CI/CD pipelines that incorporate AI agents for code generation, automated testing, and intelligent code review, with guardrails, quality gates, and clear human approval points.
  • Specification & Context Engineering: Design and test structured instructions, prompts, specifications, and repository context (e.g., agent instruction files, reusable skills, MCP tools) that drive accurate, context-aligned output from AI agents, and measure and improve agent output over time.
  • Code Review & Validation: Conduct in-depth reviews of both human and AI-generated code, ensuring quality, security, scalability, and alignment with domain requirements.
  • Architectural Oversight: Ensure design plans created by both human engineers and AI tools adhere to architectural best practices with a focus on modularity, bounded contexts, etc.
  • Documentation and Domain Clarity: Contribute to the development of domain models, technical documentation, and internal knowledge bases that support AI agent performance and team activity.

Engineering Excellence & Teamwork

  • Write secure code. Avoid introducing an OWASP vulnerability, including those in the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications. Know how APIs are secured, sessions are handled, and data is validated properly.
  • Serve in an on-call rotation (DevOps philosophy where you will participate in ops) and respond promptly to any production issues, including AI feature degradations, to remediate rapidly.
  • Be a teammate, help other teammates resolve complex problems or think through design/architecture challenges. Be available and responsive.
  • Mentor others and foster an excellent engineering culture based in trust, accountability, character, and honesty, including coaching teammates on using AI agents effectively and responsibly.
  • Seek feedback and deliver constructive criticism (e.g., code reviews) in a tactful and empathetic manner; build others up and mentor without ego.

Your Qualifications:

Required

  • Possess a bachelor’s degree, or equivalent experience. Emphasis in engineering, data science, computer science or information systems is preferred.
  • Have a minimum of 5 years of software engineering experience developing SaaS applications, with strong hands-on experience in our stack: Python, React, AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB).
  • Hands-on experience with LLM application patterns: prompt design, embeddings and vector search/RAG, tool/function calling, structured outputs, and agent orchestration.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering software with AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Devin, or Codex as a core part of your workflow, including integrating agents into CI/CD pipelines with automated quality gates.
  • Experience designing evaluation and testing strategies for non-deterministic systems, and the judgment to decide when AI is, and is not, the right solution.
  • Strong fundamentals in system design, API security, automated testing, and multi-tenant SaaS architecture.
  • Clear, precise written communication: specs and documentation that both people and AI agents can act on.

Preferred

  • Experience with managed model platforms and provider APIs (e.g., Amazon Bedrock, Anthropic, OpenAI) and agent frameworks or SDKs.
  • Have shipped at least one AI/LLM-powered feature to production in a SaaS product and supported it after launch (monitoring, evaluation, and iteration based on real usage).
  • Experience building MCP servers or other tool integrations for AI agents.
  • Background in regulated domains (HR, legal, risk, or compliance) and with data privacy and security standards (e.g., SOC 2, GDPR, CCPA).
  • Familiarity with AI risk and governance practices (e.g., NIST AI RMF, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications).
  • Experience with spec-driven development.

Our Technology Stack:

  • Python, React
  • AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, S3, CloudFront, API Gateway)
  • Containerized environments with CICD pipelines, RESTful APIs, etc.
  • LLM, RAG, and MCP components powering in-product AI features
  • AI coding agents integrated into the development lifecycle with automated quality gates

🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

Senior Financial Control Analyst

📍London/Cardiff | 💰£56,000 - £75,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits

⭐ Our Financial Control Team:

Monzo is growing fast - new products, new markets and new locations. As we expand we need to make sure we can support our businesses and control our processes, so we are growing our team to meet these exciting new challenges!

Our team sits within Monzo’s Finance collective and our job is getting the numbers right. We’re currently a team of seven qualified accountants, split between our Cardiff and London offices, and we ensure the ledger’s correct at every month-end. We work closely with all areas of Finance and the product teams to make that happen.

We're looking for a proactive, enthusiastic and commercially-minded accountant to work on our financial accounting, and help us build a world-class finance function. This role would be well suited to a qualified accountant with 2+ years of post-qualification experience.

You’ll work on scaling Monzo in a controlled way, while helping us optimise our financial control processes with the help of technology. You’ll report to our Financial Control Manager.

  • Manage a tight process with the rest of our internal Finance team to ensure a swift month-end close process and group consolidation.
  • Understand the business and our products to write insightful management commentary.
  • Understand our accounting systems and make sure we are taking advantage of all features we can to minimise manual elements of reporting.

  • Support our year end process working with external auditors and our Financial Reporting squad.
  • Help review new products, assessing the accounting and implementing them in our banking platform and accounting system.
  • Work with the business to assess the impact of changes in accounting standards and make proposals on accounting policy matters for new products launched.

  • You embrace change and are motivated to improve and innovate process
  • You thrive in a dynamic and constantly evolving environment
  • What we’re doing at Monzo excites you!

💰£56,000 - £75,000 ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance.

📍This role can be based in our London or Cardiff office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London)
