We believe the world has changed. We see businesses using more kinds of software, not less, that all needs to work together. To help our customers grow better in this environment, HubSpot is evolving from an “all-in-one” suite into an “all-on-one” platform.

HubSpot is a set of tools that supports a companies customer facing teams including Marketing, Sales and Service helping them to optimize each stage of the buyer’s journey and grow their business.

HubSpot’s flywheel philosophy uses the momentum of happy customers to drive referrals and repeat sales for our customers. We’ve also invested in an integrations ecosystem that helps customers do more with HubSpot and creates real value for people who adopt our suite of software.

Your Role at HubSpot

As a Lead Account Executive at HubSpot you will be engaging directly with medium to corporate sized businesses, helping them to grow. You will use proactive and inbound selling strategies to find and close new business, and increase the customer's usage of the HubSpot platform over time. You will use your knowledge of digital transformation and change management to act as a trusted advisor and business consultant to the customer, running the sales process end to end with them

What are the role requirements?

Who excels in this role?

  • Strong communication, time management and adaptability in order to be set up for success remotely

Interested in learning more about our Remote Program? Learn more here!

Pay & Benefits

WHO WE ARE

Hook is a Creative Production Agency. With a collaborative, maker-centric team, and an emphasis on production-led design, we develop creative campaigns, short-form content, and websites for well known brands.

Our mission is to integrate creative and production to help grow brands faster. But we believe what’s most important are the people who work with us and the experience they have along the way. WHAT'S A MOTION DESIGNER AT HOOK?

Motion Designers are passionate animators who bring visuals and narratives to life through their knowledge of animation principles and their proficiency with motion design and video editing tools. They utilize their understanding of the craft and inquisitive nature to elevate the motion work done at Hook, while always learning and growing their skills.

They seek to build and uphold our growth-oriented culture, to elevate the motion work done at Hook, while always learning and growing in the process. Motion Designers work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team. On small projects they may be the sole motion designer while on larger projects they have the support of others in the Motion Department.

Qualified applicants will include a resume and a statement of interest that lets us learn a little more about you.

jobs.description:
Position: Club Promoter

Company: Always The VIP LLC

Location: New York City / Remote Outreach

Classification: Independent Contractor (1099)

Compensation: Uncapped Performance-Based Commission

Openings: Multiple Positions Available

About Always The VIP

Always The VIP is New York City’s premier nightlife and hospitality group, connecting high-end guests with top-tier venues, world-class DJs, and exclusive VIP experiences across the city. Learn more at www.alwaysthevip.com/about-us.

The Role

We are seeking outgoing, high-performing Club Promoters to drive advance ticket sales, group event turnouts, and VIP bottle service table reservations across NYC’s top nightlife destinations.

This role is built for active networkers, social connectors, and street team enthusiasts who want to monetize their social reach, personal networks, and in-person presence into an uncapped, performance-based income stream.

Explore our partner venues and events at www.alwaysthevip.com/nightlife.

Who Fits This Role?

  • Side-Hustlers & Connectors: Individuals looking for a flexible way to earn extra income by inviting co-workers, friends, colleagues, or college classmates to top NYC events.

  • Nightlife & Party Enthusiasts: Active partygoers who are regularly out in the scene and want to turn their social calendar into a revenue stream.

  • Street Team Promoters: Outgoing networkers who enjoy visiting NYC nightlife hubs, lounges, and social events in person to meet people and distribute event invites.

  • Digital & Social Content Creators: Individuals with an engaged Instagram or TikTok presence looking to monetize their reach using tracked referral links and custom promo codes.

  • Hospitality Industry Professionals: Bartenders, servers, hosts, and door staff seeking high-margin side revenue by leveraging their industry connections.

  • Group & Event Organizers: Connectors who regularly organize group outings, birthdays, or weekend trips for their social circles.

Key Responsibilities & Primary Revenue Drivers

  • VIP Bottle Service Sales: Consult with high-end clients to secure VIP table reservations, qualify party size/budget against venue minimum spends, and drive premium beverage revenue.

  • Advance Ticket Sales: Promote event lineups and lock in pre-sale ticket conversions using personal tracking links and custom promo codes.

  • Group & Event Booking Facilitation: Coordinate large-group outings, corporate celebrations, birthdays, and bachelor/bachelorette parties to maximize party spend and attendance.

  • Social & Street Team Outreach: Leverage personal networks, social media, and direct networking at NYC nightlife hubs, parties, and social gatherings to invite prospective guests using your personal promo codes.

  • On-Site Client Hosting (Optional): Welcome your booked bottle service clients at the venue door and facilitate smooth table entry. While optional, hosting your clients on-site opens up opportunities to earn direct client tips. When client-purchased paid hosting services are booked, promoters also earn additional hosting commissions.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Active Social Network: Personal network or social media presence (public Instagram profile strongly preferred) with direct access to partygoers and potential bottle service clients.

  • Sales-Oriented Mindset: Focused on driving revenue conversions (ticket purchases and table deposits) rather than passive guest list management.

  • Strong Communication Skills: Confident, charismatic, and engaging when reaching out to prospective clients online or in person at social events.

  • Core Tech Literacy: Comfortable navigating social media platforms, basic Google Suite tools, and digital link-tracking tools.

  • Age Requirement: Must be 21 years of age or older.

  • Reliability & Professionalism: Dependable, self-driven, and well-presented when representing the brand and interacting with partner venues.

Earning Potential & Compensation Structure

  • Direct Ticket Sales Commissions: Earn dedicated payouts per ticket sold through your personal referral codes and tracking links.

  • Uncapped Bottle Service Commissions: Earn top-tier commission percentages on minimum table spends and total bottle service revenue generated.

  • Client Hosting Payouts & Tips: When clients book paid hosting add-ons, promoters earn additional hosting commissions. Even when hosting without a paid add-on package, attending on-site provides direct opportunities to receive optional client tips for exceptional service.

Perks & VIP Privileges

  • Schedule Freedom: Work on your own time with total independence—no mandatory shifts.

  • Complimentary Access: Enjoy free venue entry whenever hosting booked guests on-site or expanding your network across partner venues.

  • Promotional VIP Tables: Active promoters gain access to promotional VIP tables with complimentary drink service on select event nights.

  • Industry Access: Receive guest passes and VIP entry across premier partner clubs and event lineups.

Legal Disclosures & Engagement Terms

  • Pay Transparency: In compliance with NYC Local Law 32, compensation for this role is strictly performance-based (commission). There is no base hourly wage or salary provided. Earnings are directly tied to documented ticket sales, guest entry turnouts, bottle service revenue generated, and contracted hosting services. Client tips are optional and provided at the client's sole discretion.

  • Independent Contractor Status (1099): This engagement is strictly that of an Independent Contractor (1099-NEC). Contractors maintain full autonomy over their schedules, promotion methods, and client outreach.

  • Tax Compliance: Contractors are solely responsible for all federal, state, and local tax obligations. Prior to payout disbursement, a valid IRS Form W-9 must be submitted. Always The VIP LLC will issue an IRS Form 1099-NEC as required by law.

  • Venue Compliance & Age Restrictions: Promoters and their hosted guests must strictly adhere to venue entry requirements, dress codes, state liquor laws, and security protocols. Promoters and guests must be at least 21 years of age with valid government-issued photo identification. Entry is at the discretion of venue door management.

  • Equal Opportunity Statement: Always The VIP LLC provides equal engagement opportunities to all independent contractors regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, or gender identity.

How to Apply

Apply online at www.alwaysthevip.com/jobs. Submit your application along with your primary social media handle for review (ensure your profile is set to public). Qualified candidates will be contacted for an interview.

jobs.excerpt: Location: Remote, Eastern Territory US Reporting to: Senior Director, Medical Affairs – Americas Orchard Therapeutics, a Kyowa Kirin company, is a global gene therapy leader focused on transforming the lives of patients with rare disorders through innovative gene therapies based on gene-modified hematopoietic stem cells (HSCs).
jobs.description:
Location: Remote, Eastern Territory US

Reporting to: Senior Director, Medical Affairs – Americas

Orchard Therapeutics, a Kyowa Kirin company, is a global gene therapy leader focused on transforming the lives of patients with rare disorders through innovative gene therapies based on gene-modified hematopoietic stem cells (HSCs). Orchard has its global headquarters in London, England, and its U.S. headquarters in Boston, Massachusetts.

Job Summary

The Senior Medical Science Liaison (Sr MSL) is a therapeutic and disease area scientific expert for investigational and approved gene therapy clinical programs. They demonstrate leadership in field medical excellence and coaching as well as medical and scientific support with national level strategic planning in the Eastern Territory of the United States. As a field-based member of the medical affairs team, the Sr MSL will be responsible for developing and enhancing professional relationships with external thought leaders involved in all phases of the clinical development process through a fair-balanced and high-value exchange of clinical and scientific information. In addition to these typical MSL responsibilities, the Sr MSL will develop strategy, serve as a team mentor, and lead national level initiatives. This position necessitates professionals exhibiting established personal and scientific credibility and self-awareness, who work well in a collaborative, cross-functional environment with other individuals within broader US and Global organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify, build and maintain collaborative partnerships with healthcare providers (HCP’s) and key external experts such as KOL’s and academic institutions to become a trusted scientific partner.
  • Provide timely, audience-appropriate information and updates to enhance the understanding of the scientific and medical value of Orchard’s programs. This includes, but is not limited to, collaboration with Market Access, Government Affairs, Diagnostics, Patient Advocacy, Clinical Development etc.
  • Maintain training records and deliver training updates to ensure all personnel in assigned Qualified Treatment Centers are appropriately trained according to Orchard’s SOPs and the latest Product Manual.
  • Develop a territory profile including Centers of Excellence, key expertise, newborn screening approaches and leaders, and market access pathways to inform medical strategy and tactical planning in collaboration with our Commercial, Diagnostic, and Patient Advocacy partners.
  • Gather insights from the field on data, therapeutic area, and competitive intelligence to help inform company strategies and evidence generation plans.
  • Build thorough operational understanding to ensure excellence in execution balanced with risk management within the boundaries of all governance processes.
  • Review and oversee Investigator-Sponsored Trial (IST) requests and Early Access Program (EAP) requests throughout the internal review process and any follow up requests for information.
  • Build effective internal partnerships through communication and collaboration across the organization with individuals from Medical Affairs, Patient Advocacy, Public Affairs, Clinical Development, Clinical Operations, Technical Operations, Market Access, Commercial, etc.
  • Ensure compliance with internal and external regulatory and legal guidelines.
  • Maintain clinical, scientific, and technical expertise in therapeutic area.
  • Develop strategic initiatives to support departmental goals from a field medical excellence perspective
  • Successfully manage at least two large cross-functional projects with demonstrated leadership and collaboration skills while successfully maintaining geographical responsibilities
  • Proactively seek out and demonstrate successful peer coaching of other team members
  • Develop US field resource materials specific to stakeholder group, disease state, and technology.
  • Provide strategic insights by maintaining expertise in the therapeutic area and related fields to effectively communicate scientific insights and support strategic objectives
  • Monitor the competitive environment for advances and trends in the therapeutic area, including new treatment management and therapies, competitive products and provide feedback to internal stakeholders on specific initiatives of competitors
  • Serves as peer leader to mentor and coach new or junior MSLs, supporting onboarding, training, and field excellence

Requirements

Education / Key Competencies

  • Advanced Scientific / Healthcare Degree (PhD, PharmD, MD, NP, DVM, CGC or similar preferred; RN, MS, or similar with substantial experience considered)
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in a scientific, clinical or MSL role within the biotech or pharmaceutical industry
  • Extensive experience as an MSL supporting post-approval commercial products in the field
  • Ability to lead and motivate team members without a direct reporting relationship including coaching and mentoring colleagues
  • Track record of successfully establishing relationships with health care provider thought leaders and extended clinical care teams to become a preferred point of contact and trusted resource.
  • Understanding of US government and industry guidelines, regulations, laws, etc., for appropriate and compliant exchange of scientific and clinical information with external stakeholders.
  • Experience and relevant knowledge in one or more key therapeutic areas: hematopoietic stem cell transplantation, gene therapy, and neurology/genetics (neurometabolic genetics preferred).
  • Experience in developing and delivering effective scientific educational materials and programs for multistakeholder/multispecialty audiences across disease states.
  • Strong knowledge and established network with health care providers and industry experts
  • Fluency in both spoken and written English
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills to concisely convey complex clinical and scientific information
  • Effective interpersonal skills and awareness of inward and outward emotional intelligence
  • Ability to apply technical expertise and solutions to diverse/individualized situations
  • Experience in achieving results, generating ideas and influencing outcomes through collaboration in a fast-paced environment.
  • Highly effective in building close working relationships with cross-functional partners
  • Growth mindset – curious by nature, proactive in keeping abreast of key scientific developments and building understanding of assigned territory
  • Valid US Driver’s License and clean driving record
  • Ability to travel frequently (75%), often overnight

Salary Range:

The anticipated salary for this position will be $190,000 - $240,000. The actual salary offered for this role at commencement of employment may vary based on several factors including but not limited to relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, education (including applicable licenses and certifications), job-based knowledge, location, and other business and organizational needs. The company may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. The listed salary is just one component of the overall compensation package. At Orchard Therapeutics North America we provide a comprehensive range of benefits in addition to incentive programs.

The compensation and benefits information set forth in this posting applies to candidates hired in the United States – and this range is specific to Boston and the North-East region of the United States. Candidates hired outside the United States or in a different region of the United States will be eligible for compensation and benefits in accordance with their local market.

Orchard is an equal opportunity employer. We recognise and celebrate the diverse culture of our workforce and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for our employees. We fully support the principle of Equality and Diversity in employment and oppose all forms of unlawful or unfair discrimination. We assess all applications on basis of job requirements and individual qualifications.

We work within the requirements of all current legislation and we implement the provisions of regulatory codes of practice in employment.

Notice to All Applicants: Orchard Therapeutics participates in E-Verify

RECRUITERS

All employment offers and CV’s are managed through our Human Resources Department and all candidates are presented through this avenue. Therefore, the Human Resources Department at Orchard Therapeutics requests that recruiters are not to contact Orchard Therapeutics employees directly to present candidates. Complying with this request will be a factor in determining future professional relationships with Orchard Therapeutics. We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, from top-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber.

Our HQ is in New York City with a hybrid schedule (3 in-office days per week). We prefer NYC-based candidates or those open to relocation.

Role Overview

We’re hiring a Principal Engineer to own the evolution of our architecture and platform so it works for agents as well as people. Our goal is simple: double the output of our entire organization while raising the quality bar. The scope is the whole platform. You’ll work across infrastructure, shared services, and product code, and step in as a product engineer anywhere in the stack when that is the fastest way to move.

The ideal candidate is deep in code architecture and platform engineering, already works agent-first, and has built foundations that other teams adopted because they were better. This role reports directly to our VP of Engineering.

What You'll Do

  • Own the architecture of our codebase. Set the patterns, module boundaries, and domain abstractions across our monorepo, and lead the refactors and migrations that get us there.

  • Design the monorepo for agents. Structure packages, ownership, the build graph, and conventions so an agent can find the right context, make a scoped change, and verify it without reading the whole repo.

  • Scale verification with volume. Build AI-assisted code review, test generation, and CI gates so confidence to merge keeps pace as PR volume doubles. Decide where human review is required and where it is not.

  • Put agents to work in the background. Stand up agents that pick up well-scoped tickets, triage flaky tests, run dependency upgrades and large migrations, and draft fixes from incidents and error reports.

What We're Looking For

  • You've owned the architecture of a large, multi-team codebase. You've set the module boundaries and patterns others build within, run monorepo tooling (Nx, Turborepo, Bazel, or similar), and led migrations that changed how a whole org works.

jobs.description:
Client : Secteur manufacturier

Lieu : 100 % télétravail

Mode de travail : Remote

Durée : 12 mois, avec possibilité de renouvellement

Heures : 35 h/semaine

Langue : Anglais obligatoire – candidats anglophones acceptés

CV : Anglais

À propos du poste

Nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur(e) de données senior spécialisé(e) en SAP Master Data, intégration et migration de données afin de contribuer à un important programme de transformation technologique au sein d'une grande organisation du secteur manufacturier.

La personne intégrera l'équipe Enterprise Data Management (EDM) et sera responsable de concevoir, développer et exploiter les pipelines de données permettant à Jaggaer Supplier Lifecycle Management (SLM) de devenir la source de référence (Golden Record) pour les données maîtres fournisseurs de l'organisation.

Le mandat s'inscrit dans un environnement complexe de transformation SAP ECC / Jaggaer SLM / SAP S/4HANA, avec un accent particulier sur la migration, l'intégration, la consolidation et la qualité des données fournisseurs.

La ressource devra assurer la circulation fiable des données entre les systèmes : SAP ECC alimente Jaggaer SLM, qui retourne ensuite les données vers SAP ECC via les IDocs, avant leur migration ultérieure vers SAP S/4HANA.

Le profil recherché doit posséder une solide expertise pratique en Data Engineering, SQL, Python, SAP Vendor Master Data, ETL/ELT et intégration SAP IDocs, ainsi qu'une expérience concrète de projets complets de conversion ERP ou Master Data.

Exigences principales

Minimum de 8 années d'expérience en ingénierie de données (Data Engineering).

Participation à au moins 2 projets complets de conversion ERP ou Master Data, incluant les différentes étapes de migration.

Expérience pratique avec SAP Vendor Master Data.

Bonne connaissance des principales tables fournisseurs SAP :

LFA1 – Données générales fournisseurs

LFB1 – Données fournisseurs au niveau de la société

LFM1 – Données fournisseurs au niveau de l'organisation d'achats

LFBK – Coordonnées bancaires fournisseurs

Expérience avec les SAP IDocs, notamment :

Structures IDoc

Monitoring avec WE02 / WE19

Retraitement avec BD87

Connaissance des messages CREMAS

Maîtrise avancée de SQL et Python pour le développement, la transformation et la validation des données.

Expérience avec au moins une technologie ETL/ELT ou de migration de données, notamment :

SAP Data Services

Syniti

SAP Migration Cockpit

Informatica

Snowflake

dbt

Azure Data Factory

Expérience concrète en Master Data Matching, Deduplication et Survivorship.

Capacité à développer des règles de nettoyage, standardisation, enrichissement et consolidation de données.

Expérience dans la conversion de règles d'affaires en code testé, versionné et reproductible.

Capacité à exécuter des simulations de conversion et des répétitions de mise en production (Mock Conversions / Cutover Rehearsals).

Expérience en réconciliation et validation des données après migration.

Bonne compréhension des mécanismes de Data Quality, Data Lineage et Data Governance.

Capacité à travailler avec des équipes EDM, architectes de données, intégrateurs et partenaires externes.

Grande autonomie et capacité à évoluer dans un environnement peu structuré, avec une documentation limitée.

Maîtrise professionnelle de l'anglais obligatoire.

Atouts importants

Expérience d'implantation avec Jaggaer SLM, Jaggaer SRM ou Jaggaer Advantage.

Expérience avec le modèle SAP S/4HANA Business Partner et Customer/Vendor Integration (CVI).

Connaissance de Snowflake Cortex ou d'outils de matching et classification assistés par IA.

Expérience avec Collibra ou des outils comparables pour la gouvernance, la traçabilité et la qualité des données.

Expérience avec des sources de validation et d'enrichissement des fournisseurs :

Dun & Bradstreet (D&B)

Tax ID

Validation des comptes bancaires

Certification CDMP (Certified Data Management Professional) ou équivalent.

Expérience dans un environnement manufacturier complexe.

Expérience dans des projets de transformation ERP impliquant plusieurs systèmes et partenaires externes.

Responsabilités principales

Conversion et migration des données fournisseurs

Concevoir, développer et exécuter les pipelines ETL/ELT permettant la migration des données maîtres fournisseurs de SAP ECC vers Jaggaer SLM.

Assurer la préparation des données pour le chargement initial et la mise en production.

Implémenter les règles de nettoyage, normalisation et enrichissement approuvées par les équipes EDM.

Développer les mécanismes de matching, déduplication, fusion et survivorship.

Assurer la traçabilité entre les données historiques et les enregistrements consolidés dans le Golden Record.

Exécuter les simulations de conversion et répétitions de Cutover.

Effectuer la réconciliation des volumes, champs clés et attributs financiers après chaque chargement.

Identifier et résoudre les écarts de migration.

Intégration SAP / Jaggaer SLM

Soutenir les intégrations de données entre SAP ECC et Jaggaer SLM.

Participer à l'intégration basée sur les SAP IDocs, notamment CREMAS.

Contribuer au mapping des données entre les systèmes.

Assurer le monitoring des interfaces et le suivi des erreurs.

Participer au retraitement des messages et à la résolution des anomalies.

Valider que les données fournisseurs retournées de Jaggaer vers SAP ECC sont compatibles avec les besoins de migration vers SAP S/4HANA Business Partner.

Collaborer avec le partenaire d'implantation sur les spécifications d'interfaces, les tests et les corrections.

Qualité et gouvernance des données

Traduire les règles de qualité des données fournisseurs en contrôles automatisés.

Développer des indicateurs et rapports permettant de suivre la qualité des données.

Mettre en place des Data Quality Scorecards et rapports d'exceptions.

Réaliser le profilage des données sources.

Identifier les anomalies et les communiquer aux responsables concernés.

Maintenir à jour les documents de Data Mapping et Data Lineage.

Documenter les métadonnées techniques dans les outils de gouvernance.

Contribuer à la fiabilité et à l'intégrité des données fournisseurs.

Développement et automatisation

Développer des solutions de traitement et transformation de données avec SQL et Python.

Convertir les règles d'affaires en processus automatisés, testés et versionnés.

Optimiser les performances des pipelines de migration et d'intégration.

Mettre en place des mécanismes de validation et de gestion des erreurs.

Assurer la reproductibilité et la maintenabilité des traitements.

Participer à l'amélioration continue des mécanismes d'intégration.

Exploitation et pérennité des solutions

Livrer des pipelines de données production-ready, documentés et surveillés.

Assurer la stabilité et la fiabilité des traitements après la mise en production.

Rédiger les procédures opérationnelles (Runbooks).

Documenter les procédures de chargement récurrent.

Définir les mécanismes de gestion des files d'erreurs et de retraitement.

Mettre en place les contrôles visant à prévenir la création de fournisseurs en double.

Assurer le transfert de connaissances aux équipes EDM.

Compétences comportementales

Autonomie : Capacité à avancer sans supervision constante, à identifier les bons interlocuteurs et à assurer le suivi de ses dossiers.

Agilité : Capacité à évoluer dans des environnements dynamiques, peu structurés et impliquant plusieurs fournisseurs et partenaires externes.

Adaptabilité : Capacité à gérer les changements de priorités et les nouveaux contextes.

Proactivité : Capacité à anticiper les difficultés et à proposer des solutions.

Rigueur : Attention particulière à la qualité, à l'intégrité et à la traçabilité des données.

Collaboration : Capacité à travailler avec les équipes d'affaires, EDM, TI et partenaires d'implantation.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Medical Virtual Assistant (Prior Authorization & Healthcare Administration)

Position type: Part-Time

Work hours: 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time (4 hours per day/20 hours per week)

Work days: Monday to Friday

Salary: $6 - $7 per hour

Workplace: Remote

Preferred Candidate Location: Philippines

Our client is a U.S.-based healthcare organization dedicated to providing quality, patient-centered care and efficient healthcare services. We are seeking a proactive, highly organized, and detail-oriented Medical Virtual Assistant specializing in Prior Authorization and Healthcare Administration to support essential administrative operations, streamline insurance authorization processes, and maintain accurate staff credentialing records.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced healthcare administrative professional who enjoys managing important processes, coordinating with insurance providers, and helping healthcare teams focus more on patient care.

As a Medical Virtual Assistant, you will primarily handle prior authorization requests, incoming phone calls, and HR credential tracking. You will also assist with insurance verification, medical billing support, community outreach, scheduling coordination, and general administrative responsibilities as needed.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience submitting and managing U.S. healthcare prior authorizations, strong English communication skills, excellent organizational abilities, and the confidence to work independently.

While prior authorization experience is essential, previous HR administration, credentialing, or healthcare-specific phone-handling experience is not required. Training will be provided for the practice's HR processes, and training resources are available for its EHR system.

If you're an experienced Medical VA who enjoys staying organized, solving problems, and making a meaningful difference behind the scenes of patient care, we'd love to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities

Prior Authorization Management (Top Priority)

  • Prepare, submit, track, and manage prior authorization requests for healthcare services.
  • Coordinate with insurance providers to confirm authorization requirements and submission procedures.
  • Ensure all necessary patient, provider, and supporting documentation is complete and accurate before submission.
  • Follow up on pending authorization requests and monitor their progress through determination.
  • Track authorization approvals, denials, pending requests, and outstanding documentation.
  • Monitor authorization expiration dates and provide timely reminders to prevent interruptions in authorized services.
  • Maintain accurate records of authorization numbers, effective dates, expiration dates, payer correspondence, and follow-up actions.
  • Identify authorization discrepancies or missing requirements and coordinate appropriate resolutions.
  • Communicate authorization updates and outstanding concerns to the appropriate healthcare staff.
  • Help reduce the therapist's administrative workload by maintaining an organized and efficient authorization process.
  • Manage approximately five prior authorization requests per week, supporting a practice with approximately 60 active clients.

Phone Management & Call Coordination (Top Priority)

  • Answer incoming calls professionally, courteously, and efficiently.
  • Provide general assistance to callers and direct inquiries to the appropriate staff members.
  • Screen spam, unsolicited, and irrelevant calls to minimize unnecessary interruptions.
  • Route patient, insurance, and administrative inquiries to the appropriate team members.
  • Take accurate messages and document relevant call details when necessary.
  • Maintain professional phone etiquette and clear communication.
  • Escalate urgent or sensitive concerns according to established procedures.
  • Support an estimated call volume of approximately 10 incoming calls per week.
  • Assist with outbound calls as needed for administrative follow-ups and outreach.

HR Administration & Staff Credential Tracking (Top Priority)

  • Maintain organized and accurate records of staff credentials, professional certifications, and required training.
  • Track credential, certification, and training expiration dates.
  • Monitor upcoming renewal deadlines and provide timely reminders to the appropriate staff members.
  • Update credentialing trackers, spreadsheets, and administrative records.
  • Identify missing, outdated, or incomplete staff documentation.
  • Follow up on outstanding credentialing or training requirements.
  • Assist with organizing and maintaining confidential HR-related documentation.
  • Support compliance-sensitive administrative tracking according to established organizational procedures.
  • Learn and follow the client's HR administration and credential management processes.

Training will be provided for the client's HR and credential tracking procedures. Previous HR or credentialing experience is not required.

Insurance Verification & Medical Billing Support (Secondary Priority)

  • Assist with verifying patient insurance eligibility, coverage, and benefits.
  • Contact insurance providers to clarify coverage information or resolve insurance-related inquiries.
  • Support medical billing-related administrative tasks as assigned.
  • Assist with organizing billing records, documentation, and outstanding follow-ups.
  • Identify incomplete or inconsistent insurance information and communicate concerns to the appropriate staff.
  • Maintain accurate records of insurance communications and verification results.

Community Outreach & External Communication (Secondary Priority)

  • Make outbound calls to community organizations, stakeholders, and other relevant contacts as directed.
  • Assist with email outreach to community partners and stakeholders.
  • Respond to routine administrative inquiries and coordinate follow-up communications.
  • Maintain organized records of outreach activities and responses.
  • Support administrative initiatives that strengthen communication with community stakeholders.

Scheduling & General Administrative Support (Secondary Priority)

  • Assist with appointment scheduling and coordination when needed.
  • Maintain accurate administrative records, trackers, and documentation.
  • Support routine clerical tasks, data entry, and document organization.
  • Coordinate with internal staff regarding outstanding administrative requests.
  • Assist with managing multiple tasks and deadlines efficiently.
  • Follow established healthcare administrative procedures and confidentiality standards.
  • Identify opportunities to improve organization, tracking, and administrative workflows.

Top 3 Priorities

1. Prior Authorization Management

Take ownership of healthcare prior authorization workflows, including submission, tracking, payer follow-ups, and monitoring authorization expiration dates. Ensure requests are properly documented and processed efficiently to reduce the therapist's administrative workload and prevent avoidable service interruptions.

2. Professional Phone Management

Handle incoming calls, screen spam or irrelevant inquiries, and route callers to the appropriate staff members. Maintain professional, clear, and courteous communication while ensuring important calls and messages are handled appropriately.

3. HR Administration & Credential Tracking

Maintain accurate records of staff credentials, certifications, and required training. Proactively monitor expiration dates, organize documentation, and send timely renewal reminders to support efficient administrative operations.

What Success Looks Like

A successful Medical Virtual Assistant consistently demonstrates:

  • Accurate and timely submission of healthcare prior authorization requests.
  • Organized tracking of pending, approved, denied, and expiring authorizations.
  • Proactive insurance follow-ups and timely communication of outstanding requirements.
  • Reduced administrative workload for the therapist and healthcare team.
  • Professional handling of incoming calls and accurate routing of inquiries.
  • Effective screening of spam and unnecessary calls.
  • Accurate maintenance of staff credentialing and training records.
  • Timely reminders for upcoming credential and certification renewals.
  • Strong organization and attention to detail across multiple administrative responsibilities.
  • Accurate insurance verification and reliable billing-related support when needed.
  • Professional communication with patients, insurance representatives, staff, and community stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Consistent adherence to HIPAA requirements and patient confidentiality standards.

Tools & Platforms

  • Integrity Checkpoint EHR: Used for patient records and healthcare administrative workflows. Training is available.
  • Regular Text Messaging & GroupMe: Used for internal communication, coordination, and updates.

Requirements

Prior Authorization Experience

  • Proven hands-on experience submitting, tracking, and managing U.S. healthcare prior authorizations (mandatory).
  • Familiarity with insurance authorization requirements, submission procedures, and payer follow-up processes.
  • Experience monitoring authorization statuses, approval dates, and expiration dates.
  • Ability to identify missing documentation and resolve administrative authorization issues.
  • Strong attention to detail when reviewing authorization requests and supporting records.
  • Ability to maintain organized trackers and follow up on outstanding requests independently.

U.S. Healthcare Administrative Experience

  • Previous experience supporting U.S.-based healthcare practices or healthcare administrative operations.
  • Familiarity with common healthcare workflows, medical terminology, and insurance-related processes.
  • Understanding of insurance eligibility, benefits verification, and general medical billing support.
  • Experience maintaining accurate patient or administrative records.
  • Knowledge of HIPAA requirements and patient confidentiality.
  • Ability to handle healthcare information professionally and securely.

Communication & Phone Management

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills (mandatory).
  • Strong professional phone etiquette and confidence handling incoming and outbound calls.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with patients, insurance representatives, staff members, and external contacts.
  • Strong active listening skills and attention to detail when documenting messages.
  • Ability to screen calls and appropriately route inquiries.
  • Comfortable communicating professionally in a remote healthcare environment.

Organization & Administrative Coordination

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
  • Ability to maintain accurate trackers, spreadsheets, and administrative records.
  • Attention to detail when monitoring staff credentials, certifications, and training expiration dates.
  • Ability to provide timely reminders and follow up on outstanding requirements.
  • Comfortable handling confidential administrative and staff information.
  • Ability to learn and follow HR credentialing and compliance-tracking procedures.

Previous HR administration or staff credentialing experience is not required. Training will be provided.

Technical Skills & Independent Work

  • Experience using EHR/EMR systems or similar healthcare administrative platforms.
  • Strong computer literacy and proficiency with digital documentation, spreadsheets, and online communication tools.
  • Willingness and ability to learn Integrity Checkpoint EHR.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to administrative responsibilities.
  • Excellent time management, multitasking, and prioritization skills.
  • Dependable, adaptable, and committed to completing tasks accurately and on time.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience as a Medical Virtual Assistant, Prior Authorization Specialist, Healthcare Administrative Assistant, or similar role.
  • Experience supporting therapists, behavioral health providers, or other U.S.-based healthcare professionals.
  • Experience handling insurance eligibility and benefits verification.
  • Familiarity with medical billing workflows and insurance follow-ups.
  • Previous experience managing staff credentials, certifications, or training records.
  • Experience handling inbound calls in a healthcare environment.
  • Experience with community outreach, outbound calls, or email communication with external stakeholders.
  • Experience using Integrity Checkpoint EHR or similar healthcare systems.
  • Experience supporting scheduling coordination and general healthcare administrative operations.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We're looking for someone who is:

  • Experienced in Prior Authorizations: Confident managing authorization submissions, follow-ups, and expiration tracking.
  • Highly Organized: Keeps accurate records, monitors deadlines, and ensures nothing important is overlooked.
  • An Excellent Communicator: Handles phone calls, insurance inquiries, and professional correspondence clearly and courteously.
  • Proactive: Anticipates deadlines, follows up on pending requests, and identifies potential issues early.
  • Detail-Oriented: Carefully reviews healthcare documentation, authorization information, and administrative records.
  • Independent & Self-Motivated: Takes ownership of responsibilities without requiring constant supervision.
  • Reliable & Accountable: Consistently completes assigned tasks and communicates progress appropriately.
  • Adaptable & Tech-Savvy: Comfortable learning new systems, including Integrity Checkpoint EHR.
  • A Strong Multitasker: Effectively balances authorization requests, calls, credential tracking, and secondary administrative tasks.
  • Professional & Confidentiality-Conscious: Handles sensitive healthcare and staff information responsibly.

Basic Requirements

  • Must be proficient in speaking and writing clear, professional English.
  • Must have hands-on experience with U.S. healthcare prior authorizations.
  • Must have relevant U.S. healthcare administrative experience.
  • Must be comfortable handling incoming calls professionally.
  • Must be able to manage multiple responsibilities independently.
  • Must be able to submit an NBI Clearance and/or Local Police Clearance before onboarding (mandatory).
  • Must be available for video meetings with camera on when required.
  • Must be available to work part-time, Monday through Friday, from 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time.

Technical Requirements

  • Computer: Reliable laptop or desktop computer.
  • Internet: Stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps).
  • Audio: Noise-canceling headset.
  • Video: Working webcam for virtual meetings.
  • Workspace: Quiet and professional work environment.

Benefits

  • Dedicated HR & Contractor Support Team: Access to world-class support for questions, guidance, contract matters, and client communication.
  • Premium VPN Access (Optional): A secure VPN license can be provided upon request to enhance privacy and security for client-related tasks.
  • HIPAA & Cybersecurity Training + Certification (Provided): Access to our internal HIPAA compliance training, cybersecurity modules, and certification to help you confidently handle PHI for U.S. healthcare clients.
  • Top 1% VA Performance Training: Access to our proprietary training on communication, client management, productivity systems, and best practices to help you become a top-performing VA and increase long-term client retention.
  • Client-Approved U.S. Holidays: Contractors may take U.S. holidays off according to the client’s needs and schedule.
  • Client-Approved Paid or Unpaid Time Off: Time off may be granted by your client. Paid time off is optional and only if offered by the client.
  • Access to Tools & Resources: Templates, workflow guides, productivity tools, and client-specific SOP support to help you perform at your best.
  • Optional Performance-Based Incentives: Some clients may offer bonuses, incentives, or increased hours based on your performance.

These are optional resources and client-approved allowances available to you as an independent contractor. Any resources, training, or allowances listed are optional contractor perks and not employee benefits.

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Staff Regional Marketing Manager, you will own regional marketing for the sales team in your territory and set the standard for how the regional team plans and runs its work. You will choose, plan, and run the events and campaigns that create, expand, and accelerate pipeline in your region, and you will move easily between high-level strategy and creative, detailed execution. Staff is a leadership-level individual contributor role: you lead through the work you build and ship, not through direct reports. In a modern marketing organization, that means building and running your own plans, programs, measurement, and AI-assisted automation instead of handing them off, and it suits builders who are comfortable being a leader without a team to manage. Your audience is CIOs, CTOs, VPs of engineering and platform, and the security leaders who govern how their teams ship software. You will judge audience quality by seniority and buying role, not headcount, so you will need to understand how they work and what they want from a vendor.

You will support both direct and channel sales teams, work with GitLab partners on Channel and Alliance Marketing activities, and partner with external agencies and third parties to prepare and run campaigns. As a senior individual contributor, you will mentor other regional marketers, help build and improve team process, and share best practices with regional peers by planning and operating transparently. Your impact is measured in pipeline: the target is 10X spend contribution to sales pipeline for your region, with your regional budget spent within 5% variance. This role supports one of our sales regions (AMER, EMEA, or APAC), and involves travel up to 50% of the time.

What You’ll Do

  • Drive results for your region as its marketing leader: own the pipeline and growth outcomes, and go beyond events and experiences to bring partners in to drive marketing across channels, in support of growth through our revenue team.
  • Adapt digital and content marketing programs to the needs of your regional sales team.
  • Create, expand, and accelerate sales opportunities through regional and account-focused campaigns that promote GitLab’s products and services, within the marketing strategy.
  • Set regional event and campaign strategy, with discretion over which events and campaigns best support regional sales goals, and manage events onsite, including logistics, booth staffing, and swag.
  • Project manage every campaign from start to finish, following the GitLab process, so each one meets its objectives, arrives on time, and stays within budget, then measure and report on its effectiveness.
  • Lead cross-functional work to drive demand generation and regional marketing plans, and advocate for your sales region within marketing and for marketing with your sales team.
  • Support Channel and Alliance Marketing activities with GitLab partners, from campaign approval through execution.
  • Work with external agencies and third parties to prepare, manage, and execute campaigns.
  • Mentor and guide regional marketing specialists and managers, and lead in building and driving process within the team.

What You’ll Bring

  • Proven ability to build and execute a regional strategy, with a record of delivering, accelerating, and expanding sales pipeline through regional marketing.
  • Experience supporting both direct sales and channel sales teams, and in enterprise solution demand creation and regional marketing.
  • Exemplary analytical skills and a proven aptitude for using data to optimize program performance and inform future strategies.
  • Excellent communication skills, with a proven ability to convey ideas and data clearly in writing and in presentations to a variety of audiences, without a fear of over-communicating. You plan and operate transparently and share best practices with other regional marketers.
  • A proven aptitude for building and driving a budget within your territory, and extreme attention to program details and deadlines.
  • The capacity to empathize with CIOs, CTOs, VPs of engineering and platform, and the security leaders who govern how their teams ship software, and a passion for, and substantial understanding of, the developer tools, IT operations tools, and/or IT security markets.
  • Ability to use GitLab, and you share our values and work in accordance with them.
  • Ability to travel up to 50% and to comply with the company’s travel policy.

About the team

Regional Marketing at GitLab turns marketing strategy into regional action. We support our sales teams in AMER, EMEA, and APAC by running the events and campaigns that build pipeline in their territories, working with direct sellers, channel sellers, and alliance partners. We work closely with Product Marketing, Corporate Events, Digital Marketing, Marketing Operations, Developer Relations, Business Development, Customer Success Managers, and Solution Architects. Our goals are set through the Marketing OKRs and measured in pipeline contribution and regional budget. To see how the role fits in the team and where it can lead, read the Regional Marketing Manager job family and the Regional Marketing leadership page.

We’re building a cutting-edge AI team, and this role is for an engineer who wants to apply AI to real problems in energy. You’ll also ship customer-facing features using VLMs and LLMs, and build AI tools and agents that make teams across Fuse more productive, from customer support to warehouses and back office. This is an applied engineering role, not pure research: you’ll own what you build, from spec to production.

Practice Overview: The Business Integration Services (BIS) practice is a high-growth technology consulting practice delivering enterprise-scale integration, digital transformation, and solution design engagements for complex, multi-stakeholder clients. The practice is in its third year of a structured build and scale phase, expanding from a founding team to a full-capability organization spanning four pillars: Project Management (PMO), Business/Technical Analysis, Solution Architecture, and Engineering.
The practice operates at the intersection of business strategy and technology execution, working closely with technology partners and vendors to deliver outcomes that are both architecturally sound and commercially meaningful. It is entering a pivotal phase of maturity, transitioning from practice-leads delivery to a structured operating model with defined build paths, methodology standards, and delivery governance.
Position Overview: The Senior Manager role is newly created role designed to build and run the operational backbone of the BIS practice. This person is also a people manager while owning the internal operating infrastructure that allows the practice to scale without losing delivery quality or team cohesion. The Senior Manager is an experienced professional including consulting background with over 10 years of hands-on experience driving and building delivery excellence, can build and sustain a high-performing team culture, and has the operational discipline to manage experienced professionals through a period of rapid growth.
This role demands strong operational leadership, industry knowledge, and technical fluency to drive results in complex client environments.
Key Responsibilities:
Practice Operations & Delivery Coordination:

  • Own the weekly resource coordination sync and alignment across multiple projects — aligning deployment to project demand, managing capacity constraints, and ensuring no engagement is under-resourced
  • Maintain a real-time view of utilization across all active engagements; proactively identify over-allocation, burnout risk, or skill mismatches and resolve before they affect delivery.
  • Build and maintain the practice's operational cadences: team meetings, delivery check-ins, onboarding sequences, and inter-pillar coordination mechanisms.
  • Escalate delivery risks that require leadership action; translate ground-level team intelligence into clear, actionable executive signals without filtering out critical information
  • Ensure the project teams have the tools, templates, methodologies, and standards they need to deliver consistently across different engagement types and client environments
Capability Building:
  • Partner with the project teams to define and maintain the practice's methodology: discovery frameworks, requirements standards, stakeholder engagement approaches, and deliverable quality benchmarks
  • Build a learning and development calendar for the team that reflects real engagement needs — not generic training — including cross-pillar exposure across all pillars.
  • Create and maintain a competency framework that provides clear, credible criteria for performance evaluation and career progression, recognizing that most team members are already highly experienced
  • Drive/support the development of BIS delivery playbooks, templates, and standards for discovery, change management, testing, cutover, and post-implementation support.
  • Identify patterns across engagements where capability gaps surface and systematically address them through targeted development rather than reactive support
  • Use insights from the quarterly coach roundtable to shape new hire onboarding for incoming cohorts, ensuring lessons from active delivery are embedded into how new team members learn the practice
People Leadership & Team Development
  • Lead structured onboarding for incoming new hires, ensuring they integrate into the practice culture and reach delivery readiness within 60-90 days.
  • Serve as a direct people manager for the reporting team that includes senior business analysis professionals with process, data, business/technical requirements and systems/product implementation skillsets.
  • Hold a quarterly coaching roundtable with cross-pillar coaches to aggregate team development signals and translate them into management action
  • Retain and support a team of experienced senior practitioners— understanding the difference between craft recognition and career progression for high-expertise individual contributors
Practice Strategy & Governance
  • Contribute to capacity planning working with leadership to project capacity needs against pipeline and growth targets
  • Partner with leadership on the design of the coaching model, cross-pillar development programs, and any structural adjustments as the practice scales
  • Maintain the operating model documentation: org structure, role definitions, operating norms, and governance processes that align with the team structure on implementation projects.
Continuous Improvement & Quality Assurance
  • Promote continuous improvement through lessons learned, feedback loops, and project retrospectives.
  • Ensure project deliverables meet established quality standards, conduct quality audits and reviews, and implement quality improvement processes.
Educational Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Management, or a related field or equivalent experience.
  • Advanced degree (MBA or Master’s) is preferred.
Required Skills and Experience:
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in technology consulting, professional services, or a related discipline, with demonstrated experience leading or managing teams of senior practitioners.
  • Proven track record as a people manager — comfortable owning performance reviews, difficult conversations, retention risk, and career development for experienced individual contributors
  • Experience working with Agile and Waterfall methodologies in SaaS companies or with system integrators.
  • Strong working knowledge of the four pillars as a discipline: what excellent discovery looks like and how requirements mature through an engagement
  • Experience managing resource deployment and capacity planning in a project-based or consulting environment
  • Demonstrated ability to build trust with experienced peers and direct reports who have strong professional identities and do not require or respond well to directive management styles
  • Comfort operating in a high-growth, structurally evolving environment where processes are being built while delivery is ongoing
  • Strong understanding of utility operations, asset management, and regulatory compliance.
  • Demonstrated experience in team building and leadership, with the ability to inspire and develop talent.
  • Excellent project management skills, including proficiency in project planning, execution, and risk management.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage clients and stakeholders at all levels.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to engage with clients effectively, collaborate with internal teams, and interact with management.
  • Ability to travel domestically and(or) internationally if required.
Preferred Skills:
  • Prior experience in practice operations, delivery management, or capability development role within a consulting firm or technology services organization
  • Familiarity with the cross-functional dynamics between PMO, BA, solution architecture, and engineering in integrated delivery engagements
  • Experience with coaching models, structured mentoring programs, or formal learning and development initiatives in a consulting context
  • Exposure to Big 4 or top-tier consulting operating models — particularly how those firms separate craft leadership from people management at scale
  • Experience hiring and onboarding senior practitioners in a compressed timeline.
  • Certifications: PMP/PMI-ACP, Prosci/Change Management, ITIL, SAFe/Agile or relevant certifications.

jobs.excerpt: Program Evaluation & Data AnalystPosition OverviewThe Program Evaluation & Data Analyst will support GPS's program data management, monitoring, reporting, quality assurance, and evaluation activities.
jobs.description:
Program Evaluation & Data Analyst

Position Overview

The Program Evaluation & Data Analyst will support GPS's program data management, monitoring, reporting, quality assurance, and evaluation activities.

Reporting to Vice President of Programs and working closely with the Evaluation & Quality Assurance Lead, this position will assume primary responsibility for day-to-day program data operations, including data extraction, cleaning, validation, reconciliation, reporting preparation, and maintenance of program datasets.

The analyst will work across multiple data collection and management platforms to identify and resolve discrepancies, improve data accuracy and consistency, and ensure that reliable information is available for program monitoring, funder reporting, and external evaluation activities.

The position will also support ongoing evaluation efforts through data preparation, descriptive analysis, performance indicator tracking, reporting documentation, and coordination of designated evaluation activities.

This is a hands-on, applied position suited to a detail-oriented and analytically skilled professional who is comfortable working with complex, real-world datasets, independently investigating data quality issues, and collaborating across program, administrative, technical, and evaluation teams.

The successful candidate will combine strong quantitative skills with practical problem-solving abilities, sound judgment, excellent organizational skills, and an interest in using data to strengthen program implementation and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

1. Program Data Management, Extraction & Quality Assurance (40%)

  • Extract, compile, organize, and consolidate program data from multiple systems, including participant registration platforms, attendance records, learning management systems, participant surveys, and program tracking tools.
  • Maintain accurate, organized, and standardized datasets, reporting files, data dictionaries, and supporting documentation.
  • Conduct routine data cleaning, validation, reconciliation, and quality assurance reviews to assess completeness, accuracy, consistency, and integrity.
  • Identify, investigate, and document discrepancies across systems, including missing records, inconsistent dates, duplicate entries, incomplete survey responses, and conflicting participant information.
  • Maintain data quality tracking logs documenting identified issues, corrective actions, responsible parties, and resolution status.
  • Collaborate with internal program staff and external technical vendors to investigate data discrepancies, troubleshoot reporting issues, and verify system corrections.
  • Develop and maintain standardized procedures for data extraction, cleaning, validation, reconciliation, and documentation.
  • Support updates to data collection forms, survey instruments, tracking templates, and reporting tools as program and evaluation requirements evolve.
  • Ensure appropriate confidentiality, data security, and responsible handling of participant-level information.

2. Monthly Data Reporting & Funder Submissions (25%)

  • Coordinate the preparation of monthly program datasets for funder reporting and external evaluation activities.
  • Extract and consolidate data from relevant platforms in accordance with established reporting specifications, definitions, and deadlines.
  • Conduct pre-submission quality assurance checks to verify that reporting files are accurate, complete, internally consistent, and appropriately formatted.
  • Prepare accompanying documentation, including cover letters, reporting-period summaries, data source descriptions, identified limitations, notable changes, and unresolved discrepancies.
  • Maintain documentation of reporting definitions, assumptions, corrections, and data preparation procedures.
  • Collaborate with the Evaluation & Quality Assurance Lead to review reporting files, resolve discrepancies, and ensure consistency with established evaluation requirements.
  • Support responses to routine data clarification requests from funders and external evaluation partners.
  • Maintain an organized archive of submitted datasets, supporting documentation, and reporting records to ensure transparency and reproducibility.
  • Track reporting deadlines and communicate potential delays or data quality concerns to Vice President of Programs and designated evaluation staff.

    This is a part-time, fully remote position requiring approximately 20–25 hours per week, with the potential to transition to full-time as organizational needs and funding allow. The position offers scheduling flexibility, with availability required for designated team meetings, reporting deadlines, and coordination with external partners.

3. Program Data Analysis & Performance Monitoring (15%)

  • Conduct descriptive and exploratory analyses of program data to monitor implementation, participation, engagement, and emerging program outcomes.
  • Calculate and track established performance indicators, including participant enrollment, attendance, retention, repeat participation, training completion, survey response rates, and other relevant measures.
  • Analyze trends across reporting periods, programs, implementation partners, and other relevant categories.
  • Identify patterns, potential data gaps, and emerging issues that may affect program implementation or reporting.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards, performance tracking tools, summary tables, and other data visualizations.
  • Prepare concise analytical summaries highlighting key findings, trends, limitations, and potential implications for program improvement.
  • Support the preparation of quarterly reports, funder updates, and internal performance summaries.
  • Ensure consistency of reported figures across datasets, dashboards, reports, and other organizational materials.

4. Evaluation Implementation & Support (10%)

  • Support implementation of GPS's established evaluation activities in collaboration with the Evaluation & Quality Assurance Lead and external evaluation partners.
  • Maintain evaluation tracking systems and documentation to monitor data collection activities, timelines, and deliverables.
  • Support participant follow-up and longitudinal data collection activities, including survey administration, participant tracking, and data linkage across reporting periods.
  • Monitor participant survey completion, follow-up eligibility, response rates, and missing data.
  • Assist with organizing and preparing qualitative and quantitative datasets for evaluation activities.
  • Support participant interviews and qualitative coding activities when assigned, following approved protocols and established evaluation methods.
  • Document changes in data collection procedures, program implementation, and reporting practices that may affect interpretation or comparability of findings.
  • Assist with synthesizing findings and preparing supporting tables, visualizations, and documentation for evaluation reports.

The analyst will provide operational and analytical support for evaluation activities. Overall evaluation methodology, research design, and interpretation of complex evaluation findings will remain under the guidance of the designated evaluation lead and external evaluation partners.

5. Cross-Functional Coordination & Process Improvement (10%)

  • Collaborate with Vice President of Programs, Program Coordinator, Evaluation & Quality Assurance Lead, administrative staff, and external technical partners to support accurate and timely data collection and reporting.
  • Participate in regular data review and coordination meetings to identify priorities, review discrepancies, and monitor corrective actions.
  • Communicate data quality issues, reporting risks, and recommended solutions clearly and promptly.
  • Coordinate with technical vendors to troubleshoot system issues and confirm that corrections are reflected accurately in reporting datasets.
  • Develop practical tools, templates, and documentation to strengthen data quality, reporting efficiency, and consistency.
  • Provide guidance to program staff on data entry requirements, tracking procedures, reporting definitions, and documentation practices.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline data workflows, reduce manual reconciliation, and improve the reliability of program reporting.
  • Perform other related data management, reporting, analysis, and evaluation duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

Professional Experience & Competencies

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience managing programmatic, operational, or research datasets, including data extraction, cleaning, validation, reconciliation, and analysis.
  • Experience working with information collected across multiple platforms or data sources.
  • Experience preparing analytical reports, tables, charts, dashboards, or other data products for organizational, programmatic, or research audiences.
  • Familiarity with program monitoring, performance measurement, evaluation, or applied data analysis.
  • Understanding of survey administration, data collection methods, performance indicators, and basic evaluation principles.
  • Strong analytical reasoning and problem-solving skills, including the ability to independently investigate discrepancies and identify practical solutions.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and a systematic approach to data validation and documentation.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills, including the ability to manage recurring reporting deadlines and competing priorities.
  • Excellent written communication skills, including the ability to prepare concise analytical summaries, data quality documentation, and technical explanations.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with program staff, technical vendors, and evaluation partners.
  • Ability to work independently and reliably in a remote environment.
  • Commitment to confidentiality, ethical data practices, and responsible handling of sensitive participant information.

Technical Qualifications

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and/or Google Sheets, including pivot tables, lookup functions, advanced formulas, data validation, filtering, data cleaning, and reconciliation.
  • Experience importing, merging, organizing, reshaping, and analyzing datasets from multiple sources.
  • Ability to create repeatable, well-documented data preparation and reporting workflows.
  • Proficiency in developing charts, tables, dashboards, and other data visualizations using spreadsheet applications or comparable tools.
  • Experience using online survey platforms, learning management systems, registration databases, or comparable data collection and management systems.
  • Ability to learn new technology platforms quickly, troubleshoot data inconsistencies, and collaborate with technical support teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience using statistical or data analysis tools such as R, Python, SPSS, Stata, or comparable software.
  • Familiarity with Power BI, Tableau, Looker Studio, or other dashboard and business intelligence tools.
  • Experience using survey platforms such as Alchemer, Qualtrics, or SurveyMonkey.
  • Familiarity with learning management systems such as LearnWorlds and CRM platforms such as HubSpot.
  • Experience managing participant-level data across multiple program activities or longitudinal follow-up periods.
  • Experience supporting qualitative interviews, thematic coding, or mixed-methods evaluations.
  • Experience preparing funder reports or collaborating with external evaluation teams.
  • Experience working in healthcare, behavioral health, healthcare workforce well-being, peer support, public health, or community-based programs.
  • Experience developing standardized data quality procedures, reporting templates, or process improvements.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Public Health, Statistics, Data Analytics, Epidemiology, Psychology, Health Informatics, Program Evaluation, Social Sciences, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant applied experience.
  • Master's degree in Public Health (MPH), Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Health Informatics, Program Evaluation, or a closely related field preferred.
  • Demonstrated technical proficiency and practical experience working with complex datasets will be strongly valued.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented, analytical, and solutions-focused professional who enjoys working directly with data and improving the systems that support it.

They are comfortable navigating imperfect datasets, investigating discrepancies, reconciling information from multiple sources, and following data quality issues through to resolution.

They understand the importance of accurate, timely, and well-documented data for program implementation, funder accountability, and organizational learning.

They can work independently while maintaining strong communication and collaboration with program staff, technical vendors, and evaluation partners.

They bring curiosity, accountability, sound judgment, and a commitment to using data responsibly to support meaningful community-based programs.

Position Schedule & Scope

This position is initially anticipated to require 20–25 hours per week, with the potential to expand to full-time depending on organizational needs, funding availability, and program growth.

The position is fully remote, with scheduling flexibility and availability for designated team meetings, reporting deadlines, and coordination with external partners.

Responsibilities will be prioritized based on the agreed-upon work schedule, with primary emphasis on data quality assurance, data management, monthly reporting preparation, and essential evaluation support.

No Health benefits are offered with this position

Equal Opportunity Statement

GPS Group Peer Support is committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful work environment. We welcome applicants with diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and lived experiences and are committed to equitable consideration of qualified candidates.

Salary: $35 – $40 / hour

Are you interested in joining one of the fastest growing professional services firms in the nation?

If yes, consider joining Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP (BT) as a Sage HCM Implementation & Support Manager! At BT your main responsibilities will include leading client implementations and providing ongoing functional and technical support for Sage HCM solutions.

The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between new implementations, client training, configuration projects, troubleshooting, and ongoing support. Job Title:

HRIS Lead - Workday
