jobs.title: Salesforce Administrator
jobs.excerpt: Overview & ResponsibilitiesThe Salesforce Administrator is a business-owned role based in New Apparatus (NA) and is the day-to-day owner of Ebara Elliott Energy's (EEE) Salesforce platform for both North America and Global Services (GS/ES).
jobs.description:
Overview & Responsibilities

The Salesforce Administrator is a business-owned role based in New Apparatus (NA) and is the day-to-day owner of Ebara Elliott Energy's (EEE) Salesforce platform for both North America and Global Services (GS/ES). The role turns business needs into scalable Salesforce solutions and balances priorities across both groups, while working within the enterprise standards for security, integration, data, and change management set by EEE IT. IT remains the technical partner and owner of enterprise architecture, integrations, identity, and cybersecurity.


Background and Experience:

Required Experience & Skills

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical work experience.
  • Experience: 6+ years of hands-on enterprise Salesforce administration experience, preferably within a global manufacturing, aftermarket service, or complex supply-chain environment.
  • Automation Depth: Expert-level mastery of Salesforce Flow Builder and declarative process automation.
  • Cloud Architecture: Deep foundational knowledge of Sales Cloud and Service Cloud data models, object behaviors, and security architecture.
  • Governance: Proven experience working within IT governance (change and release management, sandbox strategy, and security reviews) in partnership with an enterprise IT organization.
  • Multi-Group Support: Experience supporting multiple business units or divisions on a shared org and balancing competing priorities.
  • Communication: Ability to explain technical trade-offs clearly to business leaders, users, and IT.

Certifications

  • Required: Salesforce Certified Platform Administrator (formerly Administrator).
  • Preferred: Salesforce Certified Platform Administrator II (formerly Advanced Administrator).
  • Pluses: Platform App Builder, Agentforce Specialist, architect-track certifications, or CPQ / Revenue Cloud credentials.

Preferred

  • Sales Baseline: Experience in Salesforce, CPQ, or similar as an active user in a sales environment.
  • Field Service: Experience with Field Service or Aftermarket service processes (service quotes, work orders, installed base).
  • Programmatic Elements: Familiarity reading or writing basic programmatic elements (Apex, SOQL, or LWC).
  • Integration Concepts: Working knowledge of integration concepts (APIs, middleware such as MuleSoft or Boomi) and data tools such as Data Loader.
  • Analytics Platforms: Experience connecting Salesforce data to advanced analytics platforms like Tableau or Power BI.

Nature of the Job:

To ensure seamless operations, alignment with enterprise architecture, and robust risk management, the Salesforce Administrator operates under a co-ownership model with EEE IT.

Governance & Architecture Reviews

  • Joint Salesforce Governance Forum: Lead recurring (e.g., monthly) Salesforce governance forum with NA, GS/ES, and IT leadership to align the platform roadmap, review system health, and prioritize the backlog across business units equitably.
  • Pre-Approval Gateways: Obtain formal IT review and approval prior to executing any modifications that impact integration points, API users, or the fundamental security sharing model.
  • Third-Party Evaluation: Coordinate with IT Systems and Security teams to vet, approve, and clear all AppExchange packages, connected apps, or external developer tools before introduction.

Environment & Release Management

  • Production Protection: Adhere strictly to the IT-approved environment strategy. Absolutely no declarative configuration or development changes are to be built directly in the Production environment.
  • DevOps Alignment: Utilize only EEE-approved DevOps tooling (e.g., Salesforce DevOps Center or GitHub) for all lifecycle deployments moving from sandbox environments through testing, user acceptance (UAT), and deployment.
  • Upgrade Coordination: Collaborate directly with IT during Salesforce's major triannual releases to proactively evaluate system compatibility, run regression testing, and safely evaluate emerging technologies (such as Einstein AI and Agent force) within IT's data security framework.

Identity, Security, & Business Continuity

  • Access Lifecycle Integration: Partner with IT to automate and audit the user access lifecycle (onboarding, role changes, offboarding) and enforce technical mandates like multi-factor authentication (MFA) and least-privilege permission sets.
  • Break-Glass Administration: Provide and maintain a designated "break-glass" System Administrator account reserved exclusively for IT to ensure platform access during emergencies or personnel vacancies.
  • Data Continuity: Align all backup, recovery, and data retention schedules with IT Infrastructure policies to prevent data loss and ensure compliance with global records retention standards.

Specific Job Responsibilities/Competencies:

Platform Ownership & Automation

  • Flow Optimization: Design advanced Flow automations, custom objects, validation rules, and scalable data models that support NA and GS/ES business processes on a shared, consistent Salesforce (SF) platform.
  • Feature Management: Manage core go-to-market (GTM) and operational features for NA and GS/ES, including account management, pipeline tracking, quoting, contract handoffs, service processes, and related workflows.
  • Technical Standards: Maintain configuration standards, naming conventions, and a technical-debt log for the org, favoring declarative (configuration-first) solutions; engage IT before introducing custom code, new managed packages, or major data model changes.
  • Backlog Tracking: Maintain a single, transparent intake and backlog for NA and GS/ES requests, prioritized through the Salesforce governance forum so both groups are supported equitably.
  • Enterprise Integration & Data Governance
  • IT Architecture Support: Partner with IT, which owns integration architecture and middleware, to define requirements for, test, and support integrations between Salesforce and enterprise systems such as ERP, CPQ, and others, as the business requires.
  • Data Hygiene: Oversee data integrity and hygiene across pipelines, funnel tracking, and on-time delivery (OTD) quote-to-cash processes, using data normalization and deduplication tools and aligning with IT on enterprise master data (e.g., customer and product records).
  • Operational Analytics: Create, manage, and optimize custom reports and operational dashboards for NA and GS/ES pipelines, PM, KAM, executive leadership, and others, as the business requires.
  • Security, Compliance & Release Management
  • Security Model Control: Administer the Salesforce security model, including role hierarchies, sharing rules, permission sets, public groups, and field-level security, in line with EEE IT security policies and the principle of least privilege.
  • Project Leadership: Serve as business project lead during large-scale enhancements, upgrades, or changeovers where Salesforce is the cornerstone system, coordinating with IT and implementation partners.
  • Regulatory Compliance: Ensure data in Salesforce is handled in line with EEE policies for export control, privacy, and records retention.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration & User Support
  • Cross-Functional Liaison: Partner with NA and GS/ES leaders across Sales, Service, Operations, Finance, PM, KAM, and Commercial Excellence to translate complex business problems into concrete technical solutions.
  • Escalation & Support: Act as the primary escalation point for Salesforce functional issues, system errors, and user support tickets; route issues involving login/SSO, integrations, or other connected systems through EEE’s IT ticketing process.
  • System Documentation: Document system configurations, architectural changes, and administrative processes in a shared repository accessible to IT; provide SF mentorship to junior administrators, analysts, and power users.
  • User Coaching: Act as the primary trainer, technical writer, resource, and user coach wherever Salesforce user education and resources are needed.
  • Licensing Coordination: Coordinate with IT and Procurement on Salesforce licensing, renewals, and the relationship with Salesforce and implementation partners.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Ebara Elliott Energy is an equal employment opportunity/affirmative action employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by the federal, state or local laws of the United States. Technology alone does not create impact—the right teams do. Founded in 2018, Parser is a boutique technology services and consulting firm helping global organisations solve complex business challenges through digital transformation, product development and AI enablement.

jobs.description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Compliance Director and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one.

You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area.

What You’ll Own

  • Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures.

  • Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite.

  • Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients.

  • Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity.

  • Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments.

  • File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR.

  • Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board.

  • Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest.

  • Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters.

  • Prepare the firm for the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027.

  • Build the compliance and AML team as the business grows.

What We’re Looking For

  • Significant experience in AML/CTF at a regulated EU financial institution. Ideally at an investment firm, neobroker, neobank or e-money institution.

  • Experience with digital onboarding and remote identity verification at scale.

  • Hands-on experience building risk assessments, monitoring scenarios and EDD processes.

  • Experience filing suspicious activity reports and handling regulatory inspections.

  • Knowledge of MiFID II conduct and investment-services compliance, or the ability to learn it fast.

  • Experience selecting and overseeing KYC, screening and monitoring tools.

  • Strong judgment and the confidence to challenge senior colleagues.

  • Clear, concise writing for policies, board reports and regulators.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a key function holder.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania or the FNTT.

  • Knowledge of Lithuanian AML law and Bank of Lithuania instructions.

  • Experience with clients across several EEA countries.

  • CAMS (ACAMS) or ICA certification.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • People who copy policies from templates without fitting them to the business.

  • People who say no without offering a compliant way forward.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised.

jobs.description:
Redefining Healthcare with AI

Xsolis is an AI-driven technology company reducing administrative waste in healthcare by enabling smarter collaboration between providers and payers. Since 2013, our vision has been to create a frictionless healthcare system.

We are proudly headquartered in Franklin, TN - one of the nation's fastest-growing hubs for healthcare innovation - we are at the heart of a thriving ecosystem of health systems, payers, and technology leaders.

Our flagship product, Dragonfly®, is the first and only AI-driven platform to continuously assign real-time predictive scores for medical necessity. Dragonfly has delivered proven results across 600+ hospital, health system, and health plan clients and earned repeated industry recognition. With recognition on the Inc. 5000  and Deloitte Technology Fast 500 lists, Xsolis is also one of the fastest-growing privately-held companies in the country and across North America, and we're looking for talented people to grow with us.

Position Summary DetailsXsolis is hiring a Senior Manager, Data Science to set the vision for how we use predictive, generative and agentic AI, and to build and lead the team that delivers it. You will spot the opportunities worth pursuing, shape them into a strategy, and take them from idea to production.

This is a leadership role with expectation on deep hands-on coding knowledge. We want a self-starter who doesn't wait for a roadmap: someone who can take a rough idea, rally a team around it and run with it. You will have the technical depth to guide decisions on model training, LLM fine-tuning and agent design, and you will spend your time leading people and driving outcomes in partnership with product and engineering teams

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

The essential functions include, but are not limited to the following:

Vision and strategy

• Define a multi-year vision and roadmap for data science, ML and agentic AI, tied to business goals.

• Identify where AI creates the most value and make the case to leadership for where to invest.

• Track where the field is heading (LLMs, agents, fine-tuning) and decide what the team adopts, and when.

Taking ideas from zero to one

• Take loosely defined ideas and turn them into scoped bets with clear goals, milestones and success metrics.

• Move quickly from concept to prototype to production without waiting for a fully formed plan.

• Own outcomes end to end, and know when to push forward, pivot or stop.

Team leadership

• Build, hire and grow a high-performing team of data scientists and ML engineers.

• Mentor through regular 1:1s, career plans and honest feedback, and develop future leaders on the team.

• Create a culture of ownership, experimentation and high standards.

• Delegate the technical work and empower the team to make decisions.

Technical direction: models and LLMs

• Set standards and review designs for training deep learning models, including GPU and distributed training (data, model and pipeline parallelism).

• Guide LLM strategy: when to prompt, use RAG, or fine-tune with PEFT methods such as LoRA and QLoRA.

• Make sure models are evaluated rigorously before and after they ship, and that GPU spend stays under control.

Technical direction: agentic AI and infrastructure

• Shape the architecture for agentic systems on AWS: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, SageMaker, Lambda, EventBridge and ECS, with CloudWatch for observability.

• Champion MLOps practices: Docker, infrastructure as code with Terraform, CI/CD for models and production monitoring.

• Set guardrails for safe, responsible AI: agent permissions, data privacy and human review.

Stakeholders and delivery

• Partner regularly with product, data engineering and platform leaders to align on priorities and roadmap.

• Communicate vision, trade-offs and results clearly to executives and non-technical audiences.

• Run the team in an agile cadence (sprint planning, backlog prioritization, retros) with predictable delivery.

Minimum Qualifications (Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities)

• 8+ years in data science or ML, including 3+ years leading teams of data scientists or ML engineers and experience in building agentic systems

• A track record of setting a technical vision and delivering it, ideally taking new AI products or capabilities from idea to production.

• Strong understanding on practical deployment of agents to production using Agentcore and aligning with the organization’s agentic AI roadmap.

• A self-starter who thrives in ambiguity and drives initiatives without needing detailed direction.

• Deep understanding of deep learning and GPU training at scale, including distributed training, enough to guide the team and challenge its decisions.

• Strong grasp of LLM fine-tuning (PEFT, LoRA, QLoRA) and agentic AI architecture.

• Familiarity with AWS ML and serverless services (SageMaker, Bedrock AgentCore, Lambda, EventBridge, ECS), Docker and Terraform.

• Experience leading agile teams and managing projects across several stakeholder groups.

• An excellent communicator who can influence product, engineering and executive stakeholders.

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, statistics, math or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience building a data science or AI function from the ground up, or startup or founder experience.

• Experience presenting strategy to executive leadership

• Master's or PhD in a quantitative field.

• Familiarity with RAG, vector databases and agent frameworks such as LangGraph, Strands Agents or MCP.

• Responsible AI practice: bias testing, safety evaluations and data governance.

• Experience owning cloud and GPU budgets.

Working Environment and Travel Requirements

  • Work is typically in a normal office administrative environment involving minimal exposure to physical risks.
  • Position requires little to moderate physical activity. Mostly sedentary work exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally or a negligible amount of force to lift, carry, push, pull, or otherwise move objects. Work involves sitting most of the time, but may involve walking or standing for brief periods of time. No significant stooping is usually required.

jobs.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Role Overview

The Business Intelligence (BI) Solution Developer serves as a key member of the Measurement Enablement team, responsible for ensuring client healthcare marketing data is accurate, current, and ready for reporting and analysis. This role bridges the gap between Data Engineering, analytics teams, and client stakeholders by managing data ingestion processes, validating data quality, maintaining reporting-ready data structures, and resolving issues throughout the data lifecycle.

The ideal candidate enjoys investigating data questions, identifying root causes of data discrepancies, improving data quality, and working across multiple teams to ensure reliable data powers business decisions.

This role can be remote within the United States or based in any of our U.S. office locations, including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Lambertville, NJ, San Francisco, or Carmel, IN.

Primary Responsibilities

Data Ingestion & Source Management

  • Coordinate the onboarding of new client data sources and data feeds.
  • Partner with Data Engineering to ensure successful ingestion of data into Databricks.
  • Monitor data delivery schedules and ingestion processes.
  • Maintain source documentation, field mappings, and data inventories.
  • Work directly with internal teams and external partners to resolve source-related issues.

Data Quality & Stewardship

  • Monitor data freshness, completeness, and accuracy across client datasets.
  • Perform ongoing quality assurance and reconciliation checks.
  • Investigate missing, unexpected, or inconsistent data.
  • Escalate, coordinate and resolve remediation efforts with the appropriate teams.
  • Maintain documentation of data quality findings and resolutions.
  • Support the development of automated data quality checks and monitoring processes.

Data Modeling

  • Develop and maintain client-specific standard, custom, and master tables and reporting views within Databricks based on a medallion architecture.
  • Assist with transforming and standardizing data from multiple sources into reporting-ready structures.
  • Solve problems and help build solutions related to the data model to meet evolving reporting and analysis needs.
  • Document business rules, transformation logic, and metric definitions.
  • Support maintenance of reusable reporting datasets and standardized data models.

Stakeholder Support

  • Act as the primary point of contact for routine data-related questions.
  • Partner with Client Services, Media, Strategy, and Data teams to align on data outputs and expectations.
  • Work with analysts and measurement leads to understand reporting requirements, translate into technical requirements, and provide database-modeled data for reporting.
  • Communicate data issues, impacts, and resolutions to stakeholders.
  • Assist with troubleshooting data discrepancies impacting reporting deliverables.

Reporting Support

  • Support Power BI developers and business analysts with data-related questions.
  • Assist with report validation and troubleshooting.
  • Help verify data displayed in dashboards aligns with source systems and business requirements.
  • Provide support for semantic models and reporting datasets when needed.

Qualifications

  • Strong SQL and Python skills, in a Databricks environment preferrable.
  • Experience using ETL tools and data manipulation concepts (Funnel.io, DBT, or similar applications).
  • Comfort partnering with Data Engineering on data sources, schemas, and refresh logic.
  • Deep analytical and problem-solving skills related to data storage and structure for reporting.
  • Experience reviewing data logic, KPI definitions, and QA outputs.
  • Basic BI (Tableau, Power BI) skills including data modeling, dashboard structure, calculated fields, usability, data storytelling.
  • Strong written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to translate complex business reporting requests into modeled data to support current and future analysis.

Preferred / Bonus

  • Pharma, HCP, or healthcare media analytics experience, including experience with media PLD (Physician Level Data).
  • Digital media measurement expertise (media KPIs, attribution concepts, omnichannel analysis).
  • Experience inheriting or stabilizing existing data warehouse schemas.

Pay Range:$90,000-$110,000

jobs.title: Associate Director, Programmatic
jobs.excerpt: About DarkroomDarkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow.
jobs.description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s. Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom's role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

We are hiring an Associate Director, Programmatic to build and lead Darkroom's programmatic capability inside the Paid Media function. This is a foundational hire, not a standard channel-management role. Today, Darkroom is strongest across Meta and Google. Our next stage requires deeper expertise across Amazon DSP, CTV, OLV, Retail Media Networks, high-impact display, and privacy-safe media environments, and you'll be the person who builds that sub-function from the ground up.

The ideal candidate is a senior programmatic strategist with hands-on experience activating and scaling programmatic media across high-growth brands, someone who knows how to use Amazon DSP, streaming video, OLV, CTV, and broader programmatic channels to create demand, prove incrementality, and connect media investment back to business outcomes.

Programmatic is the primary focus of this role, but it's not a full-time channel on every account at every point in time. When programmatic work is light or between test cycles, you'll flex into Paid Social execution across Meta, TikTok, Reddit, and Pinterest, so the role is built for someone who wants deep specialization without losing a holistic, hands-on media skill set.

You'll report to the Managing Director of Paid Media and partner closely with Paid Social, Paid Search, Creative, Growth Strategy, and Analytics.

What We're Building

We're empowering small teams with technology that makes it easier to market and grow businesses. Our current focus is to help consumer brands shift from "workflow automation" to "agent management" within their marketing operations. Shadow is the AI coordination layer, providing shared AI memory, centralized agent control, and model orchestration for marketing teams.

The Agency Behind the Product

Shadow is built alongside Darkroom, a performance marketing agency that's been operating for 10 years, employs 100+ people, runs 100+ clients at a time, and has worked with over 1,000 consumer brands. The agency is both our proving ground and our first user, which means the programmatic function you build here gets tested against real client budgets and real business outcomes from day one, and feeds directly into Shadow's programmatic backbone.

What You'll Own

  • With support from the Paid Media MD, build Darkroom's programmatic media capability across Amazon DSP, CTV, OLV, RMNs, display, and high-impact media.

  • Lead strategy, planning, activation, optimization, and measurement for programmatic campaigns across key client accounts.

  • Serve as the internal subject matter expert for Amazon DSP, retail media, streaming video, connected TV, online video, and programmatic buying strategy.

  • Develop test plans that connect programmatic investment to business outcomes, not just impressions, reach, or platform-reported conversions.

  • Partner with Analytics and Growth Strategy to design incrementality-minded test structures across geo holdouts, matched-market tests, exposure-log measurement, clean rooms, and lift studies.

  • Build clear client-facing narratives around the role of programmatic in a broader growth system.

  • Evaluate programmatic partners, publishers, DSPs, RMNs, and measurement vendors.

  • Establish programmatic best practices, SOPs, QA standards, pacing rules, and reporting expectations.

  • Collaborate with Creative to define channel-specific creative requirements across video, display, high-impact, and RMN environments.

  • Create case studies that prove programmatic's incremental impact and support future new business.

  • Educate the broader Paid Media team on programmatic strategy, terminology, platform capabilities, measurement expectations, and client use cases.

  • Help define the long-term roadmap for building a programmatic practice inside Darkroom.

  • Work closely with the Shadow product team to enhance Shadow's programmatic backbone.

  • Step in on Paid Social campaign management and optimization across Meta, TikTok, Reddit, and Pinterest when programmatic priorities are lighter, acting as a flexible resource for the broader Paid Media team.

Must Have

  • 6-8+ years of programmatic media experience, preferably in a fast-paced agency or high-growth brand environment.

  • Deep experience with Amazon DSP is required.

  • Strong experience planning or activating CTV and OLV campaigns.

  • Experience with Retail Media Networks and audience-led media environments.

  • Hands-on Paid Social media buying experience across at least two of Meta, TikTok, Reddit, or Pinterest, comfortable executing and optimizing campaigns when programmatic priorities allow.

  • Ability to build programmatic strategies that connect to business outcomes, incrementality, and budget decisioning.

  • Strong understanding of programmatic buying models, inventory quality, audience strategy, frequency management, supply paths, brand safety, and measurement limitations.

  • Experience working with streaming video, display, high-impact, contextual, publisher-direct, and DSP-based media.

  • Comfort building test plans, media forecasts, budget recommendations, and client-facing measurement readouts.

  • Experience partnering with analytics or measurement teams on incrementality testing, lift studies, clean rooms, exposure logs, or MMM inputs.

  • Strong client communication skills. You can explain complex programmatic concepts in plain English and make a clear recommendation.

  • High ownership mindset. This is a new function, so you should be excited to build systems, not just inherit them.

  • Comfort operating in a remote, fast-moving, high-accountability environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with MMM, MTA, and strong measurement points of view.

jobs.excerpt: Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.
jobs.description:
Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.

More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it’s because they are employed by a company that doesn’t offer a retirement plan. Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.

We’re a high-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock, TPG (The Rise Fund), SoftBank, Glynn Capital, NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more.

About the role

This is a high-impact, hands-on engineering role building the future of our mobile app experience. As a Senior Software Engineer on our Mobile team, you will design, build, and ship the features millions of employees and plan administrators rely on to manage their financial future, and help set the technical foundation for mobile engineering at Human Interest. The team's scope is broad, spanning multi-persona mobile experiences, native and cross-platform architecture, and release operations.

This is a rare greenfield opportunity. As one of the founding engineers on a team built from the ground up, you will have a blank slate: pipelines, release process, QA, telemetry, and the native-vs-cross-platform architecture do not exist yet, so nothing is constrained by legacy decisions. You will ship the earliest versions, shape the patterns the team adopts, and partner with your engineering manager, Product, and Design, owning the outcomes that matter: app store ratings, crash-free sessions, and reliable delivery.

This role is about leveraging AI to build. Operating as the architect and decision-maker, you will direct AI coding agents across the development lifecycle and help shape the team's agentic workflows, pairing that speed with an app that is fast, secure, accessible, and built to last.

What you get to do every day

  • Build a polished experience across iOS and Android, native or cross-platform, that helps employees understand and grow their retirement savings, plus future experiences for 401(k) plan admins to manage plans on the go.
  • Architect a modern, modular codebase from scratch, with modern concurrency, clean dependency management, and testability at its core, and no legacy constraints.
  • Use AI coding agents as a core part of how you build, directing them across the development lifecycle as the architect and decision-maker and helping shape the team's agentic workflows and quality bar.
  • Solve hard fintech problems on mobile: accurate, real-time balances, secure authentication and biometrics, and protecting sensitive financial data.
  • Own how we ship: CI/CD, phased App Store and Play Store rollouts, feature flags, and automated UI testing, with crash-free rates and app ratings as your scoreboard.
  • Sweat the details with Design, from animations and haptics to data visualization and accessibility, so saving for retirement feels as good as any consumer app.
  • Partner with backend engineers on API contracts and backend-driven UI, and help define our native and cross-platform direction.

What you bring to the role

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience building and maintaining software in production, including shipping and owning consumer mobile apps through many App Store and Play Store release cycles.
  • Deep expertise in native mobile development (Swift and SwiftUI, or Kotlin and Jetpack Compose) or cross-platform frameworks (React Native, Flutter, Kotlin Multiplatform), with strong opinions on app architecture, performance, and testing.
  • Experience owning features end to end, from technical design through release and iteration, in a collaborative, cross-functional environment.
  • Experience taking a mobile app from 0 to 1 is a plus, whether at a startup, a larger product company, or an established financial services firm.
  • Experience with fintech, security-sensitive applications, or regulated domains is a plus.

AI-Augmented Engineering

  • Hands-on, regular use of agentic coding tools such as Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor on production work. We allow and actively encourage them.
  • Sound judgment on where AI helps and where it does not, and the habit of keeping agent-generated code correct, secure, and well-tested.

Technical Acumen

  • Deep technical background in mobile software engineering across native and cross-platform stacks, with strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, concurrency, and asynchronous programming.
  • Solid understanding of mobile architecture trade-offs, performance tuning, device farms, automated UI testing (XCUITest, Espresso, Appium), client-side telemetry (Sentry, Firebase, Datadog), and API contract design.
  • Desire to work with our backend stack (Node, TypeScript, Kotlin, AWS). A commitment to accessibility and to writing well-tested, maintainable code.

Leadership and Collaboration Skills

Top-notch communication, both verbal and written: you can work well with engineers and non-engineers alike. A strong product sense and an eye for craft: you notice dropped frames, awkward transitions, and inaccessible UI, and you fix them. A proactive, empathetic mindset and a bias toward ownership: you roll up your sleeves to solve problems for our customers, mentor through code reviews, and raise the bar for those around you.

Education

Typically requires a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Why you will love working at Human Interest

Human Interest is tackling one of our country's biggest challenges - closing the retirement gap. You'll be instrumental in architecting and scaling solutions that bring financial security to employees at small and medium-sized businesses nationwide. We’ve made significant progress, but there is still growth ahead, offering you a unique opportunity to solve complex problems, drive innovation, and advance your career alongside a dedicated, mission-driven team. We value hard work and recognize that our team's contributions are key to our continued success.

Join Human Interest and make a lasting impact by shaping the future of retirement.

Our operating principles define how we work together as a team. They reflect Human Interest’s unique view on what’s important and what’s right. Documenting this core aspect of our culture helps employees make good decisions on their own. It also helps candidates considering career opportunities critically evaluate whether they will thrive at Human Interest.

  • Customer obsession: We're all about creating amazing experiences for our customers. We put their needs first and go the extra mile to make them smile.

  • Fundamental Optimism: We see the glass as half full (and then we fill it up with more amazing ideas!). We believe in the power of positivity and the potential for greatness.

You think in both inbound and outbound motions, you have a point of view on how AI is changing demand generation right now (not two years ago), and you're fluent in the modern martech stack, especially HubSpot and Salesforce. You measure marketing in pipeline dollars and closed revenue, not activity, and you would rather ship something effective this week than something elegant next quarter.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and lead Grace Hill's Demand Generation function end-to-end: inbound (SEO/AEO/GEO, paid media, lifecycle/content), outbound (ABM, intent data), and customer marketing, hiring and developing the team as it stands up.
  • Set and own the pipeline strategy and targets: marketing-sourced and influenced pipeline dollars, conversion through to closed-won revenue, pipeline coverage, CAC, and payback (lead volume is an input, not the goal), and report on them credibly to executive leadership.
  • Own paid media and the demand generation program budget end to end: channel mix, agency and vendor management, and monthly reallocation based on pipeline per dollar, CAC, and payback rather than clicks or lead volume.
  • Lead the marketing portion of a weekly pipeline review with Sales leadership and take part in forecast calls: report sourced and influenced pipeline, stage conversion, and gaps to plan, and leave every review with owners and next actions.
  • Set and enforce lead response and handoff SLAs with Sales and SDR/BDR leadership, including follow-up on every qualified inbound lead within 24 hours.
  • Partner with the Brand, Events & Communications team to turn conferences, sponsorships, and hosted events into pipeline: target account lists and pre-event outreach, meeting goals, post-event follow-up within agreed SLAs, and event-level pipeline and ROI reporting.
  • Design the outbound/ABM motion in partnership with Sales: define target account criteria, operationalize intent data (e.g., ZoomInfo and similar sources), and hand Sales a prioritized, sales-ready account list.
  • Bring a real point of view on where AI belongs in demand gen today: content production, intent scoring, campaign optimization, personalization at scale, and separate what's genuinely useful from what's hype.
  • Put AI to work inside the team, not just in the plan: use it to cut production and research time, personalize at scale, and amplify proven campaigns, and report the time and cost it saves.
  • Run a disciplined test roadmap: change one variable at a time, write down the hypothesis and success metric for each test, and make a clear call to scale, fix, or stop.
  • Own the HubSpot/Salesforce ecosystem at a strategic level: lead scoring and routing logic, attribution, and funnel reporting, in close partnership with Rev Ops and GTM operations/engineering (Rev Ops owns day-to-day marketing automation administration), co-owning one set of pipeline stage definitions, source-of-truth dashboards, and a quarterly forecast of marketing-sourced pipeline by segment.
  • Roll up your sleeves where needed, building a campaign brief, fixing a broken workflow, or writing a landing page, particularly during the team's first 6–12 months.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Brand & Communications, Sales, Customer Success, and Rev Ops to ensure demand gen work ladders up to one coherent go-to-market motion.

Qualifications

Required

  • 10+ years in B2B demand generation including at least 4 years leading a demand generation team (ideally managing managers or senior specialists) at a B2B SaaS company. Candidates with 8+ years and an exceptional build track record will be considered at the Senior Director level.
  • Direct experience scaling a marketing/demand function through significant company growth, ideally in the $80M to $150M+ ARR range or a comparable stage and can speak concretely to what changed in the org and the motion at each stage.
  • A track record of building teams from a small or partial base, not just managing an already-mature function.
  • Hands-on fluency with HubSpot and Salesforce: you can look at a workflow or a report and know whether it's built correctly, even if you're not the one building it day-to-day.
  • Working knowledge of the modern demand gen and intent-data stack (e.g., ZoomInfo, 6sense, Bombora, or comparable tools) and a clear point of view on where AI tools genuinely improve output versus add noise.
  • Demonstrated command of both inbound (SEO/AEO/GEO, content, paid) and outbound/ABM motions; this is not a purely brand or content background.
  • A track record of owning a paid media and program budget at a company of comparable scale, and of reallocating spend based on measured pipeline and payback.
  • Experience running or co-running recurring pipeline reviews and forecast cadences with Sales leadership, and defending marketing’s numbers in front of Sales and Finance.
  • Experience partnering with Rev Ops or GTM operations/engineering to build attribution, funnel dashboards, and pipeline forecasts that leadership uses to plan.
  • Experience aligning with SDR/BDR teams on routing, follow-up cadences, and response-time SLAs.
  • Experience turning trade shows and sponsored events into measurable pipeline, working with an events or field marketing team you do not manage.
  • Hands-on use of AI tools in your own and your team’s daily workflow, with specific examples of measured efficiency gains.
  • Comfortable operating without a fully built team or process in place and energized rather than frustrated by that stage of building.
  • Sharp, data-literate communicator who can present pipeline performance and strategy clearly to a CMO, and CEO.

Preferred

  • Experience in real estate technology, proptech, or another vertical SaaS market with a similarly relationship-driven buyer.
  • Experience operating inside a PE-backed or newly-scaling marketing org, where the team is being built in real time alongside the strategy.
  • Experience with signal-based or AI-native GTM tooling (e.g., Clay, Common Room, Claude) used to prioritize accounts and time outreach.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: Up to $195K + Bonus
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits
  • Remote work option
  • Collaborative, mission-driven culture

Success in the First Year Looks Like

  • Core Demand Generation team hired and ramped against a hiring plan agreed with the CMO, with clear owners for inbound, outbound/ABM, and lifecycle/customer marketing.
  • A functioning ABM/intent-data motion delivering prioritized, sales-ready account lists to the sales team on a predictable cadence.
  • Clear, trusted pipeline reporting that the CMO and executive team rely on for planning., built with GTM operations and reviewed weekly with Sales leadership
  • Paid and program spend running against agreed CAC and payback targets, reallocated monthly on results.
  • Lead response and handoff SLAs, including 24-hour follow-up on qualified inbound leads, in place and consistently met.
  • Every major event has a target account list, a follow-up plan, and reported pipeline and ROI.
  • At least two meaningful AI-enabled improvements integrated into the demand gen workflow, each with measured time or cost savings

About Grace Hill

Grace Hill helps companies managing multifamily residential properties develop and retain top talent to reduce the operating risk and elevate property performance - with an integrated talent performance management platform encompassing policies, training, and assessment. Our advanced technology-enabled solutions are bolstered by years of multifamily experience, in-depth service level expertise, and outstanding customer support. Today, over 1,600 companies covering a workforce of over 500,000 people rely on talent performance solutions from Grace Hill.

Alors, votre profil nous intéresse !

Rejoignez une entreprise où l’humain, l’innovation et l’impact se rencontrent.

Si votre profil correspond, vous serez invité à un entretien avec un opérationnel pour échanger sur vos compétences et votre vision du métier. Vous rencontrerez ensuite Dylan, chargé de recrutement, pour un moment d’échange autour de votre parcours, vos aspirations et notre culture d’entreprise.

#CS #GRC #Cybersécurité

Protéger les territoires, anticiper les menaces.

jobs.description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Compliance Director and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one.

You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area.

What You’ll Own

  • Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures.

  • Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite.

  • Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients.

  • Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity.

  • Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments.

  • File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR.

  • Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board.

  • Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest.

  • Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters.

  • Prepare the firm for the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027.

  • Build the compliance and AML team as the business grows.

What We’re Looking For

  • Significant experience in AML/CTF at a regulated EU financial institution. Ideally at an investment firm, neobroker, neobank or e-money institution.

  • Experience with digital onboarding and remote identity verification at scale.

  • Hands-on experience building risk assessments, monitoring scenarios and EDD processes.

  • Experience filing suspicious activity reports and handling regulatory inspections.

  • Knowledge of MiFID II conduct and investment-services compliance, or the ability to learn it fast.

  • Experience selecting and overseeing KYC, screening and monitoring tools.

  • Strong judgment and the confidence to challenge senior colleagues.

  • Clear, concise writing for policies, board reports and regulators.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a key function holder.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania or the FNTT.

  • Knowledge of Lithuanian AML law and Bank of Lithuania instructions.

  • Experience with clients across several EEA countries.

  • CAMS (ACAMS) or ICA certification.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • People who copy policies from templates without fitting them to the business.

  • People who say no without offering a compliant way forward.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised.

jobs.description:
Cin7 is a fast-growing global software company that provides solutions for modern-day product sellers. We help these sellers connect and simplify their operations, keep track of their inventory at scale, and help them sell their products across multiple sales channels around the world.
Cin7 is expanding very quickly with a mission to empower product sellers to thrive by making selling as easy as buying. We are committed to this mission to become the leading Inventory Management Software brand in the world.
Serving over 8,000 customers globally, processing more than 125 million orders per year, and supporting over $35B of Gross Merchandise Value, Cin7 has been rated best overall in inventory management software in 2024 by Forbes Advisor.

How you'll make an impact:

Owning Power BI dashboards and datasets end to end means tracing data from source systems through Azure Data Factory into Fabric, building the semantic models and DAX measures behind self-service reporting, and making sure what leadership sees is accurate. This is a build-and-maintain role first and ad hoc analysis second, and it calls for sound judgment on AI: knowing where automation genuinely improves a reporting workflow and where it doesn’t.

What you'll do:

  • Design, build, and maintain Power BI datasets, data models, and dashboards — not just visuals, but the relationships and measures underneath them
  • Understand and be able to explain how data flows from source systems through Azure Data Factory into Fabric and into Power BI, well enough to diagnose issues independently rather than escalating every anomaly
  • Partner with stakeholders across departments to gather requirements and translate them into technical specs
  • Own data accuracy and quality for reporting outputs — troubleshoot and resolve issues as they surface, not just flag them for someone else
  • Document data models, datasets, and reporting logic for team continuity and QA
  • Actively build AI into the daily workflow — using AI tools to draft queries, DAX/Power Query logic, and documentation, and proactively identifying where AI or automation can replace manual reporting steps — while independently validating correctness before anything reaches a stakeholder
  • Identify and build AI-powered automation for manual reporting workflows, expanding self-service analytics and offsetting capacity constraints without added headcount
  • Grow into Cin7’s broader Customer Operations systems over time — ChurnZero, Salesforce, ZenDesk — with training provided as needed. Not an immediate priority for this role, but baseline ChurnZero configuration is expected of every Customer Ops team member, given how central it is to the function.

What you'll bring:

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (information systems, computer science, business analytics, or similar) — or demonstrated equivalent experience with a track record in BI-specific roles
  • 2–3 years of hands-on Power BI experience: building datasets and data models, not just consuming or lightly editing existing dashboards — relationships, DAX measures, Power Query
  • Working knowledge of SQL, framed as a diagnostic/conceptual skill (reading and validating data, understanding joins/keys/grain) rather than daily production querying
  • Demonstrated ability to explain what data means and where it comes from, not just how to reproduce a report
  • AI-native fluency, demonstrated rather than claimed: able to build AI tools into daily BI workflows (query drafting, DAX/Power Query, documentation, automation), independently validate their output before it reaches a stakeholder, and bring a practical sense of what these tools are and aren't good at

It's a nice to have if you bring:

  • Direct exposure to Microsoft Fabric (lakehouses, dataflows) or Azure Data Factory
  • Experience owning a BI dataset/model end-to-end at a prior job, not just building on top of one someone else designed

In return, we offer:

  • Competitive benefits include medical, dental, vision, and a 401k company match program.

  • A flexible PTO policy, allowing you the time you need to recharge.

  • A diverse team, where everyone helps each other and inclusion is a core value.

  • Remote work flexibility allows you to maintain a work-life balance in a way that suits your needs.

  • Frequent company-sponsored events so you can get to know your coworkers.

Why CIN7?

CIN7 is a leader in one of the most exciting software verticals right now, and we're growing exponentially. We're looking to add people to our team who are passionate about working with a fast growth tech company.
At CIN7, we make great products available to everyone. Every month, millions of sales orders flow through our platform reducing the cost, effort and time for product sellers so they can quickly get products to customers and build their brands without worrying about their operations. We pride ourselves on providing Inventory Management and Supply Chain software to help medium-large product businesses thrive in a highly competitive, digital world. CIN7 centrally manages inventory across multiple locations and channels, connecting 500+ systems to support receiving, selling and shipping stock.
We value diversity at Cin7, and bring people into the heart of everything we do. We hire, recruit, and promote without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, pregnancy or maternity, veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law. We understand the importance of creating a safe and comfortable work environment and encourage individualism and authenticity in every member of our team

Description

Head of Data Center and Capacity Partnerships, AI Infrastructure

DriveNets, AI Business Unit. Remote US-based preferred; frequent travel.

About the Company

DriveNets is a leader in high-scale networking software for AI infrastructure and service providers. The company pioneered a disaggregated networking architecture that transforms the economics of large-scale networks while maximizing performance, utilization, and operational efficiency. DriveNets-powered networks are deployed by global leaders, including AT&T and Comcast, supporting more than 30% of total U.S. internet traffic. DriveNets AI Fabric delivers full-stack networking for AI infrastructures, providing the highest-performance, Ethernet-based alternative to InfiniBand. The solution is deployed by hyperscalers, NeoClouds, and enterprises worldwide. With over $1B raised, DriveNets continues to push the boundaries of modern networking infrastructure.

The Role

DriveNets builds the networking fabric and services behind large AI clusters for neoclouds, AI companies and enterprises. As our AI business scales, the relationships that matter most sit with the people who control compute and data center capacity: data center operators and developers, colocation and power providers, and the clouds building on top of them.

We are hiring a senior partner to own those relationships. This is a relationships-first role: your network in the AI data center world is your most valuable asset. You will know where capacity exists and is being built, who controls it, when it is ready and what it costs, and you will use that knowledge to help our customers and partners get clusters built faster.

This is not a procurement or supply chain role. You need to be able to pick up the phone and get a straight answer on megawatts, timing and price, structure the partnership that follows, and stay close to the deal through deployment.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain partnerships with data center operators and developers, colocation and power providers, and neoclouds across the geographies our customers need.
  • Keep a current, accurate picture of available and upcoming capacity: power, space, ready dates and commercial terms.
  • Work with our sales team and executives to connect capacity with customers that need it, and respond quickly to urgent “can you find me capacity” requests.
  • Structure and negotiate partnership agreements with capacity providers, within guidelines set with leadership.
  • Bring data center partners into customer engagements alongside our silicon and server partners, and keep the relationship through deployment and expansion.
  • Provide market intelligence to leadership on where AI capacity is being built, by whom, and on what economics.

Who you are

  • Established, direct relationships with data center operators and developers, colocation and power providers, and neoclouds, with a proven record of sourcing capacity (MW or GPUs) through them.
  • Deep, current knowledge of the AI data center landscape: where capacity exists, who controls it, what it costs, and how to reach capacity before it is widely available.
  • Commercial judgment to structure and negotiate partnership agreements.
  • Technical understanding to talk credibly with engineers about power, cooling, site readiness, GPU types and cluster requirements.
  • Deal-making instinct: you understand what each party in an infrastructure deal needs in order to say yes.
  • Organized and fast: you can track dozens of providers with accurate availability and pricing, and respond to urgent requests in hours.
  • A clear communicator across providers, customers, executives and internal teams.
  • Stability and long-term thinking: this is a relationship business.

Preferred

  • Experience at a neocloud, GPU aggregator or marketplace, data center developer or colocation provider where capacity availability was the constraint.
  • Existing relationships with the major neoclouds and with the cloud partner ecosystems of the leading AI silicon vendors.
  • Knowledge of bare-metal data center operations, power procurement and capacity planning.
  • Understanding of GPU types, specifications and AI/ML workload requirements.
  • High-growth startup background.

  • Knowledge of bare-metal data center operations, power procurement and capacity planning.

Hi, we're Oscar. We're hiring a Provider Data Operations Lead to join our Network Operations.

Oscar is the first health insurance company built around a full stack technology platform and a relentless focus on serving our members. We started Oscar in 2012 to create the kind of health insurance company we would want for ourselves—one that behaves like a doctor in the family.

About the role:

The Provider Data Operations Lead is a provider data and production workflow expert within a payor healthcare environment. This role is responsible for creating, implementing, and optimizing production workflows while driving team performance against established goals and KPIs. The Lead provides day-to-day coaching and leadership to support staff and partners with cross-functional stakeholders to develop workflow solutions that improve operational efficiency, data accuracy, quality, and overall team performance.

You will report into the Manager, Provider Data Operations.

Work Location: This position is fully remote and open to candidates residing in the U.S., excluding Alaska; Delaware; Hawaii; Louisiana; Montana; North Dakota; Oklahoma; West Virginia; Wyoming; and U.S. Territories. Daily work is completed from your home office, with occasional travel required for team meetings and company events.

Pay Transparency: The base pay for this role is: $55,890 - $73,355 per year. You are also eligible for employee benefits, participation in Oscar's unlimited vacation program and annual performance bonuses.

Responsibilities:

  • Hire and manage a team of Oscar colleagues with direct responsibility for performance management, their growth and development, and associated HR administrative tasks
  • Manage your team's outcomes, monitor dashboards, and track operational KPIs, conducting root-cause analysis and constructing action plans when issues arise
  • Understand and be connected to the type of work your team does on a daily basis, being able to make volume-based decisions that best serve our customers.
  • Serve as a central communicator by leading team huddles with Oscar colleagues, connecting colleagues to the mission, vision, and values of Oscar, and providing guidance and motivation to achieve daily operational objectives
  • Be a culture carrier, driving engagement with your team by creating an inclusive and inviting culture that aligns with Oscar's core values
  • Actively lead and participate in continuous improvement activities that drive or influence the improvement and development of a high performing production team
  • Identifying and closing gaps on existing operational workflows
  • Work collaboratively across production and other Oscar teams to implement best practice
  • Compliance with all applicable laws and regulations
  • Other duties as assigned

Requirements:

  • 2+ years experience of provider data experience with a health insurance company
  • 1+ year of direct people management experience
  • 1+ years of experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
  • 1+ years of experience working with teams in multiple locations and multiple disciplines
  • Work according to the Work Location section above.

Bonus points:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Lean Six Sigma or Process Improvement certification
  • Prior healthcare and/or insurance experience
  • Advanced Google Suite or Microsoft Office capabilities
  • 2+ years experience solving complex inquiries
  • 1+ years managing projects

This is an authentic Oscar Health job opportunity.

At Oscar, being an Equal Opportunity Employer means more than upholding discrimination-free hiring practices. It means that we cultivate an environment where people can be their most authentic selves and find both belonging and support. We're on a mission to change health care -- an experience made whole by our unique backgrounds and perspectives.

Full-time employees are eligible for benefits including: medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, paid sick time, paid parental leave, 401(k) plan participation, life and disability insurance, and paid wellness time and reimbursements.

Artificial Intelligence (AI): Our AI Guidelines outline the acceptable use of artificial intelligence for candidates and detail how we use AI to support our recruiting efforts.

jobs.title: NewGen Project Manager
jobs.excerpt: At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen.
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Resource Manager, NewGen

__

Every great transformation starts with a clear plan and someone who can bring people together around it. As our NewGen Project Manager, you will be that person. You will shape how our projects are planned, delivered and adopted. You will turn ambitious ideas into measurable business outcomes, working with colleagues across functions and business areas at ABB.


Key responsibilities:


You will start by setting the direction. You will define a planning strategy that covers all the activities needed to manage the project well. You will choose the delivery approach that fits best, whether that is waterfall, agile or a hybrid. You will align with stakeholders on the scope and build a schedule that reflects it.

Next, you will define the budget, resources, timelines and work allocation together with your stakeholders. You will plan, coordinate and deliver your projects within the agreed time, scope, cost and quality. Along the way, you will prioritize tasks, keep project plans and charters up to date, and keep everyone informed of progress.


You will create the key project documents with your stakeholders. These include scope, acceptance criteria, financials, schedules and risk plans. You will guide the work through its phases and stage-gates, so resources are used efficiently and each milestone is met. You will make sure every activity follows company, program and IS procedures, as well as quality and safety standards.

Risk management will be part of your daily routine. You will identify, mitigate and monitor risks, issues and decisions, and you will spot opportunities and act on them. You will draw on your experience to anticipate contingencies and choose the best way forward. You will track progress, costs and resources, and address variances early.


You will also be the trusted contact and escalation point for your stakeholders. You will manage expectations, build strong relationships and keep projects aligned as strategies evolve. You will prepare and drive project and budget approvals, and you will define the governance structures and committees that support them. You will report on performance against plans and business outcomes, and you will keep a steady focus on realizing business value through delivery and implementation.


When a project closes, you will make sure the handover is smooth and capture lessons learned, so the next project benefits from them. Throughout, you will follow sound methodology, ABB directives and program management standards.


What you bring:


To be successful in this role, you bring more than 12 years of project management experience, ideally in transformation or change programs. You are comfortable working in cross-functional environments with many stakeholders, and you know how to keep everyone moving in the same direction.


You have a proven track record of aligning projects with program objectives and delivering measurable business outcomes. Your strengths include project planning and execution, and managing resources and budgets. You are also experienced in managing risks, issues and dependencies, and you communicate clearly with stakeholders and governance forums.


You are a natural collaborator. You build alignment across multiple projects and teams, and you help business areas adopt change.


You also hold a recognized certification. This could be PRINCE2 Practitioner, PMP, an Agile/Scrum certification (such as CSM or SAFe), or ABB Program PM Certified under the IS Function Standard for IS Project Manager Certification.


Why ABB


At ABB, you will work in a global, collaborative environment with room to grow and learn. We welcome people from all backgrounds, perspectives and experiences. If you meet most of these criteria but not every one, we still encourage you to apply. We would like to hear your story.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Health Economics Consultant
jobs.excerpt: When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.
jobs.description:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

About Parexel

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose. We move with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry-leading innovation. With Heart®

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Consultant, Health Economics and Outcomes Research (HEOR): Evidence Evaluation to join our Access Consulting. As a Senior Consultant, you will provide scientific and technical leadership across evidence evaluation projects, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of systematic and targeted literature reviews that inform regulatory, reimbursement, and publication decisions.

You will lead key aspects of project delivery, provide methodological and scientific direction, and lead client-facing technical discussions and presentations, with opportunities to shape how evidence is generated and used across the industry.

You will join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through project leadership, scientific expertise, and the adoption of approved AI and technology-enabled approaches. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Senior Consultant can guide and develop junior colleagues, contribute to business development, and expand their influence across evidence evaluation.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Guide literature reviews for regulatory activities, HTA and JCA submissions, AMCP dossiers, global value dossiers, orphan drug designation, publications, and other evidence-generation needs, including the expected outputs for each purpose
  • Lead project kick-off activities and client discussions, ensuring clear agreement on scope, methodology, deliverables, responsibilities, and timelines
  • Provide expert input on review protocols, complex search strategies, and eligibility criteria, aligned with relevant JCA and national HTA requirements
  • Guide screening, study selection, data extraction, and critical appraisal, and oversee the quality of these activities
  • Provide overall direction on evidence synthesis and reporting, ensuring key findings, evidence gaps, limitations, and conflicting evidence are clearly identified and communicated
  • Ensure all project deliverables meet client-ready quality standards, and monitor milestones, timelines, and project financial health
  • Lead day-to-day client communication, present key findings, and take ownership of technical, methodological, and deliverable queries
  • Lead, mentor, and develop junior team members through technical training, constructive feedback, and knowledge sharing
  • Contribute to business development, including project scoping, change-order requests, and competitive proposals
  • Contribute to abstracts, posters, manuscripts, and thought leadership on topics such as AI applications, JCA, and methodological refinements
  • Apply approved AI and technology-enabled workflows across all stages of systematic and targeted literature reviews, with rigorous human quality oversight
  • Maintain clear activity guidance, query logs, and decision records to support consistent application of agreed decisions across the project team

You will thrive in this role if you bring:

Strong computing skills, particularly in MS Office

High analytical ability and a strong attention to detail, with a high degree of written accuracy

Good communication skills, both oral and written, especially in relaying technical information

Self-motivation, enthusiasm, and a flexible attitude toward new assignments and new learning

The ability to manage multiple and varied tasks and prioritize workload effectively

A genuine interest in medical research, healthcare provision, and the pharmaceutical industry.

Required Qualifications:

Master's degree or equivalent in a life science or quantitative discipline, such as health economics, economics, mathematics, or statistics

5+ years of training and extensive experience in health economics, including the conceptualization and development of cost-effectiveness and budget impact models

Experience managing modeling projects and leading or coaching a project team

Fluent English, with excellent verbal and written skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience in a consultancy environment.

Experience with programming and software such as VBA, SAS, or R or R.

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.

If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be a perfect fit, send them the link to apply!
