jobs.description:
TikTok Specialist

Join the Zulay Kitchen Team!

Zulay Kitchen is a fast-growing consumer products brand creating innovative, practical, and affordable kitchen products that make everyday life easier.

We're looking for a creative, proactive, and results-driven TikTok Specialist who understands how to grow a brand's presence on TikTok, create engaging content strategies, and drive traffic and sales through the platform.

About the Role

The TikTok Specialist will help manage and grow Zulay Kitchen's TikTok presence, including content planning, TikTok Shop operations, affiliate coordination, and performance monitoring.

We're looking for someone with hands-on experience managing TikTok accounts or TikTok Shop for an e-commerce brand who understands the platform, keeps up with trends, and knows how to turn content and engagement into business results.

You don't need to know everything, but you should have a solid understanding of TikTok, be creative, data-driven, and comfortable testing new ideas to improve performance.

Key Responsibilities

TikTok Content Strategy & Management

  • Develop and execute content strategies that align with the brand's goals, products, and target audience.

  • Plan and maintain a consistent content calendar.

  • Identify trending sounds, hashtags, formats, and content opportunities relevant to the brand.

  • Coordinate with the creative team, video editors, and other departments to produce engaging TikTok content.

  • Monitor comments, messages, and audience engagement to maintain an active brand presence.

TikTok Shop Management

  • Manage day-to-day TikTok Shop operations, including product listings, pricing, inventory, and promotions.

  • Ensure product information, images, descriptions, and links are accurate and up to date.

  • Monitor shop performance, order issues, product status, and account health.

  • Troubleshoot listing, fulfillment, and other shop-related issues.

  • Stay updated on TikTok Shop policies and platform requirements.

Affiliate & Creator Management

  • Identify and connect with relevant TikTok creators and affiliates to promote Zulay Kitchen products.

  • Manage affiliate outreach, product collaborations, and sample requests.

  • Monitor affiliate performance, content submissions, and sales generated.

  • Build and maintain relationships with creators to encourage long-term partnerships.

  • Identify opportunities to expand the brand's affiliate network.

Performance Tracking & Optimization

  • Monitor TikTok account and TikTok Shop performance, including views, engagement, traffic, conversions, and sales.

  • Analyze content performance and identify what works best for the target audience.

  • Track campaign and affiliate results and recommend improvements.

  • Prepare regular performance reports and provide actionable recommendations.

  • Test different content formats, posting strategies, and promotional approaches to improve results.

Platform Updates & Growth Opportunities

  • Stay informed about TikTok trends, algorithm updates, new features, and e-commerce opportunities.

  • Research competitors and identify opportunities to improve the brand's visibility and performance.

  • Recommend new strategies to increase audience engagement, product discovery, and sales.

Qualifications

  • Previous hands-on experience managing TikTok accounts or TikTok Shop for a brand or e-commerce business is REQUIRED.

  • Familiarity with TikTok Shop Seller Center and its day-to-day operations.

  • Experience with TikTok content strategy, trend research, and social media management.

  • Understanding of TikTok affiliate marketing and creator partnerships.

  • Ability to analyze content and sales performance using platform analytics.

  • Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

  • Creative mindset with an understanding of what makes content engaging and shareable.

  • Comfortable using Google Sheets, Excel, and other digital business tools.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.

Bonus Points For:

  • Experience managing TikTok Shop for a U.S.-based e-commerce brand.

  • Experience with TikTok Shop Ads, TikTok Ads Manager, or paid social campaigns.

  • Experience recruiting and managing TikTok affiliates and influencers.

  • Familiarity with product seeding, UGC, and creator-generated content.

  • Experience working with Amazon, Shopify, or other e-commerce platforms.

  • Experience growing a TikTok account and generating measurable sales through content.

The Ideal Candidate

You're creative, resourceful, and always looking for ways to help a brand grow. You understand TikTok beyond simply posting videos—you know how to identify trends, create engaging strategies, build creator relationships, and use performance data to make better decisions.

You're also organized and take ownership of your work. You can manage multiple campaigns and priorities while staying on top of platform updates and new opportunities.

Most importantly, you bring a positive attitude, take initiative, and want to grow with a successful e-commerce company.

Why Join Zulay Kitchen?

At Zulay Kitchen, we're not just building great kitchen products. We're building a company where people take ownership, support one another, and work together to create something meaningful.

Our mission is to deliver innovative, high-quality culinary products and services that foster family values, enhance people's lives, and create joyful moments worldwide.

jobs.description:
JD Edwards Data & ERP Consultant

Particle41 is seeking a talented and versatile JD Edwards Data & ERP Consultant to join our innovative team. We are staffing a dedicated consultant for a large enterprise client that runs JD Edwards as its core ERP. The client needs someone who knows the JDE data model inside and out and can build reliable data pipelines around it. This is a working seat on the client team, not a short advisory project. You will work shoulder to shoulder with their ERP, IT, and business teams every day.

In This Role, You Will:
Own JDE data work: Extract, model, and transform data from JD Edwards tables (Address Book, Item Master, Sales Order, General Ledger, and related files).
Build data pipelines: Design and maintain ETL/ELT flows from JDE into the client's data warehouse or reporting platform.
Support ERP implementation work: Lead data mapping, conversion, cleansing, and reconciliation for implementation, upgrade, or migration efforts. Support cutover planning and execution.
Enable reporting: Build clean, trusted datasets for BI dashboards and finance and operations reporting.
Protect data quality: Set up validation and reconciliation checks between JDE and downstream systems. Find and fix root causes.
Partner with the business: Work with finance, distribution, and manufacturing users to turn their questions into data requirements.
Document as you go: Keep data flows, mappings, and conversion rules clear and current for the client team.

Skills and Experience We Value:
5+ years of hands-on JD Edwards experience (EnterpriseOne and/or World). Deep knowledge of the JDE data model and table structures is required for this role.
Strong SQL on Oracle, SQL Server, or DB2 / IBM i (AS400).
Data engineering experience: ETL/ELT development, pipeline design, and data modeling.
At least one full-cycle ERP implementation, upgrade, or migration where you owned data conversion or data migration work.
Working knowledge of core JDE modules: Financials, Distribution / Logistics, and Manufacturing.
Able to work full-time during US business hours.
Clear, confident written and spoken English. Comfortable working directly with client stakeholders.
Able to work as an independent contractor.

Nice to Have
JDE technical tools: Orchestrator, Business Services (BSSV), UBEs / Report Design Aid, Table Conversion, and Form Design Aid.
Cloud data platforms: Snowflake, Azure Data Factory, Databricks, AWS (Glue, Redshift), or dbt.

BI tools: Power BI, Tableau, or OBIEE.

Python for data processing and automation.
Industry background in manufacturing, distribution, or automotive aftermarket.
Oracle JD Edwards certification.
Prior consulting or staff augmentation experience.

What Success Looks Like
First 30 days: You understand the client's JDE footprint, key tables, and current data flows. You deliver a first pipeline or dataset fix.
First 90 days: The client team trusts your data. Reporting and conversion work runs on documented, repeatable pipelines.
Ongoing: You are the go-to person for JDE data questions on the client team.

About Particle41
Our core values of Empowering, Leadership, Innovation, Teamwork, and Excellence drive everything we do to achieve the ultimate outcomes for our clients. Empowering Leadership for Innovation in Teamwork with Excellence ( ELITE )

E - Empowering: Enabling individuals to reach their full potential.
L - Leadership: Taking initiative and guiding each other toward success.
I - Innovation: Embracing creativity and new ideas to stay ahead.
T - Teamwork: Collaborating with empathy to achieve common goals.

SaaS Revenue & Financial Analyst — Flosum

About Flosum

Flosum is a Salesforce-native platform company delivering enterprise-grade DevOps, data protection, and security solutions to some of the world's largest organizations. Our product portfolio spans Cloud DevOps, Data Migrator, Data Masking, Data Backup, Org Security, Cloud Trust Center, and Sandbox Synchronization — all built natively on the Salesforce platform. We serve enterprise customers across technology, energy, financial services, healthcare, and federal government. Flosum is a growth-stage company operating with the intensity and speed of a startup backed by the discipline of a mature operator.

The Role

We're hiring a SaaS Revenue & Financial Analyst who will own the measurement layer of our entire business. You will be the person who knows every number — ARR, net retention, expansion, churn, pipeline conversion, cost of acquisition, gross margin by product line, services margin, cash flow, and everything in between. You'll work across Salesforce (our CRM and billing system of record) and QuickBooks (our financial system) to build a unified, always-current picture of company performance.

This is not a reporting role. This is an analytical role where you connect revenue operations data to financial outcomes and surface the insights that drive decisions at the CEO level.

What You'll Own

You will build and maintain our SaaS metrics infrastructure — ARR waterfall, cohort retention analysis, revenue recognition schedules, deferred revenue tracking, and unit economics by segment. You will reconcile Salesforce bookings data against QuickBooks revenue entries and ensure we have a single source of truth across both systems. You will produce monthly and quarterly financial and revenue packages for leadership, including variance analysis against plan. You will model scenarios for pricing changes, product bundling, geographic expansion, and headcount investment. You will monitor pipeline health and translate pipeline data into revenue forecasts with documented assumptions. You will own the data integrity between our CRM and accounting systems, flagging discrepancies before they compound. You will support board-level and investor-level reporting with clean, defensible metrics.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

You have three-plus years of experience in SaaS financial analysis, revenue operations, or FP&A at a B2B software company. You are deeply proficient in Salesforce — not as a user, but as someone who understands opportunity objects, product schedules, contract structures, and reporting at a data level. You are equally proficient in QuickBooks Online, including chart of accounts design, revenue categorization, journal entries, and reconciliation workflows. You understand ASC 606 revenue recognition principles and can apply them to a multi-product SaaS business with annual and multi-year contracts. You can build financial models from scratch in Excel or Google Sheets — not from templates, from logic. You think in terms of cohorts, not just totals. You understand the difference between bookings, billings, and revenue, and you can explain why each matters. You are precise, skeptical of your own numbers, and obsessive about data integrity.

Preferred

Experience at a company with a mix of subscription revenue and professional services. Familiarity with Salesforce CPQ or native Salesforce quoting and contract objects. Exposure to investor or board reporting at a growth-stage company. Experience with Marketo or HubSpot data as it relates to CAC and attribution modeling.

Why Flosum

You'll report directly into the CEO's operating rhythm. Your work will not sit in a queue — it will shape hiring plans, product investment, and go-to-market strategy in real time. Flosum is building the definitive platform for Salesforce lifecycle management, and we need someone who can measure every dimension of that growth with precision.

The Quality & Training vertical sits at the heart of our Content & Data operation. We run a closed-loop model — audit → action → coach→ re-audit . We believe audit insights do not stop at a report; they trigger coaching, SOP fixes, and process changes whose impact we then measure. As our operation increasingly blends human judgement with our Classification Engine and human-in-the-loop (HiTL) workflows, Quality Analysts are central to keeping both the people and the models accurate.

Requirements

Primary Responsibilities and Impact Drivers: (not limited to)

Quality auditing & defect identification

  • Perform daily quality audits against the relevant SOP across classification, attribution, mapping, and related workflows, meeting defined productivity and quality targets.
  • Identify anomalies — SOP defects, process gaps, and recurring error patterns and distinguish a genuine miss from an acceptable judgement call.
  • Comprehend and apply SOPs with minimal supervision, and flag where an SOP itself is unclear, outdated, or silent on an edge case.
  • Track process SLAs and turnaround commitments, ensuring audit and review queues are closed on time and any slippage is escalated early with context.
  • Investigate and help resolve client-raised troubleshooting requests, triaging the issue, identifying whether it stems from a data, process, or model gap, and driving it to closure with the relevant team.

Root cause analysis & continuous improvement

  • Go beyond what broke to why it broke and identify preliminary root causes and explain your rationale clearly.
  • Propose practical solutions on quality and productivity, and partner with managers to drive them to closure on agreed milestones.
  • Bring a continuous-improvement mindset (RCA, basic Lean/Six Sigma thinking welcome) to reduce recurring defects over time.
  • Recommend process and system improvements from SOP and workflow changes to tooling and automation enhancements — that remove recurring defects at the source rather than re-catching them.

Calibration & standards consistency

  • Participate in and help run calibration sessions so that audit scoring stays consistent across analysts, processes, and shifts.
  • Support evaluator readiness and certification so that two analysts auditing the same work reach the same verdict.
  • Work with your data governance counterparts to turn recurring defect trends into targeted refreshers and SOP updates, so coaching translates into measurable improvement.
  • Ensure 100% compliance to data governance rules and perfect data quality standards.

Feedback & associate enablement

  • Deliver clear, specific, and respectful feedback to associates, and close the loop on every audit observation.
  • Work with your Training counterparts within the Q&T function to turn recurring defect trends into targeted refreshers and SOP updates, so coaching translates into measurable improvement.

Insights & reporting

  • Prepare key trend insights and share regular, clear quality reports with managers and stakeholders.
  • Surface emerging risks early and flag updates to the QnT Manager with enough context for a fast decision.

AI / human-in-the-loop quality

  • Audit AI-assisted and HiTL outputs as our Classification Engine footprint grows by evaluating where the model is reliable and where human review must stay.
  • Contribute structured feedback that helps improve ML model accuracy.

Role Mandate - How you will raise the bar

i) You treat the quality of the process as yours to defend. You “OWN” the space end to end, you do not wait to be asked.

ii) You identify errors early. You investigate fast and you share feedback faster. You do not stop at reporting the problem.

iii) You hit the daily audit sample targets and move the process accuracy. Activity is not your goal, Impact is.

iv) You are obsessed with Quality standards. You do not let any known error pass.

v) You strive to make the process better than you found it – for associates, for your team, for the organization and for the clients who rely on our data.

vi) You also partner closely with internal teams like Governance , ML , Data engineering and Product to give feedback to HiTL models.

What You Will Deliver

Success Measures: (first 60 days)

  • You are calibrated and audited to standard across your assigned processes.
  • Your feedback loops are closing — observations are actioned, not just logged.
  • You have surfaced at least one recurring defect trend with a proposed, evidence-led fix.
  • Managers trust your audits as an accurate picture of process health.

After 60 days : Drive floor-wide accuracy to a >98% baseline. Restructure the new-hire onboarding curriculum to reduce speed-to-proficiency ramp time by 15%, ensuring new associates hit target SLAs faster.

Qualifications and skill requirements

  • Demonstrated accuracy and attention to detail in a classification, attribution, mapping, or data-processing role.
  • Ability to comprehend and apply SOPs independently and identify gaps in them.
  • Sound judgement in distinguishing a true defect from a defensible call.
  • Clear written and verbal English communication — able to write a feedback note or a trend summary that needs no follow-up meeting.
  • A constructive feedback style and the maturity to coach peers respectfully.
  • Proficiency in using analytical methodologies such as 5 Why analysis and Pareto Analysis to understand and resolve quality issues.
  • Advanced proficiency with G-Suite, Looker studio, project-management tools (e.g., Jira), and basic AI familiarity, with the technical ability to use proprietary platforms to review, classify, and attribute ads across media channels, and to create and update complex product records within a centralized Product Catalog under strict governance standards.
  • Ability to analyse data and maintain excellent recordkeeping — reporting on accuracy, sampling, coverage, volume, and other key performance metrics — and to apply analytical methodologies such as 5-Why and Pareto analysis to resolve quality issues, including creating and maintaining SOPs, training manuals, and training plans.
  • Comfortable with mining data from dashboards, building basic ones and basic data analysis; SQL is an added advantage.

Preferred

  • Prior exposure to quality auditing, calibration, or RCA.
  • Familiarity with continuous-improvement methods (Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen).
  • Experience working with AI-assisted or human-in-the-loop workflows.
  • Experience supporting multiple processes or stakeholders concurrently.

About Spark Advisors

We're building healthcare tech for a system that desperately needs it.

Each year, millions of Americans deal with confusing changes to their Medicare plans that impact their prescriptions, access to care, and pocketbooks. These aren’t just inconveniences – they are potentially life-altering changes that leave seniors medically and financially vulnerable.

Independent Medicare advisors play a crucial role in guiding seniors through this complexity and helping them find the right coverage for their needs. But their ability to be effective healthcare advocates has long been hamstrung by broken tools and outdated systems.

Spark is fixing that. We’re the fastest-growing Medicare platform in the country, combining AI, an industry-leading CRM, and client services to transform how 10,000+ brokers acquire, enroll, and support clients in their local communities.

Join a talent-dense team from Square, Ramp, Yext, Oscar, and Cedar — backed by Primary Ventures and Viewpoint Ventures — that is serious about building technology to expand access to quality healthcare. We offer remote work, sabbaticals, company retreats, and other generous benefits that earned us recognition as one of Inc. Magazine’s Best Workplaces of 2025

Healthcare is overdue for innovation. Let’s redefine what its future looks like — together.

Summary

Spark Advisors is building the technology backbone for a modern Medicare distribution platform — supporting thousands of independent agents with compliant, AI-augmented tools. We're looking for a hands-on leader to own Technical Operations: the intersection of IT, security, DevOps, and infrastructure that keeps our AWS-native platform reliable, compliant, and secure as we scale.

This is a foundational hire. You'll be the first dedicated owner of this domain, building out policy, tooling, and a team as appropriate, while working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering leadership on a live, regulated production environment. You'll report directly to our SVP, Engineering and have significant influence over how the function is structured and staffed.

AI is core to how we operate, not a side initiative. We expect this function to run lean by design — using AI agents and tooling to extend what a small team can own, from infrastructure and security operations to how the broader org works day to day. You'll be expected to bring a point of view on where AI genuinely replaces manual toil versus where it adds risk, and to build the function with that judgment baked in from day one.

What You'll Do

DevOps & Infrastructure

  • Manage on-call rotations and runbooks; be a calm, decisive presence during incidents

Information Security & Compliance

  • Own the security posture of a HIPAA- and CMS-regulated platform: policies, controls, risk assessments, and audit readiness
  • Lead SOC 2 / HIPAA compliance programs, vendor security reviews, and incident response
  • Partner with engineering on secure-by-default practices (secrets management, least-privilege IAM, PHI handling, encryption at rest/in transit)
  • Own security awareness training and access governance across the company

IT Operations

  • Manage corporate IT: employee onboarding/offboarding, endpoint management, SSO/identity (Okta or similar), device security, and helpdesk support
  • Own vendor and SaaS management, including procurement, licensing, and access reviews
  • Build scalable, self-serve IT processes appropriate for our headcount

Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Build and lead a small, high-leverage team as the function grows — hire well, and know when not to hire, favoring automation and good tooling over headcount
  • Partner closely with the VP of Engineering, Data Engineering, and Product on shared infrastructure needs
  • Represent technical operations to the board, auditors, and enterprise customers/partners when needed
  • Set and report on operational KPIs; uptime, deployment frequency, MTTR, security findings closure rate

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years in a technical operations, DevOps, infrastructure, or security leadership role, ideally with 2+ years managing people or leading cross-functional initiatives
  • Deep hands-on experience with AWS; IAM, networking, serverless, and container services
  • Direct experience with security compliance frameworks (SOC 2, HIPAA, ISO 27001) — you've been through an audit, not just read about one
  • Strong infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD chops
  • Experience operating in a regulated or high-stakes environment such as healthcare, fintech, insurance is a strong plus
  • A builder's mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, allergic to unnecessary process, and biased toward reversible, incremental decisions
  • Excellent judgment under pressure — you're often the person who is calm when something breaks in production
  • Clear communicator who can translate technical risk into business terms for non-technical stakeholders

Compensation

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our company’s size and industry, and are one part of the total compensation package that also includes equity, benefits, and other opportunities at Spark. In accordance with New York City, Colorado, California, and other applicable laws, Spark is required to provide a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. Individual pay decisions are ultimately based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, geography, and balancing internal equity. Base Salary
$170,000—$215,000 USD

Why you should join our team

By joining Spark, you will get in on the ground floor of a fast-moving, well-funded, and mission-driven startup where you will have a profound impact on the brokers and beneficiaries we serve. And you'll learn, grow, be challenged, and have fun with your team while doing it.

We strive to help you and your family thrive. We're committed to supporting your happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing a comprehensive benefits program. In addition to your base salary, we also offer:

Compliance

Furthermore, for security and compliance requirements, we’re unable to accommodate international remote work. While we fully support travel and time off, all work must be conducted from an approved location within the U.S.

The Litigation Team works on behalf of dozens of local governments in significant cases that affect the rights and welfare of millions of people across the country, with billions of dollars at stake.

JOB SUMMARY

Public Rights Project seeks to hire an experienced litigator to serve as a Senior Staff Attorney on its Litigation Team. The Senior Staff Attorney will be a key member of PRP’s Litigation Team, advancing the work of local governments protecting civil rights in the face of attacks by the federal government, as well as state governments and private actors. The Senior Staff Attorney will lead cases and case teams in litigation, lead case development and strategy discussions, conduct and oversee research, lead internal and external meetings, and manage various litigation and pre-litigation activities. The Litigation Team is expected to handle matters in which government clients are both plaintiffs and defendants and in both state and federal courts.

This position reports to the Litigation Director. This position will also work closely with other Litigation Team staff, the Director of PRP’s Civil Rights Hub, the Director of PRP’s Election Protection Hub, and other Program Team staff.

The application window for this position will close on Friday, Nov 20, 2026, at 5:00pm ET.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Identify opportunities for advocacy and strategize pathways to action;
  • Independently build and run litigation from idea generation through conclusion, including legal and factual development, case pitching, motions practice, discovery, oral argument, client management, coalition engagement, and more;
  • Conduct legal research and provide guidance and analysis of laws across a range of jurisdictions;
  • Draft, review, edit, and provide feedback on analytic and persuasive written work product;
  • Effectively advise government clients, including legal, political, and justice considerations of each particular circumstance;
  • Participate in and sometimes lead regular meetings for the Litigation Team and other crucial strategic meetings and discussions, including ensuring alignment, collaboration and clear next steps;
  • Meet with government and non-government stakeholders;
  • Synthesize input and feedback from internal and external stakeholders; and
  • Contribute to an innovative, inclusive, and supportive group of advocates.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Licensed to practice law and in good standing in a jurisdiction of the United States.
  • At least 10 years of relevant experience in litigation. Relevant experience may include complex civil litigation and/or government enforcement.
  • Prior experience with remote work in large teams in support of fast-moving and mission-driven litigation is preferred.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

  • Outstanding writing and editing skills, including drafting and editing complex briefs and legal analysis.
  • Excellent judgment about both legal issues and strategy;
  • Strong communication skills, both writing and speaking;
  • Demonstrated ability to handle all aspects of litigation including client management, discovery, oral advocacy, brief writing, deadline management, electronic filing, navigating local rules, working with cooperating counsel, and expecting the unexpected;
  • Strong project management skills and ability to use electronic tools to coordinate with other team members;
  • Familiarity and comfort working on issues of federal law, constitutional law, civil rights law, and other relevant legal topics;
  • Team player who can work with government partners, co-counsel, community-based organizations, and other advocates, as well as internal teams;
  • Demonstrated positive and respectful attitude, ability to work well with diverse people and communities, capacity to show presence, self-confidence, common sense, and good listening ability; and
  • Belief in the power of local government to make positive change in the world.

ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIP

This position reports to the Litigation Director. This position will also work closely with members of the Litigation Team and other Program Team staff.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

Requires sitting, talking, and listening for up to 8 hours per day. Certain situations may require lifting items up to 20 pounds.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

Fully remote organization and team. This role requires travel several times a year to PRP events, case hearings, conferences or meetings.

COMPENSATION

The determined salary range for this Level 4 role is set at $121,440 - $182,160, and exact salary will be based on candidate experience. For internal equity purposes, PRP will not negotiate with candidates outside of the role’s designated range.

PRP offers a comprehensive benefits package which includes medical, dental, and vision coverage; fertility care; online mental health therapy membership; and HSA and FSA options. Additional benefits include professional development and home office stipends, monthly phone and internet reimbursements, and “Flex Fridays.”

PRP HIRING COMMITMENT

PRP is committed to the principles and practices of equal employment opportunity. A diverse and inclusive workplace, both at PRP and within the government offices we serve, is a key ingredient for achieving our mission of building equitable enforcement capacity within state and local government.

We aim to assemble a team that reflects the world we live in and the communities we serve with respect to race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, and immigration status. People with personal or family experience with the type of harms we seek to combat, including wage theft, predatory lending, fraud, discrimination, and environmental degradation are particularly encouraged to apply.

jobs.description:
DATA & AI ARCHITECT

This is a fully remote position

PURPOSE:

The Data & AI Architect is Ascend Technologies’ technical owner of its enterprise data and AI platform. This person sets the roadmap and designs, builds, secures, and operates the data infrastructure supporting reporting, automation, and AI applications. They keep data trusted, protected, and ready to scale, working hands-on across the database, pipelines, and AI integrations, and they chair the Data Governance Committee. Over time, the role grows into the architectural authority for how Ascend uses data and AI: a partner to every team that builds on the platform.

THE ENVIRONMENT:

Ascend uses a modern, cloud-based data and analytics environment incorporating technologies such as PostgreSQL, Azure, and Python to support business intelligence, data integration, automation, and AI-enabled solutions. The environment emphasizes security, governance, and scalability. You will work alongside our Data Analytics and Reporting Lead and our engineering partners, and you will be the technical lead for what gets built.

Tools you’ll use: PostgreSQL, dbt, Prefect, Azure, Python, GitHub / GitHub Actions, Power BI, Claude / Claude Code, MCP, n8n, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Sage Intacct, Paylocity.


RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Own the platform roadmap and architecture, setting priorities and directing work across staff and engineering partners.
  • Design and maintain dbt models, the semantic layer, and data quality tests that keep reported numbers trusted.
  • Administer PostgreSQL, including performance, backup and recovery, and monitoring, and run automated, repeatable pipeline deployments (Prefect, GitHub Actions) with no dependence on any one person’s machine or credentials.
  • Manage security and access: implement appropriate access controls, data protection measures, encryption, and credential management practices.
  • Chair the Data Governance Committee, working with system owners and data stewards to keep definitions, standards, and data quality current.
  • Design and operate secure AI integrations, and guide the build of AI-native applications and automations from prototype to production.
  • Other responsibilities as assigned by management

MINIMUM SKILLS, EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:
  • Experience: At least 5+ years in data engineering, database administration, data architecture, or a similar role.
  • PostgreSQL & SQL: Strong SQL and hands-on database administration, including performance tuning, backup, and recovery.
  • Modern Data Stack: Experience with dbt (or equivalent transformation tools) and orchestration tools such as Prefect or Airflow.
  • Cloud: Working knowledge of Azure or a similar cloud, including networking and identity.
  • Python: Able to build and maintain pipelines and automation in Python.
  • CI/CD: Experience building automated deployment pipelines (GitHub Actions or equivalent).
  • AI Tooling: Hands-on experience building with AI and LLM tools, such as AI coding assistants or LLM integrations.
  • Security: Practical experience with role-based access, encryption, and credential management.
  • Communication: Able to lead cross-functional groups and explain technical decisions to non-technical audiences.

PREFERRED SKILLS OR EXPERIENCE :
  • Claude Code & MCP: Experience with Claude Code or Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.
  • Containers: Experience with containerized deployments.
  • Source Systems: Familiarity with Salesforce, ServiceNow, Paylocity, or Sage Intacct data models.
  • Governance & MSP: Experience leading data governance; background in managed services or IT services.

Starting Compensation Range: $140,000 per year

The salary for this position is commensurate with experience, skills, and qualifications. The range is intended to reflect our commitment to attracting top talent, and the final offer will be based on factors including, but not limited to, the candidate's previous experience, expertise in the field, relevant certifications, and the specific requirements of the role. In addition, internal equity, market trends, and geographic location may also influence the final salary.

At Ascend Technologies we firmly believe that diversity, equity, and inclusion are not only fundamental values but also powerful drivers of innovation, growth, and success. We are committed to fostering an environment where every individual feels valued, respected, and empowered.

CORE VALUES

We are seeking highly motivated individuals who have the willingness and ability to demonstrate Ascend core values:
  • Committed to Client Success: Our actions and our words always align with the best interest of the client.
  • One Team: We work collaboratively to overcome challenges with humility and respect and do what it takes to find innovative solutions.
  • Integrity: We are unquestionably committed to doing the right thing even when it is hard.
  • Accountability: We hold ourselves and each other accountable for keeping our commitments to our clients, our communities, and one another.
  • Transparency: We create open lines of communication with each other and our clients, fostering relationships founded on candor and trust.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

Must be able to sit, stand, and bend for the duration of shift. The position is mainly sitting, with occasional lifting up to 50 lbs, such as laptop, server equipment, and, driving to the work site to meet with client(s).

jobs.description:
At Woolpert, you’ll do work that matters.

As a leading global architecture, engineering, and geospatial firm, we help clients solve complex challenges that shape communities, strengthen critical infrastructure, advance technology, and improve the world around us. Here, you’ll collaborate across disciplines, tackle meaningful projects, and build a career defined by growth, opportunity, and impact.

Position Overview

Woolpert is hiring a CAD Technician to join our dynamic Survey & Geomatics team. The Survey CAD Technician will work collectively with the Survey Team Leader, Phase Manager, and cross-functional internal departments. This individual will create, collect, analyze and validate enterprise asset data and associated land data within the CAD, enterprise geographic information system (GIS), or other asset information storage databases. Our Survey CAD Technician is responsible for reduction of field data, land record research, preparation of boundary surveys, and topographic maps to meet internal and external customer requirements. Our Survey CAD Technician will have a proven ability to work with and directly interact with cross-functional internal contacts to execute the required work, interact with the client staff in a professional and proactive manner to resolve issues, track progress, perform QA work associated with the requirements, make necessary corrections, and continually manage schedule and ensure quality.

We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position. Applicants must already possess work authorization in the country the job is located.

What You Will Do:

  • Process daily field data in Trimble Business Center, including but not limited to GPS Static files, RTK Conventional files, and Conventional Total Station files.
  • Convert data between standard spatial data formats including but not limited to AutoCAD, Esri geodatabase feature classes, and ESRI shapefiles.
  • Prepares highway right-of-way map deliverables.
  • Prepares ALTA boundary survey plat deliverables.
  • Prepares topographical surfaces from field data and corresponding map deliverables.
  • Prepares subdivision plats as needed, including replats.
  • Research and interpret government files, utilities, and public record documentation.
  • Produce accurate and legible maps, survey reports and legal descriptions, or displays for various departments.
  • Verify map feature and attribute accuracies.
  • Identify and recommend process improvements and enhancements on existing projects.

What You Will Bring:

  • Demonstrated knowledge of AutoCAD, Civil 3D, and Trimble Business Center
  • Able to review, process and close traverse data, control networks
  • Experience using MicroStation with GeoPak and/or OpenRoads
  • GIS related experience a plus
  • Licensed Surveyor in Training (L.S.I.T) Certificate is a plus
  • Knowledge of reading highway plans, plats and deeds
  • Able to graphically present information clearly and concisely
  • Demonstrated ability to organize and manage multiple priorities
  • Ability to provide excellent customer service
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in a dynamic environment
  • Strong organizational, time management, attention to detail and analytical skills
  • Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment; offer constructive feedback and direction to support goal

Benefits You Will Love

Certified as a Great Place to Work, Woolpert is one of the fastest-growing architecture, engineering, and geospatial companies in the world. With over 75 offices and countless projects around the globe, you’ll work on meaningful assignments that improve quality of life around the world. In addition to offering competitive pay, we provide employees with a robust set of unique benefits, including:

  • Freedom to Work program: Set your own schedule and location (as appropriate).
  • Principal program: Earn the opportunity to become an owner of the firm.
  • Flexible paid time off/vacation: Take time off when it makes sense for you and your team.
  • Career development: Explore a wide range of learning and growth opportunities within and across industries.
  • Health, life, vision, and dental insurance: Cover all your medical bases.
  • Paid sick time, retirement plan, fitness reimbursement, pet insurance, identity protection, technology stipend, employee assistance program, and more!

Base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Pay Range
$24.56—$36.87 USD

We recruit, train, compensate, and promote regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law. jobs.excerpt: DescriptionCompany Profile The Solar Energy Industries Association (SEIA) is the national trade association for the solar and storage industry and represents more than 1,000 member companies and an industry workforce of more than 255,000 across the United States.
jobs.description:
Description

Company Profile

The Solar Energy Industries Association (SEIA) is the national trade association for the solar and storage industry and represents more than 1,000 member companies and an industry workforce of more than 255,000 across the United States. SEIA is leading the transformation to a clean energy economy and is creating the framework for solar to reach 30% of U.S. electricity generation by 2030. We work with our member companies and strategic partners to advocate for policies that create jobs and shape fair market rules that promote competition and the growth of reliable, low-cost solar power.

SEIA does this by supporting pro-solar policies at the state and federal level, developing cutting-edge market research, hosting educational events and webinars, and serving as the voice of the solar and storage industry.

SEIA employees are passionate, forward-thinking leaders who start every day knowing that their work makes a difference. SEIA fosters an inclusive, lively company culture that values our employees’ varied backgrounds and experiences and celebrates team success. The Association has earned numerous awards for its work and company culture and was named The Washington Post as a Top Workplace in 2023 and 2024 and by the Nonprofit Times as one of the “Best Nonprofits to Work For” in America in April 2022

Position Summary

The Sr. Manager, Midwest Regional is responsible for the development and implementation of SEIA’s policies and positions in the dynamic and growing solar markets in the Midwest. The position reports to the Vice President of State Affairs and will work in close collaboration with other SEIA departments, including Research, Communications, and Membership.

The ideal candidate should have the desire and demeanor to build a strong network within the solar and clean energy industries and will have had professional exposure to energy policy and/or markets, and be familiar with topics such as storage, demand response, virtual power plants, distribution management systems, and interconnection policies. The successful candidate must be able to build relationships and be a natural collaborator. They should be able to manage project teams effectively and facilitate dialogue with both internal and external colleagues.

Core Duties and Responsibilities

Candidates will have experience with the regulatory and legislative processes in the region, in the traditional or renewable energy sector.

  • Oversees regulatory & legislative activity in SEIA priority states in the Midwest US, with a particular focus on Illinois, Michigan, and Minnesota.
  • Manages the SEIA Midwest Region Committee and day-to-day activities in collaboration with company leads. This includes facilitating regular calls/meetings with SEIA members.
  • Participates in legislative/lobbying initiatives.
  • Works with outside counsel, contract lobbyists, and technical consultants as needed.
  • Collaborates with other associations, SEIA state affiliates, other stakeholders and parties, consultants, etc.
  • Participates as available/necessary in other states and overall SEIA activities as time permits.

Requirements

Professional Experience, Education, and Other Qualifications

  • A bachelor’s degree is required.
  • Minimum 4 – 8 years’ experience with clean energy research, energy policy, utility program/policy development, or related fields
  • Regulatory experience in Illinois, Michigan, or Minnesota is preferred, and legislative experience is a plus.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Ability to manage challenging and diverse views of members.
  • Self-starter – can work independently and remotely.
  • Ability to work effectively as part of a team and is able to perceive when to lead and when to build consensus.

Working Conditions

  • Work is in an office environment or a remote-office environment suitably equipped with internet and telephone access.
  • The successful candidate will preferably be located in the greater Chicago area. Consideration will be given to candidates based in Springfield, IL, or Lansing, MI.
  • Travel will be necessary, primarily in-region, but additionally to Washington, DC, for SEIA meetings and events.

﻿Compensation Range

  • $85,000-$115,000 annually, based on experience, plus an excellent benefits package.

Working at SEIA

SEIA welcomes different perspectives, identities, and backgrounds, working collaboratively in support of our mission, regardless of job function. We believe this creates a more resilient organization that supports a strong, equitable solar industry. SEIA envisions an industry that is committed to fostering a culture of inclusivity and respect for all.

SEIA provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, homelessness, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. SEIA complies with applicable federal, state, and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which we employ staff. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Standard Job Description

Coordinates planning, organization, control, integration and completion of engineering projects within area of assigned responsibility. Plans and formulates engineering program; reviews product design for compliance with engineering principles, company standards, customer contract requirements, and related specifications. Evaluates and approves design changes, specification and drawing releases. Coordinates activities concerned with technical developments, scheduling, and resolving engineering design and test problems.

The Project Engineer, Engineering Metrics will partner with the Engineering Metrics Lead to manage and continuously improve the full lifecycle of Engineering Standards Metrics (ESM) and EPRS technical, production, and engineering standards reporting. The role coordinates across engineering disciplines, Enterprise Engineering Functional Excellence organizations, program teams, and other stakeholders to establish consistent processes, support accurate and timely reporting, and advance automated data collection and metric-generation capabilities.

Key responsibilities include supporting new metric development, maintaining reporting tools and documentation, tracking EPRS-reportable programs, and coordinating Monthly Metric Review Board activities. The Project Engineer will analyze trends and data-quality issues, help develop corrective actions, build cross-functional alignment, and prepare updates and recommendations for senior leadership. Basic Qualifications

  • Advanced analytical skills, including the ability to interpret complex data, identify trends, and communicate actionable insights.

  • Strong project management and stakeholder coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliverables.

jobs.description:
Our Mission

Our mission is to SAVE AND IMPROVE LIVES BY EMPOWERING HEALTHCARE CONSUMERS. Come be part of remarkable.

Overview

Program Manager, Identity & Access Management (IAM)

How you can make a difference

We are looking for a Program Manager to bring structure, visibility, and momentum to our Identity & Access Management (IAM) program. In this role, you will connect the work across the IAM organization—partnering with IAM leadership, the IAM Architecture and Engineering, Hygiene, and Application Onboarding teams to build and maintain the program roadmap, run disciplined intake, backlog, and sprint processes, and measure what matters through clear OKRs and metrics. You will also partner closely with IT teams across the organization to understand their identity and access needs, translate those needs into IAM requests and roadmap priorities, and make sure every identity and access requirement is captured, prioritized, and delivered.

In addition, you will work with the IAM teams to explore where AI can support the IAM program and use AI tools where they help with planning and reporting.

What you'll be doing

  • Connect the dots between all functions within the IAM organization and what's happening outside of IAM:
    • Meet regularly with IAM leaders to keep forward momentum across each IAM pillar, aligning on priorities and clearing any roadblocks that could slow progress.
    • Coordinate with IT, Security, and Engineering leaders on upcoming and in-flight projects to identify IAM dependencies and support needs early. Use these inputs to inform the IAM roadmap and sprint planning.
    • Lead IAM-focused requirements gathering with IT teams to identify identity and access needs that IAM can fulfill, translating them into clearly scoped requests for the appropriate IAM team.
  • Roadmap creation & maintenance:
    • Facilitate the creation and ongoing maintenance of the IAM program roadmap in collaboration with IAM leadership, IAM architects, and other key IAM team members, adjusting it as priorities shift.
    • Collaborate with the IAM architect and engineering team to identify emerging IAM trends and technologies that should be incorporated into the roadmap.
    • Work with the IAM architect and engineering team to identify and build AI capabilities that augment the IAM program.
  • Intake management:
    • Participate in each IAM team's intake process, helping prioritize and scope incoming project-based requests.
  • Backlog management:
    • Manage and groom the Azure DevOps backlogs for the IAM teams (namely Engineering, Hygiene, and App Onboarding).
    • Prioritize each team's backlog, focusing on items that will have the greatest impact or are required to execute the IAM roadmap.
  • Sprint planning:
    • Facilitate sprint planning for the IAM teams, pulling prioritized items into each sprint based on their sizing and the team's capacity.
  • Capacity & resource planning:
    • Build on existing capacity planning practices by providing clear visibility into capacity and utilization across the IAM teams, helping keep work balanced and aligned to priorities.
    • Partner with IAM leadership to strengthen resource planning, aligning team capacity with the roadmap and incoming demand so the program can continue to scale effectively.
  • OKRs & metrics:
    • In collaboration with IAM leadership, define measurable metrics to track the health, compliance, and progress of IAM operations and roadmap execution.
    • Gather updated metrics on a regular cadence to give IAM leadership a clear view of program performance and roadmap progress.
  • Reporting, dashboards & data analysis:
    • Create and maintain IAM reporting dashboards that give leadership and stakeholders a clear, current view of program health, operations, and roadmap progress.
    • Automate data collection and dashboard refreshes to reduce manual reporting effort.
    • Analyze IAM data (e.g., access requests, certifications, onboarding, and hygiene metrics) to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities, using AI and automation where applicable.

What you will need to be successful

  • 5+ years of program or project management experience, including at least 3 years supporting an Identity & Access Management, Identity Governance, or Information Security program.
  • Working knowledge of core IAM concepts and capabilities—identity lifecycle (joiner/mover/leaver), access requests and certifications, role-based access, SSO/federation, MFA, privileged access, and application onboarding.
  • Hands-on experience with IAM platforms such as SailPoint ISC, Microsoft Entra ID, or BeyondTrust.
  • Technical fluency in IAM technologies, including how the platforms integrate, where dependencies sit, and what a given change involves, so you can partner credibly with architects and engineers.
  • Proven ability to build and maintain a multi-team program roadmap and adjust it as priorities shift.
  • Ability to judge the time, effort, resources, and cost required for IAM initiatives to succeed (for example, application onboarding, platform changes, and hygiene or certification campaigns), and to turn that judgment into realistic estimates, timelines, and budget and staffing inputs.
  • Experience running Agile practices—intake, backlog grooming, prioritization, and sprint planning—preferably in Azure DevOps.
  • Comfort using AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot / Claude) in day-to-day work, such as drafting status updates or summarizing information.
  • Ability to define, collect, and communicate OKRs and operational metrics that give leadership a clear view of program health, compliance, and progress.
  • Strong relationship-building and communication skills, with a track record of partnering across IT, Security, and Engineering and influencing without direct authority.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to AI or automation initiatives within an IAM or security program.
  • Familiarity with compliance and audit frameworks relevant to access management, such as SOX, HIPAA, PCI DSS, or SOC 2.
  • Certifications such as PMP, PMI-ACP, Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), SAFe, CISSP, or an IAM vendor certification.
  • Experience in healthcare, financial services, or another highly regulated industry.
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

This is a remote position.

Salary Range

$104500.00 To $136000.00 / year

Benefits & Perks

The actual compensation offer is determined based on job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, and work location. This position will be eligible for performance-based incentives as part of the total compensation package, in addition to a full range of benefits including:

  • Medical, dental, and vision
  • HSA contribution and match
  • Dependent care FSA match
  • Uncapped paid time off
  • Paid parental leave
  • 401(k) match
  • Personal and healthcare financial literacy programs
  • Ongoing education & tuition assistance
  • Gym and fitness reimbursement
  • Wellness program incentives

Onboarding & Travel

This is a remote role, with an in-person onboarding training component. New team members must participate in Trailhead, HealthEquity’s immersive onboarding experience Trailhead is designed to foster meaningful connections, support your integration into the organization, and equip you with a strong understanding of our business. Trailhead participation is a key expectation of this role. Trailhead is held onsite at our headquarters once per quarter. HealthEquity covers all required travel and accommodations.

LocationThis role is fully remote in US East or West, with travel as needed.

Who We Are
Become part of the team behind Attribute™. Following our recent acquisition, we're bringing together visionary engineers and go-to-market leaders to disrupt cloud management with real-time, tagless cost visibility across cloud and AI workloads. You'll join a founding GTM movement inside an established market leader trusted by over 4,500 global customers.

DoiT empowers cloud-native organizations to scale faster and innovate with confidence. By combining our Cloud Intelligence technology with Forward Deployed Engineers and deep specialization across AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure, we help tech-forward companies navigate their toughest infrastructure and cost governance challenges end to end.

The Opportunity
As an Account Executive for Attribute™, you will be at the forefront of building a brand-new region from scratch and introducing a groundbreaking solution to a fundamental business problem in modern FinOps. Traditional cloud cost allocation methods rely heavily on static tagging—an approach that becomes obsolete in modern, shared cloud and AI infrastructure. When multi-tenant clusters, shared GPUs, microservices, and dynamic AI workloads dominate, organizations face severe blind spots: they cannot accurately determine the true cost-to-serve for specific applications, autonomous agents, or business teams, making it impossible to calculate true gross margins at a granular customer level.

Attribute™ solves this by taking a completely different approach. Leveraging runtime eBPF technology, Attribute™ captures real-time network traffic signals and kernel-level observability without requiring engineering teams to manually tag or instrument code. By analyzing actual runtime consumption across CPU, GPU, memory, network, and AI model API requests, it provides accurate total cost of ownership (TCO) and unit economics based on real usage. Organizations finally get precise cost governance and gross margin visibility across complex cloud and AI environments with zero developer overhead.

As an Account Executive building this region from scratch, you will establish a high-potential greenfield territory. You will drive sales end-to-end with a heavy emphasis on net-new logo acquisition, defining the regional go-to-market strategy and creating the foundational customer success stories that define this category.

You will own full-cycle deal execution across Startup, Digital Native, and Enterprise segments—prospecting new accounts, running compelling solution pitches, navigating complex technical evaluations alongside engineering partners, and closing strategic partnerships end to end.

You'll have the rest of the Cloud Intelligence portfolio behind you: 4,500 customers, AWS/Google Cloud/Azure partnerships, and Forward Deployed Engineers who solve problems other vendors walk away from. But the product you'll carry every day is Attribute™, and the market is only just learning it exists. That's the opportunity.

jobs.description:
Field Sales Representative

Location: Guildford, covering Guildford and surrounding areas (fully field-based)

£50,000–£90,000 OTE (£30,000–£54,000 base salary + uncapped commission, based on experience) + £800 monthly car allowance and a comprehensive benefits package

Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services have made life harder for them, with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that. We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe, bringing together payments, business accounts and other business tools with simple technology and real human support. From card payments and business accounts to financing solutions, we help our Members spend less time worrying about their finances and more time doing what they love.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you’re ambitious, enjoy meeting new people and want to make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you.

Your Mission

We’re looking for ambitious, driven people to join our growing Field Sales team and help bring Teya to more local businesses across the UK.

As a Field Sales Representative, you’ll take ownership of your own territory, getting out into your local community, meeting business owners face-to-face and showing them how Teya can help their businesses thrive.

This is a role for someone who enjoys being out in the field, building relationships and winning new business. You’ll have the freedom to manage your territory, the support of a team that wants you to succeed, and the opportunity to build a rewarding career in sales.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own your territory: Proactively identify and engage local businesses through face-to-face prospecting, networking, referrals and other opportunities to generate new business.

  • Build meaningful relationships: Get to know business owners, understand their challenges and identify how Teya’s products and services can make their lives easier.

  • Win new Members: Use a consultative, value-led approach to demonstrate Teya’s solutions, build trust and turn conversations into long-term customer relationships.

  • Deliver results: Take ownership of your sales performance, maintain a healthy pipeline and consistently work towards your commercial targets.

  • See things through: Take responsibility for your Members’ experience from the first conversation through to onboarding, ensuring they’re set up successfully and ready to start using Teya.

  • Keep learning: Develop strong knowledge of our products, competitors and sales methodology through structured training, coaching and feedback.

  • Represent Teya: Be a trusted face of Teya in your local community, delivering the genuine care and hospitality that we want every Member to experience.

  • Help us improve: Share insights from the field to help us continuously improve our products, sales approach and Member experience.

Your Story

We believe great salespeople come from all kinds of backgrounds.

You might already be an experienced field sales professional with a strong track record of winning new business. Or you might be earlier in your career, with the ambition, drive and potential to become an exceptional salesperson.

What matters most to us is your mindset, your ability to connect with people and your willingness to learn and improve.

We’re looking for people who bring:

  • Ambition and drive: You’re motivated to succeed, enjoy working towards challenging goals and take pride in delivering great results.

  • A competitive mindset: You enjoy winning, hold yourself to high standards and are always looking for ways to improve.

  • Resilience and determination: You’re comfortable with rejection, stay positive when things get tough and don’t give up easily.

  • Strong people skills: You enjoy meeting new people, build rapport naturally and can have meaningful conversations with business owners from all walks of life.

  • Curiosity and commercial awareness: You ask good questions, listen carefully and want to understand what makes a business successful.

  • Coachability: You’re open to feedback, willing to challenge yourself and committed to developing your skills.

  • Ownership and self-discipline: You’re organised, proactive and comfortable managing your own time and priorities in a field-based role.

  • A genuine care for others: You understand that great sales isn’t just about closing a deal. It’s about doing what’s right for the customer and building trust that lasts.

Experience in field sales, business development, payments or financial services is an advantage, but not essential for every level. We care just as much about your potential as your experience.

You’ll also need:

  • Fluency in English.

  • A full UK driving licence and access to a car.

  • The right to work in the UK.

  • Willingness to work in a fully field-based role, travelling regularly throughout your territory.

The Perks

We believe great performance should be recognised and rewarded. Alongside the opportunity to build your career in a growing European fintech, you’ll receive:

  • £30,000–£54,000 base salary, depending on your experience and demonstrated capability.

  • Uncapped commission.

  • £800 per month car allowance (£9,600 annually), on top of your salary and commission.

  • 25 days of paid annual leave, plus UK bank holidays.

  • Bupa private healthcare and life insurance.

  • Employer pension contributions through our company pension scheme.

  • Free gym membership through Wellhub, alongside one-to-one therapy sessions, meditation and digital fitness and nutrition apps.

  • Structured onboarding, practical sales training, ongoing coaching and opportunities to grow your career at Teya.

What Happens Next?

Our recruitment process is designed to help us get to know you, understand your strengths and give you a genuine opportunity to show us what you can do.

Stage 1 - Introductory conversation (30 minutes)
A conversation with our Talent team to learn more about you, your motivation and what you’re looking for in your next role.

Stage 2 - Hiring Manager Interview (60 minutes)
An opportunity to explore your experience, how you approach challenges and what makes you successful.

Stage 3 - Final Assessment (60 minutes)
You’ll meet members of our Sales leadership team, present a short territory plan and take part in a practical sales role-play. We’ll share everything you need to prepare in advance.

We know interviews are a two-way process, and we’ll make sure you have plenty of opportunities to ask questions and get to know us along the way.

Teya is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, including those without a traditional sales or commercial track record.

Teya is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work. We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, stronger outcomes, and a more supportive workplace for all.

If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process whether for interviews, assessments, or other parts of the application—we encourage you to let us know. We are committed to ensuring that every candidate has a fair and accessible experience with us.

If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

The SOC Analyst is responsible for the continuous monitoring, triage, and investigation of security events across the organization's environment, as part of a global follow-the-sun Security Operations Center. This position reports to the SOC Lead. The role goes beyond acknowledging alerts: the focus is on understanding what each alert means, investigating suspicious activity end to end, responding to real threats, and handing over cleanly between regions so that nothing is lost across shifts. The ideal candidate has solid SOC experience, a strong investigative mindset, and thrives in a fast-paced, fully remote setting where accuracy, discipline, and security are essential. Hands-on engineering experience with core security platforms is a big plus.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor, triage, and analyze security alerts and events from the organization's security stack, including SIEM, Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Security Service Edge (SSE), and Web Application Firewall (WAF) platforms.

  • Investigate security incidents end to end, from initial triage through analysis, containment, eradication, and post-incident documentation, coordinating with relevant teams throughout.

  • Determine the scope, severity, and impact of security events, separating true positives from false positives and escalating confirmed incidents according to defined procedures.

  • Execute response actions within the security platforms, such as isolating endpoints, blocking indicators, disabling compromised accounts, and enforcing access restrictions.

  • Ensure structured, high-quality shift handovers across regions in the follow-the-sun model, so that open investigations, ongoing incidents, and pending actions continue seamlessly around the clock.

  • Proactively threat hunt across endpoint, network, and log data to uncover suspicious activity that existing detections may have missed, mapping findings to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.

  • Provide feedback on detection quality and contribute to the tuning of SIEM correlation rules, EDR custom detections, and WAF rules to reduce noise and improve coverage.

  • Enrich investigations with threat intelligence, including indicators of compromise, attacker techniques, and emerging campaigns relevant to the organization.

  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and incident response playbooks.

  • Collaborate with IT, infrastructure, application, and security engineering teams to resolve incidents and support day-to-day operations.

  • Support vulnerability management and drive continuous improvement of the organization's overall security posture.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience as a SOC Analyst, triaging alerts and investigating security incidents in a production environment.

  • Solid working knowledge of core security technologies such as EDR, SSE, SIEM, and WAF, and of how to use them to investigate and respond to threats.

  • Hands-on experience implementing, configuring, and tuning these platforms, or writing and tuning detection content, is a big plus.

  • Experience with incident response and threat hunting, ideally with familiarity with the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

  • Excellent understanding of network security, endpoint security, cloud security, and Zero Trust principles.

  • Relevant certifications such as Security+, CySA+, GCIA, GCIH, BTL1, or vendor-specific credentials are a plus.

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with a high attention to detail.

  • Ability to handle sensitive information responsibly and securely.

  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English, and the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams and across time zones.

About You

You are a hands-on security analyst who wants to understand what is really happening behind an alert, rather than only closing tickets. You dig into the data, follow the evidence, and know when and how to escalate. If you have also stood up or tuned the tools you work with, or written your own detections, even better. You are structured, reliable, and comfortable working independently in a remote, follow-the-sun team, and you take pride in leaving a clear handover for the next shift. You are curious about new threats and technologies, and you enjoy working closely with both technical teams and end users to raise the security bar across the environment.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

Role Purpose
The Senior Business Analyst provides expert business analysis across products and client projects throughout the end-to-end development lifecycle, ensuring business needs, processes, and requirements are understood, clearly documented, and effectively delivered. Combining hands-on analysis with people leadership, they lead larger and more complex projects independently, set the standard for analysis practice across the wider team, and work with the Product Manager to shape the future direction of the product.
The role includes leading requirements elicitation and analysis, quality-assuring the outputs of the wider analysis team, and guiding both the team and stakeholders to ensure technology solutions meet business objectives and comply with company, industry, and regulatory standards. The Senior Business Analyst may also build the capability of the team through mentoring and coaching, and works across multiple product areas.
Key Responsibilities
Business Improvement & Analysis
  • Leads the investigation of business situations to uncover opportunities for efficiency, innovation, or added value, recommending feasible improvements supported by structured analysis and evidence.
  • Applies advanced analytical techniques to identify the underlying causes of complex business issues, producing authoritative recommendations that address systemic problems, not just symptoms.
  • Evaluates the implications of proposed changes on processes, systems, and stakeholders, providing structured assessments that inform decision-making and risk management at project and programme level.
Stakeholder Engagement & Facilitation
  • Engages and influences senior stakeholders to understand needs, expectations, and constraints, building trust by presenting analysis outcomes clearly and resolving concerns and conflicts effectively.
  • Plans and facilitates workshops with senior and cross-functional audiences to elicit requirements and analyse business needs, encouraging balanced participation and ensuring outputs are captured effectively.
Requirements Management
  • Selects and applies suitable techniques to draw out stakeholder requirements, validating and refining them to ensure clarity, accuracy, and relevance; resolves conflicting needs directly, escalating to the Product Manager only where necessary.
  • Produces and quality-assures clear, comprehensive business requirements throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring they are traceable, managed against agreed objectives, and reflect the needs of a diverse client base.
  • Refines requirements through structured analysis, validation, and prioritisation, ensuring they are complete, consistent, and aligned with business objectives, and sets the standard for requirements quality across the team.

  • Establishes and maintains traceability of requirements across the lifecycle, providing evidence that solutions meet business needs.
Scope, Process & Business Rules
  • Defines and communicates scope boundaries for business analysis work across projects, ensuring stakeholders share a common understanding of what is included and excluded.
  • Leads business process mapping, producing and quality-assuring process models at varying levels of detail to support communication, analysis, and decision-making.
  • Identifies, documents, and analyses the rules that govern business decisions and processes, ensuring they are consistent, traceable, and aligned with organisational objectives.
User Experience & Acceptance
  • Leads the analysis of user interactions, needs, and behaviours to inform solution design, providing structured recommendations to enhance usability and customer satisfaction; directs the production of wireframes alongside developers and UX experts where appropriate.
  • Leads stakeholders through user acceptance testing to validate that solutions meet agreed requirements, analysing test outcomes and owning issues and escalations through to resolution.
Delivery Support
  • Owns and prioritises backlog items in line with business objectives and delivery plans, ensuring the backlog reflects current priorities and stakeholder input, and coaches others in effective backlog management.
