  • Holds regular 1:1s focused on development, wellbeing, and career progression.
  • Leads performance reviews (mid-year and year-end)using a 360 feedback model, drawing on peer feedback and feedback from line managers and mentors.
  • Supports development using tools and resources from Nucleus and personalised learning plans.
  • Supports talent calibration discussions and succession planning within their area (annually).
  • Manages sickness (recording on Bob, return-to-work) and joiners, movers, and leavers within the team, with support from Group HR.
Skills & Experience Required
  • Extensive business analysis experience (typically 6+ years), ideally within financial services or a WealthTech environment.
  • Deep working knowledge of business analysis techniques and tools, and their practical application across the full project and business lifecycle.
  • Demonstrable experience of leading, mentoring, and developing others, ideally within a business analysis or product team.
  • Proven ability to produce and quality-assure clear business requirements and process documentation.
  • Experience engaging and influencing senior stakeholders, communicating effectively with audiences of varying technical understanding.
  • Previous experience working within a change-focused environment; experience of working within a software development organisation is preferable but not essential.
Personal Attributes
  • Remains calm, positive, and decisive under pressure, taking the lead when needed.
  • A natural leader who inspires, supports, and develops others, and builds high-performing teams.
  • Self-driven, with a genuine commitment to personal and professional growth, both their own and their team’s.
  • Enthusiastic, adaptable, and proactive approach to work, with strong organisational skills and the ability to prioritise effectively and meet deadlines.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, and a logical approach to problem-solving; displays integrity and awareness of confidentiality, particularly regarding financial data.
Our Values: Smart, Heart, Courage
  • Smart – We think with clarity, use good judgment, and continually seek better ways of doing things. We stay informed and strive for excellence.
  • Heart – We care about each other and our clients. We act with empathy, foster collaboration, and always aim to do the right thing.
  • Courage – We speak up, challenge respectfully, and are open to change. We take ownership and stand by our decisions.
These values guide how we work with one another and with our clients. They shape our culture and underpin every decision we make.
A little about us
We’re the Nucleus Financial Platforms group and we help make retirement more rewarding.
People come first - whether it’s our colleagues, or the advisers and customers we support, we know that working in partnership and collaboration leads to the best outcomes. Together, we’ve shaped the platform to how it is today. We work hard, and we celebrate hard too. 
Our ambition is to create a platform with a difference, putting the customer centre stage meant tearing up the rule book and starting from scratch. We’ve come a long way since then, but our mission remains just as focused. That’s why our culture, values, and social responsibility are things we keep at the top of our agenda – because we know they matter and have a big impact. 
Our culture is one of the many things that sets us apart from the pack. We want to have an environment where our people feel that they can make a real difference, know they’ll be rewarded for their efforts and more importantly, enjoy themselves at work. 
Inclusion and diversity at Nucleus
As with most things in life, who cares, wins. We really care about inclusion. 
For us it’s not a tick box exercise; inclusion and diversity are embedded in our culture and everything we do. It’s a commercial imperative. It isn’t about being PC. It’s about being future-relevant and durable. We owe it to ourselves and the industry to ensure we are playing our part in creating a fair, balanced and transparent financial services sector. 
More diversity means broader experience, a wider set of perspectives and a better collective ability to problem-solve. And it means being more representative of customer groups, which supports areas such as product development.

Contributors will evaluate audio recordings against corresponding prompt text. The Payroll Operations Services Manager (OSM) provides end-to-end oversight of payroll operations for assigned clients and serves as the primary operational escalation point. The OSM coordinates delivery teams, third-party providers, Client Service Leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders to meet contractual obligations and service commitments. The OSM leads operational health, service-level performance, payroll change execution, audit readiness, financial and resource management, service recovery, and continuous improvement. The OSM is also a people leader who develops aligned payroll colleagues to deliver consistent, compliant, and client-focused outcomes.


Core Accountabilities

1. Payroll Service Delivery Oversight

· Provide oversight for day-to-day payroll delivery across service locations, platforms, internal teams, and third-party providers.

· Monitor payroll workload, critical processing activities, capacity, dependencies, risks, and open items to ensure business-as-usual work and projects meet required deadlines and quality standards.

· Lead payroll status calls and key client-event planning, including annual and recurring payroll activities including Union agreement changes, bonus cycles, year-end operations, legislative changes, mergers and acquisitions, and changes in scope.

· Ensure consistent execution of operating procedures, controls, contractual requirements, and approved service delivery practices.

· Evaluate orphaned or unclear work to define the process, establish ownership, or eliminate unnecessary activity.

· Lead operational readiness and stabilization activities for new services, transitions, vendor changes, and material payroll initiatives.


2 Client Delivery and Service Partnership

· Partner with the CSL to ensure governance actions, service priorities, and client commitments are completed accurately and on time.

· Build trusted relationships with key client contacts and serve as the secondary operational contact for payroll delivery matters.

· Participate in and, as appropriate, lead client governance meetings, operational reviews, and status calls, presenting payroll performance, risks, actions, and recommendations.

· Provide payroll operational consultation, recommendations, and best-practice guidance to support changes, releases, and legislative or tax updates.

· Coordinate timely client communications regarding payroll operations, delivery risks, service improvements, resource changes, and other business initiatives impacting payroll delivery.


3 Governance, Metrics, and Operational Health

· Monitor payroll operational health and performance across aligned clients and teams, driving achievement of established service and operational targets.

· Analyze dashboards, productivity data, operational metrics, open-item reporting, and service results to identify trends, emerging risks, performance gaps, and improvement opportunities.

· Develop and coordinate mitigation and recovery plans for missed targets, operational risks, escalating concerns as appropriate.


4 Escalation Management, Service Recovery and E&O

· Serve as the primary escalation point for payroll service delivery issues and high-impact or highly visible service failures.

· Coordinate issue investigation to determine root cause, impacted population, operational and client impact, risk exposure, and required corrective actions.

· Develop and coordinate service recovery and mitigation plans, ensuring actions are tracked through completion and appropriate stakeholders are engaged.

· Coordinate Root Cause Analysis documentation and coordinate required internal review, approval, and client delivery.

· Initiate and support Errors and Omissions processes, ensuring required documentation is completed and coordinating with the CSL and applicable stakeholders to mitigate financial and client impacts.

· Review and track service recoveries, corrective actions, and recurring issues to identify trends and drive process improvement and risk-reduction opportunities.


5 SLA, Contract, Risk and Compliance Management

· Serve as the payroll operational subject matter expert for aligned Statements of Work, service commitments, SLA definitions, calculations, targets, and contractual obligations.

· Monitor SLA, KPI, and other contractual performance, coordinating root cause analysis, remediation, recovery actions, and reporting when performance targets are not met.

· Ensure payroll delivery remains within contractual scope and identify potential scope creep or work requiring a Change Request.

· Conduct applicable risk-based audits and ensure required payroll controls are executed, monitored, and maintained in accordance with established control requirements.

· Coordinate and actively participate in SOC1 audits, control assessments, evidence collection, remediation activities, and other applicable compliance reviews.

· Maintain payroll Business Continuity plans for aligned clients and coordinate required testing, recovery exercises, and execution during business continuity events.


6. Change Requests, Projects, and Continuous Improvement

· Provide oversight for payroll Change Request activities, including intake, operational scoping, assumptions, work estimates, testing requirements, and implementation readiness.

· Validate detailed payroll scope, requirements, and estimates for work owned by the aligned service area, including estimates prepared by delivery teams.

· Coordinate with the CSL, impacted domains and service areas, vendors, Finance, and project resources to support end-to-end Change Request delivery.

· Manage payroll-specific projects when a dedicated project manager is not assigned, maintaining appropriate plans, risks, issues, actions, and status reporting.

· Identify and implement opportunities for standardization, automation, global sourcing, demand reduction, capacity creation, and process improvement.

· Ensure process documentation, training, knowledge transfer, and appropriate monitoring are completed to support the effective transition and sustainability of new or improved processes.


7. Financial and Resource Management

· Monitor variable charges, resource utilization, headcount and cost for Global team, time recording, non-colleague costs, project hours, and other financial drivers for assigned clients, identifying variances and taking appropriate action.

· Identify and implement cost-management, global sourcing and efficiency opportunities while balancing client commitments, control requirements, colleague capacity, and service quality.

· Manage global sourcing partner performance through regular scorecard reviews, service oversight, root cause analysis, and implementation of opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce costs

· Develop and maintain resource and staffing plans based on delivery requirements, anticipated demand, workload, risk, and required skills and capabilities.

· Identify talent, capacity, and coverage risks and implement appropriate mitigation plans, including cross-training, succession, and continuity planning.

· Support functional estimation, sales, renewal, and growth activities by providing payroll operational expertise and input as required.


8. People Leadership

· Lead, coach, and develop aligned payroll colleagues through clear expectations, accountability, performance management, development and succession planning, effective workload assignment, and capability building, while connecting individual goals to business outcomes.

· Lead change management and drive consistent communication of key priorities, standards, decisions, and expectations across payroll operations.

Voor een cliënt is een flexibele agenda fijn, maar voor jou als behandelaar ook. Jij bepaalt hoeveel cliënten je behandelt en wanneer je dat doet. Zo heb je de regie over je eigen work/life balance. Werken vanuit Bali, Turkije, Colombia of Italië? Fantastisch! Het enige wat je écht nodig hebt is een stabiele internetverbinding en een rustige werkplek.

Wat voor ons telt, is dat je voldoening uit je werk haalt en blij wordt van het bieden van de best mogelijke hulp aan mensen.

Hulp van een buddy

Wil jij een kleine en overzichtelijke caseload die je intensief behandelt? Met de steun van een deskundige buddy aan je zij? Dan koppelen wij je graag aan een ervaren regiebehandelaar die jou helpt bij het kwalitatief goed behandelen van cliënten. Het is fijn om advies in te winnen bij een collega.

Online werken bij LMcare

  • Cliënten behandel je online via je computer, tablet of smartphone;

  • Kleine, overzichtelijke caseload en daardoor sterke therapeutische link;

  • Een toegewezen buddy - een vast aanspreekpunt om mee te sparren;

  • MDO’s met medebehandelaars doen we ook online;

  • LMcare Academy: ons kennisinstituut over de do's & don'ts van online behandelen in de GGZ;

  • Maandelijks werkoverleg + lunch & learn sessies met het hele team.

Naast online werken, zien we elkaar ook fysiek met de jaarlijkse studiereis (Stockholm, Scheveningen, Brussel, Berlijn, Parijs), studiedagen en spontane borrels!

Vereisten voor kwaliteit

Uiteraard willen we de kwaliteit van onze zorg op hoog niveau aanbieden. Daarom stellen we een aantal belangrijke eisen aan jou als medebehandelaar:

  • Opleiding tot psycholoog (WO)

  • Aantoonbaar CGT- en/of EMDR kennis

  • Minstens 5 jaar behandelervaring in de ambulante SGGZ

  • Handigheid in het werken met digitale media

  • Bereidheid om minstens 24 uur per week aan onze cliënten te besteden

Zorg voor onze collega's

Bij LMcare ben jij als behandelaar onze topprioriteit. Samen bepalen we per maand hoeveel uren jij gaat werken. Deze uren zet je in onze gedeelde agenda. Overdag, of liever ’s avonds wanneer de kinderen slapen? Alles is mogelijk. De cliënt boekt een intake in overleg met de triagist en de vervolgafspraken plannen jullie vervolgens samen in.

Behandelen volgens FIT-method, uniek in Nederland

Wetenschappelijk onderzoek bewijst het succes van meerdere behandelsessies per week. Als behandelgesprekken elkaar snel opvolgen, blijven informatie, inzichten en oefeningen beter hangen bij cliënten. Dit werkt ontzettend motiverend voor de cliënt én de behandelaar. Bij LMcare behandelen we daarom succesvol volgens onze zelf ontwikkelde FIT-method. FIT staat voor Frequent, Intensive Therapy. Door onze ervaring met de FIT-method, weten we dat een sGGZ-traject bij LMcare gemiddeld binnen 4 maanden succesvol afgerond kan zijn. Terwijl het landelijk gemiddelde op 8 maanden ligt. Hiermee versnellen we de doorstroom van cliënten en dragen we ons steentje bij aan het verkorten van de wachtlijsten.

Iets voor jou?

LMcare is een no-nonsense GGZ-instelling die psychische zorg voor volwassenen in een nieuw jasje steekt. Laagdrempelig en zonder stoffige bureaucratie. We werken volledig volgens de Wtza, schakelen snel en hebben een open bedrijfscultuur. Alle behandelaars werken op afstand vanuit verschillende landen en continenten, maar zijn een hecht team.

Werken bij de grootste online GGZ-instelling van Nederland:

  • 30 WO-basispsychologen en 30 regiebehandelaars.

  • meer dan 250 consulten per dag.

  • Reeds 4300+ cliënten behandeld.

Klinkt als iets voor jou? We maken graag kennis met je!

Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.

Organized, detail-oriented, and adaptable, you will ensure accurate and timely payroll processing while helping to build and refine processes from the ground up. They improve contribution processing workflows, increasing speed and accuracy while identifying automation opportunities to reduce manual tasks. The team resolves issues through detailed analysis and validation, ensuring accurate reports and enhancing operational efficiency and data integrity. By collaborating with cross-functional teams, they address customer needs, improve processes, and contribute to product enhancements. They also support internal teams by sharing operational insights to guide decision-making and ensure successful project execution, while managing key projects to align resources and timelines with business goals for timely delivery.

  • Proactively identify discrepancies and correct errors, ensuring high-quality, consistent data for reporting and operational purposes.

  • Time management skills to prioritize tasks effectively
  • Basic problem-solving abilities
  • Interest in research and learning

jobs.description:
Inventory Cost Accounting Manager

Location: Remote (US)

ABOUT BARK
Think Disney for dogs. We aren’t just selling toys; we’re creating the joy, connection, and delightful chaos that defines the bond between dogs and their people. At our core, we believe dogs make life better, and we’re on a mission to return the favor by building THE Dog Company.

We operate at the intersection of data, technology, and pure creativity. We move fast, test relentlessly, and use real feedback from millions of pups to build smarter systems, better products, and more meaningful experiences. We’re looking for people who want to challenge the status quo and help us invent what’s next for dogs and their humans.

THE TEAM
The Accounting team keeps BARK’s financial reporting accurate, reliable, and ready for the decisions that move our business forward. We own the monthly close, financial controls, and GAAP reporting that our internal teams and investors rely on.

As Inventory Cost Accounting Manager, you’ll report to the Controller and own the accounting for two of our biggest financial drivers: inventory and cost of goods sold (COGS). Our inventory moves across subscription boxes, retail partners, and direct-to-consumer orders, with new themed products every month, so the accounting is anything but static. You’ll lead a team of accountants and work closely with Purchasing, Fulfillment, Logistics, FP&A, and our systems teams to make sure the numbers reflect what’s actually happening across our business.

WHO WE’RE SNIFFING FOR
We’re looking for someone who knows inventory accounting inside and out, can lead a team through a clean, accurate close, and isn’t afraid to dig into the details when something doesn’t add up.

You bring strong accounting judgment, know how to turn complex inventory data into clear answers, and look for ways to make processes simpler and more reliable. You’re comfortable rolling up your sleeves, developing your team, and using technology and automation to make the work better. And, of course, you love dogs.

KEY DUTIES

  • Own inventory and COGS accounting across our 3PL warehouses and manufacturing partners, ensuring accurate inventory valuation and financial reporting.
  • Deliver a clean, on-time monthly inventory close and give Finance leadership a clear read on what’s driving COGS and gross margin, including reserves, landed and average costs, and purchase price variances.
  • Keep inventory audit-ready and controls tight. Review journal entries and reconciliations, oversee physical counts, support quarterly reviews and the annual audit, and document conclusions on complex transactions.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of accountants, setting clear priorities, reviewing work, and helping the team deliver accurate results on time.
  • Improve how inventory accounting gets done. Partner with Operations, Finance, and systems teams to strengthen data accuracy, reduce manual work, and use automation and AI-enabled tools where appropriate to make reconciliations, reporting, and controls more efficient.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Strong experience in inventory and cost accounting, ideally within a consumer products, retail, manufacturing, or direct-to-consumer business.
  • Hands-on knowledge of inventory valuation, COGS, landed costs, reserves, and inventory reconciliations.
  • Solid understanding of US GAAP and SOX controls in a public company environment.
  • Experience leading and developing accountants, with the ability to balance hands-on work and team management.
  • Experience with NetSuite or similar ERP systems and inventory management applications.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to investigate discrepancies, understand root causes, and explain what’s moving the numbers to the Controller, FP&A, and Operations partners.
  • A track record of improving accounting processes through better systems, automation, and data-driven workflows.
  • Comfort making judgment calls on gray-area inventory issues and keeping the close on track when priorities shift.

This is a full-time, remote position open to candidates based in the United States, with potential quarterly travel to New York City and our 3PL warehouses. We offer competitive compensation, equity, and benefits designed to support both you and your pack, including comprehensive healthcare and pet wellness coverage.

PAY TRANSPARENCY

  • The base salary range for this position is $115- $130K
  • This position is eligible for equity.

  • Protect US direct-material supply into the holiday peak — no availability gaps on either category attributable to the handover.
  • Work AI-first — operate the tiered approval model, feed the spend cube, use automated PO/confirmation workflows rather than manual handling.

Requirements

  • 4–7+ years in purchasing / buying / commodity management, ideally in musical instruments, consumer electronics or consumer goods and across more than one country or region.

Job Description:

Job Title: Bid and Proposal Manager

Location: Remote, UK based

Type: Permanent, Full-Time 37.5 hours per week

Velonetic represents the joint ventures between DXC Technology, the International Underwriting Association (IUA), and Lloyd’s of London. Previously referred to as the London Market Joint Ventures, we have been operating for over 20 years in the London market (Lloyd's and Company), in both insurance and reinsurance business. Processing over £101 billion worth of premium and claims transactions today, we are building a new digital platform and services that will enable our customers to move transactions and money through the processing lifecycle with greater efficiency and speed, releasing time to drive innovation and focus on higher value activities. Our core business services involve performing checks on insurance documents, processing premium transactions and processing claims transactions.

Individual will reside in the UK and have Right to Work in the UK.

Job Overview

This is an exciting opportunity for someone with good communication skills and an eye for detail that enjoys being part of an enthusiastic and determined team. The Velonetic Bid and Proposal Lead is the single point of contact to the Sales lead for all activity required to develop and publish a compelling client proposal from pursuit strategy and proposal development to content creation and editing.

The Bid and Proposal Lead role is typically involved in all formal bid submissions required by Velonetic. They engage in the request for information (RFI) and request for proposal (RFP) stages and assist with, or lead, the creation of messaging collateral.
After the arrival of the RFP, The Bid and Proposal Lead is responsible for the effective operation of the Bid team, developing the bid plan, which includes at a minimum adherence to required stages of Velonetic governance and that encompasses a dedicated plan to produce and deliver the proposal document, applying industry best practice throughout.

They must understand the business context of the opportunity and the essence of the Velonetic offering, messaging, solution, differentiators and win themes. Success in the role is based on understanding the client, their industry and their drivers for coming to market and then eliciting and translating the Velonetic perspective into a client-oriented story through the proposal, orals, and any other written collateral.

The Bid and Proposal Lead is also responsible for working with the Bid Team and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to provide guidance and coaching on how to deliver the messaging and story for maximum client impact and differentiation against any competitors. They should also be able to provide writing support to the rest of the pursuit members, covering all proposal tasks including strategy, messaging, Executive Summary, managing the proposal production and writing.

What you will be doing

Pursuit Strategy

  • Supports proposal strategy development and other planning activities that help the Bid team plan and shape client deliverables
  • Determines the right proposal resource mix and engagement plan based on complexity of the deal
  • Builds trusted relationships with key stakeholders (Sales, Delivery, product management, legal, pricing) to identify and capture proposal inputs
  • Leads Proposal Storyboarding by actively participating in strategy sessions for example, Client Solution Strategy, Solution Design Workshops
  • Facilitates and owns development of the Message Map
  • Supports and guides the Sales Lead to develop the opportunity Executive Summary
  • Ensures consistency of messaging across all proposal deliverables, for example, proposal documents, orals session slides
  • Provides ongoing leadership and guidance to the Bid team throughout the proposal life cycle

Proposal Development

  • Leads kick off meetings, regular deal review forums, and working sessions
  • Researches the client organisation, its media, marketing, and approach to articulate what the client organization stands for; knows the client graphic and written style; and briefs and coaches the team on the client’s ‘hot buttons’
  • Actively works to clarify the meaning of proposal content with team members to ensure consistency of core messages

Proposal Management

  • Analyses RFx/bid requirements and tailors the proposal structure to ensure compliance and responsiveness to the client’s evaluation criteria
  • Oversees the proposal development process including initial proposal content creation and design, and production of graphics, quality reviews, and production
  • Develops proposal production plan and communicates with support areas for efficient execution
  • Sets up file structure in SharePoint for proposal files
  • Ensures writers understand RFP requirements and meet proposal deadlines
  • I able to use relevant AI packages to efficiently produce content from existing collateral, in both text and graphical formats.
  • Ensures proposal best practices are followed and delivers completed written proposal responses against agreed RFP deadlines, escalating issues as required
  • Tracks the status of each proposal deliverable and escalates issues in a timely manner
  • Uses Velonetic branded proposal-related tools, templates, and packaging
  • Plans and conducts quality reviews and applies changes required
  • Leads the production team to produce, quality check, and deliver the final documents
  • Delivers a quality and complete proposal, on time

Content Creation

  • Collaborates effectively with all relevant stakeholders to populate and update content
  • Partners with the sales lead for the content and approach to the Executive Summary and other client communications, assisting sales and deal leaders to ensure maximum impact in each communication opportunity
  • Identifies and re-works pre-written content as relevant to client-specific requirements
  • Proofreads and edits content written by SMEs to ensure that it is compelling and convincing, that messaging and win themes are followed and to achieve "One Voice“ throughout all proposal deliverables
  • Balances the need to develop an optimal proposal (client story, proposal language, and presentation) with the flexibility to adapt in the interests of timely delivery
  • Actively works to clarify the meaning of proposal content with team members, given the diversity of specialisations and styles in the team, working with them to revisit and ensure consistency of core messages
  • Researches the client organisation, its media, marketing and approach, to articulate what the client organisation stands for; knows the client graphic and written style; and briefs and coaches the team on the client’s ‘hot buttons’

What we’re looking for

· A successful candidate for this position is likely to have a university degree or similar qualification

· The candidate should have excellent written English and good spoken English.

· Experience of several years writing commercial or proposal documents, or in a similar writing capacity

· Experience of managing and delivering proposals within large pursuit teams, coordinating the delivery on-time of content from a number of different authors.

· A general understanding of the technicalities behind the solutions being described will be very useful. Failing this an ability to understand technical solutions rapidly and describe them accurately will be essential

At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. Our work model prioritizes in-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

jobs.excerpt: About TekmetricTekmetric is the all-in-one, cloud-based software helping auto repair shops run smarter, grow faster, and serve customers better.
jobs.description:
About Tekmetric

Tekmetric is the all-in-one, cloud-based software helping auto repair shops run smarter, grow faster, and serve customers better.

Built by a shop owner and shaped by the needs of the industry, Tekmetric brings together innovation, real-world experience, and a thriving community to help shops thrive - not just survive. From running a shop, to securing payments to engaging customers, our platform simplifies operations so shop owners can focus on what really matters: delivering exceptional service, earning trust, and growing sustainably.

Officially founded in Houston in 2017, Tekmetric has grown from a single shop’s vision to the industry’s leading solution - all by staying true to our values of transparency, integrity, innovation, and a service-first mindset.

But we’re not just building shop management software. We’re building a movement. We’re empowering repair shops to rise above the daily grind, create meaningful connections with their customers, and lead the industry forward - one interaction at a time.

Come build with us. Join the journey. Shape the future of auto repair.

Working the Tekmetric Way

At Tekmetric, we’re building a culture where winning matters - not for ego, but because when our customers win, we win together.

We move fast, stay curious, and take full ownership of our results — no excuses, no finger-pointing. If you thrive in ambiguity, take initiative, and view honest feedback as fuel for growth, you’ll feel right at home here.

We’re direct but respectful, ambitious yet grounded, and collaborative at every level. Everyone leads through impact and is encouraged to speak up, share ideas, and challenge assumptions (even your manager’s). This is a place for builders, not bystanders.

Success here takes focus, follow-through, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves — but if you’re driven by meaningful work and real results, it’s deeply rewarding. You’ll join a team that cares about the work, supports one another, and takes smart risks to achieve bold goals. Be yourself, stay mission-focused, and you’ll thrive. If that energizes you, we can’t wait to meet you.

Where We Work: At Tekmetric, great work happens anywhere, but great teams are built through intentional connection. We offer hybrid and remote work models based on your proximity to our office hubs. Because we value in-person collaboration, travel is an expected part of every role. We come together several times a year for team and company-wide offsites to align on goals and strengthen relationships. Attendance at these events is expected and fully supported.

About the Role

We are looking for a Director of Customer Support to own the quality, efficiency, and people strategy of our customer support organization. This is a high-impact leadership role responsible for customer satisfaction and quality assurance across every support channel and every tier (Tier 1–3), while building the team, processes, and metrics that allow support to scale with a growing SaaS business.

Our customers depend on our platform to run their businesses every day, and support is often where they decide whether they trust us. You will lead the full support organization across phone, chat, email, and AI-assisted channels, setting one consistent standard of quality and building/maintaining the programs to measure, coach, and sustain it. You will lead managers and team leads, shape the structure and career paths of the team, and be accountable for the experience customers have every time they reach out.

You will set the standard for what great support looks like, hold the organization accountable to it, and develop the leaders and agents who deliver it. Support Operations owns the systems, data, forecasting models, and process infrastructure behind that work. You will partner closely, bringing Ops prioritized improvement ideas and the data to back them, and Ops will turn them into roadmap delivery. This role is built for someone who is equally comfortable coaching a frontline agent, presenting KPIs to executives, and partnering with Product and Engineering to fix root causes.

In your first year, you will:

  • Establish a unified QA and customer satisfaction framework that applies consistently across all channels and tiers
  • Improve CSAT and resolution quality while holding or improving efficiency metrics such as FCR, TTR, and SLA adherence
  • Define clear career paths, training programs, and coaching practices that strengthen retention and internal promotion
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to turn support insights into fixes that reduce contact volume
  • Work with Operations to refine the forecasting, staffing, and reporting rhythm that lets leadership see support performance clearly and plan with confidence

You will report to executive leadership and work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, remote-first environment where support is treated as a strategic driver of retention and growth, not a cost center.

Key Responsibilities

Quality & Customer Satisfaction

  • Own customer satisfaction outcomes (CSAT, NPS) across all support channels, including phone, chat, email, and AI-assisted interactions
  • Design, run, and continuously improve the QA program for Tier 1, Tier 2, and Tier 3, with consistent scorecards, calibration sessions, and sampling methodology
  • Ensure quality standards are applied consistently across channels and tiers, and that QA findings drive coaching, training, and process changes
  • Review customer feedback, low-CSAT interactions, and escalations to identify trends and drive corrective action
  • Establish quality benchmarks and hold managers and team leads accountable for results
  • Evaluate and improve the quality of AI and automation-handled interactions alongside human-handled contacts

Efficiency & Operations

  • Own operational efficiency metrics including FCR, AHT, TTR, SLA adherence, backlog, and cost per contact
  • Partner with Support Operations on forecasting, staffing, scheduling, and capacity planning to meet service levels
  • Identify and lead initiatives that reduce handle time, increase deflection and self-service, and improve resolution rates without sacrificing quality
  • Define and maintain escalation paths, tier definitions, and handoff processes between Tier 1, Tier 2, and Tier 3
  • Evaluate and provide feedback on gaps in the support tech stack, including ticketing, telephony, QA, knowledge base, and AI tools

People Development & Career Pathing

  • Hire, onboard, and retain a high-performing support organization, including Managers, Team Leads, and frontline agents
  • Build clear career paths and role definitions from Tier 1 through leadership, including promotion criteria, skill matrices, and development plans
  • Lead coaching and performance management practices, equipping managers to give consistent, data-driven feedback
  • Own the training strategy, including new-hire onboarding, product and tool training, soft-skills development, and ongoing upskilling
  • Foster a culture of accountability, engagement, and recognition; monitor team health, attrition, and morale

Strategy, Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Develop and execute the customer support strategy and multi-year roadmap in alignment with company goals
  • Own headcount planning and organizational design around forecasted needs
  • Serve as the voice of the customer, translating support trends and root-cause insights into actionable recommendations for Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Sales
  • Partner with Engineering on Tier 3 escalations, bug triage, and incident communication
  • Deliver regular performance reporting and data-driven recommendations to executive leadership
  • Inform where there are gaps in the knowledge base and support documentation, and champion self-service resources
  • Lead the team through change, including product launches, customer incidents, and periods of rapid growth

Qualifications

Required

  • 8+ years of experience in customer support or contact center operations, with 5+ years leading managers or a multi-tier support organization
  • Proven track record improving CSAT and quality through a structured QA program
  • Experience managing support across multiple channels (phone, chat, email) and tiers (Tier 1–3)
  • Demonstrated success building career paths, training programs, and coaching frameworks that improve retention and performance
  • Strong analytical skills with experience using KPIs and dashboards to drive decisions
  • Experience managing a department including headcount plan, and forecasting
  • Hands-on experience with support platforms such as Salesforce, Zendesk, Intercom, or similar
  • Exceptional communication and executive presence, with the ability to translate operational data into leadership-ready insights
  • Background in SaaS or technology-sector support organizations

Preferred

  • Experience implementing or optimizing AI and automation in support (chatbots, deflection, AI-assisted QA)
  • Experience with QA and conversation intelligence tools such as Gong
  • Experience scaling a support team through rapid growth
  • Familiarity with automotive or other vertical SaaS industries

Why You'll Love Working With Us

Health & Wellness That Have You Covered:

  • Enjoy the flexibility of remote work
  • Competitive base salaries that reflect your value.
  • Flexible PTO — No set number of days, just the trust to take the time you need. We genuinely encourage our team to disconnect and recharge.
  • Support for every stage of life—with paid maternity, parental bonding, and medical leave for you or your loved ones.
  • Comprehensive health benefits, including Medical, Dental, Vision, and Prescription coverage. For employee only, we offer plans that cover 100% of premiums and we cover 50% of costs for families.
  • Prioritizing your mental health: get free, confidential counseling through our partnership with BetterHelp.

Investing in Your Future (and Present):

  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with 100% employer match on contributions up to 6% - so your future self will thank you.
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Health Savings Accounts (HSA) to make your money go further.
  • Life and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D) Insurance for added peace of mind.
  • Wellness on your terms: get up to $60/month toward fitness, mental health, or almost anything that helps you feel your best.
  • After one year of employment, enjoy a $300 home office setup bonus to help make your space work for you.
  • Keep growing with support for continuing education - we’re invested in your development.

Most importantly, we have a stellar team, a whole lot of fun, and work that actually matters to the shops and families we serve!

We hire hard-working individuals, regardless of gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We know that when our employees feel appreciated and included, they can be more creative, innovative and successful.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

jobs.title: Senior Growth Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt: About OnboardedOnboarded is the API for the workflows that have to be right.
jobs.description:
About Onboarded

Onboarded is the API for the workflows that have to be right. In hiring, that's the work between the ATS and payroll: compliance, verifications, forms, approvals and handoffs. Software platforms embed Onboarded in their products, companies building their own hiring products build on it, and employers that hire in volume run it directly.

We're a Series A company with a small marketing team and a big opportunity ahead. We're early in building demand with technical buyers, and there's no established growth playbook to inherit.

That's where you come in.

The Role

We're looking for a hands-on B2B marketer who can build demand from the ground up.

You'll own demand generation, including paid advertising, from reaching the right buyers to turning interest into qualified sales opportunities. Our primary audience is product and engineering leaders at HR technology and workforce software companies and at businesses building their own hiring products, with staffing firms and high-volume employers second.

You’ll set the demand generation strategy: which audiences, channels, and campaigns are worth investing in, and in what order. You'll build and launch them yourself and use the results to decide what comes next. You'll use AI and automation extensively to move faster and make a small team more effective.

The work is highly collaborative. You'll report directly to our Head of Marketing and work closely with other functions, like our GTM engineer (who owns outbound and the CRM) and our sales team. This is a senior individual contributor role with meaningful ownership and the opportunity to contribute across marketing as our needs evolve.

What You'll Do

  • Own paid advertising. Set the paid strategy and run it: channel mix, targeting, spend allocation within the budget we set, and optimization across LinkedIn and the new channels we test. Build and manage campaigns yourself, from targeting and creative to landing pages, testing, and performance reporting. Know when to scale, adjust, or stop spending.

  • Build demand from scratch. Develop programs that introduce Onboarded to the right buyers, even when they aren't actively shopping. Combine paid media with account-based marketing on our target accounts, content distribution, and new ways to reach technical buyers.

  • Own campaigns end to end. Handle targeting, campaign copy and creative, landing pages, and follow-up. Work from the positioning and messaging we set, adapt it for each audience, test what lands, and work closely with sales to turn engagement into opportunities.

  • Turn interest into pipeline. Build and optimize conversion paths, lead capture, nurture, and handoffs. Work with our GTM engineer to build the automation and systems that support the full funnel.

  • Measure, learn, and improve. Own campaign and funnel reporting across GA4, the ad platforms, self-reported attribution, and AI referrals. Give every test a hypothesis, a metric, and a stop point. Make smart decisions with limited data, decide what to scale, change, or stop, and recommend when the budget should grow.

  • Pitch in on events. Help with logistics for the conferences and field events we attend, and make sure the conversations from each one get followed up.

  • Contribute across marketing. Bring new ideas, help shape strategy, and support other priorities as the company grows.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong B2B Saas demand generation experience. You have 5 to 7 years in B2B marketing, with hands-on experience creating demand and generating qualified pipeline.

  • A generalist with deep demand generation skills. You're strongest in demand generation but comfortable with other (not all) parts of marketing. That includes writing ad and landing page copy, a nurture email, or a newsletter section when it's needed; you don't need to be a content expert, but you do need to be a good written communicator.

  • Hands-on paid media experience. You've personally managed B2B paid campaigns. You understand targeting, creative testing, conversion optimization, attribution, and budget management. You know how to make limited spend count.

  • You've built something from zero to one. You've taken a channel or program from nothing to its first pipeline, ideally with a limited budget and a clearly defined audience. You can tell us what it cost, how long the first qualified meeting took, and what you shut off along the way.

  • You understand complex B2B buying journeys. You know how to reach decision-makers, build interest over time, tailor campaigns to different audiences, and work with sales through longer buying cycles.

  • You're strategic and hands-on. You can identify an opportunity, develop a plan, write the copy, launch the campaign, and analyze the results. You're comfortable doing the work, not just directing it.

  • You're fluent in AI. You use AI to run, test, and build: campaigns, reporting, and page changes. You've replaced manual work with workflows you built yourself.

  • You take initiative and adapt. You're a self-starter with ideas and recommendations, not just updates. You're collaborative, resourceful, and comfortable changing priorities as we learn.

Experience in startups, HR technology, workforce technology, or marketing to technical buyers is a plus.

What Success Looks Like

We move fast, here’s what to expect.

  • By day 30: You’ve taken over our LinkedIn campaigns and launched your first demand tests to our target accounts, each with a hypothesis, a stop point, and a way to measure it.

  • By day 60: Your programs are reaching our target accounts and have booked their first qualified meetings.

  • By day 90: You’ve cut what isn’t working, put more behind what is, and used real data to set a monthly qualified-meeting target with us.

Why Join Us

You'll be our first marketer dedicated to growth and demand generation, working directly with our Head of Marketing to shape how we go to market.

You'll have room to experiment, ownership of your work, and the opportunity to build something that matters to the business. As our team grows, this role can grow into owning more of the marketing budget.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary + equity in a fast-growing startup

  • Health, dental, vision, and retirement benefits

  • Remote-first culture with periodic in-person collaboration

  • The chance to build the demand gen engine that defines the next stage of Onboarded's growth

jobs.excerpt: Volontariat VirtuelEmplacement du partenaire : République démocratique du Congo Date de début : Décembre 2026 Durée de l’affectation : 3 Mois (au moins 7 heures par semaine ; disponibilité à temps plein bienvenue).
jobs.description:
Volontariat Virtuel

Emplacement du partenaire : République démocratique du Congo

Date de début : Décembre 2026

Durée de l’affectation : 3 Mois (au moins 7 heures par semaine ; disponibilité à temps plein bienvenue).

Exigences linguistiques : Français Niveau 4 - Avancé

L'éligibilité : Ouvert aux citoyens canadiens et aux résidents permanents du Canada seulement

Rôle du coopérant-volontaire

Contribuez à l'essor de la prochaine génération d'entrepreneurs en République démocratique du Congo.

L'Université Canadienne de Kinshasa est un établissement d'enseignement supérieur reconnu pour son approche axée sur l'innovation, l'entrepreneuriat et les technologies émergentes. Grâce à son incubateur d'entreprises, elle accompagne les étudiants, jeunes diplômés et entrepreneurs dans le développement de projets à fort potentiel.

À titre de Conseiller(ère) en marketing numérique, vous partagerez votre expertise afin d'aider les entrepreneurs à renforcer leur présence en ligne, développer leurs ventes numériques et saisir les opportunités offertes par l'économie numérique.

En collaboration avec l'équipe de l'incubateur, vous concevrez et animerez des formations pratiques portant notamment sur le marketing digital, les réseaux sociaux, le référencement (SEO), la création de contenu, les plateformes de commerce électronique et les stratégies d'acquisition de clientèle. Votre accompagnement contribuera directement à améliorer l'employabilité des étudiants et la croissance des entreprises incubées.

La personne sélectionnée devra mener les activités suivantes :

  • Évaluer les besoins des étudiants, entrepreneurs et membres du personnel afin d'identifier les compétences prioritaires à développer en marketing numérique et commerce électronique.
  • Concevoir des formations pratiques et des outils d'apprentissage sur le marketing numérique, les médias sociaux, le référencement (SEO), la création de contenu et la vente en ligne.
  • Animer des ateliers interactifs visant à renforcer les connaissances et les compétences des participants.
  • Accompagner les entrepreneurs dans l'amélioration de leur visibilité en ligne, le développement de leur clientèle et l'utilisation des plateformes de commerce électronique.
  • Transférer des bonnes pratiques et des ressources durables à l'équipe de l'incubateur afin de soutenir l'accompagnement futur des entrepreneurs.

Compétences académiques essentielles:

  • Diplôme en marketing, communication numérique, commerce, commerce électronique, gestion ou domaine connexe.

Expérience / Compétences professionnelles essentiels:

  • Expérience pratique en marketing numérique, commerce électronique ou gestion de campagnes numériques.
  • Bonne connaissance des réseaux sociaux, du SEO, de la création de contenu et des outils de vente en ligne.
  • Expérience en formation, mentorat ou accompagnement entrepreneurial constituant un atout.

À propos du coopérant-volontaire

Le programme de volontariat virtuel de Cuso International accueille de nouveaux et anciens bénévoles à travailler à distance avec nos partenaires internationaux et bureaux pays. Le volontariat virtuel offre plusieurs des avantages du volontariat international, cependant se démarque pour sa flexibilité; pouvant être géré à partir de chez soi et en accord avec sa disponibilité. Contribuer ses compétences à une communauté, acquérir de nouvelles compétences, et de faire de nouvelles connexions sont les avantages communs du volontariat virtuel, et pour Cuso International c’est aussi une grande opportunité pour engager plus de personnes dans sa mission.

Certains de nos partenaires se trouvent dans des zones reculées avec une connexion Internet peu fiable. Par conséquent, lorsque vous travaillez avec les partenaires, il est raisonnable de supposer que les réponses à vos courriels ne seront pas envoyées immédiatement (structure change in this sentence). De plus, pour certains de nos partenaires, il s'agit de leur première expérience de travail avec des volontaires virtuel, de sorte que la flexibilité et la patience sont une caractéristique précieuse du volontariat virtuel.

À propos de nous

Cuso International (Cuso) est une organisation internationale de coopération et de développement basée au Canada qui œuvre à créer des opportunités sociales et économiques pour les groupes méritant l'équité. Forts de plus de soixante ans d'expérience, nous relevons les défis mondiaux en nous attaquant aux causes profondes des inégalités. En collaboration avec nos partenaires, nous nous concentrons sur les efforts visant à améliorer la résilience économique, à promouvoir l'équité et l'inclusion pour tous et à faire progresser l'action climatique. Nous croyons qu'en partageant nos compétences et habiletés, nous pouvons bâtir un avenir meilleur. Guidée par ses valeurs de courage, d'inclusion, de durabilité et de redevabilité, Cuso combine des stratégies innovantes et des partenariats durables pour créer un changement significatif et durable dans les communautés d'Afrique, d'Amérique latine, des Caraïbes et du Canada.

Projet : SHARE (partage du savoir-faire canadien pour le développement inclusif et l’égalité des genres)

Partenaire : Université Canadienne au Congo

Requirements

Conditions de sélection

Veuillez noter que si vous êtes présélectionné(e) pour l'affectation, vous devrez :

  • Fournir 2 références professionnelles
  • Compléter une évaluation linguistique lors de l'entretien téléphonique préliminaire dans la langue requise pour votre affectation.

jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

About the role

We're hiring a Senior Strategic Account Executive to win and grow strategic enterprise accounts. You will own the commercial outcome, from pipeline creation to close, by practicing insight-led selling: reframing the customer's initial problem, quantifying the cost of inaction, and mobilizing buying committees around a compelling "why now."

You'll lead multi-stakeholder enterprise cycles with CFO/CIO/Shared Services/Procurement leadership, partnering closely with Solutions Engineering, Marketing, and Customer Success to run disciplined deal plans, deliver value-based proposals, and land enterprise rollouts.

What you'll own

Pipeline creation and territory strategy

  • Build and execute a territory/account plan: target accounts, stakeholders, sequencing, and multi-threading strategy.

  • Create net-new pipeline through outbound prospecting, partner motion, events, and customer referrals.

  • Maintain disciplined pipeline hygiene and forecasting, and report proactively on progress, risks, and what you need from the organization.

Insight-led selling and deal shaping

  • Practice insight selling: challenge the customer's initial framing and introduce a sharper point of view on where value is trapped (exceptions, approvals, master data, controls).

  • Run executive discovery to uncover operational bottlenecks and decision friction, and translate it into a crisp target-state narrative, urgency, and mutual action plan.

  • Build internal alignment across CFO/CIO-led buying committees, including champions, economic buyers, IT/security, and process owners.

Commercial ownership: value case, negotiation, and close

  • Own the business case, pricing strategy, proposals, negotiation, and contracting.

  • Quantify and communicate value (capacity release, cycle time reduction, control/compliance improvements, stack simplification) and tie it to executive priorities and budget.

  • Drive the deal to closure with clear next steps, strong deal governance, and accurate forecasting.

Orchestration across presales and delivery

  • Partner with Solutions Engineers to run workshops/demos and de-risk technical concerns (security, integration, rollout).

  • Align with Customer Success on implementation readiness, success criteria, and expansion paths.

  • Ensure clean handoffs from close to kickoff, maintaining continuity of value narrative and outcomes.

Competitive positioning

  • Position blp against point tools and fragmented stacks (OCR/IDP/workflow/process mining/RPA) with an "end-to-end + exceptions-first" narrative.

  • Anticipate and neutralize competitive plays with crisp differentiation and proof.

What we're looking for

Must-haves

  • 5–10+ years of enterprise B2B SaaS selling experience (or equivalent complex solution sales), with a consistent track record of hitting/exceeding targets.

  • Strong executive presence with CFO/CIO/Head of Shared Services and comfort navigating enterprise procurement.

  • Ability to manage complex, multi-threaded deals: mutual action plans, MEDDICC-style qualification, forecasting discipline.

  • Strong collaboration with presales/SE and post-sales teams; you sell what can be delivered.

Strong plus

  • ERP/SAP exposure (S/4, ECC, Public/Private Cloud) or selling into finance/procurement/shared services transformations.

  • Experience selling automation platforms (workflow/RPA/process mining/IDP) and winning against incumbents.

  • Experience with global enterprise rollouts and multi-country stakeholders.

Language

  • Fluent in English and German (or another major European language depending on territory).

What you'll get

  • Uncapped earnings. High, realistic OTEs with uncapped commission.

  • Real ownership: employee-owned company; choose annually to take variable compensation in cash or shares.

jobs.excerpt: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!
jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with regular visits to customers across the DACH region.

Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by BLP.

Your Career Path in AI Transformation Consulting

Our AI Transformation Consulting team has a clear path, and we hire at every step of it. We place you according to your experience and the impact you have had, and we are explicit about what the next step requires.

  • AI Automation Specialist: Hands-on in the automation itself: you tune agents, run automation sprints and take on your first customers end to end. Typically you bring up to 2 years of experience.

  • AI Transformation Consultant: You own a portfolio of live customers as their run lead, including health, growth and account economics. Typically you bring 3+ years in transformation consulting, process improvement or ERP process ownership.

  • Principal AI Transformation Consultant: Our most complex and sensitive accounts, at executive level, and you coach the consultants and specialists around you. Typically you bring several years of leading process change at customers.

  • Next steps: Lead an AI Transformation Consulting team, or become a Client Partner on our strategic accounts.

Moves into Project Management or Customer Success Engineering are open at every level, and many of our people make them.

Your Mission

For a process to run autonomously, four things have to line up: the technology, the process itself, the data behind it, and the people who work with it. That alignment does not happen at go-live. It happens in the months after, and that is where our AI Transformation Consulting team sits.

Our customers go live with a working solution. What they do not have on day one is an organization that operates in an AI-native way. Processes were designed around people checking things. Data was maintained well enough for humans to interpret. Teams know the old workarounds better than the new system. Our job is to lead that transition, from a process that is automated in parts to a process that genuinely runs on its own.

As a Principal AI Transformation Consultant

You take our most complex and sensitive accounts: large groups with several entities, ERP landscapes and stakeholder levels, where the move to AI-native operations is a real change program and not a configuration task. You lead that change at executive level, with CFOs, heads of shared services and process owners, and you are the person they trust to tell them what has to change on their side for automation to work.

You set the direction on your accounts and make the team around you better. You coach the AI Transformation Consultants and AI Automation Specialists who work with you, you shape how our team runs accounts, and you turn what you learn on the hardest customers into practices the whole team uses. On our strategic accounts you work side by side with the Client Partner, who carries the relationship and the commercial number.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the outcome on our most complex accounts, from go-live to high automation, and act as the final escalation point for them.

  • Lead process change at executive level: build the case, align the decision makers, and make the changes stick in the operating teams.

  • Diagnose why automation stalls across entities and processes, and set the plan that the team executes.

  • Own customer health and account economics on your accounts, and spot and shape expansion with Sales and the Client Partner.

  • Coach and develop the AI Transformation Consultants and AI Automation Specialists around you, and raise the bar on how we run accounts.

  • Feed recurring patterns back to Product and Engineering, and help shape new services and ways of working.

What We're Really Looking For

The following key attributes ensure success in this team:

  • Process Excellence: You understand core business processes, P2P and O2C, and you can see why a process is shaped the way it is and what it could look like instead.

  • Trusted Partner: You bring customers with you. You are strict on the things that matter and flexible on the things that do not.

  • Pattern Recognition: You notice that thirty exceptions are really one problem.

  • Comfort with Data: You go into the numbers yourself to find where automation is leaking.

  • Ownership: You see a job through, and you take a customer from live to high automation without being told the steps.

  • Growth Mindset: You learn fast, ask when you are stuck, and get better every month.

What You Bring

  • Master's degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • Typically 7+ years in transformation consulting, shared services or finance and supply chain operations, with several years leading process change at customers.

  • Deep, end-to-end knowledge of purchase-to-pay or order-to-cash, and a track record of changing how large finance or procurement organizations actually work.

  • Executive presence: you hold the room with a CFO, especially when the conversation is difficult.

  • Experience coaching or leading consultants.

  • Fluent in German and English, spoken and written.

  • Bonus points for experience with ERP systems, AP automation or AI-driven SaaS.

Benefits

  • High ownership environment: you shape your projects, outcomes, and career path.

  • Impact at scale: your work powers automation across global enterprises.

  • Cross-functional exposure: work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily.

  • Real growth: fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.

  • Employee ownership: be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option program.

  • Amazing team: become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

  • Technology exposure: be at the forefront of AI and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.

  • Visits & offsites: paid visits and stays at our HQ in Zurich, including collaborative team offsites.

Ready to make autonomous operations the new standard? Join us and own your impact.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Business Development Representative (Healthcare & Aesthetics)

Position type: Part-Time (with full-time opportunity)

Work hours: 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM Pacific Time

Work days: Monday to Friday

Salary: $6 - $7 per hour

Workplace: Remote

Preferred Candidate Location: El Salvador, Honduras, Colombia, Venezuela, and Philippines

Our client, a U.S.-based medical aesthetics practice, is looking for a Business Development Representative to drive patient engagement, convert inquiries into booked appointments, reactivate inactive leads, and close treatment package sales.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who thrives in sales, enjoys building relationships, and is motivated by measurable results. You'll play a key role in growing the practice by connecting with prospective and existing patients, following up on sales opportunities, and creating a welcoming, professional experience.

The ideal candidate is a proven sales closer with strong appointment-setting skills, a warm and confident phone presence, and the persistence to turn leads into paying customers.

Experience in medical spas, aesthetics, or healthcare is highly preferred, but strong sales professionals from other industries are welcome to apply. Spanish fluency is also highly preferred but not required.

The position starts at 20 hours per week, with the goal of transitioning to full-time as the practice grows. You'll receive direct training, sales scripts, and guidance to help you succeed.

Key Responsibilities

1. Lead Follow-Up, Appointment Conversion & Sales Closing (Top Priority)

  • Follow up with new inquiries and convert prospective patients into booked appointments.
  • Proactively reconnect with inactive patients, lost leads, and previous inquiries to generate new sales opportunities.
  • Conduct outbound calls and consistent follow-ups to encourage appointment bookings and treatment purchases.
  • Explain available treatments and packages using approved information and sales guidelines.
  • Confidently ask for the sale and help close treatment or package purchases.
  • Send secure payment links, monitor payment status, and follow up on outstanding deposits or purchases.
  • Maintain a warm, persuasive, and professional approach throughout the sales process.
  • Track lead conversions, appointment bookings, and sales performance against agreed goals.

2. Phone Coverage & Patient Communication (Top Priority)

  • Answer incoming and overflow calls using RingCentral.
  • Respond to patient inquiries promptly and professionally.
  • Provide accurate general information about services, appointments, and next steps.
  • Build rapport with prospective and existing patients through friendly, confident communication.
  • Direct clinical or other specialized inquiries to the appropriate staff members.
  • Document important call details and ensure timely follow-ups.

3. CRM Management & Administrative Support (Top Priority)

  • Maintain accurate patient and lead information in Aesthetic Record CRM.
  • Update lead statuses, document calls, and track follow-up activities.
  • Schedule appointments and maintain an organized practice calendar.
  • Monitor appointment readiness and coordinate necessary follow-ups.
  • Organize sales pipelines and identify leads requiring additional outreach.
  • Provide general administrative and back-office support as needed.

Sales & Lead Management

You'll work with an established database of prospective and existing patients, including:

  • Approximately 5–10 new leads per day, depending on marketing activity.
  • An existing database of approximately 1,000 contacts for follow-up and reactivation.
  • Leads generated through marketing campaigns, social media, email, and other practice channels.

You will not be responsible for sourcing or purchasing lead lists. The client provides leads through Aesthetic Record.

Outbound outreach and lead reactivation will be especially important during the initial part-time arrangement. Lead volumes may increase as marketing campaigns expand, and prompt responses to new leads will be a key priority.

Tools & Platforms

  • Aesthetic Record CRM: Lead management, patient records, appointment scheduling, and follow-up tracking. Training will be provided.
  • RingCentral: Incoming and outgoing calls, patient communication, and sales outreach.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently converting qualified inquiries into booked appointments.
  • Proactively reactivating inactive leads and generating treatment sales.
  • Following through on sales opportunities, payment links, and outstanding deposits.
  • Maintaining professional, welcoming communication with every patient.
  • Keeping CRM records, lead statuses, and follow-up activities accurate and updated.
  • Meeting agreed appointment conversion and sales performance goals.
  • Managing responsibilities independently and adapting to the practice's evolving needs.

Requirements

Required Skills & Experience

  • Proven sales experience with demonstrated closing ability.
  • Hands-on experience with appointment setting, lead follow-up, and sales conversion.
  • Experience conducting outbound calls, proactive outreach, and cold calling.
  • Ability to reactivate inactive leads and confidently pursue sales opportunities.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
  • Strong phone etiquette with a friendly, warm, persuasive, and professional approach.
  • Confidence explaining products or services, overcoming objections, and asking for the sale.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail when maintaining CRM records and tracking follow-ups.
  • Ability to manage multiple leads, prioritize opportunities, and work toward performance targets.
  • Willingness to learn the client's treatments, packages, sales scripts, and established processes.
  • Familiarity with customer confidentiality and willingness to follow HIPAA requirements.
  • Proactive, persistent, self-motivated, reliable, and comfortable working independently.
  • Willingness to transition from part-time to full-time as business needs grow.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience in medical spas, aesthetics, healthcare sales, or a related industry.
  • Familiarity with Aesthetic Record CRM or similar medical spa/aesthetics platforms.
  • Experience selling treatments, service packages, memberships, or other high-value offerings.
  • Experience managing large lead databases and reactivation campaigns.
  • Experience handling patient inquiries, appointment scheduling, and front-desk support.
  • Spanish-English bilingual proficiency is highly preferred but not required.

Candidates with strong sales closing experience from other industries are encouraged to apply. Proven sales ability and excellent English communication are more important than industry-specific experience or bilingual proficiency.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We're looking for someone who is:

  • A Confident Sales Closer: Comfortable asking for the sale, overcoming objections, and turning inquiries into paying customers.
  • Persistent & Results-Driven: Motivated to follow up consistently and convert inactive leads into new opportunities.
  • Warm & Personable: Creates a welcoming experience while building trust and rapport with prospective patients.
  • Proactive & Independent: Takes ownership of the sales pipeline and identifies opportunities without constant supervision.
  • Highly Organized: Maintains accurate CRM records, schedules, and follow-up activities.
  • Adaptable & Coachable: Learns new systems and services quickly and applies feedback effectively.
  • Reliable & Accountable: Consistently follows through on commitments and works toward agreed performance goals.

Basic Requirements

  • Must be proficient in speaking and writing clear, professional English.
  • Must have relevant sales experience, including appointment setting and closing.
  • Must be comfortable handling inbound and outbound calls.
  • Must be available Monday–Friday, 10:00 AM–2:00 PM Pacific Time.
  • Must be open to potentially increasing working hours to full-time.
  • Must be able to submit an NBI Clearance and/or Local Police Clearance before onboarding (mandatory).
  • Must be available for video meetings with camera on when required.

Technical Requirements

  • Computer: Reliable laptop or desktop computer.
  • Internet: Stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps).
  • Audio: Noise-canceling headset.
  • Video: Working webcam for virtual meetings.
  • Workspace: Quiet and professional work environment.

Benefits

  • Dedicated HR & Contractor Support Team: Access to world-class support for questions, guidance, contract matters, and client communication.
  • Premium VPN Access (Optional): A secure VPN license can be provided upon request to enhance privacy and security for client-related tasks.
  • HIPAA & Cybersecurity Training + Certification (Provided): Access to our internal HIPAA compliance training, cybersecurity modules, and certification to help you confidently handle PHI for U.S. healthcare clients.
  • Top 1% VA Performance Training: Access to our proprietary training on communication, client management, productivity systems, and best practices to help you become a top-performing VA and increase long-term client retention.
  • Client-Approved U.S. Holidays: Contractors may take U.S. holidays off according to the client’s needs and schedule.
  • Client-Approved Paid or Unpaid Time Off: Time off may be granted by your client. Paid time off is optional and only if offered by the client.
  • Access to Tools & Resources: Templates, workflow guides, productivity tools, and client-specific SOP support to help you perform at your best.
  • Optional Performance-Based Incentives: Some clients may offer bonuses, incentives, or increased hours based on your performance.

These are optional resources and client-approved allowances available to you as an independent contractor. Any resources, training, or allowances listed are optional contractor perks and not employee benefits.

Tala is the AI-native credit infrastructure that connects global capital to the global majority. Description

Physical AI for Mission Critical Operations.

Percepto is the Physical AI platform for continuous infrastructure visibility. Our mission is to give asset operators one certainty: nothing changes without them knowing first.

We orchestrate autonomous and remote data capture across drones, sensors and other systems into one continuously verified, always-current picture of every asset an operator is accountable for. Periodic inspections force operators to assume everything is fine; continuous visibility replaces assumption with certainty.

Our solutions:

• Axion – the Physical AI platform: a continuously verified model of every asset, the AI and the workflow.

• AIM – the autonomous mission control for every Percepto and third party drone and docking station.

• Ranger – the autonomous capture layer that keeps AIM's picture current without sending people into the field.

• Harbor – the autonomous station that lets Ranger fly continuously with no one on site.

Percepto holds a nationwide FAA Beyond Visual Line of Sight (BVLOS) waiver, supports EPA-aligned methane inspection workflows, and is trusted by Fortune 500 energy operators across oil and gas, electric utilities, solar and heavy industry.

Percepto is consolidating its engineering, manufacturing, assembly and remote operations center in the United States: built for American infrastructure, and increasingly built here. This role sits at the center of how we tell that story to the US market.

  • Clear communicator with operations and site-level customer teams
  • Experience in energy, utilities or industrial markets preferred

Why join Percepto

  • Shape the voice of a Physical AI company as it builds its future in the US.
  • Work on technology that keeps critical energy infrastructure safer and more reliable, and takes people out of harm's way.
  • Tell the story of a platform with real proof behind it: a nationwide FAA BVLOS waiver and Fortune 500 customers.
