jobs.description:
About the Role

Receptive is seeking a Software Engineer to build and improve the technology that connects people with mental and physical health services. You’ll support our three telehealth brands, developing software that improves how people access care and how our teams deliver it.
Reporting to the Head of Technology, you’ll work with engineering teammates and cross-functional partners to turn business and user needs into reliable, maintainable software. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys solving problems, taking ownership of their work, and delivering improvements through frequent, thoughtful iteration.
You’ll bring strong engineering fundamentals, a practical approach to automation and AI-assisted development, and an interest in understanding the people and workflows behind the code you write.

Why Join Us

Receptive is a modern digital health platform dedicated to emotional wellness, mental clarity, and holistic health. Since our founding, we have helped over one million individuals access the right care at the right time by connecting them with trusted professionals who support their mental and physical well-being.
Licensed in all 50 states and serving more than 100,000 members each year, Receptive brings together leading brands across behavioral and lifestyle health. Our portfolio includes Pettable, ADHD Advisor, and Top Nutrition Coaching, which provides evidence-based nutrition care through virtual coaching and insurance-supported programs.
Grounded in clinical excellence and a people-first mission, we empower licensed providers with the autonomy, technology, and support they need to deliver accessible, personalized care.

What You'll Do

Build and Deliver Useful Software
  • Develop, test, and ship features that support accessible digital health services across Receptive’s brands.
  • Build and maintain full-stack applications and integrations using Webflow, TypeScript, Node.js, and AWS.
  • Work with product and business partners to understand needs, clarify requirements, and turn problems into practical technical solutions.
Own Your Work from Development through Delivery
  • Take responsibility for getting agreed-upon features production-ready, from technical planning through implementation, testing, deployment, and follow-up.
  • Break work into manageable increments, communicate progress and tradeoffs, and work through roadblocks, bringing in teammates when needed to keep delivery moving.
  • Investigate bugs and production issues, address underlying causes, and improve the reliability and performance of the systems you work on.
Strengthen Engineering Quality and Ways of Working
  • Write clear, maintainable code and review pull requests to identify defects, surface risks, and maintain consistency across the codebase.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, debugging, and testing while remaining accountable for the quality and security of your work.
  • Support quality assurance through automated and hands-on testing, regression checks, and clear defect documentation; verify fixes and help assess release readiness.
  • Collaborate with teammates, share knowledge, and apply appropriate security and privacy practices when working with sensitive healthcare information.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, preferably in a product or technology-enabled services company.
  • Proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js, with experience building and maintaining APIs and applications deployed on AWS.
  • Ability to work across application layers and learn the tools needed to deliver a complete solution.
  • Experience writing automated tests, performing hands-on functional and regression testing, and contributing to deployment workflows and reliable production systems.
  • Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools, with the judgment to review, test, and validate their output.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and sound judgment about scope, quality, speed, and maintainability.
  • Clear communication, collaborative working habits, and the ability to move work forward independently while seeking input when needed.
  • Experience working in a growing company where priorities and processes can shift and evolve, sometimes quickly.
  • Curiosity, openness to feedback, and a commitment to improving both your work and the way the team builds software.
What Helps You Stand Out
  • Relevant experience in healthcare tech, HIPAA, or another highly regulated industry.
  • Hands-on, working experience with Healthie, GraphQL, or Webflow.
  • Data warehousing, Snowflake, business intelligence, or reporting tools.
  • Familiarity with collaboration and project management tools such as Asana and Notion.

Where You’ll Work & What You’ll Receive

Receptive is a remote-first company.
The target base salary range for this role is $140,000-$175,000, depending on experience, expertise, internal pay equity, and other business considerations.
Full-time, US-based employees are eligible for comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage with generous employer contributions (Receptive covers 100% of the premium for an employee’s coverage), a 401k with 4% employer match, monthly wellness stipend, annual L&D budget, flexible time off, company holidays, and paid parental leave.

Success means well-supported conclusions and dependable reporting each period, with the opportunity to apply your expertise to increasingly complex leases.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

About the roleFortify Health believes in making data-driven decisions. In order to make these decisions, it is critical that we have high-quality data available to decision-makers. The Data Officer will play a critical role in ensuring an efficient data collection system, accurate data processing and transformation, and analysis of this data across the organisation. This role will work closely with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and design, implement, and maintain data systems that enable data-driven decision-making across the organization.
The Data Officer will report to Fortify Health’s Senior Data Officer.

Key Responsibilities

The Data Officer will work closely with the Quality and Program teams to strengthen Fortify Health's data systems, improve data quality, and generate reliable insights to support program implementation and decision-making. The role will involve the following responsibilities:
  1. Data Management and Infrastructure
    • Develop, maintain, and improve digital data collection systems, automated data pipelines, and data transformation workflows using tools such as SurveyCTO, Google Sheets, Airbyte, BigQuery, and dbt.
    • Ensure the availability, consistency, and usability of data across systems by maintaining data models, troubleshooting technical issues, and improving the reliability and cost-effectiveness of data infrastructure.
  2. Data Quality, Analysis, and Reporting
    • Develop data quality checks, automated validations, and monitoring mechanisms to identify discrepancies, investigate root causes, and support timely resolution of data issues.
    • Analyze program and operational data, develop dashboards and reports, and generate actionable insights to support monitoring, reporting, and decision-making across the organization.
  3. Data Governance and Process Improvement
    • Support data governance, security, access control, storage, backup, and documentation practices to ensure responsible data management and compliance with organizational policies.
    • Identify opportunities to improve data systems and streamline manual processes through data audits, automation, AI, and other relevant technologies; test potential solutions and contribute to their implementation.
  4. Collaboration and Support
    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand operational and research requirements and develop practical data solutions.
    • Provide technical support and guidance on data collection tools, reporting systems, and data interpretation, and support research and evaluation activities through data preparation, validation, and analysis.
Please note that this job description is a guide to the work you will initially be required to undertake, but does not cover all of the duties the post holder may have to perform. Responsibilities will evolve over time, in discussion with the Senior Data Officer.
If you were here right now, you would support with…
  • Premix Stock Intelligence and Predictive MonitoringTaking FH's premix stock tracking initiative further by developing analytical approaches to identify potential stockouts, ageing premix batches, and discrepancies in stock reporting across partner mills. You would explore how historical stock, production, and premix consumption data can be used to generate early warnings and support more timely procurement and dispatch decisions.
  • Data Systems Audit and Improvement Roadmap
    Building on FH's recent data systems audit, you would help prioritise and implement recommendations to address gaps in data security, access controls, auditability, and data management practices across our datasets. The project would involve working with different teams to strengthen existing systems and establish more reliable, secure, and sustainable data management processes.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Requirements
  • Expertise:
    • Bachelor's degree or higher in any relevant discipline, such as Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field. Candidates from other academic backgrounds with relevant technical skills and experience are also encouraged to apply.
    • 2+ years of experience managing the end-to-end data lifecycle, from data collection and processing to analysis and reporting.
    • Strong proficiency in advanced SQL and spreadsheet tools (Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets), including complex queries, formulas, data manipulation, and analysis.
  • Execution:
    • Able to translate requirements into structured tasks and deliver accurate, well-documented outputs within agreed timelines.
    • Demonstrates ownership, attention to detail, and consistency in completing tasks and maintaining documentation.
    • Able to plan and coordinate projects by defining actionable tasks, tracking timelines and milestones, and coordinating with relevant stakeholders to ensure timely delivery.
  • Collaboration:
    • Able to work effectively with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and develop practical data solutions.
    • Open to feedback and willing to support colleagues in using data tools and resolving data-related issues.
  • Communication:
    • Communicates technical issues, analytical findings, and progress clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writing in English.
    • Able to document workflows, explain data limitations, and present insights in an accessible manner
  • Problem-solving:
    • Demonstrates structured and analytical thinking to investigate data discrepancies, identify root causes, and develop practical solutions.
    • Able to break down complex problems, test potential solutions, and identify opportunities to improve data quality and process efficiency.
  • Growth Mindset:
    • Demonstrates curiosity and a willingness to learn new tools, technologies, and analytical techniques through hands-on practice and feedback.
    • Open to experimentation and continuous improvement, including exploring AI and automation while critically evaluating their accuracy and limitations.
Desirable attributes
  • Experience working with remote team members.
  • Experience working independently.
  • Experience working in an NGO or in the development sector.
  • Proficiency in both Hindi and English, written and spoken.
  • Enthusiasm about our opportunity to improve people’s lives.

Benefits

At Fortify Health, we’re building a team of passionate, driven individuals who want to create measurable public health impact. We believe that people thrive when they feel supported, trusted, and empowered to grow. Here’s what you can expect when you join our team:
  • Opportunities for career growth:
    • Whether you’re early in your career or bringing years of experience, we offer opportunities to take on new responsibilities, build your skills, and grow into leadership roles. We support professional development through feedback, mentorship, and learning resources.
  • Flexible work hours:
    • We understand that everyone works differently. Fortify Health offers flexible working hours to help you manage your time effectively and maintain a healthy work-life balance.
    • (This role also offers remote or hybrid work options, depending on the nature of work activities).
  • Inclusive and supportive culture:
    • We foster a collaborative and respectful work environment where diverse perspectives are valued.
    • Our team is supportive and mission-driven, united by a shared commitment to improve public health through wheat fortification.
  • Meaningful, impact-driven work:
    • Your work at Fortify Health will directly contribute to improving nutrition and health for millions of people. We focus on high-impact, evidence-based solutions, and every team member plays a role in driving our mission forward.
  • Transparent and structured systems:
    • We strive for clarity in how we work. From performance reviews to team communications, we use structured systems to ensure that expectations are clear, feedback is regular, and growth pathways are visible.
  • Learning and Development:
    • Team members have access to resources for professional development, including training, workshops, and mentorship opportunities.

This is a highly targeted, consultative sales position where you’ll manage both inbound and outbound calls, primarily engaging prospective learners in the US and other international markets. You’ll work directly with prospective learners to understand their goals, overcome objections, and guide them toward the Nexford program that best fits their career aspirations.

The role requires balancing productivity and quality: not only exceeding enrollment targets but also upholding Nexford’s standards through rigorous QA call marking during downtime. Every enrollment you secure contributes directly to Nexford’s growth, helping us expand our reach and impact.

We’re looking for exceptional sales professionals who bring end-to-end sales experience, education sales expertise, resilience, consultative-selling skills, and a passion for making a measurable difference in a high-impact EdTech environment.

  • Meaningful Impact: Help make high-quality education accessible worldwide by guiding learners to achieve their career goals with Nexford’s programs.
  • Consultative Sales: Use a targeted, consultative approach to connect with learners, meet sales goals, and optimize enrollment strategies.
  • Global Reach: Engage with learners from over 110 countries, making a tangible difference in lives across diverse communities.
  • US Market Exposure: Work directly with prospective learners in the US market and develop your experience in a global B2C sales environment.
  • Purpose-Driven Growth: Join a mission-focused startup where your contributions are valued, and participate in continuous learning to support Nexford’s vision of accessible, career-focused education.

What You'll Be Owning 🎯

  • Convert high-priority leads by understanding learners’ goals and recommending the program that best fits their needs.

jobs.description:
Join Shift Collab — Bring Accessible Therapy to Clients Across Canada

At Shift Collab, we're a women-led, award-winning collective of over 125 Registered Social Workers and Registered Psychotherapists reshaping virtual mental health care across Canada. For the past 8 years, we've partnered with Maple, Canada's premier virtual care platform, to offer true on-demand and scheduled therapy delivered from the comfort of home.

We are expanding our network with bilingual therapists who can provide psychotherapy in both English and French. This is an independent contractor role requiring flexible, week-to-week availability. On-demand support means being available for clients needing care in the moment, between 8:00 a.m. and 8:00 p.m. EST, seven days a week — on-demand availability is a meaningful part of this role.

Our Hiring Philosophy

Our organization is deeply committed to equity and diversity. We wholeheartedly welcome applications from women, members of racialized groups, visible minorities, Aboriginal persons, persons with disabilities, persons of any sexual orientation, and persons of any gender identity or gender expression. We are also committed to ensuring that each individual will have genuine, open, and unhindered access to opportunities within our company. Accommodations are available for applicants with disabilities. If you require accommodations for interviews or other meetings, please let us know.

What This Role Actually Looks Like

Through the Maple platform, you'll deliver two types of sessions each week, for a total of 6 hours of availability:

  • On-Demand Sessions: Pick up sessions between 8:00 a.m. and 8:00 p.m. EST, seven days a week, for up to 6 hours per week based on demand. Clients connect with you when they need support and you show up ready.
  • Scheduled Sessions: Allocate 6 hours per week in the Maple calendar so clients can book directly through the app at a day and time that works for them.

You'll support clients across a range of presenting concerns, including mood disorders, perfectionism, imposter syndrome, work or school stress, and life transitions.

What We Offer

We know your time is best spent with clients, not on administrative overhead. That's why we take care of the things that slow most independent practitioners down:

  • Flexible, week-to-week scheduling that works around your existing practice
  • A competitive per-session rate, shared during the interview process
  • Access to a steady stream of clients through the Maple platform
  • A supportive, women-led collective that values your clinical voice
  • Platform orientation and setup support so you can hit the ground running
  • Billing, admin, and back-office support handled for you
  • A long-term partnership with a team that takes quality care seriously
  • An accessible point of contact on our Clinical and People & Operations team throughout your time with us

Who Thrives Here

You're a strong fit if you:

  • Build rapport quickly, earn client trust, and support retention from the first session forward
  • Show up consistently for on-demand sessions alongside your scheduled hours
  • See quality care as the standard, not the ceiling
  • Bring strong clinical judgment and expertise to every session
  • Are comfortable working with clients across the lifespan, aged 14 and up
  • Want a long-term partnership built on trust, clinical autonomy, and meaningful work
  • Are looking to supplement your existing income with flexible, client-focused work
  • Are committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion in your practice

What You Bring

  • Bilingual and able to offer psychotherapy in both English and French with clinical fluency, meaning you can assess, build rapport, and deliver therapy confidently in either language (required)
  • Registered as an MSW RSW or RP in Ontario and/or Quebec, with the ability to see clients in other provinces and territories, or willingness to register in additional provinces
  • Master 's-level degree in Social Work or Psychotherapy
  • 2+ years of post-licensure experience providing individual therapy to adults
  • Minimum 6 hours of availability per week on a consistent schedule
  • Individual professional liability insurance
  • Proficiency with virtual therapy platforms and secure telehealth tools
  • Reliable internet and a private, secure workspace
  • Ability to practice independently and problem-solve without supervision
  • Adherence to program requirements and Shift Collab guidelines
  • Professional references and a Vulnerable Sector Check (required for all successful candidates)

Disclaimer

In the interest of transparency, we want to share how we use artificial intelligence in this hiring process. Shift Collab uses applicant tracking software (Workable) that may include AI-assisted features to help organize, parse, and rank applications. All hiring decisions, including screening, interviewing, and final selection, are made by members of our People & Operations team. AI is used to support our process, not to make decisions on our behalf.

Rejoignez Shift Collab — Offrez une thérapie accessible aux clients partout au Canada

Chez Shift Collab, nous sommes un collectif dirigé par des femmes, primé, regroupant plus de 125 travailleurs sociaux et psychothérapeutes agréés qui transforment les soins de santé mentale virtuels à travers le Canada. Depuis 8 ans, nous travaillons en partenariat avec Maple, la principale plateforme de soins virtuels au Canada, pour offrir une thérapie sur demande et planifiée, accessible depuis le confort du domicile.

Nous élargissons notre réseau avec des thérapeutes bilingues capables d'offrir de la psychothérapie en anglais et en français. Il s'agit d'un rôle de travailleur autonome nécessitant une disponibilité flexible, semaine après semaine. Le soutien sur demande signifie être disponible pour les clients ayant besoin de soins sur le moment, entre 8 h et 20 h HNE, sept jours sur sept — la disponibilité sur demande constitue une part importante de ce rôle.

Notre philosophie d'embauche

Notre organisation est profondément engagée envers l'équité et la diversité. Nous accueillons chaleureusement les candidatures de femmes, de membres de groupes racialisés, de minorités visibles, de personnes autochtones, de personnes en situation de handicap, de personnes de toute orientation sexuelle, ainsi que de personnes de toute identité ou expression de genre. Nous nous engageons également à garantir à chaque individu un accès véritable, ouvert et sans entrave aux opportunités au sein de notre organisation. Des mesures d'adaptation sont disponibles pour les candidats en situation de handicap. Si vous avez besoin d'accommodements pour les entretiens ou d'autres réunions, veuillez nous en informer.

À quoi ressemble vraiment ce rôle

Par l'entremise de la plateforme Maple, vous offrirez deux types de séances par semaine, pour un total de 6 heures de disponibilité :

  • Séances sur demande: Acceptez des séances entre 8 h et 20 h HNE, sept jours sur sept, jusqu'à 6 heures par semaine selon la demande. Les clients se connectent avec vous lorsqu'ils ont besoin de soutien, et vous êtes prêt à les recevoir.
  • Séances planifiées: Réservez 6 heures par semaine dans le calendrier Maple afin que les clients puissent prendre rendez-vous directement via l'application, au jour et à l'heure qui leur conviennent.

Vous accompagnerez des clients présentant diverses problématiques, notamment des troubles de l'humeur, le perfectionnisme, le syndrome de l'imposteur, le stress lié au travail ou aux études, et les transitions de vie.

Ce que nous offrons

Nous savons que votre temps est mieux utilisé auprès des clients, et non dans les tâches administratives. C'est pourquoi nous prenons en charge ce qui ralentit la plupart des praticiens indépendants:

  • Une planification flexible, semaine après semaine, qui s'adapte à votre pratique existante
  • Un taux par séance compétitif, communiqué lors du processus d'entretien
  • Un accès à un flux constant de clients via la plateforme Maple
  • Un collectif solidaire dirigé par des femmes qui valorise votre voix clinique
  • Un soutien pour l'orientation et la configuration de la plateforme afin que vous soyez opérationnel rapidement
  • La facturation, l'administration et le soutien administratif pris en charge pour vous
  • Un partenariat à long terme avec une équipe qui prend la qualité des soins au sérieux
  • Un point de contact accessible au sein de notre équipe Ressources humaines et opérations tout au long de votre collaboration avec nous

Qui s'épanouit ici

Vous êtes un bon candidat si vous :

  • Créez rapidement des liens, gagnez la confiance des clients et favorisez la fidélisation dès la première séance
  • Êtes présent de façon constante pour les séances sur demande en parallèle de vos heures planifiées
  • Considérez la qualité des soins comme la norme, et non comme le plafond
  • Apportez un jugement clinique solide et une expertise à chaque séance
  • Êtes à l'aise pour travailler avec des clients de tous âges, à partir de 14 ans
  • Souhaitez un partenariat à long terme fondé sur la confiance, l'autonomie clinique et un travail porteur de sens
  • Cherchez à compléter votre revenu existant grâce à un travail flexible axé sur les clients
  • Êtes engagé envers la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion dans votre pratique

Ce que vous apportez

  • Être bilingue et capable d’offrir de la psychothérapie en anglais et en français avec une aisance clinique, c’est-à-dire évaluer, créer un lien thérapeutique et intervenir avec confiance dans les deux langues (obligatoire)
  • Être inscrit en tant que TSI (travailleur social inscrit) ou psychothérapeute agréé (PA) en Ontario et/ou au Québec, avec la capacité de voir des clients dans d'autres provinces et territoires, ou la volonté de s'inscrire dans des provinces supplémentaires
  • Détenir une maîtrise en travail social ou en psychothérapie
  • Avoir 2 ans ou plus d'expérience post-accréditation en thérapie individuelle auprès d'adultes
  • Avoir une disponibilité minimale de 6 heures par semaine selon un horaire régulier
  • Détenir une assurance responsabilité professionnelle individuelle
  • Maîtriser les plateformes de thérapie virtuelle et les outils sécurisés de télésanté
  • Disposer d'une connexion Internet fiable et d'un espace de travail privé et sécurisé
  • Être capable de pratiquer de manière autonome et de résoudre des problèmes sans supervision
  • Respecter les exigences du programme et les lignes directrices de Shift Collab
  • Fournir des références professionnelles et une vérification du secteur vulnérable (obligatoire pour tous les candidats retenus)

Avis de transparence

Dans un souci de transparence, nous souhaitons vous informer de la façon dont nous utilisons l'intelligence artificielle dans ce processus d'embauche. Shift Collab utilise un logiciel de suivi des candidatures (Workable) qui peut inclure des fonctionnalités assistées par l'IA pour aider à organiser, analyser et classer les candidatures. Toutes les décisions d'embauche, y compris la présélection, les entretiens et la sélection finale, sont prises par des membres de notre équipe Ressources humaines et opérations. L'IA est utilisée pour soutenir notre processus, et non pour prendre des décisions en notre nom.

About OSS

Oxbridge Summer Scholars(OSS) runs two-week residential summer and winter programmes in Oxford and Cambridge colleges for students aged 14 to 18. Students explore their chosen stream, build university-study skills and experience Oxbridge life through rigorous lectures, seminars and tutorials. Each student writes an essay and receives detailed individual feedback from a subject specialist; the strongest essays earn Excellence Awards.

Role Purpose

We are seeking a Business, Economics & Entrepreneurship Academic Consultant to join our team. This is a subject-matter specialist who provides expert academic input into the OSS Science, Innovation & Technology Stream. This stream focuses specifically on Business, Economics, Entrepreneurship and Management.

Working alongside the Academic Curriculum Manager and Head of Programme, the Consultant supports the development, review and continuous improvement of Stream content. The Consultant does not own curriculum development; their role is to provide specialist expertise, quality assurance and assessment support to ensure that the programme reflects appropriate academic standards, current developments and expectations relevant to pre-university study.

A key responsibility is to assess student essays and provide detailed, individualised academic feedback, contributing to both the educational value of the programme and the quality of the student experience.

Engagement

Location: Fully remote. No travel to Oxford or Cambridge is required.

  • Outside programme dates: Up to 10 hours per week, on an on-demand basis, depending on programme development requirements.

  • During programme dates and the following week: Up to 30 hours in total, primarily dedicated to student essay assessment and feedback. Essay submission deadlines and expected workload will be communicated in advance.

OSS Programme Dates for 2026/27

  • December 6-19, 2026

  • July 4-17, 2027

  • July 18-31, 2027

  • August 1-14, 2027

Responsibilities

1. Subject-Matter Consultation & Content Development

  • Provide expert advice to the Academic Curriculum Manager and Head of Programme on the academic content of the Business, Economics & Entrepreneurship Stream.

  • Advise on appropriate topics, concepts, theories, case studies and current developments across business, economics, management and entrepreneurship.

  • Recommend subject-specific approaches and academic skills that would be valuable for students preparing for university-level study.

  • Review proposed content and suggest improvements where specialist expertise would strengthen the programme.

2. Academic Quality Assurance

  • Review selected lectures, seminars, tutorials, learning materials and other academic content from a subject-specialist perspective.

  • Check content for academic accuracy, relevance, appropriate depth and level.

  • Identify gaps, inaccuracies or areas requiring clarification or further development.

  • Support the Academic Curriculum Manager and Head of Programme in maintaining a high and consistent academic standard across the Stream.

3. Essay & Assessment Framework

  • Provide subject-specific input into the development of essay questions and prompts.

  • Advise on the academic skills and competencies students should demonstrate, including critical thinking, analytical reasoning, evaluation of evidence, interpretation of data and application of theory to real-world contexts.

  • Help establish a clear standard for strong pre-university academic work within the Stream.

4. Essay Assessment & Individualised Feedback

  • Assess student essays according to the agreed Stream-specific criteria.

  • Within 24 hours of the essay submission deadline (2pm on Wednesday of the second week for each programme), review all essays and nominate those that merit an Excellence Award. Expected workload will be communicated in advance.

  • Provide detailed, constructive and individualised written feedback, highlighting strengths, areas for development and practical recommendations for improvement. Return this within five working days of the programme finishing.

Consultants complete a first review of essays, nominating those that merit an Excellence Award, by 2pm on Thursday 15 July. Their full written feedback for each essay is due by 5pm Friday 23 July.

Desirable

About SANS

Founded in 1989, SANS Institute (SANS) began as a cooperative research and education organization. Over the next 25 years, it grew to become the most trusted and widely recognized provider of information security training and certification in the world. Today, SANS has served more than 300,000 cybersecurity professionals around the world, with more than 60,000 earning Global Information Assurance Certification (GIAC) security certifications—the leading certification that provides assurance to employers that their people and prospective hires can do the job.

At the heart of SANS is a community of practitioners, from auditors and network administrators to CISOs, who share their lessons learned and collaborate on solutions to the challenges they face. These experts, working across corporations, government agencies, and universities, come together to support and strengthen the global information security community.

Why SANS?

At SANS, our culture is defined by three pillars: Mission, Brand, and People.

  • Our Mission is to hire people who understand the importance fighting against cybersecurity threats.
  • Our Brand reflects a commitment to delivering the highest quality training.
  • Our People are grounded in a culture of fairness, honesty, customer focus, and a pragmatic approach.

What You’ll Achieve at SANS

We are seeking a Technical Director, ISC to join our Mission team. This role will be responsible for leading ISC operations and guiding its next chapter. In this role, you will oversee day-to-day operations, steward the contributor community, and serve as a trusted public voice and resource for practitioners, researchers, and organizations worldwide.

The SANS Internet Storm Center (ISC) is a community-driven cyber threat detection network that serves as an early warning system for the global cybersecurity community. Built on data and analysis contributed by volunteers and sensors around the world, the ISC helps defenders everywhere understand emerging threats and respond with confidence.

As a Technical Director, ISC, you will:

ISC Leadership

  • Direct the operations and strategic development of the SANS Internet Storm Center (ISC).
  • Oversee the infrastructure supporting ISC data collection, including honeypot networks and associated systems.
  • Oversee and collaborate on research projects, which may involve working with SANS subject matter experts and SANS staff.
  • Oversee the ISC website and supporting technical platforms.
  • Guide the ongoing development and maintenance of honeypot software used by both the Internet Storm Center and institutional programs.
  • Coordinate the daily publication schedule and contributions from ISC volunteer handlers.
  • Oversee students interns for ISC from SANS.edu
  • Produce technical analyses and content for ISC publications as needed.
  • Serve as the primary media contact for the Internet Storm Center.

Cybersecurity Thought Leadership

  • Host or contribute to the Internet Storm Center Daily Podcast.
  • Contribute technical content and analysis to SANS NewsBites and @Risk newsletters.
  • Maintain vulnerability intelligence systems used to identify, prioritize, and communicate emerging cybersecurity threats.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

What We’re Looking For

Every SANS employee brings something unique. For this role, we’re looking for candidates with:

  • Demonstrated expertise in cybersecurity research, threat intelligence, or security operations.
  • Experience mentoring student research and supervising faculty or technical professionals.
  • Strong technical background in cybersecurity, including applied security research and incident response.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience producing technical publications for professional audiences.
  • Demonstrated leadership in the cybersecurity community through research, publications, presentations, or other recognized contributions.
  • Unrestricted authorization to work in the USA; visa sponsorship is not available.

Benefits and Perks of Working at SANS

We’re committed to fair and equitable compensation. The expected base salary range for this position is $175,000–$200,000, depending on geographic location, skills, and experience. This position is also eligible for a bonus. At SANS, we are committed to pay equity and transparency.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports your total well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

  • Financial Benefits: Competitive base salary, bonus opportunities, and a 401(k) plan with company match.
  • Health & Wellness: Robust medical, dental, and vision plans; company-provided short term disability; optional long-term disability, supplemental life and AD&D insurance for employees and dependents; voluntary benefits including accident insurance and identity theft protection; fitness and wellness programs; and a company paid employee assistance program (EAP).
  • Time Off & Flexibility: Generous paid time off, including volunteer time.
  • Learning & Development: Access to professional development and SANS training opportunities.

Flexibility and Balance at SANS

We support our colleagues with the tools and flexibility they need to thrive, both professionally and personally. As a primarily remote work environment, we are committed to maintaining strong connections, collaboration, and a vibrant culture across virtual teams. While most roles operate remotely, some positions may require occasional in-person presence depending on role-specific or business needs.

An overview of this role

Support Engineering at GitLab believes that healthy teams deliver a healthy customer experience, and that command during a crisis shouldn't fall to whoever happens to be senior and available. GitLab's global Incident & Escalation Management (IM/EM) function coordinates critical incidents, complex multi-team engagements, and executive-level escalations for enterprise customers. What you'll do

  • Coordinate with Incident Managers during concurrent technical incidents to maintain a single, coherent narrative for the customer.
  • Own external escalation communications using GitLab's approved templates and cadence, and represent GitLab in high-stakes customer conversations where clarity and ownership influence retention.
  • Engage Sales, Customer Success, and executive stakeholders as needed, including executive-to-executive communication for Severity 1 and 2 events. Brief GitLab leadership with concise summaries that distinguish what's known, what's unknown, and next steps.
  • Lead post-escalation reviews and relationship repair plans, contribute corrective actions with named owners and due dates to postmortems, and hand the relationship back to the account's Customer Success Manager at resolution.
  • Partner with the Head of IM/EM to develop playbooks, communication templates, and process improvements based on patterns from escalations.

  • Experience in enterprise technical support, customer success, or incident and escalation management at a business-to-business software-as-a-service or enterprise software company.

We operate a follow-the-sun model anchored in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East and Africa, and Asia-Pacific, providing year-round, 24-hour coverage for enterprise customers. Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Responsibilities

Peraton is looking for a Senior Cloud Security Engineer to lead proactive threat hunting, vulnerability analysis, and remediation in support of a multi-cloud environment with 70+ customer tenants and growing. Aside from technical qualifications, the applicant should have effective communication skills, both written and verbal.

The applicant must have hands-on security experience across multiple cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI) and expertise with Qualys and Tenable for vulnerability management. This role goes beyond scanning: the engineer will form and test threat hypotheses, correlate vulnerability, configuration, and log data to find active or likely compromise, and drive findings through to verified remediation. An investigative mindset, strong analytical skills, and attention to detail are prerequisites for this position.

The Senior Security Engineer will collaborate closely with our customers, internal engineering and patching teams, and ISSOs/ISSMs to ensure threats are identified early, risk is prioritized accurately, and remediation is completed and documented.

Location: Remote (but must reside and perform all work within the United States)

Work hours: This position requires working online from 8:00 AM Eastern to 5:00 PM Eastern

Day to Day Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Plan and conduct hypothesis-driven threat hunts across AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI environments, using threat intelligence and the MITRE ATT&CK framework to identify adversary activity that automated tools have not detected
  • Analyze cloud-native telemetry (AWS CloudTrail and GuardDuty, Microsoft Defender for Cloud and Azure Monitor, Google Security Command Center, OCI Cloud Guard and Audit logs) alongside SIEM data to investigate suspicious activity
  • Administer and optimize Qualys and Tenable (Tenable.io/Tenable.sc/Nessus) scanning across all cloud tenants, including scan policies, agent and connector deployment, asset coverage, and credentialed scanning
  • Analyze vulnerability and configuration findings, eliminate false positives, and prioritize remediation by exploitability, asset criticality, and exposure, including CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV)
  • Lead remediation of identified threats and vulnerabilities, working with engineering and patching teams to patch, harden, or apply compensating controls, and verify closure through rescanning
  • Identify and remediate cloud misconfigurations, excessive IAM permissions, exposed services, and STIG/CIS benchmark deviations
  • Develop and tune detection rules, queries, and automated hunt playbooks so successful hunts become repeatable detections
  • Support incident response as a senior technical resource, including scoping, containment recommendations, and root cause analysis
  • Produce hunt reports, remediation tracking, and POA&M inputs, and brief findings and risk to customers, ISSOs/ISSMs, and leadership
  • Mentor junior security engineers in threat hunting techniques, vulnerability analysis, and tool usage

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree and 12 years of experience or a Masters degree and 10 years of experience or an Associates degree and 14 years of experience or a High School diploma/eqivalent and 16 years of experience.
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain/maintain a DHS Public Trust.
  • 8+ years of experience in information security, including 5+ years in cloud security engineering
  • Hands-on security experience in at least three of the following cloud platforms: AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI
  • Expertise with Qualys (VMDR, Cloud Agent, Policy Compliance) and Tenable (Tenable.io, Tenable.sc, Nessus) for vulnerability scanning, analysis, and reporting
  • Demonstrated experience conducting threat hunts and investigations using the MITRE ATT&CK framework
  • Proficiency writing queries and analyzing logs in a SIEM or log platform (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Elastic, or equivalent)
  • Experience remediating vulnerabilities and misconfigurations on Windows and Linux systems, containers, and cloud-native services
  • In-depth understanding of cloud identity and access management, network security, encryption, and logging architecture
  • Scripting or automation experience in Python, PowerShell, or Bash, and familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible)
  • Working knowledge of STIGs, CIS Benchmarks, and NIST 800-53 controls

Preferred Qualifications:

  • One or more relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, GCIH, GCTI, GCFA, AWS Certified Security - Specialty, Microsoft AZ-500, or Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer

Target Salary Range

$135,000 - $216,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

jobs.excerpt: Specialty Care Patient Engagement helps patients and caregivers understand their disease, have informed conversations with their healthcare providers about treatment options, and stay appropriately on therapy.
jobs.description:
Specialty Care Patient Engagement helps patients and caregivers understand their disease, have informed conversations with their healthcare providers about treatment options, and stay appropriately on therapy. This means engaging patients as appropriate throughout their treatment journey — from diagnosis and treatment initiation through ongoing management — with support tailored to what they need at each stage. Patient Engagement supports patients across Sickle Cell Disease, Alopecia Areata, ATTR-CM, Immunoglobulin (Ig) therapies, and Hemophilia, conditions that carry distinct clinical, emotional, and access challenges. This role sits at the intersection of patient needs and commercial strategy, with the opportunity to raise the bar for how patients are supported across specialty care


Why This Role Matters

Go-To-Market (GTM) Excellence is the connective tissue ensuring Patient Engagement strategy is aligned with brand strategy and translates into effective execution — and that execution data flows back to refine strategy over time. In partnership with Marketing and other functions, this role ensures the team has the right processes, tools, playbooks, and governance to execute with excellence, and continuously evolves those capabilities to keep pace with patient needs.

This person will work cross-functionally with Marketing, Patient Solutions leadership, Patient Solutions Enablement, Legal, Compliance, and other functions to operationalize strategy into scalable, compliant, and measurable Patient Engagement execution — including the go-to-market and launch plans that stand-up new patient engagement models and programs, and accelerate or evolve existing ones to better meet patient needs. This role will report to the Specialty Care Patient Engagement Enablement Team Lead.


Key Responsibilities

Strategy Translation & Go-To-Market Planning

  • Partner with Patient Engagement leadership and brand/marketing leads to translate strategy into actionable go-to-market plans, including segmentation, targeting, channel mix, field execution, and program sequencing
  • Build go-to-market plans that both launch new Patient Engagement programs and capabilities and evolve or accelerate existing ones, including timelines, milestones, and cross-functional readiness criteria
  • Tailor GTM frameworks to each phase of the program lifecycle (pre-launch, launch, growth, maturity), driving the cross-functional action items and deliverables required for field execution

Content Operations, Marketing Partnership & Review Committee (RC)

  • Work with Marketing to develop, evolve, and maintain appropriate internal and customer- and patient-facing resources, including SOPs, call guides, guardrails, training materials, and patient education collateral
  • Represent Patient Engagement in the Review Committee (RC)/MLR process, partnering with Marketing to clearly present resources, their intended use, and the supporting rationale needed to accelerate review
  • Submit resources for Review Committee (RC) review as needed, ensuring materials are complete and positioned for efficient approval
  • Partner with Legal and Compliance to obtain necessary permissions and to develop, approve, and maintain SOPs, call guides, guardrails, and supporting documentation
  • Ensure approved resources are properly loaded, tagged, and available across content and resource platforms (e.g., the Amplify platform/Centris) and confirm materials are current, findable, and ready for field and patient-facing use

Targeting & Segmentation

  • Own or co-own the development of customer/account and patient population targeting models in partnership with IIS, Enablement and Patient Engagement Leadership
  • Work with the Enablement team and Marketing to build and maintain segmentation and tiering criteria (e.g., Tier 1/2/3 HCPs, patient support needs) to prioritize field engagement
  • Ensure targeting stays aligned with approved indications and compliance guardrails

Channel & Field Execution

  • Lead core operational work including territory mapping, workload analysis and alignment recommendations
  • Design territory alignment, call planning, and multichannel engagement models (field, digital, patient support, peer-to-peer)
  • Monitor field force effectiveness and ensure patient-facing teams are equipped with the right approved tools and materials
  • Accelerate and streamline ways of working between Patient Engagement field roles and other customer-facing teams (Sales, KADs, Medical, Access and Reimbursement etc.) to close coordination gaps and improve the end-to-end customer and patient experience
  • Support meeting planning, including Year Beginning, Mid-Year and POA meetings

Analytics & Performance Management

  • Serve as a strategic thought partner with the Patient Solutions Enablement team, IIS, and other enablement roles on KPIs, metrics, reporting dashboards, field technology, and related tools, ensuring they are fit for purpose and consistently defined
  • Partner with IIS and enablement teams to shape dashboard and reporting requirements that track targeting effectiveness, channel performance, and program productivity
  • Deliver regular insights to Patient Engagement Leadership and marketing, recommending strategy or execution adjustments based on performance data
  • Partner with the Patient Solutions Enablement team to translate execution into a clear strategic narrative for leadership and brand marketing — connecting performance against strategy, tactics, and KPIs

Cross-Functional Governance & Enablement

  • Partner with GCET to develop Patient Engagement team competencies and equip leaders to coach effectively against them
  • Serve as a key liaison across Marketing, Sales, Patient Solutions, Medical, Legal, Compliance, Digital, and other functions to ensure aligned, compliant, and efficient GTM execution
  • Create internal training resources and partner with Marketing and Training to ensure effective pull-through of tactical plans
  • Support training and enablement to ensure Patient Engagement field teams understand and adopt GTM tools and processes
  • Update and maintain Patient Engagement scope and guiding principles to reflect role evolution and ongoing alignment across Patient Engagement leadership, Marketing, Legal, and Compliance

Qualifications

Must-Have

  • 8 + years of combined pharmaceutical experience across consumer marketing, operations, and strategy, with a demonstrated track record of leadership and high performance
  • Experience leading others in a matrix organization, with the ability to manage direct and indirect reports with authority
  • Ability to influence key stakeholders internally and externally, with proven executive communication skills and leadership qualities
  • Forward-looking and results-oriented, with effective planning, prioritization, and organizational project skills
  • Strong, proven project management skills, demonstrating the ability to deliver multiple time-horizon-focused projects simultaneously in the short term and long term
  • Track record of leading and managing complex programs and teams to deliver improved outcomes
  • Strong strategic skills, including effectiveness in identifying and addressing major strategic challenges (e.g., shifting market environment) and the ability to balance short-term needs with long-term vision
  • Strong interpersonal skills, as well as excellent written, verbal communication, and presentation skills to address leadership and external audiences
  • Good judgment and high ethics are a must

What Success Looks Like

  • Meeting or exceeding key Patient Engagement KPIs and measurements of success
  • Faster, more predictable MLR/RC review cycles with fewer bottlenecks and faster approvals of internal and external resources
  • Well-executed go-to-market and launch plans for Patient Engagement programs and models
  • Targeting models that measurably improve field and program productivity
  • Clear, data-backed feedback loops between field execution and Patient Engagement/brand strategy
  • Strong adoption of GTM tools and processes across Patient Engagement teams

Other Job Details

  • Non-Standard Work Requirements:25% Travel

    We are on a mission to change how the world approaches digital analytics, and that requires exceptional people, strong leadership and a culture where performance and accountability matter.

    We are also operating in a period of significant change. How we work, the capabilities we need and the expectations of our teams are evolving. We need someone who can help leaders navigate uncertainty, make difficult decisions, bring people through change and create an environment where high performance can thrive.

    • High-performance culture: Strengthening accountability, leadership capability and performance standards across our global teams.

Together, we are building a future of health that is better and more accessible for all.

To learn more about Care Access, visit .

How This Role Makes a Difference

The Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer is responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of software applications that support clinical research and participant pre-screening operations. This position collaborates with cross-functional product development teams to develop, execute, and maintain comprehensive manual and automated testing strategies, with a strong emphasis on end-to-end test automation using Playwright. The QA Engineer identifies, documents, and helps resolve software defects throughout the development lifecycle, contributing to the delivery of high-quality, compliant, and reliable software solutions that support organizational objectives and enhance the user experience.

How You'll Make An Impact

  • Design, build, and maintain automated end-to-end test suites using Playwright across web and API surfaces.
  • Perform exploratory and structured manual testing on complex user flows, edge cases, and regression scenarios.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to enable fast, reliable feedback on every pull request.
  • Collaborate closely with engineers and designers during development to shift quality left, writing tests alongside features, not after.
  • Triage, reproduce, and document bugs with clear steps and context that accelerate resolution.
  • Contribute to and improve QA processes, standards, and tooling across the engineering organization.
  • Participate in test planning, sprint ceremonies, and release readiness reviews.

The Expertise Required

  • Strong proficiency with Playwright (or a comparable framework like Cypress or Puppeteer) and the ability to write maintainable, reliable tests.
  • Solid manual testing instincts: you know when to automate and when hands-on exploration surfaces more value.

jobs.title: Psychotherapeut // online
jobs.excerpt: LMcare gaat de strijd aan met de wachtlijsten in de GGZ.
jobs.description:
LMcare gaat de strijd aan met de wachtlijsten in de GGZ. Dankzij onze succesvolle FIT-behandelmethode, kunnen we de wachtlijsten kort houden. Met een doorverwijzing van de huisarts kunnen cliënten de volgende dag al een afspraak plannen met onze triageverpleegkundige. Hierop volgt een kort, intensief traject via videobellen. Alles via een beveiligde verbinding in onze app, volledig vergoed door de zorgverzekeraar.

Psychotherapeut bij LMcare

Voor een cliënt is een flexibele agenda fijn, maar voor jou als behandelaar ook. Jij bepaalt hoeveel cliënten je behandelt en wanneer je dat doet. Zo heb je de regie over je eigen work/life balance. Werken vanuit Bali, Turkije, Colombia of Italië? Fantastisch! Het enige wat je écht nodig hebt is een stabiele internetverbinding en een rustige werkplek.

Wat voor ons telt, is dat je voldoening uit je werk haalt en blij wordt van het bieden van de best mogelijke hulp aan mensen.

Behandelen volgens FIT-method, uniek in Nederland.

Wetenschappelijk onderzoek bewijst het succes van meerdere behandelsessies per week. Als behandelgesprekken elkaar snel opvolgen, blijven informatie, inzichten en oefeningen beter hangen bij cliënten. Dit werkt ontzettend motiverend voor de cliënt én de behandelaar.

Bij LMcare behandelen we daarom succesvol volgens onze zelf ontwikkelde FIT-method. FIT staat voor Frequent, Intensive Therapy. Door onze ervaring met de FIT-method, weten we dat een sGGZ-traject bij LMcare gemiddeld binnen 4 maanden succesvol afgerond kan zijn. Terwijl het landelijk gemiddelde op 8 maanden ligt. Hiermee versnellen we de doorstroom van cliënten en dragen we ons steentje bij aan het verkorten van de wachtlijsten.

Werken waar én wanneer je wilt

  • Cliënten behandel je online via je computer, tablet of smartphone;

  • Kleine, overzichtelijke caseload en daardoor sterke therapeutische link;

  • MDO’s met medebehandelaars doen we ook online;

  • LMcare Academy: ons kennisinstituut over de do's & don'ts van online behandelen in de GGZ;

  • Maandelijks werkoverleg + lunch & learn sessies met het hele team.

Naast online werken, zien we elkaar ook fysiek met de jaarlijkse studiereis (Stockholm, Scheveningen, Brussel, Berlijn, Parijs), studiedagen en spontane borrels!

Zorg voor onze collega's

Bij LMcare ben jij als behandelaar onze topprioriteit. Samen bepalen we per maand hoeveel uren jij gaat werken. Deze uren zet je in onze gedeelde agenda. Overdag, of liever ’s avonds wanneer de kinderen slapen? Alles is mogelijk. De cliënt boekt een intake in overleg met de triagist en de vervolgafspraken plannen jullie vervolgens samen in.

Minimale vereisten

Uiteraard willen we de kwaliteit van onze zorg op hoog niveau aanbieden. Daarom stellen we een aantal belangrijke eisen aan jou als Psychotherapeut:

  • Opleiding tot psycholoog (WO)

  • Aantoonbaar CGT- en/of EMDR kennis

  • Minstens 5 jaar behandelervaring in de ambulante SGGZ

  • Handigheid in het werken met digitale media

  • Aantal uur in overleg

Iets voor jou?

LMcare is een no-nonsense GGZ-instelling die psychische zorg voor volwassenen in een nieuw jasje steekt. Laagdrempelig en zonder stoffige bureaucratie. We werken volledig volgens de Wtza, schakelen snel en hebben een open bedrijfscultuur. Alle behandelaars werken op afstand vanuit verschillende landen en continenten, maar zijn een hecht team.

Werken bij de grootste online GGZ-instelling van Nederland:

  • 30 WO-basispsychologen en 30 regiebehandelaars.

  • meer dan 250 consulten per dag.

  • Reeds 3600+ cliënten behandeld.

Klinkt als iets voor jou? We maken graag kennis met je!

  • Define and refine target audiences, customer needs, journey stages, decision criteria, barriers to purchase, buying triggers, and conversion objectives for products and solutions across the security portfolio.
  • Translate business priorities and customer insights into integrated campaign briefs that establish the growth opportunity, journey hypothesis, target audience, offer, value proposition, content requirements, channel plan, seller role, measurement framework, and optimization approach.
  • Lead cross-functional planning and orchestration from strategy through launch and optimization, aligning Product Marketing, Demand Generation, ABM, Digital, Content, Creative, Marketing Operations, Partner Marketing, Sales, and Enablement around a common journey and execution plan.
  • Own the end-to-end journey strategy for priority attach motions, connecting core underlying services to relevant cybersecurity cross-sell solutions based on customer needs, architecture, lifecycle stage, risk profile, and buying signals.
  • Develop repeatable attach plays that help Lumen identify network customers with relevant security needs and guide them toward the appropriate solution, conversation, offer, or seller action.
  • Map content and customer experiences to each journey stage, identify gaps, and guide the development or adaptation of thought leadership, assessments, webpages, solution briefs, nurture content, customer stories, webinars, sales plays, and executive materials.

jobs.excerpt: At Hudl, we build great teams.  We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from.
jobs.description:
At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of the Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces.

We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

Your Role

We are seeking an Engineering Manager to lead a team of engineers focused on our Fan and Club products. You'll lead the teams that power millions of tickets sold, millions of livestreaming hours, and Club sports programs and high school athletic departments nationwide. This role requires a high level of strategic thinking, technical leadership, and management expertise to drive our mission forward.

As an Engineering Manager at Hudl, you will:

  • Lead Team-Level Strategy: Shape and drive the strategy for your teams, ensuring alignment with Hudl's overall vision. Your strategic insights will help set the direction for multiple teams and ensure we stay ahead in the market.
  • Manage and Develop Engineers: Foster a high performance, team-oriented culture by leading and mentoring engineers ranging from senior to new-to-career. You'll be responsible for developing leadership capabilities, promoting best practices, and ensuring high performance across your teams.
  • Collaborate Across Disciplines: Work closely with leaders from various disciplines to plan and deliver enhancements across your product suite. Your ability to integrate diverse perspectives will be key to driving innovation and ensuring our products meet the highest standards.
  • Drive Technical Excellence: Serve as a technical leader, guiding your teams in the development of robust, scalable solutions on the cloud. Your deep technical knowledge will be crucial in solving complex challenges and driving engineering excellence.
  • Champion Agentic/AI Engineering Practices: Drive acceleration of our software development lifecycle via impactful adoption of AI development tooling and patterns. We're investing heavily in the best tools available to dramatically increase how quickly we're able to get our products in the hands of customers.

Location

While local candidates in Lincoln, Nebraska are prioritized, we're open to remote applicants who reside in one of the following states: Alabama, Arizona, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, North Carolina, Nevada, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Wisconsin, Wyoming.

Must-Haves

  • Have extensive experience in cloud technology and building highly scalable software solutions. You should have a proven track record of designing, implementing, and maintaining cloud-based systems that can scale efficiently and handle millions of livestreams and ticket sales.
  • Demonstrate a track record of driving technical strategy and leading engineering efforts. You will have experience in setting technical direction for product areas like our Fan and Club groups and guiding your teams towards successful project outcomes, ensuring alignment with the company's strategic goals.
  • Possess strong managerial experience. You must have a background in leading engineering teams, with skills in career coaching and performance management.
  • Demonstrate an AI-forward mindset and strong bias for agentic engineering techniques. Hudl has been aggressively adopting AI coding tools and expects our engineering leaders to drive impactful and efficient adoption across their team.
  • Proven communication skills and ability to work collaboratively across disciplines and teams. Your ability to articulate ideas clearly and work effectively with various stakeholders will be crucial - you will partner with Product Management and Design to ship the future of our Fan experience and Club tooling.
  • Experience in product partnership. Proven ability to partner effectively with Product Managers to shape and solidify the team's roadmap is essential.
  • Be committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. You will champion diversity and inclusion within your teams, creating a workplace where all team members feel valued and empowered to contribute.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Video processing and storage experience. If you've used tools like ffmpeg, or video livestreaming protocols like HLS, RTMP, SRT or similar, that's a plus.
  • Transaction processing and financial systems experience. We use Stripe to process transactions, Stripe Connect to power user payout and operate a financial ledger to track transactions. Experience working with end-user financial systems is a plus.
  • Professional background in TypeScript, React, GraphQL, C#, MongoDB, and AWS. Adjacent languages, frameworks and services used at scale are also relevant experiences.
  • Mobile development know-how. Hudl is heavily invested in React Native to bring our Fan experience to iOS, Android, and a variety of CTV platforms with a single codebase, so experience with React Native or mobile development (native iOS or Android) would be an asset in this role.
  • Familiarity with hybrid teams. Our engineering team is spread across the U.S. with people working both in office and remotely. If you've worked with hybrid or remote teams before, that would help you adapt more quickly to Hudl's working environment.

Our Role

  • Champion work-life harmony. We'll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time, company-wide holidays and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too. Plus, every five years, we give you a paid sabbatical to unplug and recharge.
  • Guarantee autonomy. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you'll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.
  • Encourage career growth. We're lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We'll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.
  • Provide an environment to help you succeed. We're always investing in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you're at the office or working remotely, we'll provide you the tech stack and hardware to do your best work.
  • Take care of your mental and physical health. Medical plans tailored for you and your family—including vision, dental, and fertility benefits—and stay supported with our EAP and Employee Resource Groups.
  • Contribute to your 401(K). Yep, that's free money. We'll match up to 4% of your own contribution.

Compensation

We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices.

This role will also be eligible for a long-term incentive (LTI) award. Any bonuses awarded are based on individual and company performance paid at Hudl's discretion.

jobs.title: Senior Cybersecurity Engineer | Cyber Threat Intelligence & Response
jobs.excerpt: About the opportunityOur Cyber Threat Intelligence & Response (CTIR) engineers are the people we count on when something goes wrong, and the people who make sure it goes wrong far less often.
jobs.description:
About the opportunity

Our Cyber Threat Intelligence & Response (CTIR) engineers are the people we count on when something goes wrong, and the people who make sure it goes wrong far less often. This is a hands-on incident response role. You'll lead the response to security events across our platforms and applications: triage, investigate, contain, eradicate and recover, then make sure we come out of it stronger.

We're looking for someone who genuinely loves incident response. Someone who gets calmer and sharper when an incident kicks off, who is confident making decisions when the picture isn't complete, and who doesn't wait to be told what to look at. If you're a self-starter who takes ownership from the first alert to the final report, you'll fit right in.

Some of the other responsibilities include :

  • Own incidents as part of the CTIR team: detect, triage, investigate, contain and eradicate, driving each one until the threat is under control.
  • Work live incidents alongside the team and be ready to step up and take the lead yourself when the situation calls for it.
  • Lead investigations across our systems, digging into logs, endpoints, email and network data to work out what happened, how far it reached, and how to resolve.
  • Perform host and network forensics, malware triage, and email analysis (including PDF and document analysis) to understand attacker activity and build a reliable timeline.
  • Coordinate with engineering, IT and the wider security team during a response, and communicate clearly to both technical teams and leadership.
  • Hunt proactively for threats across system logs, user behaviour and threat intelligence, turning what you find into new detections and indicators of compromise.
  • Build and automate incident response workflows and playbooks so routine response is fast and repeatable.
  • Strengthen our detection coverage using the MITRE ATT&CK framework, closing monitoring gaps, and tuning to reduce noise.
  • Feed what you learn from each incident back into how the team detects and responds, so an attack pattern we've seen once is caught faster next time.
  • Analyse threat intelligence, research emerging threats, and recommend practical mitigation.
  • Be ready to work incidents as they arise, including on-call and out-of-hours cover when needed.

For this position, you'll work fully remote. You need to be based in NZ and have full working rights for this region.

What would make me a good candidate?

We are looking for curious and empathetic people. We also love to hear from people who are motivated by meaningful work, resonate with our four core values, have a positive outlook, are comfortable with ambiguity and thrive working in an ever-evolving and complex environment. We are inspired by meeting big picture thinkers and doers, people who can be both tactical and strategic, aim high and put people first in everything they do.

  • People who want to make a real difference in security, and who care about incident response in particular.
  • 3 to 6 years experience in security operations or incident response, with genuine passion for running incidents, not just watching a queue.
  • Confidence managing incidents through the full incident-handling lifecycle, and the judgement to make sound calls under pressure.
  • Strong triage and root cause analysis, with a solid understanding of different log sources and how to correlate events across them.
  • Comfortable reading logs (HTTP, SMTP, network), Windows and Active Directory, and common operating systems and servers.
  • Hands-on experience with a SIEM to investigate, hunt and build detections. Microsoft Sentinel and KQL preferred.
  • Practical experience across EDR, advanced threat protection, identity management and API security.
  • Threat-hunting experience across network flow, user behaviour and threat intelligence, plus the ability to design new ways to detect and contain attacks using scripting, analytics and automation.
  • Familiar with a broad range of attacker tools and techniques (TTPs), with the ability to map adversary activity across the Cyber Kill Chain to identify, assess, and communicate potential attack progression.
  • A self-starter who works independently, delivering projects without being chased, and keeps learning as the industry develops.
  • A critical thinker with strong problem-solving instincts and exceptional communication skills, capable of translating complex technical risks into clear, actionable insights for both the immediate team and cross-functional partners, including engineers, administrators, and leadership, through both verbal and written communication.
  • Good understanding of ITIL processes and standards such as ISO 27001 and PCI DSS, including change, incident and problem management.

Nice to have :

  • Malware analysis experience.
  • Preferred certifications such as GCIH, GCFA, AZ-500 or SC-100.
  • Experience with Jupyter Notebooks for threat-hunting.
  • Python and PowerShell scripting.
  • Experience building and tuning SOAR automation for response.

At Xplor, we believe the best innovation and ideas happen at the intersections of our differences — across cultures, generations, disciplines, and lived experiences. So even if you do not tick every box, we still encourage you to apply.

Values and Life at Xplor

Our five core values guide us from how we hire and recognise our team members to how we interact with our customers day to day:

  • Find a better way
  • Do the right thing
  • Say it straight
  • Win together
  • Own the outcome

If these values sound like you, and describe people you want to work with, you will thrive at Xplor.
