jobs.description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Senior Business Operations Analyst in our Revenue Assurance area in Brazil! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

This role is part of the Revenue Assurance team within GPS, responsible for protecting the accuracy and integrity of Wellhub's billing and revenue flows. As a Business Operations Analyst, you'll dig into incidents across Billing, Payments, Invoicing, Identity, Notification and Fraud, tracing them back to their root cause before they turn into real revenue loss. You'll work closely with Finance, IT, and Operations, and own the day-to-day operation of our RAID tool — running discrepancy analyses and supporting other teams with it. This is a great opportunity to join a growing team that sits at the core of how Wellhub safeguards its revenue, with real visibility into cross-functional decisions and a direct, measurable impact on the business.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Incident Analysis: Conduct in-depth analysis over incidents addressed to Billing, Payments, Invoicing, Identity, Fraud & Client Master Data, identifying anomalies, providing clarifications, issue root-causes, and potential revenue estimation losses;
  • Follow up and address potential changes to the root cause of identified issues. Track the implementation of recommendations to ensure the correctness of the revenue flow and that corrective actions are executed;
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate across Billing, Payments, Invoicing, Identity, and Fraud, and leverage relationships with Finance, IT, and Operations teams to address potential revenue assurance issues;
  • Documentation: Ensure that services and billing processes are comprehensively documented. Ensure that processes, findings, analysis, and resolutions are documented for later tracking and potential pattern analysis;
  • Ensure correct Billing Assurance through the lineage from issue analysis to the Billing service (recurrences, subscriptions, upsells, etc.);
  • RAID (Revenue Assurance) Tool Operations: Operate and maintain the RAID (Revenue Assurance Integrity Driller) tool, including running discrepancy analyses and supporting other teams in its use;
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Experience in Product and Engineering agile environments, including microservices, also directly involved in IT Operations;
  • Experience with SQL technology such as PostgreSQL or MySQL;
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, both in Portuguese and English;
  • Software quality and test automation mindset;
  • Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail and pattern recognition;
  • Ability to translate complex billing/revenue issues into clear, actionable findings for both technical and non-technical stakeholders;
  • Comfortable using AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini) to speed up data analysis, documentation, and day-to-day operations;
  • Proactive and collaborative team player;
  • Knowing the internal Wellhub business workflow is a plus.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in business operations and SQL are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.

Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube!

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We’re proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here.

Questions on how we treat your personal data? See our Aviso de Privacidade para Candidatos.

jobs.title: Senior Storage Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Runware is the AI inference platform that builds and runs its own infrastructure, end to end.
jobs.description:
Runware is the AI inference platform that builds and runs its own infrastructure, end to end. Our Sonic Inference Engine has served more than 20 billion requests for over 1 million developers and 500 million end users, with 400,000+ models behind a single integration, at up to 10x lower cost per token than traditional providers.

We are now building the AI Factory that runs it. The Sonic Inference Pod packs 1 MW of custom-designed compute into a 20-foot container with closed-loop, water-free cooling, sited wherever power exists. Pods are live in the US and Europe, and we are scaling to dozens of pods and tens of thousands of GPUs, all operated as one distributed fabric that reroutes traffic the moment a pod goes offline (announcement).

Every one of those 400,000 models has to be on the right GPU, in the right pod, in seconds. Storage is what makes that possible. That is the job.

The role

As Senior Storage Engineer, you will own the storage architecture of Runware's AI supercomputer: how model weights, caches and customer data move from object storage on two continents to the NVMe and GPU memory of the node that needs them. You will design the data path, build the first version with your own hands, and set the standard for how storage is run across every pod.

This is a hands-on senior individual-contributor role. You will specify the systems, benchmark them on real hardware, find the reason a 70 GB checkpoint took four minutes to load instead of twenty seconds, and then fix it at the root so it never happens again. You will work directly with our inference engine, platform and hardware teams, with our storage and NVMe vendors, and with the site teams deploying pods.

Success means a cold model loads onto a GPU anywhere in the fleet in seconds, a new pod has its working set warm before it takes traffic, and a disk, node or whole site failing is invisible to the developer calling our API.

What you'll do

  • Own the end-to-end storage architecture for the fleet: the durable object store that holds 400,000+ models, the per-pod high-throughput tier that feeds GPUs, the node-local NVMe cache, and the replication and placement logic that ties them together across the US and Europe.
  • Design and build the model distribution path. Decide how weights get from the source of truth to a pod, how they are chunked, deduplicated, prefetched and pinned, and how a new pod warms its working set before it takes production traffic.
  • Drive model load latency down and keep it down. Profile the full path from disk to GPU memory, including the kernel, file system, NVMe-oF or RDMA transport, GPUDirect Storage and the inference engine's loader, and remove the bottleneck wherever it sits.
  • Select, benchmark and operate the storage systems themselves: parallel and distributed file systems, object storage, NVMe drives and enclosures, and the software that manages them. Validate every choice on our hardware before it ships to a pod.
  • Set and hit reliability and durability targets. Own capacity planning, monitoring, alerting, drive health and failure prediction, rebuild behaviour, backup and recovery, and on-call for the storage layer.
  • Make storage a routine part of pod bring-up: a documented, automated playbook so that the storage tier of the next 1 MW pod is provisioned, validated and warm in hours, not weeks.
  • Partner with inference engine, platform and hardware engineering so that what we design is operable at scale, and feed what you learn from production back into the next generation of servers and pods.
  • Use AI to accelerate the work: automate benchmarks, runbooks, triage and tooling with LLM-based agents, so that a very small team can run storage for a very large fleet.
  • Own data residency and the operational side of storage security: encryption at rest, access control, retention and in-country placement for sovereign deployments.

Requirements

What we're looking for

  • 8+ years in storage or systems engineering, with several of those designing and running storage at a company that operates its own hardware at scale.
  • A track record of building storage systems, not just operating what someone else built. You have taken a design from a whiteboard to petabytes in production and know what goes wrong between the two.
  • Deep, current, hands-on Linux storage expertise: the block layer, io_uring and NVMe queues, file systems such as XFS, ext4 and ZFS, the page cache, and the tools to see exactly where an I/O spends its time.
  • Real experience with at least one parallel or distributed file system in production (Lustre, WEKA, VAST, GPFS, Ceph or similar) and with S3-compatible object storage at petabyte scale.
  • Strong understanding of NVMe, NVMe-oF, RDMA transports and the networking that storage rides on. You can tell a saturated PCIe link from a slow drive from a misconfigured switch.
  • Fluent in a systems language (Go, Rust or C/C++) and Python, and comfortable writing the tooling, benchmarks and automation yourself rather than waiting for someone else to.
  • You use AI to accelerate your own output every day, for scripting, benchmarking, analysis, documentation and debugging, and you have a clear view of how a small team armed with these tools should operate differently.
  • Comfortable owning outcomes in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment, making decisions with incomplete information and being accountable for latency, durability and cost.
  • Able to travel to sites in the US and Europe as needed.

Nice to have

  • Experience feeding large GPU fleets for AI training or inference: GPUDirect Storage, NCCL-aware data loading, model weight caching and the loaders in vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM or similar engines.
  • Hands-on experience with InfiniBand or RoCE fabrics and 400G+ Ethernet from the storage side.
  • Experience with content-addressed or deduplicated storage, erasure coding, and multi-region replication and consistency trade-offs.
  • Kernel or driver contributions, or deep familiarity with SPDK, DPDK or user-space storage stacks.
  • Experience with Kubernetes CSI, Ceph or Rook on bare metal, and an automation stack such as Ansible and Terraform with Prometheus and Grafana observability.
  • Familiarity with the storage hardware supply chain: drive qualification, firmware lifecycle, enclosure and backplane design, spares and RMA economics.
  • Experience building or running storage to meet data residency, sovereignty or compliance requirements across jurisdictions.

Benefits

What we offer

  • A rare mandate: design the storage layer of an AI supercomputer from the ground up, at a company whose business depends on doing it better than anyone else, with the hardware budget and backing to match.
  • Meaningful stock options.
  • We're a remote-first collective, meeting in person twice a year to plan, brainstorm and celebrate wins. We keep core hours for collaboration and calls; outside those, you set your own schedule.
  • Our release cycles are fast and intense, and they're followed by real downtime. We expect you to take it.
  • Generous paid time off, including vacation, sick days and public holidays.
  • Paid maternity, paternity and caregiver leave.
  • Twice-yearly company retreats in inspiring locations.

Intapp is seeking a Senior Finance Operations Analyst of Sales Compensation to join our global accounting team. You will translate complex compensation plans into accurate, auditable system logic that supports our monthly payouts and accounting close.

Day to day, you will configure crediting rules, quotas, and payout calculations, test and troubleshoot the platform, build reporting and integrations, and partner with Sales Operations, IT, FP&A, Payroll, and HR to keep data accurate from opportunity through final payout. You will also help administer user access and security controls in line with ITGC and SOX requirements.




What you will do



As a Senior Finance Operations Analyst, Sales Compensation, you can expect to:


  • Lead aspects of the implementation, configuration, and ongoing administration of our ICM platform, including crediting rules, quota management, payout calculations, and reporting that supports the monthly payout and accounting close.
  • Translate compensation plan documents into accurate, auditable system logic, design and maintain workflows for plan changes, exceptions, adjustments, and special cases, and run comprehensive testing to validate accuracy before annual plans launch.

Intapp is looking for intellectually curious, self-motivated professionals who like to get hands-on to contribute to the overall success of the business and their team. To apply for this Senior Finance Operations Analyst, Sales Compensation role, you will ideally have:

A Global Crew – Collaborate with brilliant teammates across Europe, the US, and beyond

Task & Pipeline Management

SEO Specialist (Technical SEO, Ahrefs & SEMrush) – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an SEO Specialist to drive organic traffic, improve search rankings, and strengthen the technical health of high-impact websites.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role where you’ll own technical SEO, keyword strategy, content optimization, site health, link building, and performance reporting.

If you’re experienced with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and technical SEO audits and know how to turn search data into measurable growth, this role is for you.

What You’ll Own

Keyword Research & SEO Strategy

  • Conduct in-depth keyword research using:
    • SEMrush
    • Ahrefs
    • Google Keyword Planner
  • Map keywords to search intent and funnel stages.
  • Identify:
    • Ranking opportunities
    • Content gaps
    • Competitor opportunities
    • High-value search terms
  • Build SEO-driven content strategies aligned with organic growth goals.

On-Page SEO & Content Optimization

  • Optimize:
    • Meta titles and descriptions
    • H1–H3 heading structures
    • Internal linking
    • URL structures
    • Image optimization
  • Implement schema markup and structured data where applicable.
  • Conduct content audits and recommend updates, expansions, or optimization opportunities.
  • Ensure content remains both search-friendly and engaging for users.
  • Improve existing pages to increase rankings, traffic, and conversions.

Technical SEO

  • Conduct technical audits using:
    • Screaming Frog
    • Sitebulb
    • SEMrush
  • Identify and resolve:
    • Crawl errors
    • Indexing issues
    • Broken links
    • Duplicate content
    • Redirect and canonicalization issues
  • Manage:
    • XML sitemaps
    • Robots.txt
    • Canonical tags
  • Improve Core Web Vitals, page speed, mobile performance, and crawlability.
  • Work with developers to prioritize and implement technical SEO improvements.

Off-Page SEO & Link Building

  • Develop ethical, scalable link-building strategies.
  • Support backlink acquisition through:
    • Guest posting
    • PR outreach
    • Partnerships
  • Monitor backlink quality and domain authority.
  • Identify potentially harmful or low-quality backlinks and support cleanup or disavowal where appropriate.

Analytics & Reporting

  • Track:
    • Keyword rankings
    • Organic traffic
    • Search impressions
    • Conversions
    • SEO performance trends
  • Analyze performance using Google Analytics and Google Search Console.
  • Build dashboards using Looker Studio, Power BI, or similar tools.
  • Prepare weekly and monthly reports with clear insights and recommendations.
  • Use performance data to continuously refine SEO strategy.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with:
    • Content writers
    • Developers
    • Marketing teams
  • Provide SEO recommendations for:
    • Website redesigns
    • Site migrations
    • New website launches
    • Landing pages
    • Content initiatives
  • Ensure SEO requirements are incorporated into development and content workflows.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of professional SEO experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with:
    • SEMrush
    • Ahrefs
    • Screaming Frog
    • Google Analytics
    • Google Search Console
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Technical SEO
    • On-page SEO
    • Off-page SEO
    • Keyword research
    • Search intent
    • Link building
  • Experience working with CMS platforms such as:
    • WordPress
    • Webflow
    • Shopify
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to translate SEO data into actionable recommendations.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Preferred Experience

  • Proven success ranking competitive keywords.
  • Advanced technical SEO audit experience.
  • Knowledge of schema markup and structured data.
  • International or multilingual SEO experience.
  • Experience within:
    • SaaS
    • E-commerce
    • Content-driven businesses
  • Basic HTML/CSS knowledge for SEO implementation and developer collaboration.

Tools & Technology

  • SEMrush
  • Ahrefs
  • Google Analytics
  • Google Search Console
  • Google Keyword Planner
  • Screaming Frog
  • Sitebulb
  • Looker Studio
  • Power BI
  • WordPress / Webflow / Shopify

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You understand both technical SEO and content strategy.
  • You care about business outcomes, not just keyword rankings.
  • You’re comfortable diagnosing technical issues and working with developers to resolve them.
  • You use data to identify opportunities and prioritize SEO initiatives.
  • You stay current with search trends and algorithm changes.
  • You’re highly organized and disciplined with execution.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may:

  • Review organic traffic, rankings, and Search Console data.
  • Research new keyword and content opportunities.
  • Conduct technical site audits.
  • Optimize existing pages for rankings and conversions.
  • Coordinate technical fixes with developers.
  • Work with writers on SEO-focused content.
  • Review backlink profiles and link-building opportunities.
  • Analyze performance and prepare SEO reports.

In short: you keep websites technically healthy, highly visible in search, and continuously growing organic traffic and conversions.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Growth in organic traffic and search impressions.
  • Improvement in Top 3 and Page 1 keyword rankings.
  • Increased organic conversion rates.
  • Reduced technical SEO issues.
  • Improved Core Web Vitals and site performance.
  • Growth in high-quality backlinks.
  • Positive ROI from SEO initiatives.

Interview Process

  • Initial Phone Screen
  • Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  • Practical Assessment (SEO Audit or Strategy Exercise)
  • Client Interview
  • Offer & Background Verification

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it—only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re an SEO Specialist who thrives on technical optimization, keyword strategy, rankings, and organic traffic growth, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and help scale sustainable organic growth through high-impact SEO execution.

jobs.description:
Saluda Medical is a commercial‑stage medical device company focused on developing treatments for chronic neurological conditions using its novel closed‑loop neuromodulation platform. The company’s proprietary technology senses and measures neural responses to stimulation and automatically adjusts therapy based on real‑time neurophysiological feedback.

Saluda Medical’s first product, the Evoke® System, is designed to deliver known, consistent, and personalized spinal cord stimulation therapy by objectively measuring neural responses and maintaining therapy within a prescribed therapeutic window. Saluda Medical is headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota.

At Saluda, we challenge boundaries. We innovate and think beyond the conventional. Our focus is to revolutionize the standard of care in neuromodulation to positively impact patient’s lives.

Saluda Medical is a pioneer in closed-loop Spinal Cord Stimulation (SCS), developing innovative technology designed to improve outcomes for patients living with chronic pain. We are seeking a highly analytical and technically proficient Commercial Business Intelligence Analyst to join our Global Commercial Operations team. This hands-on role designs, develops, maintains, and optimizes business intelligence solutions supporting commercial performance, sales effectiveness, and strategic decision-making. The ideal candidate combines advanced Microsoft Power BI, Salesforce, SQL, data modeling, and programming expertise with strong commercial acumen and can independently manage reporting environments, integrate data, automate processes, and translate data into actionable insights.

What You’ll Do:

Business Intelligence & Power BI Development

  • Own development, maintenance, and optimization of Power BI dashboards and reporting solutions supporting Global Commercial Operations.
  • Design scalable data models, relationships, calculated measures, and advanced DAX calculations; develop Power Query transformations using M.
  • Manage Power BI Service workspaces, semantic models, scheduled refreshes, gateways, and row-level security.
  • Troubleshoot refresh failures, reporting issues, performance bottlenecks, and data inconsistencies.
  • Build interactive dashboards and automate reporting to improve efficiency, scalability, and accessibility.

Salesforce & Data Integration

  • Extract, transform, and analyze Salesforce CRM data for commercial reporting and operational decisions.
  • Maintain integrations between Salesforce, Power BI, and other enterprise data sources.
  • Work with Salesforce standard and custom objects, relationships, reporting structures, SOQL, and APIs.
  • Partner with Salesforce administrators and IT to improve data quality, integration, and reporting.
  • Support pipeline, territory, account, opportunity, and sales effectiveness reporting.

SQL, Programming & Data Management

  • Write and optimize complex SQL queries to extract, manipulate, and analyze large datasets.
  • Use Python or other programming languages to automate workflows, transform data, and support analysis.
  • Develop and maintain ETL/ELT processes, reusable datasets, scripts, and automated reporting solutions.
  • Establish data validation and reconciliation processes to ensure accuracy.
  • Improve data architecture and reporting performance; document models, business logic, scripts, and processes.

Commercial Analytics & Sales Operations

  • Develop dashboards for sales performance, revenue trends, territory productivity, and commercial effectiveness.
  • Analyze sales and clinical field team performance against KPIs and business objectives.
  • Support territory alignment, segmentation, targeting, resource allocation, compensation, incentive programs, and MBOs.
  • Evaluate pipeline performance, account penetration, productivity, and growth opportunities.
  • Support launches, strategic initiatives, commercial expansion, forecasting, and business planning.
  • Deliver accurate daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Business Insights

  • Partner with Commercial Operations, Sales Leadership, Finance, Marketing, and IT to translate requirements into scalable solutions.
  • Identify trends, risks, and opportunities through proactive analysis.
  • Create executive dashboards and presentations for leadership and other stakeholders.
  • Communicate technical findings clearly and maintain strong data governance and reporting consistency.

What You'll Bring:

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, Engineering, or related quantitative field.
  • 4–7+ years in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, Sales Operations Analytics, or related technical analytical role.
  • Experience independently developing and maintaining enterprise Power BI solutions, working with Salesforce CRM data, and integrating multiple enterprise systems.

Technical Skills - Required

  • Microsoft Power BI - Advanced: Power BI Desktop and Service; advanced DAX; Power Query/M; semantic models; performance tuning; refreshes, gateways, and security.
  • SQL - Advanced: Complex joins, aggregations, subqueries, CTEs, window functions, transformations, and query optimization.
  • Salesforce - Intermediate to Advanced: CRM data architecture, standard/custom objects, reporting, extraction, SOQL and/or APIs, and BI integration.
  • Programming & Automation: Working Python proficiency for data manipulation, scripting, process automation, and troubleshooting.
  • Additional: Advanced Excel; ETL/ELT and data integration; data quality, validation, governance, and technical documentation.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in medical devices, healthcare technology, pharmaceuticals, or a complex commercial environment.
  • Experience supporting field-based sales organizations, compensation, territory management, forecasting, and commercial KPIs.
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure SQL, Azure Data Factory, or other cloud data platforms.
  • Familiarity with QAD ERP, Power Automate, and Git/version control.
  • Experience developing executive reporting; Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) certification or equivalent.

Key Competencies:

  • Technical ownership and independent troubleshooting of business-critical reporting.
  • Analytical problem-solving, root-cause analysis, and data reconciliation.
  • Commercial acumen and ability to translate business needs into technical solutions.
  • Attention to detail, communication, initiative, accountability, and cross-functional collaboration.

Measures of Success:

  • Reliable, accurate, timely business-critical commercial reporting.
  • Effective ownership and continuous improvement of the Power BI environment.
  • Improved integration, consistency, and accessibility of Salesforce and commercial data.
  • Reduced manual reporting through automation and process optimization.
  • High confidence in data accuracy and actionable insights for commercial leadership.
  • Scalable, well-documented reporting solutions supporting growth.

Our Core Values:

  • People – Our first responsibility is to the patients we serve.
  • Integrity – Do the right thing
  • Pioneering – Lead Boldly, Change Lives, Disrupt the Status-Quo
  • Performance – Win together – Deliver with Excellence.

Saluda Medical embraces diversity and equal opportunity. We are committed to building a team representative of a variety of backgrounds, perspectives and skills. We believe people are the source of our inspiration and innovation.

Unsolicited resumes or candidate information submitted to Saluda Medical by search/recruiting agencies not already on Saluda Medical’s approved agency list shall become the property of Saluda Medical.

jobs.title: Director, Early Talent, Claude Corps
jobs.excerpt: CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country.
jobs.description:
CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 50,000 students from more than 1,000 universities. Our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. After nearly a decade of training technical talent, we launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic to prepare people for careers in AI.

We're expanding into new markets and growing our team as AI changes the workforce. People joining CodePath now will help shape this next stage of our work.

We believe technical skills create opportunities. Our goal is to train millions of learners and create lasting economic impact. If you want to build something new, take ownership, and see the results of your work, this is a place to do it.

Role Details

Location: Remote (US)
Role Type: Full-Time
Reporting to: Head of People
Compensation: $165,000 - $195,000

About Claude Corps

Claude Corps is a fellowship that places early-career talent in nonprofits, government agencies, and public-interest organizations to build AI solutions those organizations can continue using after the fellowship ends. It is a partnership between Anthropic, CodePath, and Social Finance. Fellows are full-time employees for a one-year term.

Each cohort is larger than the last, and every candidate deserves a process that feels organized, responsive, and human. That’s where you come in.

About the role

You’ll own recruiting and selection for Claude Corps, from finding candidates through accepted offers and the handoff to the teams responsible for onboarding and program delivery.

You set the recruiting plan for each cohort: how many fellows we need, when we need them, where we’ll find them, and how we’ll select them. You lead the team that makes it happen, hold the bar for who moves forward, and answer for hiring results to CodePath leadership and our partners.

You’ll partner across Marketing, Anthropic, the Claude Corps program team, and the AI Practice Leads, use data to guide decisions, and use AI to reduce repetitive work.

Key Activities

Set the plan and own the numbers

  • Build the recruiting plan for each cohort, covering fellows needed, timeline, sourcing, selection, staffing, and tools
  • Own the hiring forecast from application volume to accepted offers, with one weekly view of progress and risks
  • Adjust the plan as results come in and bring clear recommendations to leadership and partners
  • Keep program leadership and partners aligned on sourcing, selection, staffing, and progress toward hiring goals

Run selection

  • Manage selection from application review through accepted offer, using the program’s eligibility requirements and evaluation criteria
  • Train screeners and interviewers to apply the same standards as volume grows
  • Use hiring results to sharpen screening questions, review guidance, and interviews
  • Give candidates clear expectations, timely updates, and consistent follow-through from first contact to offer acceptance

Lead and grow the team

  • Lead the Senior Manager, recruiters, screeners, and coordinator
  • Set weekly priorities, shift work as deadlines tighten, and coach the team to the hiring standard
  • Develop leaders within the team and plan staffing for each cohort
  • Help the whole team use AI well in daily work, keeping people responsible for decisions that need judgment

Partner across the program

  • Work with Marketing on application volume and quality targets and on which sources produce qualified candidates
  • Set clear recruiting steps, response times, and handoffs with program partners and the onboarding team
  • Build processes that let the team handle larger cohorts with the same quality

Requirements

  • You have led early-talent or high-volume recruiting at scale, owning the hiring plan, candidate pipeline, team, and results
  • You can work backward from a hiring goal, track how candidates move through each stage, plan staffing, and explain why results differ from the plan
  • You have built new candidate pipelines and partnerships, and you can show which sources led to hires
  • You have built and led a team, including managing managers
  • You have improved selection processes, trained interviewers to apply consistent standards, and used recruiting tools and AI to handle more hiring while maintaining candidate quality

Key Success Metrics

  • Cohort hiring: Each cohort reaches its hiring target on time, with fellows who meet the program’s standards
  • Candidate pipeline and sourcing: Applications open early, and effective candidate sources are established for every cohort
  • Selection quality: Screeners apply the same criteria, and regular reviews and final-round results help the team improve
  • Offer acceptance: Offers go out on time, enough candidates accept to meet cohort goals, and the onboarding team receives complete information
  • Team development: Team members take on more responsibility, and managers are ready to lead as the program grows

Full-Time Employee Benefits

This is a remote position—work from anywhere in the US! CodePath prioritizes employee well-being with a competitive benefits package to support your health, financial security, and work-life balance.

  • Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance (90% employer-covered for employees and dependents), employer-funded healthcare reimbursement, FSAs, and Employee Assistance Program
  • Financial Security: 401(k), employer-paid life & disability insurance, and identity theft protection
  • Work-Life Balance: Generous PTO, paid holidays, 10 weeks of fully paid parental leave, and an annual year-end company closure (Dec 24 – Jan 2)
  • Professional Growth: $1,000 annual professional development stipend and home office setup support
  • Student Loan Forgiveness: CodePath is a qualifying employer for Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF), helping employees manage student loan debt
  • Additional Perks: Pet wellness plans, legal services, home/auto insurance discounts, and exclusive marketplace savings
Pay range
$165,000—$195,000 USD

jobs.excerpt: Position Type: Full-Time | Remote Working Hours: Must overlap with U.
jobs.description:
Position Type: Full-Time | Remote
Working Hours: Must overlap with U.S. Mountain Time business hours for at least 4 hours per day

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Billing Specialist to manage the full professional claims cycle in eClinicalWorks (eCW), from charge review and claim submission through payment posting, denial resolution, and final claim closure. The immediate priority for this role is clearing the $0 remit (zero-payment ERA) backlog. The ideal candidate has hands-on eCW billing experience, understands Medicare Part B professional claims, and can investigate payment issues, document findings, and move claims toward the appropriate resolution.

Key Responsibilities

Full Claims Cycle Management

  • Manage the complete claim cycle in eCW, including charge review, claim submission, clearinghouse rejections, claim status follow-up, denial management, corrected claims, and resubmissions.
  • Investigate claim issues and determine the appropriate next steps to resolve outstanding balances.
  • Prepare redeterminations and appeals while carefully tracking submission deadlines and timely filing requirements.

Payment Posting & ERA Management

  • Post ERAs and EOBs accurately, including Medicare takebacks and payer recoupments.
  • Ensure payment remittances are fully processed and never left partially posted.
  • Review 835 ERA files and interpret CARC/RARC codes to understand payment adjustments and denials.

$0 Remit Backlog Resolution

  • Investigate zero-payment remittances and identify the reason for each zero-pay outcome, including denials, recoupment offsets, deductibles, or another payer being primary.
  • Post each remit correctly and determine the appropriate next action, such as rebilling, filing an appeal, or requesting a write-off.
  • Maintain clear documentation of findings and actions taken.

Documentation & Communication

  • Maintain accurate and detailed claim notes in eCW so other team members can easily understand claim status and next steps.
  • Provide clear written updates on outstanding claims, payment issues, and resolution progress.
  • Follow established billing procedures and escalate complex issues when necessary.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Hands-on experience with eClinicalWorks (eCW) billing, including claims, payment posting, and claim status management.
  • Experience with Medicare Part B professional billing.
  • Ability to read and interpret 835 ERA files and CARC/RARC adjustment codes.
  • Experience handling denials, corrected claims, resubmissions, and appeals.
  • Strong understanding of timely filing requirements and payer follow-up procedures.
  • Strong written English communication skills for claim notes and updates.
  • Excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage billing work accurately and independently.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience working with Noridian and Medicare Jurisdiction F.
  • Familiarity with Medicare takebacks, recoupments, and zero-payment remittances.
  • Experience managing provider services billing and professional claims.

Work Arrangement & Compliance Requirements

  • Full-time remote position.
  • Must have at least 4 hours of daily overlap with U.S. Mountain Time business hours.
  • eCW access and training will be provided through secure remote access only.
  • Must complete HIPAA training and sign a business associate agreement with Pavago.
  • Must pass a background check.
  • Patient data must not be stored on personal devices.

Interview Process

  1. AI Screening
  2. Client Interview
  3. Offer Stage

En dropea queremos potenciar nuestro crecimiento orgánico.
Ya contamos con canales, contenido, recursos e iniciativas de marketing. Ahora queremos dar el siguiente paso: encontrar nuevas formas de aprovechar todo ese potencial para atraer a las personas correctas, generar conversaciones y convertir nuestra presencia digital en oportunidades reales de negocio.
Para eso, buscamos una persona freelance que combine creatividad, estrategia de contenidos y mentalidad de growth. Alguien que no solo sepa crear contenido atractivo, sino que entienda cómo utilizarlo para captar audiencias, generar interés, construir relaciones y conseguir resultados.
No buscamos un Community Manager que solamente publique. Buscamos a alguien que piense, cree, experimente y encuentre formas de crecer orgánicamente.

    •

jobs.excerpt: OverviewWe are designing the grid of the future!  The Senior Protection & Controls Engineer will provide technical expertise for protection and control engineering across EPC and private-client projects, including substations, generation facilities, BESS, data centers, industrial facilities and other large-load interconnections.
jobs.description:
Overview

We are designing the grid of the future!

The Senior Protection & Controls Engineer will provide technical expertise for protection and control engineering across EPC and private-client projects, including substations, generation facilities, BESS, data centers, industrial facilities and other large-load interconnections.

The role will lead the development and review of P&C designs from conceptual engineering through detailed design, construction and commissioning. You will work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams, EPC contractors, equipment vendors, clients and interconnecting utilities to deliver practical, constructible and reliable protection and control solutions.

The successful candidate will have a strong background in protection and control design, protective relaying, substation engineering and system studies, with the ability to lead technical execution in a fast-paced consulting and EPC environment.

Responsibilities

How you can make an impact:

  • Develop/review P&C engineering and design packages for EPC and private-client projects, including substations, data centers, generation, BESS and other large-load facilities, including one-lines, three-lines, AC/DC schematics, relay logic, wiring diagrams, interconnection diagrams and panel drawings.
  • Develop and review protection philosophies and schemes for transformers, buses, feeders, transmission lines, capacitor/reactor banks, generators and other electrical equipment.
  • Develop and review protective relay settings and coordination, including overcurrent, differential, distance, breaker-failure and communications assisted protection.
  • Perform and review short-circuit, equipment-duty and protection coordination studies required to support the design.
  • Coordinate P&C design with substation physical, electrical studies, SCADA/communications, metering, civil/structural and other engineering disciplines.
  • Review vendor drawings and equipment documentation for relays, control panels, switchgear, transformers and other protection-related equipment.
  • Support projects through construction, testing, commissioning and energization, including resolution of field issues and review of testing documentation.
  • Provide technical QA/QC and senior-level review of P&C engineering deliverables.
  • Support the development of P&C engineering standards, design practices, templates and calculation methodologies to support consistent project execution.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentoring and supervision to P&C engineers and designers and help build the department's P&C capability.
  • Identify opportunities to improve engineering quality and efficiency through standardization, automation and responsible use of AI tools.

Qualifications

Bring your passion, here's what’s needed:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering
  • Licensed Professional Engineer required
  • 8-10+ years of experience in protection and control engineering, preferably including consulting, EPC or detailed design environments.
  • Strong technical background in substation P&C design and protective relaying for MV and HV systems.
  • Experience with industry-standard protection tools and relay software such as ASPEN, CAPE, SKM, ETAP, Powerbase, SEL Quickset, and GE Enervista.
  • Experience developing and reviewing complete P&C design packages from conceptual design through IFC.
  • Strong knowledge of protective relay applications, settings and coordination.
  • Experience coordinating P&C design across multidisciplinary EPC projects.
  • Experience with data centers, BESS, generation or other large-load/industrial facilities is strongly preferred.
  • Experience with inverter-based power plants is strongly preferred.
  • Experience supporting construction, testing and commissioning is preferred.
  • Strong client-facing communication, technical leadership and teamwork skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Familiarity with applicable IEEE, ANSI, NERC and utility P&C requirements.
  • Experience leveraging AI and automation tools responsibly to improve quality, productivity and innovation

Lead the Change!

Be a part of an innovative team shaping the grid of the future through advanced energy intelligence. For more than half a century, Electric Power Engineers (EPE) has partnered with power and energy clients across the globe, providing consulting expertise and energy intelligence software solutions for complex engineering and grid modeling challenges. As leaders in the renewables space, we are focused on building a modern, secure, and resilient grid. Join us in making an impact on the communities we serve and the environment in which we live. Together we can transform the future of energy.

  • Generous PTO and paid holidays

jobs.description:
1. Role Summary

The Chief Experience Officer (CXO) is responsible for developing and executing the organization's overall experience strategy across customer, client, employee, and stakeholder touchpoints. The role focuses on building a customer-centric culture, improving service quality, strengthening customer relationships, and ensuring consistent, seamless, and positive experiences across all insurance and investment products and services.

The CXO will lead customer experience (CX), service delivery, customer engagement, and experience transformation initiatives. The position will work closely with business, operations, technology, sales, marketing, claims, underwriting, and investment teams to improve satisfaction, loyalty, retention, and long-term business performance.

2. Key Responsibilities

Customer Experience Strategy

  • Develop and implement an enterprise-wide customer experience strategy aligned with the organization's business objectives.
  • Establish a customer-first culture across insurance, investment, and financial service operations.
  • Define customer experience standards, service principles, and performance benchmarks.
  • Identify opportunities to differentiate the organization through superior customer service and engagement.

Customer Journey Management

  • Map and optimize end-to-end customer journeys across product discovery, onboarding, policy issuance, premium payments, claims, renewals, investment services, and account management.
  • Identify service gaps, customer pain points, and process inefficiencies.
  • Simplify customer interactions and reduce friction across digital and traditional service channels.
  • Ensure consistent experiences across branches, call centres, websites, mobile applications, and relationship management teams.

Customer Satisfaction and Retention

  • Develop initiatives to improve customer satisfaction, loyalty, retention, and lifetime value.
  • Monitor customer feedback, complaints, service requests, and customer sentiment.
  • Establish customer feedback mechanisms, including surveys, NPS, CSAT, and customer interviews.
  • Lead initiatives to reduce customer attrition and improve policy renewal and investment account retention rates.

Digital Experience and Innovation

  • Collaborate with technology and digital teams to improve online platforms, mobile applications, customer portals, and self-service solutions.
  • Drive digital adoption and improve accessibility of insurance and investment services.
  • Leverage customer analytics, automation, AI, and CRM platforms to personalize customer interactions.
  • Champion innovative solutions that improve customer convenience and operational efficiency.

Customer Service and Relationship Management

  • Oversee customer service standards and service excellence initiatives.
  • Ensure timely resolution of customer inquiries, complaints, claims-related concerns, and investment service requests.
  • Strengthen relationship management practices for individual, corporate, institutional, and high-net-worth clients.
  • Establish service-level agreements (SLAs) and escalation procedures across customer-facing departments.

Employee Experience and Organizational Culture

  • Develop initiatives that improve employee engagement and internal service culture.
  • Promote collaboration between departments to deliver consistent customer experiences.
  • Support employee training and development in customer service, communication, relationship management, and service excellence.
  • Align employee experience initiatives with customer experience objectives.

Governance, Risk and Compliance

  • Ensure customer experience practices comply with applicable insurance, investment, consumer protection, data privacy, and financial services regulations.
  • Work with compliance and risk teams to address customer-related regulatory concerns.
  • Promote transparent communication, fair treatment, responsible product information, and ethical customer engagement.
  • Establish processes for monitoring and resolving customer complaints and service-related risks.

Leadership and Performance Management

  • Lead and develop customer experience, customer service, and service transformation teams.
  • Establish departmental objectives, budgets, KPIs, and performance management frameworks.
  • Present customer experience performance reports and strategic recommendations to the CEO and Board.
  • Collaborate with senior executives to integrate customer experience priorities into business strategy.

3. Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Finance, Management, Customer Experience, or a related field.
  • Master's degree in Business Administration (MBA) or a relevant discipline preferred.
  • 10–15+ years of progressive experience in customer experience, customer service, operations, client relationship management, or business transformation.
  • At least 5 years in a senior leadership or executive management position.
  • Experience in insurance, banking, investment management, wealth management, financial services, or other regulated service industries.
  • Demonstrated success in developing and implementing customer experience strategies.
  • Strong knowledge of customer journey mapping, CRM platforms, customer analytics, NPS, CSAT, and service quality management.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams and large-scale service improvement initiatives.
  • Strong strategic thinking, communication, stakeholder management, and leadership capabilities.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT).

- Net Promoter Score (NPS).

  • Customer retention and policy renewal rates.
  • Customer attrition and churn reduction.
  • Customer complaint resolution time and satisfaction.

- First Contact Resolution (FCR) rate.

  • Digital channel adoption and self-service utilization.
  • Customer onboarding and service turnaround time.
  • Customer lifetime value and relationship growth.
  • Employee engagement and service culture improvement.
  • Compliance with customer service standards and regulatory requirements.

jobs.excerpt: Who is Element? We serve as a partner at the intersection of innovation and our clients' needs, efficiently crafting meaningful user experiences for government and commercial customers.
jobs.description:
Who is Element?

We serve as a partner at the intersection of innovation and our clients' needs, efficiently crafting meaningful user experiences for government and commercial customers. By breaking complex problems down into their fundamental elements, we create modern digital solutions that drive efficiency, maximize taxpayer dollars, and deliver essential outcomes that serve the people.

Why Work at Element?

Make an impact that resonates-join our vibrant team and discover how you can improve lives through digital transformation. Our talented professionals bring unparalleled energy and engagement, setting a higher standard for impactful work. Be a part of our team and shape a better future.

Position Summary

Element Solutions is looking for an experienced and problem solving Integration Engineer. The Integration Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, implementing, testing, and maintaining integrations between applications, platforms, and data systems. This role focuses on RESTful API integration, data exchange, and system interoperability to ensure reliable, secure, and efficient communication between systems.

Working collaboratively with software developers, data engineers, architects, and project stakeholders, the Integration Engineer translates technical and business requirements into effective integration solutions. The position requires hands-on experience with REST APIs, API testing, data formats, authentication methods, and troubleshooting integration issues. The ideal candidate can independently develop and support routine integrations, identify and resolve technical issues, and contribute to the reliability, scalability, and security of connected systems.

Key Responsibilities

    API Development and Integration

  • Design, develop, implement, and maintain integrations between applications, services, databases, and external systems using RESTful APIs.

  • Develop and configure API requests, endpoints, and integration workflows to support reliable data exchange between systems.

  • Implement data mapping, transformation, validation, and serialization processes to ensure compatibility between integrated platforms.

  • Work with JSON, XML, and other structured data formats to support data exchange and interoperability.

  • Integrate with internal and third-party APIs while adhering to established technical standards and interface specifications.

  • Support API versioning, backward compatibility, and integration changes as systems and requirements evolve.

  • Collaborate with development teams to resolve interface dependencies and ensure successful integration across application environments.

    • Integration Testing and Troubleshooting

  • Develop and execute integration tests to validate API functionality, data accuracy, response handling, and system interoperability.

  • Use API testing tools such as Postman or comparable tools to validate requests, responses, status codes, and error handling.

  • Troubleshoot API connectivity issues, authentication failures, data discrepancies, performance issues, and integration errors.

  • Implement appropriate logging, monitoring, retry mechanisms, and exception handling to improve integration reliability.

  • Document defects, investigate root causes, and coordinate with technical teams to implement corrective actions.

  • Support integration testing, user acceptance testing, and production deployment activities.

    • Security and Performance

  • Implement API authentication and authorization mechanisms, such as OAuth 2.0, API keys, and token-based authentication, as appropriate to the integration.

  • Follow established security practices for data transmission, credential management, access controls, and sensitive information handling.

  • Apply appropriate input validation, error handling, and secure coding practices to protect integrated systems.

  • Monitor integration performance and identify opportunities to improve response times, reliability, and scalability.

  • Support compliance with organizational, customer, and applicable regulatory requirements for data privacy and security.

    • Documentation and Collaboration

  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, including API specifications, integration workflows, data mappings, configuration details, and troubleshooting procedures.

  • Collaborate with software developers, data engineers, QA personnel, architects, and business stakeholders to define integration requirements.

  • Participate in technical design discussions, code reviews, integration planning, and deployment activities.

  • Support the maintenance and enhancement of existing integrations as business and technical requirements change.

  • Identify opportunities to automate integration processes and improve development, testing, and deployment practices.

  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or Associates degree plus two years' experience.

  • At least 3 years of professional experience in systems integration, API development, application development, or a related technical field.

  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience developing, implementing, and supporting RESTful API integrations.

  • Strong understanding of REST principles, HTTP methods, status codes, request and response structures, and API design concepts.

  • Experience working with JSON and other structured data formats, including XML where applicable.

  • Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language, such as Python, Java, JavaScript, or C#.

  • Experience testing and troubleshooting APIs using Postman, Swagger/OpenAPI tools, or comparable technologies.

  • Understanding of API authentication and authorization methods, including OAuth 2.0, API keys, or token-based authentication.

  • Experience diagnosing integration failures, validating data exchanges, and resolving technical issues across connected systems.

  • Strong analytical, communication, documentation, and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to manage assigned integration tasks independently while collaborating effectively with technical teams.

  • Must live in the Continental US.

  • Be either a US citizen or Permanent Resident due to the work we do.

  • Depending on agency requirements, you may need to possess or obtain a Public Trust designation or security clearance. Regardless of the specific requirement, all positions require the successful completion of a background check, background investigation, and the standard onboarding process.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in government contracting, healthcare CMS (Center of Medicare & Medicaid) or in the health industry.

  • Experience with API gateways, integration platforms, middleware, or enterprise service integration tools.

  • Familiarity with OpenAPI specifications and API documentation standards.

  • Experience integrating cloud-based applications and services.

  • Familiarity with message queues, event-driven architectures, or asynchronous communication patterns.

  • Experience with Git, automated testing, and CI/CD practices.

  • Understanding of database concepts, SQL, and data transformation techniques.

  • Experience working in healthcare IT, government contracting, or other environments with defined security and interoperability requirements.

Our People

Be in your Element. We are a remote first company based out of Washington, DC. As a HUBZone-certified business we are committed to supporting local economic development.

Element is an equal opportunity employer All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status, marital status, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected class.

Job Description:

The role contributes to the full software development lifecycle, including the design, development, testing, support, maintenance, and optimisation of internal applications and databases, while identifying opportunities to use AI to improve efficiency, quality, and innovation across software solutions.

In this role, you will:

  • To provide 3rd level support for all Production applications, tools and data processes.
  • Working with the New Development Manager to develop new applications, tools etc...

  • To ensure that all development is carried out according to industry best-practice standards
  • To ensure that full documentation is produced for all software
  • Architecting solutions that meet both our technical aspirations and the strategic requirements of our business

Required Qualifications:

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with good judgement and decision-making ability, able to put theory in practice to find innovative ways of resolve problems.
  • Strong C#/.NET development skills spanning both current and legacy platforms: ASP.NET Core (Razor Pages and MVC) on .NET 8 and .NET 10, and legacy ASP.NET MVC 5, Web API 2, WebForms and WinForms on .NET Framework 4.8.
  • Ability to read, maintain and help modernise legacy Visual Basic 6 and Classic ASP (VBScript) applications; experience migrating VB6/COM systems to .NET is a strong advantage.
  • Solid SQL Server experience: stored-procedure-based data access via ADO.NET/Dapper and Entity Framework Core, and comfort working without an ORM where required.
  • Experience with, or a genuine willingness to learn, containerised deployments (Docker on Linux) and AWS cloud services such as ECS Fargate, Lambda, S3, Systems Manager/Secrets Manager and CloudWatch; exposure to Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform) is a plus.

  • Understanding of XML/SOAP/REST-based B2B integrations and partner/insurer messaging protocols.
  • Knowledge of using Git/GitLab for source control, and familiarity with GitLab CI/CD pipelines

Preferred Qualifications:

  • ITIL Knowledge: Familiarity with ITIL principles, ideally at least at ITIL Foundation level.

jobs.title: Senior .NET / Blazor Engineer (LATAM)
jobs.excerpt: Lateral stands for technology excellence.  We’re a profitable, award-winning design and technology company with over 20 years of experience launching bold ventures and transforming businesses.
jobs.description:
Lateral stands for technology excellence.

We’re a profitable, award-winning design and technology company with over 20 years of experience launching bold ventures and transforming businesses. A globally distributed team of 200+ experts united by a shared purpose: the continuous pursuit of quality.

Our clients come to us for results, quality and craft - and stay because we keep raising the bar.

We Do Things Differently at Lateral

Our mission is simple: design and build great products.
What sets us apart isn’t just the talent of our team - it’s the way we work:

We Have A Bias For Action & Results.

We are doers - we spot the gaps, connect the dots, anticipate what’s around the corner and take action. We move fast, stay focused, and let the results - not the effort - speak for themselves.

We Work On Time, On Budget, On Quality

Discipline is our edge - a commitment we make to each other, to our clients, and to the standards we hold ourselves to.

We Care Deeply.

We care about our work and about each other. Care Is A Competitive Advantage.

Every detail matters. Every design, every line of code, every decision. Thoughtful by default.

We Do Things Right - Because It’s the Right Thing to Do

Right over easy. Integrity isn’t up for negotiation. We hold the bar high even when no one’s watching. We take pride in doing great work the right way - not the easy way.

We Keep Improving

The best teams keep improving and we’re never done learning.

We iterate. We reflect on what’s working and what’s not. Feedback fuels us, we receive it openly, and adapt quickly. Progress over perfection.

We’re Obsessed With Agility, Not The Agile Manifesto

We don’t chase dogma or rituals - we chase momentum. We adapt processes to fit problems, not the other way around.

We Take Ownership
Everyone leads something here. You will have room to run with ideas, and the trust to execute. That trust is built on how you show up: thinking things through, sweating the details, and following through.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with product owners and UX/design teams to convert an existing portal into a modern UI built with Blazor: shifting layouts, updating components, refreshing user flows.

  • Develop front-end features using C#/Blazor, working with UI components (especially using Syncfusion Blazor) as the primary delivery mechanism.

  • Use Visual Studio 2026 as your primary IDE to build, test and debug the UI.

  • Create and execute API request/response tests using Postman (or similar tooling) to support the front-end integration with back-end services.

  • Translate design/UX changes into technical scope: interface adjustments, component configuration, responsive behaviour, data bindings, and state management.

  • Work alongside back-end engineers to integrate UI with existing APIs and services, handle data retrieval, error conditions, and user flows.

  • Ensure code quality, maintainability, and performance: write clean, modular UI code, adopt best practices, design for reusability and future extensibility.

  • Participate in code reviews, collaborate in teams, mentor more junior UI developers, and contribute to the UI component library/code standards.

  • Focus on delivering high-quality UI experiences while meeting time-to-market demands: as we modernize the portal, you’ll help shape both execution and architecture of the UI layer.

What We’re Looking For

  • Several years (5+ years, ideally) of software development experience working in the .NET ecosystem (C#, .NET 5/6/7 or later) and hands-on experience building UI with Blazor.

  • Demonstrable experience using Blazor components (ideally including Syncfusion Blazor components) to build user interfaces, handle data binding, events, state management, and dynamic layouts.

  • Experience with Visual Studio 2026 as your primary development environment.

  • Comfortable working with Postman (or similar tools) to validate and test API endpoints which your front-end UI consumes.

  • Strong understanding of front-end technologies and UI design patterns: component-based architecture, reactivity, state management, responsive design, performance considerations.

  • Ability to translate UX/design specs into working UI code: you can take a design, understand its intent, discuss variant layouts, and build the interface accordingly.

  • Ability to collaborate with back-end engineers and product/UX stakeholders: bridging design intentions, technical constraints, and business requirements.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a commitment to high-quality user experiences.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills (English and/or Spanish preferred depending on region) and comfort working in asynchronous, remote team setups across LATAM time zones.

  • You are comfortable with change, progress over perfection, and iterating to deliver value — aligning to Lateral’s culture of doing things the right way.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Real Impact: You’ll work on meaningful products that make a measurable difference - from healthcare and commerce to sustainability and next-gen tech.

  • Remote-First, Office Friendly: Work from wherever you’re most productive - whether that’s your home, a co-working space, or one of our offices. We’re a remote-first company, but if you’re near an office, you’re welcome to drop in, collaborate in person, or work onsite regularly.

    We prioritize async collaboration, respect your time zone, and focus on outcomes over hours.

  • An Outstanding Team: Talented, kind, and hard-working people who care deeply about their craft - and about each other. No egos. No politics. Just professionals doing their best work.

  • Growth: You’ll be supported in growing your craft, exploring new paths, and stepping into greater responsibility - at your own pace

  • A Culture of Excellence: We care deeply about doing the right thing - for our clients, our team, and ourselves. No burnout. No crunch. Just high-quality work, delivered sustainably.

  • Variety & Stability: We’re profitable, independent, and over a decade strong. Yet every project brings a fresh challenge. You’ll never be bored here.

This Role Might Not Be for You

We want to respect your time by being clear about what this role isn’t. You should skip this opportunity if:

  • You prefer well defined structure. If you gravitate towards a clear hierarchy, well defined roles and swim lanes, you may find our self-managed style challenging.

  • Distributed work isn’t your thing. If you find async communication, design documentation and being proactive without a manager nearby difficult, our setup won’t suit you.

  • Feedback doesn't excite you. We’re obsessed with quality and believe in continuous improvement. That means we give feedback that’s sometimes nitpicky. If refining the work until it’s excellent feels over the top, you are likely going to find working here frustrating.

  • Change makes you uncomfortable. We’re scaling and maturing. That means not everything is perfect yet. Priorities shift. Processes evolve. If ambiguity is uncomfortable, this may feel bumpy.

However, If this sounds like fuel, we’d love to talk!

How to apply and what to expect in the interview process

01. Your work
Show us the work that reflects you at your best. We’ll look at depth, design thinking, and the logic behind your choices.

02. Lateral team fit
You’ll speak with our Talent team about your career direction, your motivators, and our plans ahead.

03. Work trial

You’ll tackle a take-home challenge that mirrors what we actually do.

04.Engineering deep dive
A collaborative session with our engineers.

05. Project fit
An interview focussed on prioritization, collaboration across disciplines, and how you handle the "messy middle".

is a general purpose AI assistant that runs locally on your devices. It gives people real control over their data and how they use AI. Benefits

jobs.description:
Omada Health is on a mission to bend the curve of chronic disease.

Job overview:

Co-Intelligent Coaching is how Omada builds the future of coaching support. AI owns the member moments that run around the clock: goal setting, food guidance, reflection, and unblocking the daily challenges that happen between sessions. That frees our human coaches to do what only they can. They build real relationships and deliver care when it matters.

We are hiring a Senior Engineering Manager to own a significant piece of Omada's Co-Intelligent Coaching. You own what gets built, in what order, and how the people building it grow.

A squad owns problems from prototype to production, including the maintenance and the on-call rotation for what it ships. At this level you own more than one, which means the hardest calls you make are the ones about where capacity goes when two good things want it at the same time.

You stay technical. You are in the codebase and in the same agent workflows your builders use, close enough to review architecture, catch a weak design, and be useful in an incident. Where you manage directly, you ship production work off the critical path. Where you manage through someone else, that person's growth is your work product.

You partner with Product Strategists who spend their time in front of members, coaches, and stakeholders, and who prototype to test ideas quickly. They own what gets built and why. You own whether it can be delivered, at what cost, and by when, and you are senior enough that your answer shapes the roadmap rather than just responding to it.

About you:

You have built AI products, not just used AI to build them. You have shipped agents to production and lived with how they behave at scale. You measure quality with evals: when you change a prompt or swap a model, you can prove whether it got better.

You are comfortable being accountable for what your squads ship. You still write code, and you want to. This role ships production work off the critical path, in the same codebase and the same agent workflows as your squads, so you feel the friction your people feel first-hand.

You have a point of view on where AI-assisted development helps and where it creates rework, and it comes from changing how a real team works, not from reading about it. You have done the engineering manager job well enough that you can teach it. Whether or not you have carried the title of manager-of-managers, you have grown someone into leading, and you know the difference between doing the work for them and raising their ceiling.

Your first team is your peer group, not your reports. When something is slowing down the engineering org and it is nobody's job, you have a track record of picking it up, getting the right people in the room, and finishing it.

What you'll be doing:

  • Own the member experience that runs around the clock. AI handles the moments between sessions: goal setting, food guidance, daily reflection. You own where it hands off to a human coach, and your squads own all of it from prototype to production.
  • Own delivery across your squads. Sprint shaping, prioritization, backlog grooming, and estimation. Make the calls, write them down, and be accountable for them. When two squads want the same thing at the same time, you are the one who decides.
  • Own cycle time. Yours to improve, not at the expense of quality, and yours to explain when it changes, including why one of your squads is slower than the other.
  • Stay technical. On squads you manage directly, you ship production work every sprint, off the critical path, in the same agent workflows your builders use. On squads that run through a manager, you stay close enough to review architecture, catch a weak design, and be useful in an incident. Either way, you can teach someone to navigate the system, not just navigate it yourself.
  • Partner with your Product Strategist. They own what the squad builds; you hold the line between their scope and yours so the squad never has two people answering the same question differently.
  • Grow a manager. If an EM reports to you, their growth is your work product. Their squad's health is the evidence.
  • Plan the team you need next year, not just this quarter. Headcount, skill mix, and the onboarding path that gets a new builder productive in an agent-heavy codebase in weeks rather than months.
  • Set the AI standard past your own boundary. Write down what good looks like, teach it, and measure whether it stuck. Other squads should be able to use what you built without you in the room.
  • Take on the problem that is nobody's. You will find things that slow down engineering broadly. Some of them you should pick up, organize, and close out with your peers.

What you need for this role:

  • 8+ years in software engineering, including 4+ years managing engineers directly.
  • Experience developing another leader: a manager who reported to you, or an engineer you grew into a tech lead or EM role with real accountability attached. Tell us where they are now.
  • A track record shipping mission-critical software to production, and living with it afterwards. We all make mistakes; what sets you apart is that you own yours and turn them into something better.
  • Experience owning prioritization and estimation for a team, including saying no, not now, and explaining why.
  • Experience giving direct developmental feedback, and at least one case where you managed someone through underperformance with real support attached.
  • Currently shipping, or recently shipping, production code in at least one layer of our stack (backend (Ruby, Python, ...), web frontends (React), iOS, or Android,) with enough range to follow the conversation in the others and review architecture decisions critically.
  • Comfort with an expert-generalist team model, where a backend-heavy builder ships in the mobile app and a mobile-heavy one ships in the backend. You understand how transformative this model is, and you should be able to name the risks and opportunities it brings.
  • Hands-on experience directing AI agents through real world production changes, and a considered view on where they help and where they produce work someone else has to redo.
  • Understanding of CI/CD, logging, monitoring, and telemetry, at the level where you can tell whether your squad's operational story checks out or falls short.
  • Excellent written communication. Much of this job is writing things down clearly once so they do not have to be argued four times.

Technologies we use:

Ruby on Rails, Python (Flask, FastAPI), React, native iOS (Swift, SwiftUI), native Android (Kotlin), PostgreSQL, GraphQL, AWS (RDS, SQS), Docker, Kubernetes, GitLab, Datadog, PagerDuty.
