Parachute Health is transforming post-acute care as the leading digital ordering platform for medical equipment and supplies. We connect major health systems, health plans, and suppliers to help patients get the life-saving products they need at home. Since launching, we've connected 300,000+ clinicians and 3,000+ supplier locations across all 50 states and helped 15M+ patients. What started as a DME ePrescribing tool has become the order management platform of choice for home medical equipment.

Join our team and make a difference in patient care.

About the Role

We are seeking a Principal Engineer to be the technical leader of one of our engineering divisions. You will own the architecture and technical direction across multiple teams working on core parts of the Parachute platform — the workflows that connect clinicians, health systems, health plans, and HME providers so patients get the equipment they need at home.

This is a hands-on, division-wide role. You will partner with engineering managers, Product, and Design to set direction across teams, make the hard technical calls, and stay close enough to the code to prove them out. As Parachute pivots from feature delivery toward foundational, AI-driven infrastructure, you will serve as a definitive technical leader, trusted to untangle ambiguous problems and deliver high-impact solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Division Architecture: Define the architectural standards and target state for your division. Make sure the systems your teams own evolve coherently instead of drifting apart at the seams.
  • Large-Scale Refactoring: Drive the refactoring needed to give teams clear domain ownership and independence inside a large shared codebase, sequenced so delivery keeps moving.
  • Decisive Technical Leadership: Take ambiguous, cross-team problems and turn them into a clear direction, a plan, and shipped software. Make the call, own it, and see it through.
  • Work in the Open: Lead technical decisions through Architecture Decision Documents and open discussion. Engage directly on others' proposals, state objections plainly and early, and model the transparency you expect from others.
  • AI-Native Engineering: Set the standard for how your teams build with AI — agentic coding, review and test acceleration, repo-native tooling and MCP servers. Raise the PR bar and show what great looks like.
  • Stay in the Code: Prototype quickly, write production code on the most critical paths, and review designs and PRs across teams. Favor pragmatic, incremental rollouts that reuse what exists over rewrites.
  • Technical Shaping and Economics: Lead technical discovery, feasibility, and sizing across your division's roadmaps. Weigh engineering investment against cost and business impact, and make the case for foundational work in business terms.
  • Quality and Reliability: Define testing strategy, observability practices, and on-call health so teams can ship fast without breaking critical healthcare workflows.
  • Raise the Bar: Grow Staff and Senior engineers into technical leaders. Shape hiring and leveling, including the architecture interview.

jobs.description:
CloudLinux is the maker of Imunify360 — a suite of security products protecting millions of websites across the web hosting industry — and of CloudLinux OS, the operating system behind a large share of the world's shared hosting. To learn more about our company and products, visit our websites: and . Alongside those established product lines we run a small innovation team whose job is to find and prove the next ones.

We are looking for a Product Owner to lead that team: a small, senior, fully remote squad of engineers that takes new product concepts from idea to a working MVP in customers' hands, then hands proven products to a product line and moves on to the next concept. You will be accountable for the pipeline of ideas, the speed and rigour with which they are tested, and the evidence behind every go / no-go recommendation.

This is a hands-on lead role, not pure people management: roughly 50% discovery and leadership (customer conversations, scoping, prioritisation, coaching, reporting to the CPO) and 50% building (prototypes, spikes, design and code review, demo stands). You will not be the team's only builder, but you must be able to build a credible prototype yourself and hold a technical opinion about every part of it.

You don't need to arrive as an expert in web hosting or security. If you have taken a product from nothing to its first paying customers before — as a founder, an early engineer, or the lead of an incubation team — and you get deep into unfamiliar technical territory fast, we will teach you the market.

What the team works on

The innovation team sits across CloudLinux and Imunify and owns the product concepts that do not yet have a home in an established product line. Ideas come from customer conversations, industry events, telemetry across more than 80,000 servers and the CPO’s strategy; the team’s job is to turn them into something a customer will pay for within a quarter, using AI coding agents throughout.

What you will own

Discovery and delivery

  • Run the pipeline of product concepts: capture, size and rank ideas with their assumptions written down, and keep the backlog of bets visible to the CPO and leadership.
  • Take each funded concept to a working MVP on a fixed timebox, typically one quarter, with a named customer or design partner testing it.
  • Define success criteria up front and report against them with real numbers rather than adjectives: usage, conversion, willingness to pay, support load.
  • Make the go / no-go call honestly: hand proven products to a product line with a written runbook and roadmap, and capture what was learned from concepts that did not prove out.
  • Report status and risk to the CPO weekly; every item carries an owner and a due date.

Prototyping and technical direction

  • Choose the fastest credible build for each concept — buy, borrow, open source or write — with the trade-offs made explicit.
  • Build prototypes and demo stands yourself where that is the quickest route to evidence; review designs and code on everything the team ships.
  • Keep MVPs production-worthy enough to run on real customer servers: packaging, safe rollout, rollback and observability from the first release.
  • Work with the architecture group and the product teams so a successful MVP can be adopted without a rewrite.

People

  • Lead a small distributed team: 1:1s, goal setting, performance reviews, and career development.
  • Hire: define the profile, run technical interviews, onboard, and mentor engineers.
  • Set the working agreements that make fast async work possible — written decisions, public-by-default communication, demos over status meetings.

AI-augmented engineering

We evaluate engineers partly on how effectively they work with coding agents, and in the innovation team this is the main lever on speed. As the lead you model and coach it: prompt specificity, review quality on agent-generated code, context provision, iteration and error recovery, and end-to-end task completion. Expect to use agents to build prototypes, generate test corpora and draft customer-facing material.

First 90 days

  • 30 days: Complete 1:1s with every team member and produce a written read on the team's strengths and gaps; review the concepts in flight and the evidence behind each; spend time with sales, support and at least three hosting customers.
  • 60 days: Own the concept pipeline and the weekly status; publish success criteria for every active concept; ship at least one prototype or demo yourself.
  • 90 days: Present a ranked portfolio of bets for the next two quarters agreed with the CPO, including one go / no-go recommendation backed by customer evidence and a staffing recommendation.

Requirements

Must-haves:

  • 5+ years as a software engineer, with 2+ years leading a small team (team lead, tech lead with people responsibility, founder or engineering manager) building new products in a product company or startup.
  • A track record of taking at least one product from concept to first paying customers, and of stopping one that did not work.
  • Strong Linux proficiency at a software engineer level; comfortable building and reviewing code in a modern language (Python, Go, TypeScript) and debugging live systems on the box.
  • Practical product discovery skills: customer interviews, assumption mapping, pricing experiments, and reading usage and conversion data yourself rather than via reports.
  • Experience mastering a complex technical domain quickly and making credible architectural decisions in it.
  • Demonstrated people leadership: 1:1s, performance conversations, hiring, and growing engineers.
  • Experience working in an agentic / AI-assisted development workflow.
  • Professional proficiency in English, written and spoken.
  • Availability to work EU hours.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience in the web hosting ecosystem: cPanel/WHM, Plesk, DirectAdmin, or running infrastructure for a hosting provider.
  • Background in security products — runtime protection, web application firewalls, malware detection, vulnerability management or patching.
  • Experience with freemium or product-led growth models and self-serve billing.
  • Familiarity with the Node.js or Python runtimes and their package ecosystems.
  • Comfortable presenting to customers and at industry events.

Benefits

What's in it for you?

  • A focus on professional development.
  • Interesting and challenging projects.
  • Fully remote work with flexible working hours, that allows you to schedule your day and work from any location worldwide.
  • Paid 24 days of vacation per year, 10 days of national holidays, and unlimited sick leaves.
  • Compensation for private medical insurance.
  • Co-working and gym/sports reimbursement.
  • Budget for education.
  • The opportunity to receive a reward for the most innovative idea that the company can patent.

About Patronus AI

Patronus AI is a frontier lab developing simulation research and infrastructure to accelerate progress toward human-aligned AGI. We are on a mission to simulate all of the world’s intelligence.

We are the team behind some of the earliest and most influential research in AI evaluation likeFinanceBench, Lynx,SimpleSafetyTests,CopyrightCatcher,Humanity’s Last Exam, and more. We are formerly AI researchers and engineers from companies like Meta AI, Amazon AGI, and Google. Our customers include foundation model labs and Fortune 500 enterprises like Adobe. We are backed by top-tier investors like Lightspeed Venture Partners, Notable Capital, Stanford University, Noam Brown, Gokul Rajaram, and more.

At a glance

  • Engagement: Independent contractor, fully remote. Live screen-share sessions with our researchers plus short asynchronous write-ups.
  • Pay: $150 per hour. The trial session is paid.
  • Commitment: About 10 hours per week, 1 to 3 months to start, with extension for strong performers.
  • Start: Rolling
  • Location: Remote, any country, with a few hours of overlap with US or EU working hours.

The role

You'll work live with our research team on coding scenarios in a sandboxed payments codebase: authorization, capture and refund flows, idempotency and retries, webhook handling, reconciliation and settlement, ledger entries, chargebacks and disputes, and 3DS/SCA. You implement or review the change the way you would at work, explain your reasoning as you go, tell us where the scenario doesn't match how money actually moves, and help define what correct looks like.

Each session starts from a scenario we provide. You work through it on a shared screen, land the change or the review, and then write a short note on how you approached it. Your work becomes evaluation and training data for frontier models.

You don't need an AI background. You do need to be the kind of engineer who thinks about the duplicate webhook before the happy path, and who knows which rounding rule the ledger expects.

Areas we're hiring for

Each area is defined by the part of the money-movement path you own, so you should fit exactly one. If you work across two, apply under the one where you spend most of your time.

  • Payment processing and gateway integration. Engineers who build the checkout and money-movement path: authorization, capture, refund and void flows against a processor or acquirer such as Stripe, Adyen or Braintree, idempotency keys, retries, webhooks and 3DS/SCA. Typical titles: Payments Engineer, Backend Engineer (Payments), Integration Engineer, Checkout Engineer.
  • Ledger, settlement and reconciliation. Engineers who own the books behind the payments: double-entry ledgers, settlement files, payout schedules, reconciliation against processor and bank reports, currency handling and rounding. Typical titles: Ledger Engineer, Fintech Backend Engineer, Treasury Systems Engineer, Reconciliation Engineer.
  • Disputes, risk and compliance engineering. Engineers who build chargeback and dispute workflows, fraud and risk rules, card-data handling under PCI DSS, and the audit trails behind them. Typical titles: Risk Engineer, Fraud Platform Engineer, Disputes Engineer, Payments Compliance Engineer.

What you'll do

  • Implement and review payment flows live with a researcher in a sandboxed codebase: authorization, capture and refund paths, idempotent retries, webhook handlers, ledger entries, reconciliation jobs and dispute handling.
  • Explain your reasoning as you work, including the edge cases you check first.
  • Review scenarios we have drafted for realism and difficulty, and flag the failure modes that bite real payments teams: double charges, partial captures, currency rounding, race conditions, and stale or replayed webhooks.
  • Help write the acceptance criteria for each scenario, including the tempting wrong moves.
  • Write short notes after each session on how you approached the problem and what you verified.
  • Work in reviewer feedback within agreed turnaround times, and flag guideline gaps or edge cases you run into.

Who we're looking for

Required

  • 3+ years writing production code for a payment processor, a processor integration, a card issuer or acquirer, a fintech ledger or a bank's payments platform, including work within the last two years. You wrote the code yourself; managing the team is not enough.
  • Working command of the money-movement lifecycle end to end: authorization, capture, settlement, reconciliation and disputes, and the compliance edges such as PCI DSS and SCA.
  • Comfortable in at least one of Python, Go, Java or TypeScript, and at reading unfamiliar codebases.
  • Able to explain your reasoning out loud while you work, in clear professional English.
  • Reliable availability for scheduled live sessions and the habit of showing the evidence behind every conclusion.

Nice to have

jobs.excerpt: Technical QA EngineerLocation: Remote (Pakistan)Job Type: Full-timeWork Schedule: 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time Base Salary: Competitive, based on experience Role OverviewWe're looking for a Technical QA Engineer to help ensure the quality, reliability, and security of our software products!
jobs.description:
Technical QA Engineer

Location: Remote (Pakistan)

Job Type: Full-time

Work Schedule: 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time

Base Salary: Competitive, based on experience

Role Overview

We're looking for a Technical QA Engineer to help ensure the quality, reliability, and security of our software products! As we increasingly use AI and development agents to build and improve software, we need someone who can independently validate what those systems produce — both from a user perspective and at a technical level.

In this role, you'll test applications, APIs, databases, integrations, and new features; review and understand code well enough to identify potential quality, logic, and security issues; build and maintain automated tests; and investigate technical problems using logs, debugging tools, and application data.

We're in need of someone who's technically strong to understand how a system works, challenge assumptions, investigate failures, and independently determine whether software is behaving correctly.

Key Responsibilities

  • Test new features, improvements, integrations, and bug fixes across our software products.
  • Perform functional, regression, integration, API, database, exploratory, and edge-case testing.
  • Review and understand application code well enough to design better tests, identify likely failure points, investigate issues more deeply, and validate software behavior independently.
  • Build, maintain, and improve automated tests for critical functionality and regression coverage.
  • Use AI coding agents and AI-assisted tools to help create tests, expand test coverage, investigate failures, analyze logs, and improve QA efficiency.
  • Critically validate AI-generated software and tests rather than assuming generated output is correct.
  • Test APIs directly, including requests, responses, authentication, error handling, data validation, and unexpected inputs.
  • Validate application data and database behavior using SQL or similar tools.
  • Test integrations between internal and external systems and identify failure scenarios.
  • Investigate issues using logs, stack traces, browser developer tools, API responses, database queries, and other debugging information.
  • Help identify the root cause of defects rather than only reporting visible symptoms.
  • Reproduce and isolate software issues and provide developers with clear technical findings.
  • Create detailed bug reports with reproduction steps, expected vs. actual behavior, environment details, and supporting evidence.
  • Verify fixes and perform regression testing before issues are closed or released.
  • Work closely with developers to improve testability, reliability, and overall product quality.
  • Continuously improve QA processes, test coverage, and automation.

Requirements

  • Atleast 2 years of experience as a Technical QA Engineer, QA Automation Engineer, Software Engineer, Software Developer, or another technical software testing role.
  • Programming or scripting experience with Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Go, or another relevant language.
  • Experience using logs, debugging tools, API responses, database queries, and other technical evidence to investigate failures.
  • Experience with automated testing tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, pytest, or similar.
  • Strong understanding of web applications, APIs, HTTP, authentication, and browser technologies.
  • Hands-on experience testing APIs using Postman, curl, or similar tools.
  • Experience working with SQL and relational or NoSQL databases.
  • Comfortable using Git / GitHub or similar version control systems.
  • Comfortable using browser developer tools, logs, stack traces, and other debugging information to investigate problems.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to investigate issues beyond their visible symptoms.
  • Strong understanding of testing methodologies, regression testing, edge cases, and failure scenarios.
  • Ability to write clear, actionable bug reports with relevant technical evidence.
  • Strong attention to detail, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Good written English communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of quality validation and test coverage for assigned projects or features.

Nice to Have

  • Experience testing AI-generated or agent-generated software.
  • Experience reviewing pull requests or performing basic code-level quality checks.
  • Familiarity with common web application security risks and security testing principles.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated test execution.
  • Experience with performance or load testing.
  • Familiarity with Linux and command-line tools.
  • Experience with Docker or containerized applications.
  • Experience with web scraping or browser automation.
  • Experience designing test strategies for complex systems and integrations.

What We Value

We're looking for someone who approaches QA as a technical investigation.

When something fails, we want you to be curious about why. You should be comfortable moving between the application, API, database, logs, automated tests, and code to understand what is happening and provide developers with useful technical findings.

As more software is produced with the help of AI and development agents, independent validation becomes increasingly important. You should be comfortable testing AI-generated work critically rather than assuming that working code is necessarily correct code.

We value someone who can ask:

  • Does this actually meet the requirements?
  • What happens with unexpected or invalid inputs?
  • Are there logic or data integrity issues?
  • Could this change break something elsewhere?
  • Are there obvious security or reliability concerns?
  • What isn't being tested?
  • How can we automate this so we don't have to test it manually every time?

Your role is to provide an independent, technically capable quality layer that helps us ship reliable software with confidence.

Benefits & Perks

  • Fully Remote Work – Work from anywhere with a reliable internet connection.
  • Healthcare Coverage – Health benefits to support you and your family's well-being.
  • Leave Days, Vacation Time & Paid Holidays – Take the time you need to recharge.
  • Equipment Funds – Support for setting up or upgrading your home office.
  • Profit Sharing – Monthly and annual bonuses tied to company performance.
  • Long-Term Employment – We value team members who want to learn, grow, and build with us.
  • Collaborative Team Culture – Work with a supportive and globally distributed team.

About Us

AutoScale Ventures is a technology-driven company with 50+ team members across the Philippines, Pakistan, India, the U.S., China, and Canada.

We operate a group of businesses spanning technology, data services, recruiting, and real estate, including:

  • VinAudit – Vehicle history and market data provider
  • Proxy Services – High-speed private proxy solutions
  • EliteWork – Remote workforce platform and SaaS productivity tool
  • Voliplex – Long-term U.S. real estate investment firm

We're committed to building scalable, data-driven products and empowering a globally distributed team to take ownership, solve meaningful problems, and continuously improve how we work.

Interested in Joining Us?

If you enjoy breaking things, understanding why they broke, building automated ways to prevent them from breaking again, and critically validating software before it reaches users, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
About Us

Trase is the operating system for high-stakes environments, providing end-to-end solutions for deploying, managing, and optimizing AI within industries where security, governance, and data sovereignty are non-negotiable.

Our HIPAA- and SOC 2-compliant platform bridges the “last mile” of AI adoption, empowering sectors like healthcare and national security to run trustworthy, predictable AI agents across any model or environment—whether in the cloud, on-prem, or at the edge—with unified policy enforcement, continuous monitoring, and fully immutable audit trails.

Trase’s suite of products includes Origin, its agentic operating system; Leagues, its marketplace for specialized, configurable, ready-to-deploy agents; and Arena, where developers build, evaluate, and package the agents that run on Origin. The company has repeatedly topped Hugging Face’s GAIA Leaderboard for Generalized AI Assistants, placing it firmly at the forefront of AI-agent innovation.

About the Role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Trase, you’ll build and deploy AI agents and applications that solve real customer problems using Trase OS. You’ll join Leagues, our industry verticals team, supporting customers in healthcare, state and local government and education (SLED), financial services, or retail. Your focus may be one or more of these verticals; experience in all four is not required.

This is a hands-on software engineering role with direct customer ownership. You’ll work with users to understand their workflows, turn unclear requirements into technical plans, and take solutions from prototype through production. You’ll partner closely with Product, ML, and the Origin and Arena engineering teams to build on Trase OS and feed customer needs back into the platform.

We are hiring at Mid, Senior and Staff levels. Level will reflect your demonstrated engineering depth, independence, and scope of ownership.

Why This Role is Needed

Customer value depends on how well AI works within existing systems, data, and day-to-day operations. Leagues connects Trase OS to those environments and turns platform capabilities into solutions customers can use and trust.

This role exists to:

  • Deliver working solutions that improve customer workflows and produce measurable outcomes.
  • Bridge customer needs and platform engineering, identifying gaps early and shaping practical solutions.
  • Turn successful deployments into reusable integrations and patterns that help future customers launch faster.

What makes this role challenging

  • Customer environments vary in data quality, integration options, security requirements, and operational readiness.
  • AI behavior must be evaluated against real workflows, including failure cases, escalation paths, and human review.
  • You must balance delivery speed with reliability and maintainability, while deciding what belongs in a customer solution versus the shared platform.

Responsibilities

  • Work directly with customers to map workflows, identify useful AI applications, and agree on scope, success measures, and acceptance criteria.
  • Build production-quality agents, applications, APIs, and integrations using Trase OS, including backend services and user interfaces as needed.
  • Integrate customer systems, data sources, and identity providers; work with infrastructure engineers to deploy in customer or Trase-managed environments.
  • Own delivery through testing, deployment, customer validation, and operational handoff. Surface dependencies, risks, and scope changes early.
  • Build evaluations, automated tests, observability, and human review or escalation into agent workflows; validate quality, latency, cost, and reliability.
  • Apply appropriate access controls, data-handling policies, and audit logging in partnership with Security and customer teams.
  • Debug production issues across application, data, integration, and infrastructure layers; document solutions and create practical runbooks.
  • Contribute reusable components and product feedback to Origin and Arena; collaborate on platform improvements rather than maintaining unnecessary custom implementations.

Requirements

  • Experience building and shipping production software, with strong coding, testing, debugging, and API design fundamentals.
  • Proficiency in a modern language such as Python, Java or TypeScript, and experience with databases, backend services, and external integrations.
  • Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure, containers, CI/CD, and monitoring; ability to troubleshoot deployed applications.
  • Ability to translate customer needs into implementable work and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Practical understanding of LLM applications or AI agents, including their limitations, evaluation, and safe interaction with customer data and systems.
  • Ownership of delivery and quality, curiosity about customer operations, and comfort working through incomplete requirements.

Nice to Have

  • Experience as a forward deployed, product, full stack, or solutions engineer with substantial production coding responsibility.
  • Domain experience in healthcare, SLED, financial services, or retail; familiarity with sensitive data and regulated customer environments.
  • Experience with agent orchestration, retrieval, LLM evaluations, enterprise identity, or complex enterprise integrations.

Expectations by level:

  • Engineer II (L4): Deliver scoped features and integrations with guidance; contribute to customer discovery, testing, and production troubleshooting.
  • Senior Engineer (L5): Independently lead a customer workstream from discovery to production, make design decisions, and mentor engineers.
  • Staff Engineer (L6): Lead complex deployments and architecture across teams, resolve broader technical risks, and establish reusable patterns across Leagues.

If you want to be on the cutting edge of technology, building AI solutions for the future, and are up for a challenge, let’s talk!

Salary Range: $150,000-240,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience, skills, and other factors.

Some travel to customers may be required.

Our Trase Benefits:

For full-time roles only

  • Career track opportunity with potential for rapid advancement with strong performance as the firm grows
  • 100% employer paid, comprehensive health care including medical, dental, and vision for you and your family.
  • Paid maternity and paternity for 14 weeks at employees' normal pay.
  • Unlimited PTO, with management approval.
  • Opportunities for professional development and continued learning.
  • Optional 401K, FSA, and equity incentives available.
  • Mental health benefits are available through Tara Mind.

We’re an Equal Opportunity Employer: You’ll receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.

jobs.description:
A significant share of the work in this role is matching the exact behavior of real, already-deployed legacy and Power Platform systems from their own source exports, not just building new features from a blank slate. This role therefore calls for both strong Power Platform delivery expertise and a reverse-engineering mindset.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build Dataverse schemas, Power Automate flows, security roles, and generative code pages for Power Platform modernization workstreams.
  • Decode and faithfully replicate the behavior of existing, already-deployed systems by reading their exported source directly, not just working from requirements documents.
  • Go beyond no-code and low-code tooling when needed by authoring raw Dataverse Web API and metadata calls, debugging flows through run history and API tooling, and diagnosing undocumented platform behavior through direct testing.
  • Own the technical integrity of cross-environment integrations, JIT identity provisioning, service-account patterns, and the security model, including roles and privilege scoping.
  • Identify and clearly document design divergences from source systems, distinguishing verified behavior, new functionality, accepted simplifications, and assumptions.
  • Mentor and direct supporting developers, review flow and schema designs for correctness and maintainability, and provide hands-on coding guidance.
  • Maintain a living requirements-traceability record mapping what is built against the authoritative requirement source.

Requirements

Required Skills and Experience

Screen for concrete, demonstrable experience in each area below. 5+ years of Power Platform experience alone is not a sufficient filter for this role.

  • 5+ years of hands-on Power Platform and Dataverse delivery experience, including at least one engagement involving custom Power Automate flows and Dataverse security configuration beyond default settings.
  • Experience as a hands-on technical lead who mentors developers, works alongside the team, and demonstrates implementation approaches in practice.
  • Direct experience with Dataverse Web API and metadata operations, including creating or modifying tables, columns, and relationships through Web API calls rather than only through the Maker UI.
  • Hands-on experience with Workflow Definition Language expressions, connection references, webhook trigger subscription registration, and debugging flows through run history and API tooling rather than only the visual designer.
  • Strong experience configuring Dataverse security architecture, including security roles, table-level privilege scoping, business units, teams, JIT user provisioning, and service-principal or dedicated service-account patterns.
  • Experience with cross-environment Dataverse integration using OAuth client credentials and secret management.
  • Experience building Power Apps code apps or generative pages with React, TypeScript, and component libraries, with an understanding of platform-specific data-binding conventions.
  • Experience with advanced PAC CLI operations beyond basic solution export and import, including metadata operations, environment variables, connection references, and solution component management.
  • Experience unpacking and reading exported Power Platform solution contents to determine how an existing system behaves in practice.
  • Experience troubleshooting platform behavior through deliberate live-environment testing when documentation alone is insufficient.
  • Availability during Hawaii Standard Time business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with public-sector or government modernization.
  • Experience designing audit- and compliance-grade data trails.
  • Familiarity with Dataverse auditing settings and edge cases.
  • PL-600 or PL-400 certification.

jobs.excerpt: Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people.
jobs.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

The Chat team, part of Elastic’s Agents and Context group, builds the conversational and agentic platform that lets customers chat with and operate on their own data in Elasticsearch. We own the conversation experience, the agent harness and tools, retrieval and citations, streaming, memory, and the evaluation layer that keeps answers grounded and reliable. Everything we ship is production software that other Elastic solutions build on.

As Senior Engineering Manager you will lead a distributed team of approximately 12 engineers building this platform. Every engineering team at Elastic is led by a trio of Product Manager, Technical Lead and Engineering Manager. You will directly manage the engineers on the team, act as its primary project manager, and work with the PM and Tech Lead to define and deliver the roadmap. This is a people and delivery leadership role in a fast-moving space: the right person is energized by shaping structure where there is little, and keeps a calm, direct style while priorities shift.

Our company is distributed by intention. We hire the best engineers we can find wherever they are, whoever they are. As a result, our team is diverse and distributed across continents. The ability to lead a distributed team is critical.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own delivery of the Chat roadmap: break it into milestones, see around corners on risk, and make sure the team ships predictably.
  • Run hiring end to end for the team: job descriptions, interview loops, sourcing with Recruiting, and onboarding.
  • Coach and develop engineers at every level, with regular 1:1s, clear expectations and honest feedback.
  • Run performance management with consistency: promotions, development plans, and managing underperformance through to resolution.
  • Partner with the Tech Lead and PM to shape roadmap and priorities, and with data science, UX, and the other Agents and Context teams on shared primitives and quality signals.
  • Build and improve team process (planning, async communication, release and on-call practice) through consensus and clear writing rather than top-down mandate.
  • Represent the team to leadership and stakeholders.

What You Bring

  • A proven track record as an established engineering manager of software engineering teams, including hiring, coaching, promotions and performance management.
  • A track record of delivering large, multi-team software initiatives in a distributed, async-first environment, including creating or improving team processes.
  • Previous hands-on software engineering experience as a senior contributor, with enough technical depth to understand a TypeScript/Node/React stack, an Elasticsearch-backed system, and how LLM-powered products are built and evaluated. You will not write production code, but you need to spot bottlenecks, risks and one-way-door decisions.
  • Familiarity with LLM applications, ideally including RAG, agents and tool use, evaluation, and prompt and context engineering.
  • Experience with Elasticsearch, Kibana, search and information retrieval, or open source communities is a plus.
  • Product acumen: comfortable with ambiguity, able to set and communicate priorities, and genuinely interested in what makes an agentic product good for users.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication. Clear, concise long-form writing is how this team works.
  • Direct, kind, calm and empathetic. You hold people accountable and navigate hard conversations without drama.

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

jobs.description:
Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

We're looking for an experienced full-stack Documentation Platform Engineer to evolve our documentation site into a platform that delivers an exceptional experience for Tailscale's prospective and current customers.

You'll build, maintain, evolve, and support the platform and tools that internal teams and external contributors use to showcase Tailscale's features and products. This includes the documentation platform itself, our content pipelines, API documentation, and search. You'll work on a highly-visible customer-facing documentation site and you'll influence how documentation gets created, published, and consumed.

Key Responsibilities

  • Continuously improve and evolve our documentation site to create a helpful, delightful, and educational experience that helps homelabbers, developers, and enterprises (and their agents) get the most of out of Tailscale's products and features.
  • Maintain and expand our docs-as-code tooling and content publishing pipelines, ensuring a smooth experience for both internal and external contributors to publish error-free content quickly.
  • Work cross-functionally with other engineering and product teams to integrate documentation with the Tailscale platform.
  • Partner with designers, user research, and growth teams to implement designs and features as they move from experimentation to production.
  • Help shape and tune a modern search and discovery infrastructure to help visitors, and agents, discover answers quickly.
  • Work with open source contributors through GitHub discussions, issues, and pull requests.
  • Monitor the platform's performance and maintain scalability for millions of visitors per month.
  • Stay ahead of documentation trends through research, experimentation, and measuring results.

What We Are Looking For

  • You have a proven track record of building, extending, maintaining, and deploying documentation sites using static site generators like Hugo or Docusaurus, or documentation platforms built on NextJS, Astro, or other similar tools.
  • You are familiar with a docs-as-code publication workflow, and you understand the impact that a good documentation experience has on user awareness, adoption, and growth.
  • You are fluent in TypeScript / JavaScript and React, and are comfortable with Python, command-line interfaces, shell scripting, and Git,
  • You are comfortable with modern HTML and CSS and can implement designs provided by others.
  • You have experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and automation for content or documentation workflows to reduce repetitive tasks and provide real-time feedback to authors.
  • You can explain the impact and implications of LLMs as both tools for application development, and as consumers of content that documentation sites publish.

Nice to Have

  • You have open source experience and are comfortable engaging with contributors on GitHub issues and pull requests.
  • You understand how LLMs consume and interact with documentation.
  • You understand multi-format content output (HTML, JSON, XML, raw Markdown, PDF, ePub

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

US Pay Range
$163,000—$204,000 USD

What We Offer

  • An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.
  • A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).
  • Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!
  • Remote first company—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.
  • Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.
  • Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.
  • Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities.
  • Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world!
  • A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own.

jobs.excerpt: Lateral stands for technology excellence.  We’re a profitable, award-winning design and technology company with over 20 years of experience launching bold ventures and transforming businesses.
jobs.description:
Lateral stands for technology excellence.

We’re a profitable, award-winning design and technology company with over 20 years of experience launching bold ventures and transforming businesses. A globally distributed team of 200+ experts united by a shared purpose: the continuous pursuit of quality.

Our clients come to us for results, quality and craft - and stay because we keep raising the bar.

We do things differently at Lateral

Our mission is simple: design and build great products.
What sets us apart isn’t just the talent of our team - it’s the way we work:

We Have A Bias For Action & Results.

We are doers - we spot the gaps, connect the dots, anticipate what’s around the corner and take action. We move fast, stay focused, and let the results - not the effort - speak for themselves.

We Work On Time, On Budget, On Quality

Discipline is our edge - a commitment we make to each other, to our clients, and to the standards we hold ourselves to

We Care Deeply.

We care about our work and about each other. Care Is A Competitive Advantage.

Every detail matters. Every design, every line of code, every decision. Thoughtful by default.

We Do Things Right - Because It’s the Right Thing to Do

Right over easy. Integrity isn’t up for negotiation. We hold the bar high even when no one’s watching. We take pride in doing great work the right way - not the easy way.

We Keep Improving

The best teams keep improving and we’re never done learning.

We iterate. We reflect on what’s working and what’s not. Feedback fuels us, we receive it openly, and adapt quickly. Progress over perfection.

We’re Obsessed With Agility, Not The Agile Manifesto

We don’t chase dogma or rituals - we chase momentum. We adapt processes to fit problems, not the other way around.

We Take Ownership
Everyone leads something here. You will have room to run with ideas, and the trust to execute. That trust is built on how you show up: thinking things through, sweating the details, and following through.

What You’ll Do

As a Frontend Engineer at Lateral, you will:

  • Craft delightful digital experiences: Design, implement, and maintain front-end features using React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript. You’ll create reusable UI components and craft polished, responsive interfaces with a focus on quality

  • Collaborate & communicate: Work closely with designers, back-end developers, and product managers in an asynchronous workflow. You’ll regularly communicate with clients to clarify requirements, demo features, and ensure we’re building the right thing.

  • Optimize, Iterate & improve: Involve yourself in brainstorming and technical discussions. Ensure our apps are fast, accessible, and reliable. You’ll profile and improve page load times, refine animations, and tackle browser-specific quirks so that every user gets a smooth experience. When issues arise, you’ll dive in to debug and fix them, striving for robust solutions that scale (and writing tests to prevent regressions

  • Learn: Stay curious and keep up with industry trends, frameworks, and standards. You’ll be encouraged to continuously learn and bring in knowledge, evaluating new technologies thoughtfully to see if they can enhance our product or developer experience (we love learning, but avoid “innovation for innovation’s sake”). In short, you’ll help shape a culture of excellence, ownership, and growth on the team.

Example Projects You May Join:

  • Large scale B2B2C Commerce Platform: Help build a responsive, mobile-first experience for an international e-commerce client. For example, you might lead a dynamic multi-faceted search or a smooth checkout flow

  • Develop from scratch an application: Collaborate with a senior backend engineer/architect to build a modern application. You’ll be involved in everything from crafting components to API definition.

  • Real-Time Medical Dashboard: Develop front-end features for a real-time analytics dashboard for a pet healthcare client. You might use libraries like AGCharts to visualize large data sets, implement live updates via websockets, and ensure the interface remains highly performant and user-friendly.

Whatever the challenge, you’ll be building software that changes lives and moves industries forward.

How we measure success in this role

In the first two weeks

  • You've set up your development environment and tools.

  • You’ve pushed your first meaningful contribution (bugfix, UI tweak, or minor feature).

  • You’re familiar with our async workflows and communication style.

  • You’ve participated in your first client sync and started understanding the project's context.

In the first 3 months:

  • You’ve authored or contributed to architectural decisions and design documents.

  • You’ve established trust with clients through clear communication and technical guidance.

  • You’ve improved performance, code structure, or tooling in meaningful ways.

After 3 months:

  • You’ve initiated a broader improvement across projects (e.g., shared component library, new testing standard).

  • You’re frequently unblocking teammates, elevating code quality, and proactively identifying risks.

  • You balance speed and quality, delivering with care and clarity.

We measure success through:

  • The impact and scope of your technical contributions.

  • Your ability to lead initiatives, mentor others, and improve team practices.

  • Code quality, performance, and maintainability.

  • Positive feedback from peers, clients, and design/engineering leadership.

  • Your growth mindset, communication skills, and influence on team culture.

What We’re Looking For

We are seeking for team members who are both highly technical and deeply care about their craft and how the work gets done. You must bring:

  • 5+ years of professional front-end development experience building digital applications. Experience with modern Javascript libraries and tooling (e.g. React, npm, webpack...), fluency in CSS

  • Proven ability tocraft, polish, delight, sweat the details. You have an eye for design and UX. Pixel-perfect isn’t just a phrase to you – you care about creating beautiful, intuitive interfaces that make users happy. An understanding of design principles and attention to details like accessibility and responsive layout is important.

  • Quality and reliability
    You take pride in building high-quality software. You’re diligent about testing and documentation, and you proactively debug issues before they become problems. ￼ Performance and browser compatibility matter to you – you know how to make a web app fast and handle the quirks of different environments ￼. Ultimately, you balance speed of delivery with maintainability, ensuring the code you ship today won’t be tech debt tomorrow.

  • Self-driven and accountable: You’re comfortable managing your own projects and time without heavy oversight. When you take on a task, we can count on you to see it through with a sense of ownership. You’re a proactive problem solver who can break down complex problems, propose solutions, and drive them to completion. We trust our team members to be “managers of one” who take initiative and deliver results

  • Great communication and empathy are a must. You enjoy working closely with others, be it in pair programming, brainstorming with designers, or reviewing a teammate’s code. You can explain technical concepts clearly, listen to alternate viewpoints, and work together to find the best solutions. Our culture is about being kind, open, and constructive, so we’re looking for someone who lifts others up and thrives in a friendly, collaborative environment.

  • Remote work skills: Self-motivated and disciplined in a remote environment. You can manage your time, collaborate asynchronously, and aren’t afraid to ask questions or offer help across time zones.

Bonus points for:

  • Demonstrating craft

  • Design /delight sensibility

  • AI & Gen AI experience/tooling

  • Understanding Backend concepts

  • CSR/SSR

  • DevOps experience (continuous integration, hosting, etc.)

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Real Impact: You’ll work on meaningful products that make a measurable difference - from healthcare and commerce to sustainability and next-gen tech.

  • Remote-First, Office Friendly: Work from wherever you’re most productive - whether that’s your home, a co-working space, or one of our offices. We’re a remote-first company, but if you’re near an office, you’re welcome to drop in, collaborate in person, or work onsite regularly.

    We prioritize async collaboration, respect your time zone, and focus on outcomes over hours.

  • An Outstanding Team: Talented, kind, and hard-working people who care deeply about their craft - and about each other. No egos. No politics. Just professionals doing their best work.

  • Growth: You’ll be supported in growing your craft, exploring new paths, and stepping into greater responsibility - at your own pace.

  • A Culture of Excellence: We care deeply about doing the right thing - for our clients, our team, and ourselves. No burnout. No crunch. Just high-quality work, delivered sustainably.

  • Variety & Stability: We’re profitable, independent, and over a decade strong. Yet every project brings a fresh challenge. You’ll never be bored here.

This Role Might Not Be for You

We want to respect your time by being clear about what this role isn’t. You should skip this opportunity if:

  • You prefer well defined structure. If you gravitate towards a clear hierarchy, well defined roles and swim lanes, you may find our self-managed style challenging.

  • Distributed work isn’t your thing. If you find async communication, design documentation and being proactive without a manager nearby difficult, our setup won’t suit you.

  • Feedback doesn't excite you. We’re obsessed with quality and believe in continuous improvement. That means we give feedback that’s sometimes nitpicky. If refining the work until it’s excellent feels over the top, you are likely going to find working here frustrating.

  • Change makes you uncomfortable. We’re scaling and maturing. That means not everything is perfect yet. Priorities shift. Processes evolve. If ambiguity is uncomfortable, this may feel bumpy.

However, If this sounds like fuel, we’d love to talk!

01. Your work
Show us the work that reflects you at your best. We’ll look at depth, design thinking, and the logic behind your choices.

02. Lateral team fit
You’ll speak with our Talent team about your career direction, your motivators, and our plans ahead.

03. Work trial

You’ll tackle a take-home challenge that mirrors what we actually do.

04.Engineering deep dive
A collaborative session with our engineers.

05. Project fit
An interview focussed on prioritization, collaboration across disciplines, and how you handle the "messy middle".

jobs.excerpt: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a full-time remote opportunity. We are considering candidates based in the US and Canada only, within the Eastern or Central time zones.

The Opportunity:

As a Senior Full-Stack Engineer on the Grafana Catalog team, you will help grow the Grafana plugin ecosystem. Plugins are how Grafana connects to almost any data source, panel type or app, and the catalog has more than 300 of them from Grafana Labs, commercial partners and the open source community.

We own the full plugin lifecycle. Developers build plugins with our tooling, publish them to the catalog, and users discover, install and update them in Grafana and Grafana Cloud. We are also building the Grafana Marketplace, which lets partners and independent developers sell their plugins to Grafana users. It is in pilot today and you will help us take it from there.

What You’ll Be Doing:

Some of the things we own:

  • The Grafana Marketplace: paid plugins, publisher onboarding, and how customers buy and get access to them
  • The plugin catalog in grafana.com and inside Grafana, where users search, compare and discover plugins
  • Plugin installation and management in Grafana and Grafana Cloud
  • Plugin delivery: publishing, signing, validation and the CDN that serves plugins to every Grafana Cloud instance
  • Plugin review: every plugin published to the catalog goes through our review process before it reaches users
  • Developer tooling and developer portal that helps develop the plugins

A typical “day in the life” could include:

  • Building new Marketplace features across the Grafana frontend, our Go services and grafana.com
  • Improving how users find and install plugins, for both humans and agents like Grafana Assistant
  • Making it easier and faster for developers to build, test and publish plugins
  • Automating and improving the review process that every published plugin goes through
  • Supporting the operations and reliability of plugin installs and delivery in Grafana Cloud
  • Talking to plugin developers and partners and turning their feedback into roadmap items
  • Coming up with suggestions for process improvements
  • Working closely with the rest of the Grafana Division

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • You know how to transform ideas into working code, you are able to design a solution, get feedback and deliver large projects.
  • You are a self-driven individual who understands the power of feedback loops in making roadmap decisions and driving our product forward.
  • You are a motivated self starter with a bias towards action, and willing to take on any challenge
  • You are customer focused. We build everything with our users in mind. You have a passion for creating intuitive products that fit customers’ needs.
  • You are an excellent communicator and you enjoy collaboration
  • You are comfortable working in a remote-first company

Requirements:

  • Solid experience with Golang & Typescript
  • Experience with React and building user-facing web applications
  • Experience with Kubernetes & microservices
  • Experience writing clean, robust, and performant software that is easily maintained by others
  • Experience participating in an on-call rotation and performing operations/SRE tasks

Bonus Points For:

  • You have built or published a Grafana plugin
  • You have worked on a marketplace, app store or package registry, or on billing and licensing
  • You have built developer tooling such as CLIs, SDKs or CI pipelines used by other engineers
  • You have strong experience working with a Product Manager or external stakeholders

In US, the OTE (On-Target Earnings)/Base compensation range for this role is USD $167,143 - $200,572. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

About the role

Location: Remote – Latin America only. We are only considering candidates who currently live in a Latin American country. Applications from outside the region will not be reviewed.

We are seeking a proactive, technically strong Backend NestJs Developer to keep a live, business-critical microservices platform healthy while delivering meaningful improvements on top of it.

This is a hands-on role with a high degree of autonomy: you’ll take a bug report or change request, investigate it across the codebase, and see it through to production. You’ll balance production support with feature engineering, backed by a supportive team, and we’re embracing agentic development with AI coding agents to ship efficiently without compromising quality.

Key responsibilities

  • Resolve production issues: Triage, diagnose, and resolve issues across distributed microservices, tracing a request from the user-facing API down to the services that talk to external systems.
  • Support incident response: Investigate root causes, apply fixes, add regression tests, and document findings so issues don’t recur
  • Deliver enhancements: Build improvements to existing services, including new versions of certification programs, scorecard and scoring changes, payment adjustments, and integration updates
  • Work within the architecture: Follow established patterns and shared internal libraries in a layered service architecture, from the API gateway through the business logic services down to the adapters that integrate with external systems
  • Maintain integrations: Maintain and extend integrations with external platforms for performance data, CRM, enterprise resource planning (ERP), payment processing, email, and cloud file storage
  • Manage data changes: Write and update database migration scripts and investigate data-related production issues carefully against live data
  • Partner with QA and product: Answer testers’ questions, clarify expected behavior, help reproduce issues, and support verification so fixes and features can be signed off smoothly. Ask product clarifying questions early and confirm intent and edge cases
  • Improve observability and documentation: Contribute structured logging, masking of sensitive data, and clearer production visibility, and take part in code review while keeping documentation current as the platform grows

Required qualifications

  • Proven ability to take ownership of a problem from start to finish, from initial bug report or change request through to a tested, deployed solution
  • Production experience building and maintaining backend services with Node.js and TypeScript
  • Strong experience with NestJS (or a comparable structured backend framework), including modules, controllers, services, dependency injection, and middleware
  • Solid REST/HTTP fundamentals, including service-to-service communication, API contracts, versioning, and error handling
  • Comfortable with relational databases, writing and reviewing PostgreSQL queries, and safe migration practices
  • Experience debugging distributed systems where a single feature spans several services, reading logs and metrics to find root causes rather than symptoms
  • Sound judgment about risk, including the difference between a safe local fix and a change that calls for a rollout plan, particularly for payments, authentication, and live data
  • Experience integrating third-party systems (payment providers, CRMs, ERPs, identity providers) behind a clean internal interface
  • Understanding of authentication patterns: OAuth 2.0, JWT verification, single sign-on (SSO), and service-to-service (machine-to-machine) authentication
  • Comfortable with agentic development, using AI coding agents and tooling to investigate, build, and ship work efficiently while keeping a careful eye on quality
  • Ability to write tests that confirm fixes and prevent regressions
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including clear status updates, incident notes, pull request descriptions, and documentation others can act on

Nice to have

  • Experience supporting a platform through the transition from active build to maintenance-and-enhancement mode
  • Familiarity with adapter patterns that isolate external systems from core business logic
  • Experience with webhook-driven integrations, including verifying signatures, scoped service-to-service authorization, and safely handling repeated inbound events
  • Familiarity with containers and orchestration (Docker and Kubernetes) and services deployed on a major cloud provider such as AWS
  • Experience with observability practices such as structured logging and masking of sensitive data

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.excerpt: We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production.
jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!
